text: ILOILO CITY- Siling nila ang pagpanigarilyo, nagapaitom sang lips.
english: ILOILO CITY- They say smoking blackens the lips.

text: Pero may iban nga wala man  nagapanigarilyo apang  ngaa itom gihapon ang lips?
english: But there are others who don't smoke but why are the lips still black?

text: Yari ang sabat sang eksperto.
english: Here’s the expert’s answer.

text: Suno kay Dr. Jean Marquez, isa ka Dermatologist, ang dark lips mahimo nga tuga sang maisog nga habon nga ginagamit sa guya.
english: According to Dr. Jean Marquez, a Dermatologist, dark lips can be caused by harsh soap used on the face.

text: Bangud manipis ang panit sa lip area, kun ma-expose sa adlaw, nagaitom ini.
english: Because the skin in the lip area is thin, when exposed to the sun, it turns black.

text: Nagpanugyan ang doktor nga maggamit sang mild soap kag lip balm nga may moisturizer kag sun screen agud protektahan ang bibig kag malikawan ang discoloration..
english: Doctor advised to use mild soap and lip balm with moisturizer and sun screen to protect lips and prevent discoloration..

text: Nakagwa na sa prisohan si Former Calinog Mayor Salvador “Badong” Divinagracia nga naka-hit and run-patay sa 19-anyos nga lalaki sa banwa sang New Lucena sang gab-i sang Marso 15.
english: Former Calinog Mayor Salvador “Badong” Divinagracia who hit and run-dead a 19-year-old man in New Lucena town on the night of March 15 has been released from jail.

text: Ini matapos nga nagdesisyon ang pamilya nga indi na magpasaka sang kaso batuk sa anay nga alkalde.
english: This was after the family decided not to file a case against the former mayor.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay PLt.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, PLt.

text: John Rey Laru-an, hepe sang New Lucena Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga nagpirma kahapon sang hapon sang Affidavit of Desistance ang pamilya sang biktima rason nga nakagwa sa prisohan si Former Mayor Divinagracia.
english: John Rey Laru-an, chief of the New Lucena Municipal Police Station, said the victim's family signed an Affidavit of Desistance yesterday afternoon.

text: Suno kay PLt.
english: According to PLt.

text: Laru-an, ginpahayag sang pamilya nga bisan masakit sa ila ang natabo sa ila himata, indi na mabalik sini ang iya kabuhi bisan pa nga magpasaka sila sang kaso rason nga nagpirma na lang ang mga ini sang Affidavit of Desistance.
english: Laru-an, the family said that although they are hurt by what happened to their relative, they cannot bring back his life even if they file a case so they signed an Affidavit of Desistance.

text: Pahayag pa ni PLt.
english: According to PLt.

text: Laru-an, may yara naman sang agreement kag settlement sa tunga sang pamilya sang biktima kag sang anay alkalde kun sa diin nabatun na sang pamilya ang financial assistance halin sa anay alkalde.
english: Laru-an, there is an agreement and settlement between the victim's family and the former mayor where the family has received financial assistance from the former mayor.

text: Dugang pa sini, sa karon ginakabig na nga ‘cased close’ ang kaso bangud sa rason nga indi na magpasaka sang kaso ang pamilya sang biktima.
english: He added that the case is now considered 'cased close' due to the reason that the victim's family will not file a case.

text: GINA-dumdum sang mga Katoliko, nga gina-updan man sang iban nga denominasyon Kristiyano, ang nagtaliwan nila nga mga Pinalangga kag mga Himata sa tion sang Pyesta Minatay.
english: CATHOLICS, along with other Christian denominations, remember their dead loved ones and relatives during the Feast of the Dead.

text: Gina-selebrar ini nga okasyon sa duha ka adlaw – sa All Saints’ Day, ukon Adlaw sang mga Balaan (saints),  sa Nobyembre 1, kag sa All Souls’s Day sa Nobyembre 2  para sa tanan nga mga Kalag (souls).
english: This occasion is celebrated on two days – on All Saints’ Day, or Saints’ Day, on November 1, and on All Souls’ Day on November 2 for all souls.

text: Sa pagdumdum sa mga nagtaliwan, masami may ginahalad sa mga lulubngan sing mga bulak kag pagsindi sing kandila.
english: In memory of the dead, there is often an offering of flowers and the lighting of candles at the graves.

text: Partikular sa bahin sang mga Katoliko, ginaupdan man ini sang pagpangamuyo sa atubangan sang mga lulubngan samtang ginasindihan ang mga kandila.
english: Particularly on the part of Catholics, it is also accompanied by praying in front of graves while lighting candles.

text: Pagpabatyag ini sang ila paglaum agud mabuligan sa pagsaka sa Langit ang ila mga nagtaliwan nga wala pa lubos mapatawad sang Diyos ang ila mga kasal-anan.
english: It is an expression of their hope to help their dead whose sins have not been fully forgiven by God to ascend to Heaven.

text:
***

Indi katingalahan nga ang kadam-an naga-selebrar sang Pyesta sang Minatay sa All Saints’ Day sa Nobyembre 1.
english:
***

It’s no surprise that most celebrate the Feast of the Dead on All Saints’ Day on November 1st.

text: Una, tungod sugod ini nga adlaw sang Pyesta Minatay.
english: First, because it was the beginning of the Feast of the Dead.

text: Ikaduha, agud seguro ipangamuyo sa Diyos, sa bulig sang mga santos, ang lubos na nga kaluasan sang ila mga nagtaliwan.
english: Second, to pray to God, with the help of the saints, for the complete salvation of their departed.

text: Ang kaluasan sang kalag indi lang naton maangkon sa sinsero nga paghinulsol sa mga kasal-anan, kundi sa pagka-inosente man sang mga kabataan.
english: The salvation of the soul is not only achieved through sincere repentance of sins, but also through the innocence of children.

text: Bilang padya man sa mga may espesyal nga misyon sa Diyos katulad sang mga propeta kag matutum nga suluguon sang Diyos sa Bibliya.
english: Also as a reward for those who have a special mission to God such as the prophets and faithful servants of God in the Bible.

text: May espesyal man nga balatyagon ang Diyos sa mga gina-abusohan ang pagkatawo nga nagatampalas na sa Ispiritu Santo.
english: God also has a special feeling for those who are abused by the Holy Spirit.

text: Katulad sang natabo kay Jovelyn nga ginlugos kag ginpatay sang iya mismo pakaisa kag isa pa ka himata kag ginpabayaan lang udakan sang mga dalok sa unod nga mga kasapatan nga indi na matagaan sing respeto ang iya pagkatawo nga gintuga sang Diyos sa iya mismo  imahen.
english: Like what happened to Jovelyn who was raped and killed by her own cousin and another relative and left to be eaten by wild animals that could no longer respect her humanity created by God in her own image.

text: Tungod sa makahalanusbo niya nga nadangtan, gapati kita nga ginbaton dayon sang Diyos sa Langit si Jovelyn.
english: Because of her tragic experience, we believe that God immediately accepted Jovelyn into Heaven.

text: God bless you, Jovelyn!
english: God bless you, Jovelyn!

text:
***

Dapat indi man ibalewala ang All Souls’ Day sa Nobyembre 2.
english:
***

All Souls’ Day on November 2 should also not be ignored.

text: In fact, mas importante ini kay gapadumdum ini sa kapalaran sang katauhan sa pagbalik ni Hesukristo bilang Hari sang tanan nga katauhan, kon san-o husgaran Niya sa ulihi nga tion (Last Judgment, ukon Judgment of the Nations) ang tanan nga katauhan.
english: In fact, it is more important because it reminds us of the destiny of mankind at the return of Jesus Christ as King of all mankind, when He will judge at the last time (Last Judgment, or Judgment of the Nations) all mankind.

text: Sa ina nga tion, ibulag niya ang mga matarong nga makadto sa “eternal life” kag ang indi-matarong nga mahulog sa “eternal piunishment”.
english: At that time, he will separate the righteous who will go to “eternal life” and the unrighteous who will fall into “eternal punishment”.

text: Wala sing bisan sin-o sa aton ang makapat-ud sang pagbalik ni Kristo.
english: None of us can determine the return of Christ.

text: Gani, importante gid nga indi kita malipat sa ina nga hitabo, nga pwede malakip na naton sa aton pagpangamuyo sa Nobyembre 1.
english: Therefore, it is very important that we do not forget that event, which we can include in our prayers on November 1st.

text: Sa gospel angot sa Last Judgment, ginapanugyan diri ni Kristo ang kaayuhan nga dapat himuon naton agud mapasakop sa Iya kaharian sa duta.
english: In the gospel of the Last Judgment, Christ here suggests the good we must do to be subject to His kingdom on earth.

text: Panugyan Niya ang pag-ulikid sa kinahanglanon sang mga labing kubos.
english: He encouraged concern for the needs of the least.

text: Ginapanugyan Niya (Matthew 25:31-46 halin sa New American Bible) ang paghatag sing pagtamod sa mga bululigan kag ang mga talabangan, ang nagaantos sa bilangguan, kag ang nagakinahanglan sing paglaum sa pagpalangga sang Diyos.
english: He recommends (Matthew 25:31-46 from the New American Bible) to give attention to the needy and the helpless, those who suffer in prison, and those who need hope in God's love.

text:
***

Angot sa pagdumdum sang Last Judgment sa Nobyembre 2, ang aton abyan nga si Pedro gapati nga malapit na lang matabo ini, bisan pa siya man indi makapat-ud kon san-o gid ini matabo.
english:
***

Regarding the commemoration of the Last Judgment on November 2, our friend Pedro believes that it will soon happen, although he himself is not sure when it will happen.

text: Nagapati gani si Pedro nga basi mauna na sa sa pagkari si Kristo bag-o pa ang Last Judgment agud makabulig sa pagluas sang madamo pa nga nagtalang sa tadlong nga dalanon.
english: Peter even believes that Christ may come before the Last Judgment to help save many more who have strayed from the right path.

text: Basi kuno gani maga-disguise si Kristo.
english: Maybe Christ will be in disguise.

text:
Bilang isa ka pari sa pagpahanumdum sa mga salawayon sang batasan nga mga pari agud magbag-o.

Ukon bilang isa ka evangelist, nga pwede dira ang isa ka journalist, nga katulad ni San Juan wala mahadlok magbuyagyag sang kalainan kag kagarukan sa gobyerno.
english:
As a priest to remind the culprits of the priests' habits to change.

Or as an evangelist, which can be a journalist, who like St. John is not afraid to expose evil and corruption in government.

text: Ginbayaran gid gani niya ini sang iya ulo nga ginhalad sa bandehado sa atubangan sang demonyo nga hari.
english: He even paid for it with his head sacrificed on a platter in front of the demon king.

text: Katulad man ayhan ni journalist Percy Lapid nga ginpapatay gid?
english: Is it like journalist Percy Lapid who was killed?

text: Wala masiling si Pedro kundi maglungo-lungo lang sang iya ulo.
english: Peter couldn't say anything but shook his head.

text: Ukon ano pa nga personalidad kon diin makabulig Siya sa pagpahanumdum sa mga labing makasasala agud magliso na sang ila balatyagon pabor sa Diyos.
english: Or any other personality where He can help remind the most sinful to turn their feelings in favor of God.

text:
***

By the way, sin-o gid ayhan ang mga mastermind sang pagpapatay kay Percy?
english:
***

By the way, who exactly were the masterminds behind Percy's murder?

text: Laban-laban ang may daku gid nga motibo, may ikasarang nga magpapatay, kag nagapati nga kaya nila mahinago ang ila krimen tungod sang ila kwarta kag poder.
english: Most are highly motivated, have the ability to kill, and believe that they can hide their crimes because of their money and power.

text: Madamo gani ang nagapati nga indi na madakpan pa kon sin-o man ang mga mastermind sa pagpatay kay Percy tungod todo poderoso ini sila.
english: Many even believe that the masterminds of Percy's murder will never be caught because they are so powerful.

text: Ano abe sa imo?/PN
english: What do you think?/PN

text: Mangin kabahin ang Pinay actress nga si Dolly de Leon sa bag-o nga Hollywood series.
english: Filipino actress Dolly de Leon will be part of the new Hollywood series.

text:
Sandig sa report sang Deadline, mangin kabahin ang Golden Globe-nominated actress sang upcoming dark comedy thriller show nga gintig-uluhan nga “Maximum Pleasure Guaranteed.”

Ang role ni Dolly amo ang character ni Detective Sofia Gonzalez sa nasambit nga series.
english:
According to a report by Deadline, the Golden Globe-nominated actress will be part of the upcoming dark comedy thriller show titled “Maximum Pleasure Guaranteed.”

The role of Dolly is the character of Detective Sofia Gonzalez in the said series.

text: Una na nga nangin parte ang Pinay actress sang iya una nga Hollywood series nga Nine Perfect Strangers kaupod si Nicole Kidman.
english: The Pinay actress was previously part of her first Hollywood series Nine Perfect Strangers with Nicole Kidman.

text: Nangin nominado si Dolly para sa Best Actress in a Supporting Role sa British Academy Film Awards sang 2022 kag Best Supporting Actress in a Motion Picture sa Golden Globe Awards sang 2023 para sa iya performance sa Triangle of Sadness.
english: Dolly was nominated for Best Actress in a Supporting Role at the British Academy Film Awards in 2022 and Best Supporting Actress in a Motion Picture at the Golden Globe Awards in 2023 for her performance in Triangle of Sadness.

text: Ginbakal sang Filipino billionaire kag tycoon nga si Enrique K. Razon Jr.
english: Filipino billionaire and tycoon Enrique K. Razon Jr. bought it.

text: ang pinakadako nga independent oil producer sa Colombia.
english: the largest independent oil producer in Colombia.

text: Ini ang una nga major overseas energy deal ni Razon.
english: This is Razon’s first major overseas energy deal.

text: Ang transaksyon ang natigayon sa tunga sang Prime Infrastructure Capital, ang infrastructure unit ni Razon, kag ang SierraCol Energy Limited sang The Carlyle Group.
english: The transaction was struck between Prime Infrastructure Capital, Razon’s infrastructure unit, and SierraCol Energy Limited of The Carlyle Group.

text: Ini nga deal ang nagahatag sa Prime Infra sang control sa kompaniya nga responsable sa ginabanta 10 percent sang oil production sang Colombia.
english: This deal gives Prime Infra control of the company responsible for approximately 10 percent of Colombia’s oil production.

text: Ang transaction ang iga-subject sa regulatory approvals kag ginalauman nga ma-close ini subong nga first quarter sang 2026.
english: The transaction will be subject to regulatory approvals and is expected to close in the first quarter of 2026.

text: Nadakpan sang kapulisan ang ginakabig most wanted person nga 28 na ka tuig nga nagapanago sa kaso nga murder sa Brgy.
english: Police arrested the most wanted person who has been hiding for 28 years in a murder case in Brgy.

text: Manaulan, Lambunao, Iloilo.
english: Manaulan, Lambunao, Iloilo.

text: Ang naaresto amo si Alyas Gerry, 59-anyos, kag isa ka mangunguma.
english: The arrested was identified as Gerry, 59, a farmer.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Winston Biadog, officer-in-charge sang Lambunao Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga nagapanago ang lalaki sa Mindanao kag sang sini lang, nakabaton sang impormasyon sa pamilya sang biktima nga nakita ini sa nasambitan nga barangay.
english: Police Captain Winston Biadog, officer-in-charge of the Lambunao Municipal Police Station, said the man was hiding in Mindanao and recently received information from the victim's family that he was found in the said barangay.

text: Ginpahayag sang natungdan nga sa Brgy.
english: He said that in Brgy.

text: Paho, Lambunao ginkomiter sang suspek ang krimen sang tuig 1997 kun sa diin natiruhan sini ang biktima.
english: Paho, Lambunao, the suspect committed the crime in 1997 where he stabbed the victim.

text: Ginpanginwala naman sang suspek ang krimen nga ginpahayag nga atubangon nalang sa korte ang kaso.
english: The suspect denied the crime and said he will face the case in court.

text: Yara subong sa kustodiya sang Lambunao Municipal Police Station ang suspek para sa nagakaigo nga disposisyon.
english: The suspect is now in the custody of the Lambunao Municipal Police Station for proper disposition.

text: (Article: Bombo Phauline Pillora)
english: (Article: Bombo Phauline Pillora)

text: ILOILO CITY–Patay ang multi-awarded choreographer nga si Mr. Edwin Duero.
english: ILOILO CITY–Multi-awarded choreographer Mr. Edwin Duero.

text: Naka-secure na sang bronze medal sa Tokyo 2020 Olympics ang Pinoy Boxer nga si Eumir Marcial.
english: Pinoy boxer Eumir Marcial has secured a bronze medal at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics.

text: Ginlutos ni Marcial sa Quarterfinal 2 sang Men’s Flyweight (48-52 kilograms) si Arman Darchinyan sang Armenia.
english: Marcial defeated Arman Darchinyan of Armenia in Quarterfinal 2 of the Men’s Flyweight (48-52 kilograms).

text: Nahibaluan nga sa round 1 pa lang, ginpatumba na ni Marcial si Darchinyan.
english: It was known that in round 1, Marcial knocked out Darchinyan.

text: Sa Huwebes, Agosto 5 maga-abante na sa semi-finals sa men’s middleweight category si Marcial sa diin makasambuwa niya ang Ukrainian world champion nga si Oleksandr Khyzhniak.
english: On Thursday, August 5, Marcial will advance to the semi-finals in the men’s middleweight category where he will face Ukrainian world champion Oleksandr Khyzhniak.

text: Samtang, proud kag malipayon ang iloy sang Pinoy Boxer nga si Eumir Marcial matapos naka-secure ang iya anak sang bronze medal para sa pungsod Pilipinas sa Tokyo Olympics.
english: Meanwhile, the mother of Pinoy boxer Eumir Marcial is proud and happy after her son secured a bronze medal for the Philippines in the Tokyo Olympics.

text: Sa exclusive interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Carmelita Marcial, Iloy sang Pinoy Boxer, iya ginpahayag nga bag-o ang sambuwa sang iya anak, nakatawag pa ini sa ila.
english: In an exclusive interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Carmelita Marcial, mother of the Filipino boxer, said that before her son's fight, she called them.

text: Ginpat-od sang boxer sa iya pamilya ang nga dako ang iya kumpyansa nga makuha ang kadalag-an.
english: The boxer assured his family that he is confident of winning.

text: Wala man nagakadulaan sang paglaom ang iloy nga mabulsa pauli sang iya anak ang gold medal sa Tokyo 2020 Olympics.
english: The mother also does not lose hope that her son will pocket home the gold medal in the Tokyo 2020 Olympics.

text: JAPAN – Ginkansela ni Japanese Prime Minister Fumio Kishida ang iya byahe sa Central Asia kasunod sang paandam sang mgascientists nga preparahan ang possible matabo nga “megaquake” sa ila pungsod.
english: JAPAN – Japanese Prime Minister Fumio Kishida has canceled his trip to Central Asia following warnings from scientists to prepare for a possible megaquake in their country.

text: Suno kay Bombo Josel Palma, international correspondent sa Japan, una na nga nagpagwa ang Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA) sang advisory matapos ang natabo nga magnitude 7.1 ga linog sa nabagatnan sang Japan nga ginkapilas sang walo ka mga indibidwal.
english: According to Bombo Josel Palma, international correspondent in Japan, the Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA) earlier issued an advisory after a magnitude 7.1 earthquake struck southern Japan that injured eight individuals.

text: Si Kishida ang mapadulong kuntani sa Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan kag Mongolia kag nagaplano nga magtambong sa regional summit.
english: Kishida was supposed to travel to Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan and Mongolia and plans to attend the regional summit.

text: Nagakadapat man suno sa natungdan nga mangin mabinantayon ang publiko agud indi na masulit pa ang natabo sang 2011 sa diin gintay-og ang Japan sang major magnitude-9.0 nga linog nga ginsundan pa sang makamamatay nga tsunami kag nuclear disaster.
english: He said the public should be vigilant so that what happened in 2011 when Japan was shaken by a major magnitude-9.0 earthquake followed by a deadly tsunami and nuclear disaster will not happen again.

text: Sa amo nga insidente, ginabanta 18,500 ka mga indibidwal ang napatay kag na-missing.
english: In that incident, an estimated 18,500 individuals were killed and missing.

text: BADIANGAN, ILOILO – Arestado ang isa ka senior citizen matapos nagpanaya sang pusil sa Barangay Catubig, Badiangan, Iloilo.
english: BADIANGAN, ILOILO – A senior citizen was arrested after he shot himself in Barangay Catubig, Badiangan, Iloilo.

text: Ini amo si Renato Cabais, 67, residente sang nasambit nga lugar.
english: The suspect was identified as Renato Cabais, 67, resident of the said place.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Staff Sergeant Charlie Glenn Casador, imbestigador sang Badiangan Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga nagpanaya sang pusil ang biktima sa isa ka menor de edad nga naglabay sa ila lugar.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Staff Sergeant Charlie Glenn Casador, investigator of the Badiangan Municipal Police Station, said the victim pointed a gun at a minor who passed by.

text: Suno kay Casador, gindagdagan sang search warrant ang biktima.
english: According to Casador, a search warrant was extended for the victim.

text: Diri kag nakuha sa posisyon sini ang .38 caliber revolver nga may walo ka mga live ammunition kag holster, homemade nga 12 gauge shot gun, magazine kag apat ka mga bala.
english: A .38 caliber revolver with eight rounds of live ammunition and a holster, a homemade 12 gauge shot gun, a magazine and four rounds of ammunition were recovered from the suspect.

text: Sa subong, preso na ini sa Badiangan Municipal Police Station kag nagapangatubang sang kaso nga paglapas sa Republic Act No.
english: He is currently detained at the Badiangan Municipal Police Station and is facing charges of violation of Republic Act No.

text: 10591 ukon ang Comprehensive Firearms and Ammunition Regulation Act.
english: 10591 or the Comprehensive Firearms and Ammunition Regulation Act.

text:
‘May problema na sa suplay sang baboy sang Pilipinas, kag kuntani, indi na diri magdugang ang problema sa kakulangan sa suplay sang isda.’

Ini ang pahayag ni Senator Francis Pangilinan bangud sa ginapanan-aw nga posibilidad sang kakulangan sang suplay sang isda sa tunga sang kontrobersyal nga pagtinir sang ginatos ka Chinese vessels sa traditional Filipino fishing grounds sa West Philippine Sea.
english:
'There is already a problem with the Philippine pork supply, and hopefully, the problem of fish supply shortage will not increase.'

This is the statement of Senator Francis Pangilinan due to the expected possibility of shortage of fish supply amid the controversial stay of hundreds of Chinese vessels in traditional Filipino fishing grounds in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Suno kay Pangilinan, indi man kuntani ini pagpahanugutan nga matabo bangud mabudlay kun magmahal ang pagkaon: ‘Indi lang heart-broken ang tawo kundi ginasakitan pa sang tiyan’.
english: According to Pangilinan, this should not be allowed to happen because it is difficult when food becomes expensive: 'People are not only heart-broken but also have stomach pains'

text: Si Pangilinan ang kabahin sang proponents sang ginaduso nga Department of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources.
english: Pangilinan is one of the proponents of the proposed Department of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources.

text: Kasunod sini, nagpanawagan si Pangilinan sa gobyerno nga mag-akto gilayon sa mga pagpamahog sa teritoryo sang Pilipinas kag sa posible nga epekto sini sa ginakaon sang mga Pinoy.
english: Subsequently, Pangilinan called on the government to act immediately on threats to Philippine territory and its possible impact on Filipino food.

text: Nagpanawagan man si Pangilinan sa Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources nga maghatag sang assistance sa mga apektado nga mga Pinoy nga manugpangisda.
english: Pangilinan also called on the Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources to provide assistance to the affected Filipino fishermen.

text: SAN JOAQUIN, ILOILO – Patay ang isa ka motorista matapos naaksidente ang ginasakyan sini nga motorsiklo sa Barangay Cata-an, San Joaquin, Iloilo.
english: SAN JOAQUIN, ILOILO – A motorcyclist was killed after his motorcycle crashed in Barangay Cata-an, San Joaquin, Iloilo.

text: Ang biktima amo si James Sevilleno, 50, residente sang nasambit nga lugar.
english: The victim was identified as James Sevilleno, 50, resident of the said place.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Staff Sergeant Jessan Esguerra, imbestigador sang San Joaquin Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga naghalin ang biktima sa ila balay kag padulong kuntani sa banwa.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Staff Sergeant Jessan Esguerra, investigator of the San Joaquin Municipal Police Station, said the victim left his house and was heading to the town.

text: Suno kay Esguerra, nadulaan sang kontrol ang biktima sa iya motorsiklo sa diin wala pa ini sang suksok nga helmet.
english: According to Esguerra, the victim lost control of his motorcycle and was not wearing a helmet.

text: Tungod sini, nahulog ang biktima sa kanal sa diin nag-angkon ini sang pilas sa ulo nga amo ang gintunaan sang iya kamatayon.
english: As a result, the victim fell into the ditch where he sustained head injuries that led to his death.

text: Gindala pa sa ospital ang biktima, apang gindeklarar sang doctor nga dead on arrival.
english: The victim was rushed to the hospital, but was declared dead on arrival.

text: Ginkibot sang four-time Olympic gold medallist nga si Simone Biles ang bilog nga kalibutan sang nag-withdraw ini sa women’s gymnastics team final sa nagapadayon nga Tokyo Olympics.
english: Four-time Olympic gold medalist Simone Biles shocked the world when she withdrew from the women’s gymnastics team final at the ongoing Tokyo Olympics.

text: Sa edad nga 24 anyos, ang nasambit nga US superstar gymnast amo ang ginalantaw nga greatest female Olympian sa Tokyo, Japan subong nga tuig.
english: At 24 years old, the US superstar gymnast is expected to be the greatest female Olympian in Tokyo, Japan this year.

text: Nagapanguna siya sa United States’ defense sa ila women’s gymnastics team title kag ginalauman kuntani nga madugangan ang iya apat ka bulawan nga medalya nga nadag-an sa 2016 Rio Olympics.
english: She leads the United States’ defense of its women’s gymnastics team title and would have hoped to add to her four gold medals won at the 2016 Rio Olympics.

text: Apang subong nga tuig, nag-score si Biles sang 13.766 – ang iya pinakamanubo nga Olympic vault score – antes siya nag-isol sa event.
english: But this year, Biles scored a 13.766 – her lowest Olympic vault score – before pulling out of the event.

text: Matapos nagwithdraw sa kumpetisyon, ginapaabot na nga ‘mabuhinan ang sponsorship kag publicity’ para kay Biles apang baliskad sa popular opinion nga ‘losers ang quitters’, ginakabig si Biles nga ‘winner’ para sa mata sang mga mental health professionals.
english: After withdrawing from the competition, Biles was expected to 'reduce sponsorship and publicity' but contrary to popular opinion that 'quitters are losers', Biles is considered a 'winner' in the eyes of mental health professionals.

text:
‘TWISTIES’

Sang nadulaan sang balanse si Biles sa tunga-tunga sang iya two and a half twists sa women’s team final, maathag nga may yara sang sala kag indi ordinaryo nga hitabo — butang nga ginpahayag sang superstar gymnast nga ‘twisties’ antes ang iya dramatic exit.
english:
‘TWISTIES’

When Biles lost her balance midway through her two and a half twists in the women’s team final, it was clear something was wrong and out of the ordinary — something the superstar gymnast referred to as ‘twisties’ before her dramatic exit.

text: Ang twisties, sandig sa definition sa gymnastics, ang matabo kun madula sang isa ka gymnast ang iya sense of space kag dimension samtang yara sa hangin rason nga nagakadula ang kontrol sa lawas kag mahimo ang mga ekstra nga twists kag flips bisan indi man hungod.
english: Twisties, according to the definition in gymnastics, occur when a gymnast loses his sense of space and dimension while in the air causing a loss of body control and extra twists and flips can be done even if not intentionally.

text: Kun kaisa, mahimo pa ini tunaan sang indi safe nga pagtupa ukon landing.
english: Sometimes, it can even lead to an unsafe landing.

text: Sa malip-ot nga pulong, ginatawag ini nga mental block.
english: In short, it’s called a mental block.

text: “I don’t trust myself as much anymore.
english: “I don’t trust myself as much anymore.

text: Maybe it’s getting older.
english: Maybe it’s getting older.

text: There were a couple of days when everybody tweets you and you feel the weight of the world.
english: There were a couple of days when everyone tweets you and you feel the weight of the world.

text: We’re not just athletes.
english: We’re not just athletes.

text: We’re people at the end of the day and sometimes you just have to step back,” kabahin sang emosyonal nga pahayag ni Biles.
english: We’re people at the end of the day and sometimes you just have to step back,” Biles said in an emotional statement.

text:
‘A SUPER ATHLETE AND… A BRAVE WOMAN’

Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Professor Moniq Muyargas sang University of the Philippines in the Visayas, isa ka mental health professional, iya ginpahayag nga ‘compounded’ na ini nga balatyagon bangud sang tuman ka daku nga pressure nga ginadala ni Biles.
english:
‘A SUPER ATHLETE AND… A BRAVE WOMAN’

In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Professor Moniq Muyargas of the University of the Philippines in the Visayas, a mental health professional, said that this feeling is 'compounded' because of the huge pressure that Biles is carrying.

text: “Even ang iya nga childhood na-sacrifice ya na just for the love of the sport.
english: “Even his childhood he sacrificed just for the love of the sport.

text: It came to a point nga ‘Tama na’.
english: It came to a point that ‘That’s enough’.

text: Napuno na siya,” pahayag ni Muyargas nga posible indi na makita ni Biles ang kalipay nga una niya nga nakit-an sa gymnastics.
english: She’s filled up,” Muyargas said Biles will likely never find the joy she first found in gymnastics.

text: Lakip sa mga factor nga naga-contribute sa sini nga balatyagon suno kay Muyargas amo ang: tuman ka taas nga expectation, stress, fatigue, mental pressure — kag ang pinakaginapaabot nga rason subong nga panahon, balatyagon sa tunga sang pandemya.
english: Among the factors that contribute to this feeling according to Muyargas are: too high expectations, stress, fatigue, mental pressure — and the most expected reason nowadays, feeling in the middle of the pandemic.

text: “I dont’t like to think of it as her being a loser because nag-back out siya.
english: “I don’t like to think of it as her being a loser because she backed out.

text: Remember, she is going to lose a lot of sponsorship and publicity.
english: Remember, she is going to lose a lot of sponsorship and publicity.

text: But I think, as a mental health professional, I would like to belive that she is a winner because it is not easy to go public about mental health concerns particularly at the peak of your career with so much in line and so much to lose,” dugang ni Muyargas.
english: But I think, as a mental health professional, I would like to believe that she is a winner because it is not easy to go public about mental health concerns particularly at the peak of your career with so much in line and so much to lose,” Muyargas added.

text: May tyempo gid suno sa iya nga makasiling ang tawo, “I’m done, I cannot anymore move forward because this is not going to be the best of me” — butang nga natabo bisan pa sa pinaka-popular nga gymnast.
english: He said there is always a time when a person can say, “I’m done, I cannot move forward anymore because this is not going to be the best of me” — something that happened even to the most popular gymnast.

text:
“There is only one Simone Biles and we will remember her for her achievements, for her being a super athlete, and for her being a brave woman.”

‘IKAW… BISAN INDI KA MAN SI SIMONE BILES’

Importante ini subong nga tion sang COVID-19 pandemic.
english:
“There is only one Simone Biles and we will remember her for her achievements, for her being a super athlete, and for her being a brave woman.”

‘YOU… EVEN IF YOU’RE NOT SIMONE BILES’

This is especially important during this time of the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Suno kay Muyargas, indi lang ‘overnight’ nga nagadevelop ang amo sini nga balatyagon bangud nagatingob ini tubtub nga nagahimo na nga ‘inner turmoil’.
english: According to Muyargas, it is not just overnight that such feelings develop because they accumulate until they become an inner turmoil.

text: Subong nga tion, tuman ka damo suno sa natungdan ang naga-eksperyensya sang depression kag extreme anxiety — mga ginakabig indi makit-an nga kaaway ‘sa lain-lain nga paagi kag istorya’.
english: Currently, too many, he said, are experiencing depression and extreme anxiety — those who are considered the invisible enemy ‘in different ways and stories’.

text: Sa masobra isa ka tuig nga pangabuhi sa tunga sang pandemya suno sa natungdan, wala sang preparado kag wala sang maka-adjust sang tuman kadasig.
english: In more than a year of living in the midst of the pandemic, he said, no one is prepared and no one can adjust too quickly.

text: “No one is spared.
english: “Not one is spared.

text: Some of us are resilient.
english: Some of us are resilient.

text: Some of us are not.
english: Some of us are not.

text: This is the time to educate people,” pahayag ni Muyargas nga nagatumod pa nga indi dapat pag-i-stigmatize ang depression kag ang tanan nga sahi sang mental health issues.
english: This is the time to educate people,” Muyargas said, adding that depression and all kinds of mental health issues should not be stigmatized.

text: Panugyan sang natungdan sa kada isa, dapat i-maximize ang use of technology agud nga maka-communicate sa mga tawo sa palibot kag makamusta ang mga tawo.
english: He advised everyone to maximize the use of technology in order to communicate with the people around them and greet them.

text: “We need to help each other, we need to become support groups,” dugang pa ni Muyargas.
english: “We need to help each other, we need to become support groups,” Muyargas added.

text: ILOILO CITY-Ginkalipay sang tagdumalahan sang Iloilo Fish Port Complex ang pagkatukib sang otoridad sa barracks nga ginhimo nga drug den sang mga construction workers.
english: ILOILO CITY-The management of the Iloilo Fish Port Complex welcomed the discovery of the barracks that were turned into drug dens by construction workers.

text: Kasunod ini sang pagkadakop man sa isa ka foreman kag lima ka construction workers sa isa ka anti-illegal drug operation nga nagresulta sa pagka-rekober sang kapin P1.3 million nga balor sang shabu.
english: This follows the arrest of a foreman and five construction workers in an anti-illegal drug operation that resulted in the recovery of more than P1.3 million worth of shabu.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Justo Anaquita, spokesperson sang Iloilo Fish Port Complex, iya ginpahayag nga tatlo na ka tuig sa compound sang Fish Port ang mga construction workers nga nagatrabaho sa gina-rehabilitate nga complex.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Justo Anaquita, spokesperson of the Iloilo Fish Port Complex, said that the construction workers who are working on the complex being rehabilitated have been in the compound of the Fish Port for three years.

text: Suno kay Anaquita, tinawo sang kontraktor ang nasambit nga mga trabahador.
english: According to Anaquita, the workers are employees of the contractor.

text: Ang mga construction workers ang halin sa Bacolod City, Negros Occidental, kag Antique.
english: The construction workers are from Bacolod City, Negros Occidental, and Antique.

text: Magluwas sa construction workers, may na-monitor man nga iban nga indibidwal sa fish port complex kag empleyado sang isa ka brokerage business nga ginadudahan may kaangtanan man sa iligal nga aktibidad.
english: Besides the construction workers, other individuals in the fish port complex and employees of a brokerage business were also monitored who are also suspected of being involved in illegal activities.

text: Matandaan nga kasunod sang pagkaaresto sang anom ka mga indibidwal, nagpinalagyo man ang kapin 30 ka pa construction workers sang hana sila nga ipaidalom kuntani sa drug test.
english: It can be recalled that following the arrest of the six individuals, more than 30 construction workers also fled when they were about to undergo drug tests.

text: Nagapawagan ang Mayors for Good Governance kay President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., nga pangalanan na ang mga pulitiko kag kontratista sa likod sang mga palpak nga proyekto sa imprastruktura, ilabi na sa flood control.
english: The Mayors for Good Governance calls on President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. to name the politicians and contractors behind the failed infrastructure projects, especially in flood control.

text: Sa ila pahayag sang Sabado, ginsiling sa grupo nga ginalakipan nanday Mayor Benjamin Magalong (Baguio), Mayor Vico Sotto (Pasig), Mayor Joy Belmonte (Quezon City), kag Mayor Sitti Hataman (Isabela City) nga madugay nga may anomaliya sa sini nga proyekto kag kinahanglan na pasabton ang may kaangtanan.
english: In their statement on Saturday, the group, which includes Mayor Benjamin Magalong (Baguio), Mayor Vico Sotto (Pasig), Mayor Joy Belmonte (Quezon City), and Mayor Sitti Hataman (Isabela City), said that there have been anomalies in this project for a long time and the relevant need to be held accountable.

text: Ginhingyo nila sa Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) kag iban pa nga ahensya nga ipagguwa ang mga dolumento kag pangalan sang mga pulitiko kag kontratista nga nakaganar sang kapin P100 billion nga pondo nga nagkadto lamang sa 15 ka mga contractors halin sang 2022 tubtob 2025.
english: They urged the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) and other agencies to release the documents and names of politicians and contractors who earned more than P100 billion in funds that went to only 15 contractors from 2022 to 2025.

text: Nag-ugat ang panawagan sa pagkabalaka ni Pres.
english: The call was rooted in the concern of Pres.

text: Marcos sa kalidad sang mga proyekto, kaangay nalang sang nagguba nga flood barrier sa Calumpit, Bulacan, kun sa diin ginkadismaya gid niya ini.
english: Marcos on the quality of projects, such as the destroyed flood barrier in Calumpit, Bulacan, where he was disappointed.

text: Samtang, ginpahayag naman ni Mayor Magalong nga handa siya nga mag-volunteer nga mangin kabahin sang independent body.
english: Meanwhile, Mayor Magalong said he is ready to volunteer to be part of the independent body.

text: ILOILO CITY- Nataban sang tatlo ka suspetsado ang masobra P1.7 million nga balor sang kwarta sa natabo nga hold-up sa Rizal Street, Brgy.
english: ILOILO CITY – Three suspects stole more than P1.7 million worth of cash in a hold-up in Rizal Street, Brgy.

text: Poblacion, Pototan, Iloilo.
english: Poblacion, Pototan, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay PMSgt Mark Parreño sang Pototan Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga padulong kuntani sa bangko agud magdeposito sang ila koleksyon ang duha ka empleyado sang J&T Express-Pototan Branch sang sila ang ginbalabagan sang mga suspek nga nagasakay sa motorsiklo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, PMSgt Mark Parreño of the Pototan Municipal Police Station said the two employees of the J&T Express-Pototan Branch were on their way to the bank to deposit their collection when they were stopped by suspects on a motorcycle.

text: Suno kay Parreño, gintayaan sang armas sang isa ka suspek ang mga biktima kag ginkuha ang bag nga nagaunod sang kwarta.
english: According to Parreño, one of the suspects threw a gun at the victims and took the bag containing the money.

text: Pahayag sang pulis, matapos nakuha ang kwarta, madasig nga nagpalagyo ang mga suspetsado sa direksyon nga padulong sa Barotac Nuevo.
english: According to the police, after getting the money, the suspects quickly fled in the direction of Barotac Nuevo.

text: Ginapahayag nga nakasuksok sang bonnet ang mga suspek.
english: The suspects were reportedly wearing bonnets.

text: 𝗣𝗔𝗥𝗜𝗦, 𝗙𝗥𝗔𝗡𝗖𝗘 — Ginaatubang ni Bianca Pagdanganan ang mabudlay nga sitwasyon sa pag-crack sa top three, samtang si Dottie Ardina nagapaninguwa nga magpabilin sa maayo nga posisyon sa ikatlong round sang women’s golf sa Le Golf National.
english: 𝗣𝗔𝗥𝗜𝗦, 𝗙𝗥𝗔𝗡𝗖𝗘 — Bianca Pagdanganan faces a tough situation to crack the top three, while Dottie Ardina tries to stay in good position in the third round of women’s golf at the Le Le Golf National.

text: Ang pinal nga pwersa sang Team Philippines nagadalagan sa isa ka nagaisahanon nga pakigbato sa katapusan nga oras sang 2024 Paris Games.
english: The final force of Team Philippines is running a lonely struggle in the final hour of the 2024 Paris Games.

text: Kaangot diri, may yara sang isyu parte sa uniporme sa golf team – ukon ang kakulang sang uniporme – kag may ginalantaw nga kagul-anan sa weightlifting unit, nga nagadala sang kasubo sa pagtakop sang isa sa pinaka-maayo nga performance sang Team Philippines sa quadrennial games.
english: In this regard, there is the issue of uniforms in the golf team - or the lack of uniforms - and there is a perceived disorder in the weightlifting unit, which brings sadness to the end of one of the best performances of Team Philippines in the quadrennial games.

text: Santo sa video nga nag-viral sa social media, si Ardina, nga nagapakita nga siya nagabutang sang Philippine flag patch sa iya jersey gamit ang duct tape.
english: According to a video that went viral on social media, Ardina, which shows him putting a Philippine flag patch on his jersey using duct tape.

text: Siya nagahambal nga sila lang ang team sa golf competition nga wala sang uniform.
english: He says they are the only team in the golf competition without a uniform.

text: Sa subong, yara na sa mga kamot ni Pagdanganan kung mahimo pa niya mapauswag ang 2-0-2 nga gold-silver-bronze nga tally sang Team Philippines sa Paris Games.
english: Now, it is up to Pagdanganan to see if he can improve on Team Philippines' 2-0-2 gold-silver-bronze tally at the Paris Games.

text: Pormal nga nagsumiter sang sulat si Senate Minority Leader Tito Sotto kay Senate President Chiz Escudero, agud hingyuon ang pagpatuman sang mandatory random drug testing sa mga empleyado kag opisyal sang Senado.
english: Senate Minority Leader Tito Sotto formally submitted a letter to Senate President Chiz Escudero, requesting the implementation of mandatory random drug testing for Senate employees and officials.

text: Ini nga tikang ang ginpatigayon kasunod sang report nga may staff si Senator Robin Padilla nga nadakpan nga naggamit sang marijuana mismo sa sulod sang Senate premises, isa ka isyu nga naghatag sang kahangawa sa integridad kag seguridad sang institusyon.
english: The move follows reports that a staff member of Senator Robin Padilla was caught using marijuana himself inside the Senate premises, an issue that has raised concerns about the integrity and security of the institution.

text: Suno kay Sotto, sang 2018 pa lang sang siya pa ang nagapungko bilang Senate President, ginapatuman na ang nasambit nga drug testing bilang kabahin sang pagpatuman sang Republic Act 9165 ukon ang Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.
english: Sotto said that since 2018 when he was still serving as Senate President, the drug testing has been implemented as part of the implementation of Republic Act 9165 or the Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.

text: Gintumod niya nga ang amo nga lihok magaserbe bilang pamaagi agud masiguro nga ang Senado padayon nga mangin drug-free workplace kag modelo sang pagrespeto sa layi.
english: He pointed out that such a move will serve as a way to ensure that the Senate continues to be a drug-free workplace and a model of respect for the law.

text: Una na nga nagpahayag sang suporta sa panawagan ni Sotto sanday Senador Juan Miguel Zubiri kag Senate Majority Leader Joel Villanueva, nga lunsay nagsiling nga handa sila magpaidalom sa drug testing bilang kabahin sang transparency kag integridad sa serbisyo publiko.
english: Earlier, Senator Juan Miguel Zubiri and Senate Majority Leader Joel Villanueva expressed support for Sotto's call, both of whom said they were willing to undergo drug testing as part of transparency and integrity in public service.

text: Sa subong, wala pa sang opisyal nga sabat si Senate President Escudero sa nasambit nga sulat ni Sotto.
english: At present, Senate President Escudero has not yet officially responded to Sotto's letter.

text: LAMBUNAO, ILOILO – Ipaidalom sa autopsy examination ang bangkay sang preso nga napatay matapos naghikog sa sulod mismo sang presuhan sa Lambunao Municipal Police Station (MPS).
english: LAMBUNAO, ILOILO – The body of an inmate who died after committing suicide inside the jail at the Lambunao Municipal Police Station (MPS) will be subjected to an autopsy examination.

text: Ini amo si Alyas Jay-R sang Barangay Maite Pequeño, Lambunao, Iloilo kag nadakpan sa ginpatigayon nga sa drug buy-bust operation.
english: He was identified as Jay-R of Barangay Maite Pequeño, Lambunao, Iloilo and was arrested in a drug buy-bust operation.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Roy Tayona, hepe sang Lambunao Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga sila na mismo ang nagpanugyan sa pamilya sang biktima nga ipaidalom ini sa autopsy examination.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Roy Tayona, chief of Lambunao Municipal Police Station, said they personally advised the victim's family to submit him for an autopsy examination.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagbitay ang biktima sa diin gingamit sini ang habol nga ginhatag sang iya iloy sang adlaw nga nadakpan ini sa buy-bust operation.
english: It was learned that the victim hanged himself using a blanket given to him by his mother on the day he was arrested in the buy-bust operation.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagaisahanon lang ang biktima sa iya selda sang natabo ang insidente.
english: The victim was alone in his cell when the incident occurred.

text: Apang antes sini, nagareklamo na nga daan ang subject nga nagalain ang iya pamatyag, rason nga gindala ini sa ospital.
english: However, before that, the subject had already complained that he was feeling unwell, which is why he was taken to the hospital.

text: Suno kay Tayona, natumod sang doktor nga mataas ang blood pressure sang biktima.
english: According to Tayona, the doctor determined that the victim had high blood pressure.

text: Matandaan nga nadakpan ang subject sang Dominggo, Setyembre 22, 2024 sa diin narekober sa iya poisyon ang P34,000 nga balor sang suspected shabu.
english: It can be recalled that the subject was arrested on Sunday, September 22, 2024 where P34,000 worth of suspected shabu was recovered from his possession.

text: Ipinanawagan ng Commission on Elections ang isang kumpletong overhaul ng Omnibus Election Code na ipinasa pa noong 1985.
english: The Commission on Elections has called for a complete overhaul of the Omnibus Election Code that was passed in 1985.

text: Ayon kay Comelec Chairperson George Garcia, hindi na sapat ang mga lumang probisyon upang tumugon sa makabagong panahon ng halalan, kaya’t kailangan ng mas malawak na reporma mula sa voter registration, paghahain ng kandidatura, disqualification, hanggang sa cancellation ng candidacy.
english: According to Comelec Chairperson George Garcia, the old provisions are no longer sufficient to meet the new election era, so there is a need for broader reforms from voter registration, nomination, disqualification, to cancellation of candidacy.

text: Kabilang sa mga panukala ng Comelec ang pag-criminalize ng nuisance candidacies, paghihigpit sa candidate substitution, pagbabawal sa premature campaigning matapos ang paghahain ng COC, at pag-update sa campaign spending limits.
english: The Comelec's proposals include criminalizing nuisance candidacies, tightening candidate substitution, banning premature campaigning after the filing of COCs, and updating campaign spending limits.

text: Nakasaad din sa panukala ang pagbabago sa party-list rules, pagbibigay-suporta sa underrepresented groups, at pagpapatupad ng anti-political dynasty provision ng Saligang Batas.
english: The proposal also includes changes to party-list rules, support for underrepresented groups, and implementation of the anti-political dynasty provision of the Constitution.

text: Noong 2023, nakumpleto ng Comelec ang 964-page draft ng mga reporma para sa Batas Pambansa Blg.
english: In 2023, the Comelec completed the 964-page draft of reforms for Batas Pambansa Blg.

text: Kadungan sang courtesy call ni Hidilyn Diaz kay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte via video-conferencing, ginpanginbulahan sang chief executive ang labing-una nga Pinay Olympic gold medalist.
english: During Hidilyn Diaz's courtesy call to President Rodrigo Duterte via video-conferencing, the chief executive congratulated the first Filipino Olympic gold medalist.

text: Gin-garantiya sang Presidente ang isa pa ka “fully furnished” nga house and lot incentive kay Diaz sa iya hometown sa Zamboanga City.
english: The President guaranteed another “fully furnished” house and lot incentive to Diaz in his hometown in Zamboanga City.

text: Hatagan man sang dugang P3 million cash incentive si Diaz nagikan sa Office of the President magluwas sa P10 million cash incentive nga award sang Philippine Sports Commission (PSC) bilang kabahin sang Expanded Athletes Incentives Act para sa Olympic gold medal.
english: Diaz will also be given an additional P3 million cash incentive from the Office of the President in addition to the P10 million cash incentive awarded by the Philippine Sports Commission (PSC) as part of the Expanded Athletes Incentives Act for the Olympic gold medal.

text: Suno kay Presidente Duterte, hatagan man si Diaz sang presidential merit MEDAL kasunod sang pagdala niya sang dako nga dungog para sa pungsod.
english: According to President Duterte, Diaz will also be awarded the presidential merit MEDAL for bringing great honor to the country.

text: “As expected the nation is ecstatic about your achievement.
english: “As expected the nation is ecstatic about your achievement.

text: Your achievement is the achievement of the Philippine nation,” pahayag ni Duterte.
english: Your achievement is the achievement of the Philippine nation,” Duterte said.

text: Dugang pa sang Presidente, nagasuludo siya kay Diaz bangud sa iya gindala nga kadalag-an nga nagbatak sa pungsod.
english: The President added that he is proud of Diaz for the victory he brought to the country.

text: Tuman man ang pasalamat sang Pinay weightlifter sa Presidente.
english: The Filipino weightlifter is also very grateful to the President.

text: Nahibaluan nga magluwas sa non-cash incentives nga mabaton ni Diaz, naglab-ot na as of July 28 sa kapin P43.5 million ang kabug-usan nga cash incentives para sa Pinay Olympic gold medalist.
english: It is known that besides the non-cash incentives that Diaz will receive, as of July 28, the total cash incentives for the Pinay Olympic gold medalist reached more than P43.5 million.

text: Matandaan nga nagbubo ang pag-abi-abi sang mga Filipino kay Diaz kadungan sang iya pag-abot kahapon sa Pilipinas.
english: It can be recalled that Diaz was warmly welcomed by Filipinos upon his arrival in the Philippines yesterday.

text: Sa iya pag-abot sa Ninoy International Airport Terminal 2, suksok sang 30 anyos nga women’s weightlifting champion ang gold medal halin sa Tokyo Olympics.
english: Upon her arrival at Ninoy International Airport Terminal 2, the 30-year-old women’s weightlifting champion was wearing the gold medal from the Tokyo Olympics.

text: Kaupod man ni Diaz sa iya pagpauli sa pungsod si 2019 SEA Games gold medalist and Olympic Finalist Margielyn Didal.
english: Diaz was also accompanied by 2019 SEA Games gold medalist and Olympic Finalist Margielyn Didal.

text: Ginsugata ang Pinay weightlifter sang iya mga kaupdanan sa Philippine Air Force kag pila ka personnel sang Philippine Navy lakip na ang Philippine Sports Commission.
english: The Filipina weightlifter was met by her colleagues in the Philippine Air Force and several personnel of the Philippine Navy including the Philippine Sports Commission.

text: Nahibaluan nga myembro si Diaz sang Civil Military Operations Group sang Philippine Air Force sa diin gin-promote siya bilang staff sergeant matapos napauli ang gold medal sa Olympiyada.
english: Diaz is a member of the Civil Military Operations Group of the Philippine Air Force where he was promoted to staff sergeant after bringing home a gold medal at the Olympics.

text: Apisar nagbubo ang ulan, ginbinuksan ni Diaz ang bintana sang ginasakyan nga coaster van kag proud nga ginpakita ang una nga gold medal sa Olympics para sa Pilipinas.
english: Despite the rain, Diaz opened the window of the coaster van and proudly showed the first gold medal in the Olympics for the Philippines.

text: Lakip ang Pilipinas sa ginapan-aw nga mga pungsod sa Asya nga ulihi nga makarecover sa turismo.
english: The Philippines is among the Asian countries expected to be the last to recover from tourism.

text: Suno sa report sang Australia/New Zealand (ANZ) Research, kaupod sang Pilipinas sa ginakonsiderar ‘laggards’ ukon mahinay ang paghulag amo ang India, Malaysia kag Indonesia.
english: According to the Australia/New Zealand (ANZ) Research report, the Philippines is joined by India, Malaysia and Indonesia among those considered 'laggards' or slow movers.

text: Ini bangud ang mga destinasyon sa sini nga mga pungsod ang nagapabilin nga weak sa pagbukas sa mga turista kag nagapangabudlay gihapon sa tunga sang sluggish domestic vaccination indi makontrol nga local outbreaks.
english: This is because destinations in these countries remain weak in opening to tourists and are still struggling amid sluggish domestic vaccination uncontrollable local outbreaks.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, Singapore naman ang ginalantaw nga best place nga posible magapanguna sa tourism recovery sa Asya.
english: On the other hand, Singapore is seen as the best place to lead the tourism recovery in Asia.

text: Ini bangud gamay lang ukon wala gid gani sang kaso sang local virus transmission sa nagligad nga mga binulan kag ini man nga pungsod ang may pinakamadasig nga vaccine rollout sa rehiyon.
english: This is because there have been few or no cases of local virus transmission in recent months and the country has also had the fastest vaccine rollout in the region.

text: Ang Singapore ang nagbukas naman sang borders sa mga byahero halin sa Australia, Brunei, mainland China, New Zealand kag Taiwan.
english: Singapore has opened its borders to travelers from Australia, Brunei, mainland China, New Zealand and Taiwan.

text: Nagsugtanay na sanday anay US President Donald Trump kag Vice President Kamala Harris nga mag-atubangay sa ABC News sa Septyembre 10 para sa isa ka presidential debate.
english: Former US President Donald Trump and Vice President Kamala Harris have agreed to face each other on ABC News on September 10 for a presidential debate.

text: Ginkumpirma man ini sang network matapos nga nagpahayag si Trump nga handa siya mag-debate batok kay Harris sang pila ka beses antes ang November election.
english: The network also confirmed it after Trump said he was willing to debate Harris several times before the November election.

text: Sa tatlo ka debate nga iya gin-suhestyon, ginlakip man sini ang conservative network nga Fox News kag NBC.
english: Of the three debates he suggested, it also included the conservative network Fox News and NBC.

text: Sunod man nga ginkumpirma sang bise-presidente nga magatambong siya sa ABC debate kag nagpahayag man nga bukas siya sa dugang mga pag-atubangay.
english: The vice-president later confirmed that he will attend the ABC debate and said he is open to further meetings.

text: Mangin moderator sa debate sanday World News Tonight anchor kag managing editor David Muir kag ABC News Live Prime anchor Linsey Davis.
english: World News Tonight anchor and managing editor David Muir and ABC News Live Prime anchor Linsey Davis will moderate the debate.

text: Matandaan nga sang Hunyo, una nga nagsabak ang Republican candidate sa presidential debate apang sang amo nga tion, ang nakaatubang sini amo si President Joe Biden.
english: In June, the Republican candidate first appeared in the presidential debate but at that time, he faced President Joe Biden.

text: Bangud sa pigado nga performance ni Biden, nagtodo ang panawagan nga mag-atras na ini sa eleksyon.
english: Because of Biden's poor performance, calls for him to withdraw from the election have intensified.

text: Nag-withdraw matuod ang 81-anyos nga Democrat leader kag opisyal nga ginbotohan nga si Harris ang magabulos kag mangin standard bearer sang Democratic Party.
english: The 81-year-old Democrat leader did withdraw and Harris was officially voted in as the standard bearer of the Democratic Party.

text: Patay ang 15-anyos nga lalaki matapos siya nga malasakan sang dump truck nga minamaneho mismo sang iya nga amay sa Pasig City.
english: A 15-year-old boy was killed after he was hit by a dump truck driven by his father in Pasig City.

text: Naggwa sa inisyal nga imbestigasyon nga nabatyagan na lamang sang amay nga isa ka truck driver nga may nagbunggo sa likod sang royda sang salakyan.
english: Initial investigation revealed that the father, a truck driver, felt something hit the back of the wheel of the vehicle.

text: Sang iya ginlantaw, didto niya nakit-an ang duguon nga anak niya nga iya man nga pahinante.
english: When he looked, he saw the bloody son of his driver.

text: Padayon pa ang imbestigasyon sang pulis.
english: Police are still investigating.

text: Gin-aresto naman ang nasambit nga amay.
english: The father was arrested.

text: Dapat nga maghulag ang Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) agud mabuligan ang mga Pinoy nga biktima sang fraud ilabi na bangud labi nga nagadamo ang reports sang online theft subong nga may coronavirus pandemic.
english: The Central Bank of the Philippines (BSP) should act to help Filipinos who are victims of fraud especially as reports of online theft are increasing during the coronavirus pandemic.

text: Ini ang ginaduso ni Senator Grace Poe nga amo ang chairperson sang Committee on Banks, Financial Institutions and Currencies sa Senado.
english: This is being proposed by Senator Grace Poe who is the chairperson of the Committee on Banks, Financial Institutions and Currencies in the Senate.

text: Suno kay Poe, may yara sang grupo nga gintukod ang mga biktima sang fraud sa social media agud nga magwangal sa ila nga kapierdehan; kag isa sa sini nga grupo ang nagpahayag nga 150 ka tawo ang natabanan sang P7.5 million nga balor sang kwarta.
english: According to Poe, there is a group formed by victims of fraud on social media to complain about their losses; and one of this group said that 150 people were robbed of P7.5 million worth of money.

text: Iban sa mga nakawat nga kwarta ang nagadiretso sa acounts nga natumod man sang mga biktima.
english: Some of the stolen money goes directly to accounts identified by the victims.

text: Bangud sini nga problema, ginalauman suno kay Poe nga maghulag ang BSP agud nga makudalan ang welfare kag ang safety sang mga consumers.
english: Because of this problem, Poe said the BSP is expected to act to ensure the welfare and safety of consumers.

text: Suno kay Poe, sa sining tion nga nadulaan na sang trabaho ang mga tawo, indi maayo nga madulaan pa gid sila sang savings.
english: According to Poe, at this time when people have already lost their jobs, it is not good for them to lose more of their savings.

text: Nahibaluan nga halin sang nagligad nga tuig, madamo na nga mga bangko ang nagpaandam sa mga depositors sa lain-lain nga schemes sang mga manugtunto online samtang labi man nga nagadamo ang Pinoy ang nagsaylo sa online banking.
english: Since last year, many banks have warned depositors against various schemes of online fraudsters while more and more Filipinos have switched to online banking.

text: Sang naligad nga tuig, nagpangayo man sang dugang nga budget ang Department of Justice (DOJ) para sa anti-cybercrime operations sang National Bureau of Investigation agud mabatuan ang online schemes.
english: Last year, the Department of Justice (DOJ) also requested additional budget for the anti-cybercrime operations of the National Bureau of Investigation to combat online schemes.

text: Ginahulat man ang pag-release sang NBI sang pinal nga tally sang cybercrimes lakip na ang donation scams kag phishing nga natabo halin sang naligad nga tuig.
english: The NBI is also awaiting the release of the final tally of cybercrimes including donation scams and phishing that occurred since last year.

text: Yara na sa maayo nga kahimtangan ang isa ka panday nga nahulog sa gina-construct nga Leganes Commercial Complex matapos nga nakasalapay sang live wire.
english: A carpenter who fell from the under-construction Leganes Commercial Complex after tripping on a live wire is in good condition.

text: Ini amo si Bryan Decer, 26, residente sang Maasin, Iloilo.
english: This is Bryan Decer, 26, resident of Maasin, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Patrolman Jomar Nerios, imbestigador sang Leganes Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga minor injuries lang ang naangkon sang biktima kag conscious man ini sang gindala sa Western Visayas Medical Center sa Mandurriao, Iloilo City.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Patrolman Jomar Nerios, investigator of the Leganes Municipal Police Station, said the victim sustained minor injuries and was conscious when he was brought to the Western Visayas Medical Center in Mandurriao, Iloilo City.

text: Natabo ang insidente kahapon sang udto kun sa diin ginapahayag nga nagapangbaklas ini sang atop sang nasalapay ang live wire gani nga nahulog.
english: The incident occurred yesterday afternoon when he was reportedly cleaning the roof when he tripped on the live wire and fell.

text: Ginabanta yara sa 10-20 ka tapak ang kataason sang nahulugan sini halin sa ikaduha nga panalgan sang merkado.
english: It is estimated to be 10-20 feet high when it fell from the second floor of the market.

text: Muling iginiit ng Department of Education ang kahalagahan ng teacher education reforms sa pamamagitan ng Teacher Education Council o TEC, bilang susi sa pagpapabuti ng kalidad ng edukasyon sa bansa.
english: The Department of Education has reiterated the importance of teacher education reforms through the Teacher Education Council or TEC, as the key to improving the quality of education in the country.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo, sinabi ni DepEd Secretary at TEC Chairman Sonny Angara na ang tunay na reporma ay nagsisimula sa paghahanda at patuloy na pagsuporta sa mga guro.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, DepEd Secretary and TEC Chairman Sonny Angara said that true reform begins with the preparation and continued support of teachers.

text: Batay sa unang annual report ng TEC, ilan sa mga hamon ang kakulangan sa teacher preparation, licensing, at professional development na nakaaapekto sa kalidad ng pagtuturo.
english: According to the first annual report of TEC, some of the challenges are the lack of teacher preparation, licensing, and professional development that affect the quality of teaching.

text: Alinsunod sa Republic Act 11713, mandato ng TEC ang maglatag ng roadmap para sa teacher education, kabilang ang pagtatatag ng Teacher Education-Centers of Excellence sa bawat rehiyon at probinsya.
english: In accordance with Republic Act 11713, TEC's mandate is to lay out a roadmap for teacher education, including the establishment of Teacher Education-Centers of Excellence in each region and province.

text: Kabilang na sa mga ipinatupad na reporma ng konseho ang bagong pre-service teacher education curriculum, profiling ng 1,570 Teacher Education Institutions, at koordinasyon sa PRC para sa specialization-based licensure exams sa Setyembre 2025.
english: Among the reforms implemented by the council are a new pre-service teacher education curriculum, profiling of 1,570 Teacher Education Institutions, and coordination with the PRC for specialization-based licensure exams in September 2025.

text: Patay ang 62 ka mga tawo sang nagtibusok ang ila ginasakyan nga eroplano sa Vinhedo sa naaminhan-nakatundan sang São Paulo, Brazil.
english: Sixty-two people were killed when their plane crashed in Vinhedo, northwest of São Paulo, Brazil.

text: Sa mga biktima, 58 ang pasahero kag apat ang crew.
english: Of the victims, 58 were passengers and four were crew.

text: Suno sa city officials sa Valinhos nga kaiping sang Vinhedo, isa ka balay sa local condominium complex ang nahalitan man bangud sa plane crash apang ginkumpirma nga wala sang residente nga nasamaran ukon napatay.
english: According to city officials in Valinhos, which is adjacent to Vinhedo, a house in the local condominium complex was also damaged by the plane crash but confirmed that no residents were injured or killed.

text: Una nga nag-anunsyo si Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva sang numero sang sakay sang aircraft lakip na ang paghingyo sang isa ka minuto nga kalinong para sa biktima sang amo nga trahedya.
english: Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva first announced the number of passengers on board the aircraft and called for a minute of silence for the victims of the tragedy.

text: Sandig sa nagaguwa nga videos, nagtiyog-tiyog pa antes nagtibusok ang eroplano kag nagkalayo sang yara na sa duta.
english: According to emerging videos, the plane shook before it crashed and caught fire when it was on the ground.

text: Sa data sa Flightradar24, ang Voepass plane ang nagbiya sa Cascavel sa state of Parana kag padulong sa main international airport sang São Paulo sang nadulaan ini sang signal 1:30 p.m. local time sa Brazil.
english: According to data on Flightradar24, the Voepass plane was leaving Cascavel in the state of Parana and heading to the main international airport of São Paulo when it lost signal at 1:30 p.m. local time in Brazil.

text: Gina-imbestigaran pa kun ano ang rason sang pagtibusok sini.
english: The cause of the explosion is still being investigated.

text:
Isang simpleng birthday celebration sa The Hague, Netherlands ang nauwi sa tensyon matapos magkaalitan si dating presidential spokesperson Harry Roque at ilang Duterte supporters dahil umano sa “humba.”

Sa Facebook live ni Cecil Arceño, makikitang nagdiriwang sila ng kaarawan ni Alvin nang marinig sa background ang isang babae na sumisigaw laban sa isang “Aldo” na nag-post umano ng negatibo tungkol sa kanila.
english:
A simple birthday celebration in The Hague, Netherlands was thrown into tension after former presidential spokesperson Harry Roque and some Duterte supporters clashed over an alleged “humba.”

In Cecil Arceño's Facebook live, they can be seen celebrating Alvin's birthday when a woman can be heard in the background shouting against an “Aldo” who allegedly posted negative things about them.

text: Agad itong sinagot ni Roque at binigyang-diin na dapat ay tumindig laban sa mali.
english: Roque immediately responded and emphasized that he should stand up against wrong.

text: Nainis pa si Roque nang madamay siya sa usapin, matapos umanong kwestyunin ang pagkain niya ng humba.
english: Roque was even angry when he was hurt in the conversation, after he was questioned about eating humba.

text: Sinabi pa niya na handa siyang bayaran ang buong putahe, subalit pinigilan siya ng isang babae at ipinaalala na ang ulam ay ibinigay ng kaibigan ng birthday celebrant para sa lahat.
english: He said he was ready to pay for the whole dish, but a woman stopped him and reminded him that the dish was given by a friend of the birthday celebrant for everyone.

text: Dagdag pa ni Roque, hindi dapat sunud-sunuran sa mali at kailangang matutong manindigan.
english: Roque added that we should not follow the wrong and must stand firm.

text: Nagpasar sang resolusyon ang Iloilo Provincial Government nga nagakilala sa kadalag-an sang four-time Olympic weightlifter nga si Hidilyn Diaz nga amo ang labing-una nga nakakuha sang Olympic gold para sa Pilipinas.
english: The Iloilo Provincial Government passed a resolution recognizing the victory of four-time Olympic weightlifter Hidilyn Diaz, the first Olympic gold medalist for the Philippines.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Iloilo Third District Board Member Jason Gonzales, iya ginpahayag nga paagi ini agud nga ipabutyag ang bugal sang Iloilo nga natapos na ang 97 ka tuig nga paghulat sang pungsod para sa bulawan sa Olympiada.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Iloilo Third District Board Member Jason Gonzales said this is a way to express the pride of Iloilo that the country's 97-year wait for gold in the Olympics is over.

text: Suno kay Gonzales, maragtason man ini kag symbolic bangud magluwas nga may yara subong sang COVID-19 pandemic, ginpierde man sang Pilipinas ang China sa amo nga event.
english: According to Gonzales, it is also historic and symbolic because besides the current COVID-19 pandemic, the Philippines also defeated China in the event.

text: Matandaan nga isa ka kilo lang ang abanse ni Diaz sa iya Chinese nga kontra nga si Liao Qiuyun sa 55 kilogram-event sang women’s weightlifting.
english: Diaz is only one kilogram ahead of her Chinese opponent Liao Qiuyun in the 55 kilogram event of the women's weightlifting.

text: MOLO, ILOILO CITY – Nagdangat sa P1.3 million nga balor sang illegal nga droga ang nakuha mga construction workers sa drug buy bust operation sa Barangay North Baluarte, Molo, Iloilo City.
english: MOLO, ILOILO CITY – Construction workers seized P1.3 million worth of illegal drugs in a drug buy bust operation in Barangay North Baluarte, Molo, Iloilo City.

text: Ang subject sang operasyon amo sanday alyas Greg, 28 nga isa ka foreman, residente sang Barangay Rizal Pala-Pala 1, Iloilo City Proper; kag alyas John-John, 31, residente sang Bacolod City.
english: The subjects of the operation were alias Greg, 28, a foreman, resident of Barangay Rizal Pala-Pala 1, Iloilo City Proper; and alias John-John, 31, resident of Bacolod City.

text: Magluwas diri, naaresto man ang apat pa gid ka mga construction workers nga mabakal kuntani sang iligal nga droga.
english: In addition, four other construction workers who were trying to buy illegal drugs were also arrested.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Ryan Christ Inot, team leader sang City Drug Enforcement Unit (CDEU), iya ginpahayag nga ang foreman gid ang nagabaligya sang illegal nga droga.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Ryan Christ Inot, team leader of the City Drug Enforcement Unit (CDEU), said the foreman was the one who sold illegal drugs.

text: Suno kay Inot, gin-ako sang foreman nga nagahalin sa Bacolod City ang illegal nga droga nga iya nabaligya kag ginapaagi ini sa Roll-on/Roll-off (RORO) ships.
english: According to Inot, the foreman admitted that he was selling the illegal drugs from Bacolod City and was selling them through Roll-on/Roll-off (RORO) ships.

text: Nakuha naman sa posisyon sang mga arestado ang 195 grams sang suspected shabu kag iban pa nga drug paraphernalia.
english: Recovered from the possession of the suspects were 195 grams of suspected shabu and other drug paraphernalia.

text: Sa subong, preso na ang mga ini sa Iloilo City Police Station 1 kag nagapangatubang sang kaso nga paglapas sa Republic Act No.
english: They are currently detained at Iloilo City Police Station 1 and are facing charges of violation of Republic Act No.

text: 9165 ukon Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.
english: 9165 or Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.

text: ILOILO CITY- Hugot ang pagbantay sang mga opisyal sang Calaparan, Arevalo, Iloilo City agud indi makasulod ang mga pangayaw sa mga beach resorts sa lugar.
english: ILOILO CITY- Officials of Calaparan, Arevalo, Iloilo City are strictly monitoring the entry of foreigners into the beach resorts in the area.

text: Ini may kaangtanan sa Executive Order No.29 ni Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas nga nagamando sang pagpasirado sang mga beaches, resorts, kag waterparks sa syudad sang Iloilo tubtob sa Abril 4.
english: This is in connection with Executive Order No.29 of Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas ordering the closure of beaches, resorts, and waterparks in Iloilo City until April 4.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Barangay Kagawad Rodrigo Montaño sang Brgy.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Barangay Kagawad Rodrigo Montaño of Brgy.

text: Calaparan, Arevalo, Iloilo City, iya ginpahayag nga may nakadeploy na nga mga force multipliers, barangay tanods ,Barangay Peacekeeping Action Team, kag mga volunteers agud nga bantayan nga wala sang makasulod nga pangayaw sa mga beaches.
english: Calaparan, Arevalo, Iloilo City, he said that force multipliers, barangay tanods, Barangay Peacekeeping Action Team, and volunteers have already been deployed to ensure that no foreigners enter the beaches.

text: Suno kay Montaño, gin-abisuhan naman ang tagdumalahan sang mga beach resorts nga indi magbaton sang mga pangayaw nga luyag maglagaw kag magpaligo sa baybay.
english: According to Montaño, the management of beach resorts has been advised not to accept foreigners who want to walk and bathe on the beach.

text: Gin-athag naman sang barangay official nga hatagan nila sang konsiderasyon ang mga residente sa lugar nga makalakat-lakat sa higad sang baybay apang sa kondisyon nga nagasunod sa minimum health protocol.
english: The barangay official explained that they will give consideration to the residents in the area who can walk along the beach but on condition that they follow the minimum health protocol.

text: Ginpabutyag ni Iloilo 1st District Representative Janet Garin nga wala sang kamatuoran ang mga alegasyon nga may bayranay nga natabo sa Kamara nga may kaangtanan sa impeachment complaint batok kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: Iloilo 1st District Representative Janet Garin said there is no truth in the allegations that there was a bribe in the House of Representatives in connection with the impeachment complaint against Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Rep.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Rep.

text: Garin, iya gin-athag nga indi matuod nga may kahilabtanan ang impeachment case sa kapyerdehan sang pila ka mga kandidato sa idalom sang alyansa ni Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Garin, he explained that it is not true that the impeachment case has anything to do with the defeat of some candidates under the alliance of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: sa nagligad nga eleksyon.
english: in the last election.

text: Suno sa iya, isa siya sa nagpirma sa impeachment complaint, apang indi ini buot silingon nga kontra siya kay Vice Pres.
english: He said he was one of the signatories to the impeachment complaint, but that does not mean he is against Vice Pres.

text: Duterte.
english: Duterte.

text: Ginpahayag ni Garin nga ang iya pagpirma isa ka moral obligation kag kabahin sang proseso sa demokrasya.
english: Garin said his signature is a moral obligation and part of the democratic process.

text: Dugang pa sang natungdan nga ang impeachment ang may duha ka aspeto kun sa diin ang complainants ginahatagan sang kahigayunan nga e-justify ang ila mga alegasyon.
english: He added that the impeachment has two aspects where the complainants are given the opportunity to justify their allegations.

text: Samtang, si Vice President Duterte may kahigayunan man nga magpahayag sang iya side kun ang mga alegasyon nga ginahaboy batok sa iya ang wala sang kamatuoran.
english: Meanwhile, Vice President Duterte also has the opportunity to express his side if the allegations against him are not true.

text: Ginkumpirma man sang kongresista nga indi tanan sa Kamara ang nagpirma sa complaint.
english: The congressman also confirmed that not everyone in the House signed the complaint.

text: Nagpanugyan man ini sa publiko nga indi na dapat palawigon ang mga haka-haka nga may yara sang ginbayaran agud lamang mapatuman ini nga aksyon.
english: He also advised the public not to prolong the rumors that someone was paid just to implement this action.

text: 𝗙𝗟𝗢𝗥𝗜𝗗𝗔, 𝗨𝗦𝗔 — Nagbilin sang lima ka patay kag nagresulta sa ginabanta nga mga ginatos ka libo nga pagkautod sang kuryente ang Bagyong Debby, nga nag-umpisa laslas sa Florida bilang Category-One nga bagyo.
english: 𝗙𝗟𝗢𝗥𝗜𝗗𝗔, 𝗨𝗦𝗔 — Hurricane Debby, which tore through Florida as a Category-One hurricane, left five dead and resulted in an estimated hundreds of thousands of power outages.

text: Madasig nga hangin kag mabaskog nga ulan sang Debby ang nagdala sang madamo nga pagbaha sa Florida kag Georgia.
english: High winds and heavy Debby rains brought widespread flooding to Florida and Georgia.

text: Bangud diri, may mga report man sang pagkaguba sa imprastruktura kag mga puluy-an.
english: As a result, there were also reports of damage to infrastructure and homes.

text: Mataspos ang paglaslas sang Hurricane Debby, madamo nga mga negosyo kag mga non-profit nga organisasyon ang nag-organisar sang mga relief efforts agud buligan ang mga apektado.
english: After Hurricane Debby struck, many businesses and non-profit organizations organized relief efforts to help those affected.

text: Si Gobernador Ron DeSantis sang Florida nagbisita sa Taylor County Middle School sa Perry, Florida, kun sa diin gin-deploy sang estado ang mga resources para sa mga biktima sang bagyo.
english: Florida Governor Ron DeSantis visited Taylor County Middle School in Perry, Florida, where the state deployed resources for storm victims.

text: Nalakip man ang mga Filipino-Americans sa mga naapektuhan sang Debby sa Tampa Bay area.
english: Filipino-Americans were also among those affected by Debby in the Tampa Bay area.

text: Suno kay Rona Lyn, residente sang Valrico, Florida, may mataas nga pagbaha sa palibot sang iya balay tungod sa mabaskog nga ulan.
english: According to Rona Lyn, a resident of Valrico, Florida, there was high flooding around her house due to heavy rains.

text: Bilang nagapuyo malapit sa Alafia River, gin-obserbahan ni Rona Lyn ang madasig nga pagtaas sang lebel sang tubig samtang ang bagyo nagapadayon sa pag-ulan sa lugar.
english: As a resident near the Alafia River, Rona Lyn observed the rapid rise in water levels as the storm continued to rain down on the area.

text: Ginpahayag niya nga ang pagbukas sang duha ka lokal nga reservoir, ang posible nagpadugang sa pagbaha.
english: He said the opening of two local reservoirs, may have increased the flooding.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang Bagyong Debby amo ang ika-lima nga gin-ngalanan nga bagyo sa 2024 Atlantic Hurricane Season.
english: It is noted that Hurricane Debby is the fifth named storm in the 2024 Atlantic Hurricane Season.

text: Nahanas halin sa bata nga edad tubtub nagtapak sa kolehiyo si Gizelle Amour Tagabi, tumandok sang Tubungan, Iloilo, nga topnotcher sa March 2025 Licensure Examination for Professional Teachers.
