english: Gizelle Amour Tagabi, a native of Tubungan, Iloilo, was trained from an early age until she entered college.

text: Rank 5 si Tagabi sa pasinawan nga nakakuha sang rating nga 93.00%.
english: Tagabi ranked 5th in the examination with a rating of 93.00%.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo Iloilo sa alumna sang West Visayas State University (WVSU) La Paz, iya ginpahayag nga pareho nga manunudlo ang iya mga ginikanan nga nangin daku man nga parte sang nangin preparasyon sa iya propesyon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Iloilo, the alumna of West Visayas State University (WVSU) La Paz said that both her parents were teachers who were a big part of her preparation for her profession.

text: Ginkilala man sini ang nangin papel sang iya teachers halin sa Tubungan Central Elementary School, Tubungan National High School, tubtub sa College of Education sa WVSU.
english: He also acknowledged the role of his teachers from Tubungan Central Elementary School, Tubungan National High School, to the College of Education at WVSU.

text: “Lain gid tana basta West in teacher education,” pagdayaw sini sa buluthuan nga iya ginhalinan.
english: “He's different as long as West in teacher education,” he praised the school he came from.

text: Pahayag pa ni Tagabi, nangin daku man nga bulig sa iya ang mga oportunidad nga nahatag sa iya bangud madamo siya sang ginpasakupan sa mga aktibidad sa eskwelahan.
english: Tagabi said the opportunities given to him were also a big help to him because he participated in many school activities.

text: “I learn everything I can, anywhere I can,” pahayag sini.
english: “I learn everything I can, anywhere I can,” it stated.

text:
“Ang mga naman-an from those experiences nag-accumulate gid kag amo gid to ang naka-help sa akon sa LET.”

Ginpakigbahin man sini nga ginkuha sini ang education bilang program sa college bangud na-inspire siya sa iya former teacher sa Senior High School.
english:
“The knowledge from those experiences accumulated and that's what really helped me in LET.”

He also shared that he took education as a program in college because he was inspired by his former teacher in Senior High School.

text: Magluwas diri, luyag man sini nga ma-explore pa ang iya napili nga major nga Social Studies.
english: Besides, she also wants to explore her chosen major of Social Studies.

text: Nahibaluan nga si Tagabi ang labing-una nga LET topnotcher halin sa Bachelor of Secondary Education major in Social Studies program sang unibersidad.
english: Tagabi is the first LET topnotcher from the university's Bachelor of Secondary Education major in Social Studies program.

text: Summa Cum Laude siya sang nag-gradwar sang 2024 kag kilala man nga nagserbe anay bilang editor-in-chief sang official student publication sang College of Education.
english: He is Summa Cum Laude when he graduates in 2024 and is also known to have previously served as editor-in-chief of the official student publication of the College of Education.

text: Nangin recipient man siya anay sang prestihiyoso nga IWAG Award sang Philippine Information Agency (PIA) nga amo ang nagakilala sang leadership, journalistic excellence, kag dedikasyon sang mga estudyante sa development communication.
english: He was also the recipient of the prestigious IWAG Award of the Philippine Information Agency (PIA) which recognizes the leadership, journalistic excellence, and dedication of students in development communication.

text: Base sa Professional Regulation Commission, 191 ka licensed secondary teachers ang na-produce sang WVSU La Paz campus sa March 2025 board exam.
english: According to the Professional Regulation Commission, 191 licensed secondary teachers were produced by the WVSU La Paz campus in the March 2025 board exam.

text: Ginpatigayon ang pasinawan sang nagligad nga Marso 23 sa nagkalain-lain nga testing centers sa pungsod lakip na diri sa Iloilo.#
english: The examination was conducted last March 23 at various testing centers in the country including here in Iloilo.

text: Mariing tinutulan ng beteranong election lawyer na si Atty. Romulo Macalintal ang pagpapaliban ng Barangay at Sangguniang Kabataan (SK) Elections sa 2025, kasunod ng pagpirma ni Pangulong Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: Mariing objected to veteran election lawyer Atty. Romulo Macalintal the postponement of the Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan (SK) Elections to 2025, following the signing of President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.

text: sa batas na nagtakda ng bagong petsa ng halalan.
english: with the law setting a new election date.

text: Ayon kay Macalintal, hindi sapat at hindi katanggap-tanggap ang mga dahilan sa likod ng Republic Act No.
english: According to Macalintal, the reasons behind Republic Act No.

text: 12232, na nagsasaad ng paglipat ng halalan mula Disyembre 2025 patungong Nobyembre 2026.
english: 12232, which promises to move the elections from December 2025 to November 2026.

text: Partikular na binigyang-diin ng abogado na ang dahilan ng “setting the terms of office” ay hindi maituturing na valid ground para sa postponement ng eleksyon, batay na rin umano sa mga naunang desisyon ng Korte Suprema, gaya ng kaso ng Macalintal vs.
english: The lawyer specifically stressed that the reason for “setting the terms of office” cannot be considered a valid ground for the postponement of the election, based on previous decisions of the Supreme Court, such as the case of Macalintal vs.

text: Comelec noong 2023.
english: Comelec noong 2023.

text: Dagdag pa niya, hindi rin makatarungan ang paggamit ng BARMM parliamentary elections bilang rason para ipagpaliban ang barangay at SK elections.
english: He added that it is also unfair to use the BARMM parliamentary elections as a reason to postpone the barangay and SK elections.

text: Aniya, may sapat na panahon at paraan ang gobyerno upang maisagawa ang parehong halalan nang hindi kinokompromiso ang alinman sa dalawa.
english: He said the government has enough time and means to conduct both elections without compromising either of the two.

text: Bukod dito, kinuwestyon ni Macalintal ang bagong itinakdang petsa ng halalan sa Nobyembre 2, 2026, na natatapat sa All Souls’ Day.
english: In addition, Macalintal questioned the newly set election date of November 2, 2026, which coincides with All Souls' Day.

text: Aniya, hindi ito praktikal at posibleng makasagabal sa pagboto ng mamamayan na karaniwang ginugugol ang araw na ito para gunitain ang kanilang mga yumaong mahal sa buhay.
english: He said this is not practical and may hinder the voting of the citizens who usually spend this day to hold their loved ones.

text: Sa ngayon, naghain na si Macalintal ng petisyon sa Korte Suprema upang hilinging baligtarin ang naturang batas at ituloy ang Barangay at SK Elections sa orihinal na petsa ngayong 2025.
english: Macalintal has now filed a petition in the Supreme Court seeking to reverse the said law and continue the Barangay and SK Elections on the original date of 2025.

text: 𝗚𝗘𝗥𝗠𝗔𝗡𝗬 —Narumpag ang isa ka hotel sa Moselle Wine Valley, Germany nga nagpatay sang duha ka tawo, samtang ang mga rescuers ang nagatrabaho sang madali sa pagkuha sang isa ka na-trap nga bisita.
english: 𝗚𝗘𝗥𝗠𝗔𝗡𝗬 —A hotel in Moselle Wine Valley, Germany collapsed killing two people, as rescuers worked frantically to extract a trapped guest.

text: Suno kay rescue operation chief Joerg Teusch, nakuha ang bangkay sang isa ka babaye apang wala pa malab-ot sang mga emergency responders ang bangkay sang ikaduha nga biktima.
english: According to rescue operation chief Joerg Teusch, the body of one woman was recovered but emergency responders have not yet reached the body of the second victim.

text: Anum ka tawo ang naluwas sa sulod sang amo nga adlaw sa isa ka komplikado nga operasyon samtang ang duha ka panalgan ang indi malig-on pagkatapos nga ang ibabaw nga panalgan sini ang narusdak.
english: Six people were rescued during the day in a complex operation while two floors were unstable after its top floor collapsed.

text: Nagsiling naman ang mga prosecutors nga ang hotel gintukod sang ika-17 nga siglo kag ginkay-o sang dekada 80.
english: Prosecutors said the hotel was built in the 17th century and renovated in the 1980s.

text:
Lakip sa mga naluwas amo ang duha ka tuig nga bata, nga wala napilasan, kag ang mga ginikanan sang bata, kon sa diin, ang mga rescuers naka-establisar sang kontak sa sulod sang isa ka gab-i.

Sa subong, indi pa maathag ang gintunaan sang pagkarumpag sang amo nga imprastraktura.
english:
Among those rescued were a two-year-old child, who was not injured, and the child’s parents, with whom, rescuers were able to establish contact overnight.

The cause of the collapse of such infrastructure is currently unclear.

text: Nagapati ang mga imbestigador nga 14 ka tawo ang yara sa hotel sang nagrumpag ang ibabaw nga panalgan, lima sa ila ang nakapalagyo nga wala sang pilas.
english: Investigators believe 14 people were in the hotel when the top floor collapsed, five of whom escaped without injury.

text: Ginpahayag man sang pulis nga 21 ka tawo sa mga puluy-an malapit sa hotel ang kinahanglan nga i-evacuate bangud man sa natabo nga insidente.
english: Police also said 21 people in homes near the hotel had to be evacuated as a result of the incident.

text: OTON, ILOILO – Dakop ang isa ka Muslim nga nagapalapta sang peke nga kwarta sa Oton Public Market.
english: OTON, ILOILO – A Muslim was arrested for spreading counterfeit money in the Oton Public Market.

text: Ang arestado amo si alyas Jahara tumandok sang Sultan Kudarat kag temporaryo naga-istar sa Taguig City.
english: The arrested was identified as Jahara, a native of Sultan Kudarat and temporarily residing in Taguig City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Jahara, iya ginpahayag nga subong lang sila nga adlaw nag-abot sa Iloilo via Aklan Port.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Jahara said they arrived in Iloilo via Aklan Port today.

text: Suno kay Jahara, ginsugo lang siya sang iya abyan nga si certain ”Rabiya” nga mabakal sang prutas, apang likom sa iya ihibalo, peke ang ginhatag sa iya nga P500 nga cash.
english: According to Jahara, she was ordered by her friend certain ”Rabiya” to buy fruit, but secretly to her knowledge, the P500 cash given to her was fake.

text: Ginpahayag sini nga ini ang iya pinakauna nga kahigayunan nga nagpadulong siya sa Iloilo.
english: He said this is his first time to Iloilo.

text: Sang ginrikisa sang mga otoridad, nakuhaan pa gid ini sang dugang pa gid peke nga mga P500 bills.
english: When the authorities searched, they recovered more fake P500 bills.

text: Sa subong, preso na ini sa Oton Municipal Police Station.
english: He is currently detained at the Oton Municipal Police Station.

text: Duha ang pilason sa nagluntad nga shooting incident sa Barangay Ilaya Poblacion, Zarraga, Iloilo subong nga gab-i, Septyembre 16.
english: Two people were injured in a shooting incident in Barangay Ilaya Poblacion, Zarraga, Iloilo tonight, September 16.

text: Ang mga biktima amo sanday Noel Madera, 49, negosyante kag residente sang Barangay Pasil, New Lucena, kag ang ginaalegar helper sini nga si Jake Susal, 25.
english: The victims were identified as Noel Madera, 49, businessman and resident of Barangay Pasil, New Lucena, and his alleged helper Jake Susal, 25.

text: Base sa inisyal nga pagpangusisa, halin sila sa store sa banwa, nagsakay sa tricyle, kag pauli na kuntani sa New Lucena sang natabo ang insidente.
english: Based on initial investigation, they were leaving a store in the town, riding a tricyle, and were on their way home to New Lucena when the incident occurred.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Staff Sergeant Ivan Christian Saludares, imbestigador sa Zarraga Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga may pilas sa tiyan si Noel samtang may samad naman sa wala nga tiil si Jake.
english: Police Staff Sergeant Ivan Christian Saludares, investigator of the Zarraga Municipal Police Station, said Noel sustained injuries to his stomach while Jake sustained injuries to his left leg.

text: Conscious man ang mga ini sang gindala sa ospital sa syudad.
english: They were also conscious when they were brought to the city hospital.

text: Kaupod man nila si Christine nga asawa ni Noel apang wala ini napilasan.
english: Noel's wife, Christine, was also with them but was not injured.

text: Sa inisyal nga impormasyon, ginaalegar nga may baisay pa nga natabo sa tunga sang riding-in-tandem suspects kag mga biktima antes ang pagpangluthang.
english: According to initial information, there was allegedly an argument between the riding-in-tandem suspects and the victims before the shooting.

text: Matapos ang krimen suno kay Saludares, nagpalagyo ang mga suspek pakadto sa direksyon sang town proper.
english: After the crime, Saludares said, the suspects fled in the direction of the town proper.

text: Isa sa ginalantaw nga anggulo amo ang hold-up apang gina-imbestigaran pa ini sang kapulisan.#
english: One of the suspected angles is hold-up but police are still investigating.

text: ILOILO – Bugal sang Iloilo ang isa sa mga umpires sa badminton sa nagapadayon nga 2020 Tokyo Olympics, the Greatest Show on Earth.
english: ILOILO – Iloilo is proud of one of the badminton umpires in the ongoing 2020 Tokyo Olympics, the Greatest Show on Earth.

text: Ini amo si Dr. Ma.
english: This is Dr. Ma.

text: Janelyn Fundal, tumandok sang Parara Norte, Tigbauan, Iloilo, pinuno sang Iloilo Sports Development and Management Office, kag isa man ka Badminton World Federation (BWF) certificated umpire.
english: Janelyn Fundal, a native of Parara Norte, Tigbauan, Iloilo, head of the Iloilo Sports Development and Management Office, and also a Badminton World Federation (BWF) certified umpire.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Fundal, iya ginpahayag nga 43 sila nga umpires nga halin sa lain-lain nga pungsod sa kalibutan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Fundal said they are 43 umpires from different countries of the world.

text: Si Fundal lang ang nagaisahanon nga umpire halin sa Pilipinas.
english: Fundal is the only umpire from the Philippines.

text: Sang 2016, napilian man si Fundal bilang labing-una nga Filipina nga nag-officiate sa hampang sa badminton sang Rio Olympics sa Rio de Janeiro sa Brazil.
english: In 2016, Fundal was also selected as the first Filipina to officiate the badminton match of the Rio Olympics in Rio de Janeiro in Brazil.

text: Pagkatapos sang tournament sa Tokyo, Japan, magabalik man si Fundal sa Iloilo agud tungdan ang iya mga obligasyon bilang pinuno sang Iloilo Sports Development and Management Office.
english: After the tournament in Tokyo, Japan, Fundal will also return to Iloilo to fulfill his obligations as head of the Iloilo Sports Development and Management Office.

text: Bisan ang mga technical officials sa Olympiada subong nga tuig ang nabudlayan kag nasubuan man maglantaw sang set-up sang mga hampang.
english: Even the technical officials at this year's Olympiad found it difficult and sad to watch the set-up of the games.

text: Suno kay Fundal, hotel kag venue lang gid ang sarang mapalapitan sang mga games officials.
english: According to Fundal, only hotels and venues can be approached by games officials.

text: Ginadumilian man sila nga magsulod sa playing venue kun wala man sila sang duty.
english: They are also prohibited from entering the playing venue unless they are on duty.

text: Indi kaangay sa festive vibe sa Rio 2016 Olympics sa Rio de Janeiro sa Brazil, tuman kadamo sang restrictions sa Tokyo, Japan suno kay Fundal bangud sa emergency alert tuga sang COVID-19 pandemic.
english: Unlike the festive vibe at the Rio 2016 Olympics in Rio de Janeiro in Brazil, there are too many restrictions in Tokyo, Japan, Fundal said, due to the emergency alert caused by the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Sa pagkamatuod suno sa iya, wala pa siya nakasugata sa isa sa delegasyon sang Pilipinas subong nga 2021.
english: In fact, he said, he has not met one of the Philippine delegation as of 2021.

text: Pagkatapos sang tournament sa badminton sa Musashino Forest Sport Plaza sa Chōfu, Tokyo, indi na pwede nga makapabilin pa ang mga technical officials bangud may ginpirmahan sila nga kasugtanan nga magpauli na sa ila tagsa ka pungsod.
english: After the badminton tournament at Musashino Forest Sport Plaza in Chōfu, Tokyo, the technical officials were not allowed to stay because they had signed an agreement to return to their respective countries.

text: Nag-isyu ang Japan sang una nga warning sa posibilidad sang “megaquake” kasunod sang 7.1-magnitude nga linog nga nagtay-og sa southern coast sang pungsod.
english: Japan has issued its first warning of the possibility of a “megaquake” following a 7.1-magnitude earthquake that shook the country's southern coast.

text: 4:42 kaina sang hapon sang natabo ang linog apang wala pa sang na-report nga daku nga mga kahalitan ukon seryoso nga injuries.
english: 4:42 pm yesterday when the quake occurred but no major damage or serious injuries have been reported.

text: Sandig sa Japan Meteorological Agency, natabo ang pagtay-og sa coast sang Miyazaki Prefecture sa main island sang Kyushu.
english: According to the Japan Meteorological Agency, the quake occurred off the coast of Miyazaki Prefecture on the main island of Kyushu.

text: Kun basehan ang statement ni Chief Cabinet Secretary Yoshimasa Hayashi, may tatlo ka mga tawo nga nasamaran apang wala sang nabaton nga impormasyon sang blackouts ukon halit sa water kag communications systems sa rehiyon.
english: According to Chief Cabinet Secretary Yoshimasa Hayashi, three people were injured but no information was received of blackouts or damage to water and communications systems in the region.

text: Base naman sa kapulisan sa Miyazaki Prefecture, may 10 ka reports sang damage samtang sa Hayashi, gin-engganyo ang mga residente nga magpalayo anay sa baybayon.
english: According to police in Miyazaki Prefecture, there were 10 reports of damage while in Hayashi, residents were urged to stay away from the beach.

text: Gilayon man nga nagpatawag sang emergency meeting ang mga opisyal agud nga maanalisar kun naapektuhan sang linog ang kaiping nga Nankai Trough.
english: Officials immediately called an emergency meeting to analyze whether the neighboring Nankai Trough was affected by the quake.

text: Gin-isyu ang “mega earthquake caution” kun sa diin na-assess nga mas mataas sa kinaandan ang posibilidad sang daku nga pagtay-og apang wala man nagakahulugan nga matabo gid ini gilayon.
english: A “mega earthquake caution” was issued, which assessed the possibility of a major quake as higher than normal but does not mean that it will happen immediately.

text: Gin-abisuhan man ang mga residente nga magpabilin nga vigilante para sa masunod nga semana para makabakwit pananglitan matabo liwat ang linog.
english: Residents were also advised to remain vigilant for next week to evacuate in case of another earthquake.

text: Suno naman kay Bombo Josel Palma, international correspondent sa Japan, lakip sa ginhaylo nga maghalin anay sa coastal areas (tubtub nga ma-lift ang tsunami advisory) amo ang sa Kochi kag Miyazaki prefectures.
english: According to Bombo Josel Palma, international correspondent in Japan, among those persuaded to leave the coastal areas (until the tsunami advisory is lifted) are those in Kochi and Miyazaki prefectures.

text: Masami nga gina-isyu ang kaangay nga abiso kun ginalauman nga magasobra sa isa ka metro ang kataason sang tsunami waves.
english: Similar warnings are often issued when tsunami waves are expected to exceed one meter in height.

text: Sa Pilipinas, ginklaro sang Phivolcs nga wala sang tsunami threat sa pungsod.
english: In the Philippines, the Phivolcs clarified that there is no tsunami threat in the country.

text: Nagpangaduha sa May 2025 Chemical Engineer Licensure Exam ang isa ka produkto sang University of the Philippines Visayas-Iloilo City.
english: A product of the University of the Philippines Visayas-Iloilo City came second in the May 2025 Chemical Engineer Licensure Exam.

text: Ini amo si Aaron Paul Infante nga may rating nga 88.50%.
english: This is Aaron Paul Infante with a rating of 88.50%.

text: Magluwas diri, sandig sa resulta nga gin-release sang Professional Regulation Commission subong nga gab-i, nagapanguna man ang UP Iloilo City sa top performing schools nga may 100% nga passing rate.
english: Besides, based on the results released by the Professional Regulation Commission tonight, UP Iloilo City also leads the top performing schools with a 100% passing rate.

text: 23 sa 23 examinees halin sa amo nga eskwelahan ang nakapasar.
english: 23 out of 23 examinees from the school passed.

text: Nagapang-apat naman sa lista ang Central Philippine University matapos 12 sa 13 ka examinees halin sa amo nga unibersidad ang nakapasar ukon katumbas sang 92.31% nga rating.
english: Central Philippine University came fourth in the list after 12 out of 13 examinees from the university passed or equivalent to 92.31% rating.

text: Base sa PRC, kabug-usan nga 799 ka mga indibidwal ang nagkuha sini nga exam subong nga bulan, apang 602 lamang ang nakapasar.
english: Based on the PRC, a total of 799 individuals took this exam this month, but only 602 passed.

text: Ginpatigayon ang Chemical Engineering board exams sang May 21-23, 2025, sa PRC testing centers sa NCR, Baguio, Cagayan de Oro, Cebu, Davao, Iloilo, Legazpi, Lucena, kag Rosales.
english: The Chemical Engineering board exams were conducted on May 21-23, 2025, at PRC testing centers in NCR, Baguio, Cagayan de Oro, Cebu, Davao, Iloilo, Legazpi, Lucena, and Rosales.

text: Luyag ni Senator Vicente Sotto III nga ibalik sang Senado ang random drug testing sa tanan nga mga Senate Employee.
english: Senator Vicente Sotto III wants the Senate to restore random drug testing for all Senate Employees.

text: Kasunod ini sa paggamit sang isa sa mga staff sang senador nga naggamit sang marijuana sa Senado.
english: This follows the use of one of the senator's staff who used marijuana in the Senate.

text: Dugang pa sini nga sang tion niya bilang Senate President, nagpatigayon ang Senate Office of the Sergeant at Arms (OSAA) sang optional nga drug test sa mga senador kag random test naman para sa mga empleyado.
english: He added that during his time as Senate President, the Senate Office of the Sergeant at Arms (OSAA) conducted an optional drug test for senators and a random test for employees.

text: Ginakasubo niya bangud sang natapos na ang iya termino kag indi na niya ni mahimo.
english: He is sad because his term is over and he can't do it anymore.

text: Suno sa iya, isa sa makahuluya ang nasambit nga hitabo bangud sa nagguba ang imahe sang Senado.
english: He said the incident was one of the most embarrassing because it damaged the image of the Senate.

text: Nahibaluan nga ginsugid sa OSAA ni Victor Patelo ang security personnel nga naka-assign sa ikalima nga panalgan sang Senate building ang lain nga sahi sang baho halin sa mga CR sang babayi.
english: It was learned that Victor Patelo, the security personnel assigned to the fifth floor of the Senate building, told the OSAA about the different smell from the women's CRs.

text: Ulihi nga nasiplatan nga ulihi nga naggamit sa Comfort Room amo ang actress nga si Nadia Montenegro nga staff subong ni Senator Robin Padilla.
english: Last spotted late using the Comfort Room was actress Nadia Montenegro who is now a staff of Senator Robin Padilla.

text: Bangud sa insidente, ginpa-leave of absence anay ang actress.
english: Due to the incident, the actress was placed on leave of absence.

text: TUNGOD sa pandemya nangin problemado ang aton pungsod – in fact, ang bug-os gid nga kalibutan – sa sulod na sang sobra duha ka tuig sa subong.
english: BECAUSE of the pandemic, our country – in fact, the whole world – has been in trouble for more than two years now.

text: Sa nasiling ta na, madamo ang nawad-an sing trabaho kag nanirado ang madamo nga mga negosyo.
english: As mentioned earlier, many people lost their jobs and many businesses closed.

text: Nagkunol man ang produksyon sang mga kaumhan kag sang iban pa nga pangabuhian.
english: Rural production and other livelihoods also declined.

text: Nagdugang pa dira ang gyera sang Rusya kag Ukraine nga nagpatimbuok sang bili sang petrolyo.
english: In addition, the Russia-Ukraine war has pushed up the price of oil.

text: Nagmahal pa gid ini sa pagnubo sang balor sang Peso kontra US Dollar, nga nagpasaka pa gid sang bili sang halos tanan nga balaklon.
english: This has become even more expensive with the depreciation of the Peso against the US Dollar, which has further increased the price of almost all goods.

text: Gingatungan pa ini sang nagalala nga mga kalamidad tungod sa Climate Change.
english: This is compounded by worsening disasters due to Climate Change.

text: Binulan kita nga nag-antos sa dala sini nga mga kahalitan sa kabuhi, palangitan-an, mga puluy-an kag mga infrastruktura nga tuga sang bagyo, baha, kag iban pa nga kalamidad.
english: We have suffered for months from the damage to life, environment, homes and infrastructure caused by typhoons, floods, and other disasters.

text: Tuga ini sang aton walay kabalaka kag pag-abuso sa ikaayong kahimtangan sang palibut.
english: This is caused by our indifference and abuse of the health of the environment.

text: Paghimulos pa gani ini sang katahum kag pagkamapuslanon sang naturalisa sa aton pagpangabuhi.
english: It is even an exploitation of the beauty and usefulness of naturalization in our lives.

text: Kag kon may ayuda man nga ginahatag ang gobyerno kag ang may ikasarang sa pribado nga sector sa problema sang kadam-an, kulang ini gihapon agud igakalipay sang publiko.
english: And even if there is assistance provided by the government and the capable private sector to the problems of the masses, it is still not enough for the public to enjoy.

text: Nangita na gid lang gani ang iban sang kon ano pa nga medyos agud indi magutman sing lubos.
english: Some are even looking for other ways to avoid starvation.

text:
***

Sunu sa International Labor Organization (ILO), sa Pinas mga 10.9 ka milyon ang nawad-an ubra kag nagnubo ang ila kita sa pagpanugod pa lang sang pandemya.
english:
***

According to the International Labor Organization (ILO), in the Philippines about 10.9 million people lost their jobs and their incomes decreased at the beginning of the pandemic.

text: Ang natam-an amo gid ang mga sector sang manufacturing, transportation kag storage, accommodation (hotels, lodging houses, resorts), food services, lakip na ang arts, entertainment kag recreation.
english: The most affected are the manufacturing, transportation and storage, accommodation (hotels, lodging houses, resorts), food services, as well as the arts, entertainment and recreation sectors.

text: Sang amat-amat na nagkulpa ang aton kakulba batok sa pandemya, nagpabilin ugaling ang kakulang sang palangitan-an kag ang ginakita sang mga workers.
english: As our fears against the pandemic gradually subsided, the lack of jobs and the income of workers remained.

text: Tungod ini sa pagpabilin pa sang epekto sang pandemya kag sang pagtinaas sang bili sang balaklon (inflation) tungod sa madamo lang nga rason.
english: This is due to the continuing impact of the pandemic and inflation for many reasons.

text: Gani, ang panawagan gihapon amo nga matagaan trabaho ang nawad-an sing trabaho, madugangan ang ginakita, kag mabuligan ang magagmay nga mga negosyo.
english: Therefore, the call is still to create jobs for the unemployed, increase incomes, and help small businesses.

text: Matuod, wala man nagapahuway ang DOLE, ang Dept.
english: True, the DOLE is not resting, the Dept.

text: of Trade and Industry (DTI), Dept.
english: of Trade and Industry (DTI), Dept.

text: of Tourism (DOT), kag iban pa nga ahensya agud mapatigayunan sing palangitan-an ang nagaproblema nga mga pumuluyo.
english: of Tourism (DOT), and other agencies to provide shelter to the struggling residents.

text: In fact, yara ang programa sang Tulong Panghanapbuhay sa Ating Disadvantaged / Displaced Workers (TUPAD) sang DOLE kag Go Negosyo sang DTI ng nagabulig sa magagmay nga mga negosyo.
english: In fact, there is the DOLE's Tulong Panghanapbuhay sa Ating Disadvantaged/Displaced Workers (TUPAD) program that helps small businesses.

text: Lakip nga nahatagan trabaho amo ang ginatos nga mga pumuluyo nga ginapabulig sa trabaho sang mga forest rangers sa ila obligasyon agud proteksyunan ang aton kabukiran batok sa panghalit sang Climate Change.
english: Among those employed are hundreds of residents who are being assisted by forest rangers in their obligation to protect our mountains against the damage of Climate Change.

text: Padayon man ang mga job fair sa ila Hiring on the Spot (HOTS) sa bug-os nga pungsod, kon diin bisan ang bag-o nagtapos sang senior high school natagaan man gani sing trabaho agud makabulig na sa ila panimalay.
english: Job fairs also continue with their Hiring on the Spot (HOTS) nationwide, where even new senior high school graduates are given jobs to help their families.

text: Madamo man ang napasulod sa trabaho sa nagkalain-lain nga kahigayunan sa turismo.
english: Many have also been employed in various tourism opportunities.

text: May ayuda man ang gobyerno agud madugangan ang kita sang mga PUV drayber lakip na ang mga pasahero paagi sa libre sakay.
english: The government also provides assistance to increase the income of PUV drivers including passengers through free rides.

text: Nagpakita man sing “optimism” ang mga negosyante sa Stock Exchange Listings, nga ang kapalaran sang ila mga negosyo sa masami gina-basehan sang lakat sang ekonomiya.
english: Businessmen on the Stock Exchange Listings also showed “optimism”, that the fate of their businesses is often based on the course of the economy.

text: In fact, ginpakita nila ini sining ulihi sa pagpataas sang ila stock prices nga nagapahibalo sang pagbaskug na sang ila mga negosyo.
english: In fact, they have shown it recently by raising their stock prices which signals the strengthening of their businesses.

text: Makabulig man diri ang pag-aprub na sang “optional” nga paggamit sang face mask sugod sadtong Setyembre.
english: The approval of the optional use of face masks starting in September will also help.

text: Nagpahapos ini sang pagpangita sang palangitan-an,kag agud ma-enjoy ang kon ano man nga ma-enjoy sa nagbukas na nga ekonomiya sa lain-lain sini nga nawong.
english: This has made it easier to find a job, and to enjoy whatever can be enjoyed in the open economy in its various faces.

text: Makapataas ining pagbukas na sang ekonomiya sang “demand” sa dugang nga mga palangitan-an kag oportunidad nga mamalaklon, nga imposible kon wala sing dugang nga kwarta nga nagalagaw.
english: This opening up of the economy will increase demand for more shopping opportunities and opportunities, which is impossible without more money in circulation.

text: Gani, basi kinahanglan na seguro nga mapanubo ang loan interest rates sang Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas kag sang mga commercial banks agud may dugang na nga kwarta ang publiko para sa nagadugang man nga mga negosyo.
english: Therefore, the Central Bank of the Philippines and the commercial banks may need to lower the loan interest rates so that the public has more money for the growing businesses.

text: No problem ini kay ma-offset naman sang dugang nga “money supply” nga kitaon sang dugang nga workers nga magamit sang ila pamilya sa pagpamakal sang ila kinahanglanon halin sa dugang nga mga negosyo.
english: This is no problem because it will be offset by the additional money supply that more workers will earn that their families can use to buy their necessities from more businesses.

text: Sa pagbalanse sang “money supply” kag “demand” sa balaklon, as a result, wala kita dapat mapaabot nga dugang nga pagtaas sang inflation.
english: With the balance of “money supply” and “demand” in goods, as a result, we should not expect further increase in inflation.

text: Good luck sa aton tanan sa ining pagbukas na sang aton ekonomiya!
english: Good luck to all of us in this opening of our economy!

text: Tani sige-sige na ini!/PN
english: I hope it keeps going!/PN

text: Arestado na sang kapulisan ang mga suspek nga ginatudlo yara sa likod sang pagpatay kanday Police Senior Master Sergeant Diane Marie Mollenido kag sa otso-anyos nga bata sini nga lalaki nga si John Ysmael.
english: Police have arrested the suspects allegedly behind the murder of Police Senior Master Sergeant Diane Marie Mollenido and her eight-year-old son John Ysmael.

text: Suno kay National Capital Region Police Office (NCPRO) Chief PMGen Anthony Aberin, nadakpan sa Quezon City ang mga suspek.
english: National Capital Region Police Office (NCPRO) Chief PMGen Anthony Aberin said the suspects were arrested in Quezon City.

text: Ini amo ang isa ka car agent kag iya bana nga isa ka dismissed police officer.
english: It was a car agent and her dismissed police officer husband.

text: Sa inisyal nga reports, kaina sang kaagahon natigayon nga pag-aresto.
english: According to initial reports, the arrest was made yesterday morning.

text: Natalana pa nga ipatpat sang mga kapulisan ang pag-aresto kag ang dugang nga detalye sa identity sang nagkaladakpan.
english: Police are scheduled to clarify the arrest and further details on the identity of the suspects.

text: Matandaan nga nasapwan ang bangkay sang iloy sa Enero 24 sa creek sa Pulilan–Baliuag Bypass Road sa Barangay Dulong Malabon, Pulilan, Bulacan.
english: The mother's body was found on January 24 in a creek on the Pulilan-Baliuag Bypass Road in Barangay Dulong Malabon, Pulilan, Bulacan.

text: Lima ka adlaw ang nagligad, nakit-an si John Ysmael sa maligwin nga lugar sa Barangay Maluid, Victoria, Tarlac.
english: Five days ago, John Ysmael was found in a secluded area in Barangay Maluid, Victoria, Tarlac.

text: Pareho na nga yara sa advanced state of decomposition ang mga bangkay sang nasapwan.
english: Both bodies were in an advanced state of decomposition when they were found.

text: Napatay si Sergeant Mollenido bangud sa samad tuga sang pagkatiro sa iya nga ulo, samtang napatay naman ang bata bangud sa asphyxia ukon kakulang sa hangin.
english: Sergeant Mollenido died of gunshot wounds to the head, while the child died of asphyxia.

text: Sandig sa pamilya, ulihi nakit-an nga buhi ang mag-iloy sang Enero 16, kag opisyal nga gin-report sa awtoridad nga missing sila sang Enero 19.
english: According to the family, the mother and daughter were last seen alive on January 16, and were officially reported missing on January 19.

text: Sa inisyal nga imbestigasyon, natalana kuntani sila nga makigkita sa car agent sa Novaliches, Quezon matapos magbaligya sang salakyan.
english: According to initial investigation, they were scheduled to meet with a car agent in Novaliches, Quezon after selling the vehicle.

text: Magapatigayon man ang pulis sang DNA tests sa mga biktima matapos may nakit-an nga tinulo sang dugo kadungan sang pag-conduct sang luminol test sa balay sang agent sa Quezon.
english: Police will also conduct DNA tests on the victims after a drop of blood was found during the conduct of a luminol test at the agent's house in Quezon.

text: Gina-establisar pa sang kapulisan kun ano ang motibo sa likod sang krimen.#
english: Police are still establishing the motive behind the crime.

text: Kun nagahatag gani sang donasyon, dapat nga santo ini sa aton nga kabubut-on, dapat nga wala ginapilit, kag dapat nga indi pakita-kita lamang.
english: When we give a donation, it should be voluntary, not under compulsion, and not just for show.

text: Apang kun halimbawa, aksidente mo lang ini nga nahatag, may kinamatarong ayhan ikaw nga bawion?
english: But if, for example, you accidentally gave it, do you have the right to take it back?

text: Amo ini subong ang gina-debatehan sa India matapos aksidente nga nahulog sang isa ka lalaki ang iya malahalon nga cellphone sa sulod sang collection box sa templo.
english: This is now the subject of debate in India after a man accidentally dropped his expensive cellphone inside a collection box at a temple.

text: Nagbisita ini nga lalaki sa Arulmigu Kandaswamy Temple sa Thiruporur kaupod ang iya pamilya agud nga magpangamuyo.
english: This man visited the Arulmigu Kandaswamy Temple in Thiruporur with his family to offer prayers.

text: Naglusot sa iya bulsa ang cellphone kag nagtupa sa “hundial” nga amo ang metal donation box samtang nagahatag siya sang donasyon sa patron deity sang templo.
english: The cellphone slipped out of his pocket and landed on the “hundial” which is a metal donation box while he was giving a donation to the patron deity of the temple.

text: Sunod nga nagkadto ang lalaki sa mga opisyal sang templo kag naghingyo kun pwede nga mabalik sa iya ang cellphone bangud indi man ini donasyon.
english: The man next went to the temple officials and asked if the cellphone could be returned to him because it was not a donation.

text: Sa iya kakibot, nagpamalibad ang mga opisyal bangud may pagsulundan sila nga kun ano man ang mabutang sa donation box, iya na ini sang deity kag indi na pag-ibalik.
english: To his surprise, the officials refused because they had a rule that whatever was put in the donation box belonged to the deity and could not be returned.

text: Suno pa sa Minister of Hindu Religious and Charitable Endowments, ang anuman nga halad sa deity — bisan nga boluntaryo man ukon aksidente — ang makabig na nga propiedad sang Diyos.
english: According to the Minister of Hindu Religious and Charitable Endowments, any offering to the deity — whether voluntary or accidental — is considered the property of God.

text: Nag-insister pa ang lalaki paagi sa pag-file sang complaint, apang sang ginbuksan ang donation box subong nga bulan, nangluya gid ang lalaki bangud wala gid nagpalingkang ang temple officials kag ginpanindugan gid ang ila desisyon.
english: The man insisted by filing a complaint, but when the donation box was opened this month, the man was very discouraged because the temple officials did not hesitate and insisted on their decision.

text: Ang ila lang gintugutan amo nga makuha sang lalaki ang data halin sa iya cellphone.#
english: All they allowed was for the man to get the data from his cellphone.#

text: Maga-atubangay ang Bulgaria kag ang defending champions nga Italy sa finals sang 2025 FIVB Volleyball Men’s World Championship nga ginahiwat diri sa Pilipinas.
english: Bulgaria will face defending champions Italy in the finals of the 2025 FIVB Volleyball Men’s World Championship being held here in the Philippines.

text: Ginlutos sang World No.
english: World No.

text: 9 team nga Bulgaria ang No.
english: 9 team Bulgaria is No.

text: 17 nga Czechia sa semifinals agud maka-abante sa championship round nga amo ang ila una nga pagtapak sa finals halin sang 1970.
english: 17 Czechia in the semifinals to advance to the championship round, their first appearance in the finals since 1970.

text: Samtang, nakuha naman sang World No.
english: Meanwhile, World No.

text: 2 kag defending champions nga Italy ang ulihi nga pwesto sa finals matapos ginpierde ang World No.
english: 2 and defending champions Italy finished last in the finals after beating World No.

text: 1 nga Poland.
english: 1 Poland.

text: Ginpangunahan naman ini sang ila nga team captain kag setter nga si Simone Giannelli agud makuha ang straight-set win pinaagi sa 24 ka excellent sets kag siyam ka digs.
english: Team captain and setter Simone Giannelli led the way to the straight-set win with 24 excellent sets and nine digs.

text: Ini na ang ikaanum nga World Championship final appearance sang Italya.
english: This is Italy's sixth World Championship final appearance.

text: Apat sa lima sa ila katapusan nga apperances ang ila nadag-an lakip na ang “three-peat” sang 1990, 1994, kag 1998.
english: They won four out of five of their last appearances including the “three-peat” in 1990, 1994, and 1998.

text: Ginmando sang Quezon City Regional Trial Court Branch 93 ang pag-aresto kilala nga showbiz columnist Cristy Fermin kag co-hosts sini nga sanday Rommel Villamor kag Wendell Alvarez.
english: The Quezon City Regional Trial Court Branch 93 ordered the arrest of well-known showbiz columnist Cristy Fermin and her co-hosts Rommel Villamor and Wendell Alvarez.

text: Ini may kaangtanan sa kaso nga cyberlibel nga gin-file sang aktres nga si Bea Alonzo sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: This is in connection with the cyberlibel lawsuit filed by actress Bea Alonzo last year.

text: Sa court order nga napetsahan sang Hulyo 21, 2025, ginsiling ni Presiding Judge Cherry Chiara Hernando nga may yara sila sang nakita nga “probable cause” agud ipaidalom sa trial ang mga akusado.
english: In a court order dated July 21, 2025, Presiding Judge Cherry Chiara Hernando said they have found “probable cause” to bring the accused to trial.

text: Nagtalana man ang korte sang P48,000 nga pyansa sa tagsa ka TV hosts.
english: The court also set bail of P48,000 for each of the TV hosts.

text: Madumdoman nga nagpasaka si Bea sang libel case batok kay Fermin sang Mayo 2024 bangud sa ginaalegar nga wala sang kamatuoran kag malisyoso nga mga impormasyon nga ginawaragwag sang host sa iya nga online show angot sa ila pagbulagay sang ex-fiancé sini nga si Dominic Roque.
english: Bea filed a libel case against Fermin in May 2024 for allegedly false and malicious information spread by the host on her online show regarding her breakup with her ex-fiancé Dominic Roque.

text: Dugang sini, gin-akusar man Bea si Fermin angot sa alegasyon nga wala ini gabayad sang buwis ini base sa ginpasaka nga kaso sang iya driver.
english: In addition, Bea also accused Fermin of allegedly not paying taxes based on the case filed by his driver.

text: Ginapanan-aw nga magalab-ot sa halos four million metric tons (MT) ang iga-procure nga bugas sang Pilipinas sa 2026.
english: The Philippines is expected to procure nearly four million metric tons (MT) of rice by 2026.

text: Ini bangud maga-resume na ang rice importation sa Enero kasunod sang apat ka bulan nga importing ban nga ginpatuman sang gobyerno agud nga mapabilin nga estable ang farm-gate prices sang humay sa pungsod.
english: This is because rice importation will resume in January following the four-month import ban imposed by the government to keep farm-gate prices of rice stable in the country.

text: Suno kay Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr., magadangat ang import volumes sa tunga-tunga sang 3.6 million kag 3.8 million metric tons.
english: According to Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr., import volumes will reach between 3.6 million and 3.8 million metric tons.

text: Lakip sa ginakonsiderar nga factor amo ang forecast sang Department of Agriculture (DA) nga magalab-ot sa 20.3-million MT ang palay production sa masunod nga tuig.
english: Among the factors being considered is the forecast of the Department of Agriculture (DA) that rice production will reach 20.3-million MT next year.

text: Ini ang pareho man sa target kuntani subong nga tuig, apang indi malab-ot bangud sa epekto sang mga pagbaha kag iban pa nga problema dala sang mga bagyo.
english: This is the same target as this year, but could not be reached due to the impact of floods and other problems caused by typhoons.

text: Kun mag-umpisa naman ang rice importation sa Enero tubtub sa Pebrero, limitahan lamang ini sa 17 ka mga pantalan sa bilog nga pungsod.
english: If rice importation starts from January to February, it will be limited to 17 ports nationwide.

text: Lakip diri ang Manila, Batangas, Tacloban, Bacolod, Iligan, Cagayan de Oro, Davao, Zamboanga, Cebu, Iloilo, Capiz, Tagbilaran, Dumaguete, Subic, Calbayog, General Santos, kag ang Tabaco.
english: These include Manila, Batangas, Tacloban, Bacolod, Iligan, Cagayan de Oro, Davao, Zamboanga, Cebu, Iloilo, Capiz, Tagbilaran, Dumaguete, Subic, Calbayog, General Santos, and Tabaco.

text: Nagpadala ang Estados Unidos sang Amerika sang dugang nga warship sa Middle East samtang nga nagadaku ang tensyon sang pungsod batok sa Iran.
english: The United States has sent more warships to the Middle East as tensions against Iran rise.

text: Sandig sa inisyal nga reports, ang pinakaulihi nga nag-abot sa rehiyon amo ang USS Delbert D. Black.
english: According to initial reports, the latest to arrive in the region is the USS Delbert D. Black.

text: Gindesinyo ini nga warship para sa multi-mission capabilities lakip na para sa air warfare, anti-submarine warfare, naval surface fire support, kag surface warfare.
english: This warship is designed for multi-mission capabilities including for air warfare, anti-submarine warfare, naval surface fire support, and surface warfare.

text: Bangud sini, nagdangat na sa anum ang destroyers sang Estados Unidos nga naka-posisyon sa Middle East, magluwas pa sa aircraft carrier kag tatlo ka iban pa nga littoral combat ships.
english: This brings the total number of US destroyers positioned in the Middle East to six, in addition to an aircraft carrier and three other littoral combat ships.

text: Manotisyaran nga pareho ini sa deployment nga nakita sang nagligad nga tuig sang ginsaylo man sa rehiyon ang US air defense hardware pananglitan magbalos ang Iran bangud sa pagbomba sang US sa tatlo ka Iranian nuclear sites kadungan sang gyera sang Israel kag Iran sang Hunyo.
english: It is noteworthy that this is similar to the deployment seen last year when US air defense hardware was also transferred to the region in case Iran retaliated for the US bombing of three Iranian nuclear sites during the Israeli-Iranian war in June.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, sa Iran, may nag-abot naman nga 1,000 drones sa nagkalain-lain nga sangay sang Army samtang ginahandaan ang posible nga military confrontation.
english: Meanwhile, in Iran, 1,000 drones have arrived from various branches of the Army while preparing for a possible military confrontation.

text: Ini nga development sa tunga sang duha ka magkaaway nga pungsod ang kasunod sang pagpamahog liwat ni US President Donald Trump nga bombahan sini ang Iran kun indi ini magsugot nga magnegosyar para sa bag-o nga nuclear deal.
english: The development between the two rival countries follows US President Donald Trump's recent threat to bomb Iran if it does not agree to negotiate a new nuclear deal.

text: Ginmensyonar ni Trump nga magapadala siya sang ‘armada’ ukon madamo nga mga warship, kag nagpaandam man sang posible nga military action kasunod sang anti-government protests sa Tehran.#
english: Trump mentioned that he would send an 'army' or many warships, and also warned of possible military action following anti-government protests in Tehran.#

text: 16 ka mga abogado ang nag-file sang ‘Appearance ad Cuatelam’ agud depensahan si Vice President Sara Duterte sa impeachment proceedings sa House Committee on Justice.
english: 16 ka mga abogado ang nag-file sang ‘Appearance ad Cuatelam’ agud depensahan si Vice President Sara Duterte sa impeachment proceedings sa House Committee on Justice.

text: Ini ginalakipan nanday Philip Sigfrid Fortun, David Ronell Golla VII, Lindon Miguel Bacquel,Gregorio Narvasa II, Sheila Sison, Carlo Joaquin Narvasa, Justin Nicol Gular, Miguel Carlos Fernandez, Karol Grace Oroceo, Clarlaine Radoc, kag Francesca Marie Flores.
english: Ini ginalakipan nanday Philip Sigfrid Fortun, David Ronell Golla VII, Lindon Miguel Bacquel,Gregorio Narvasa II, Sheila Sison, Carlo Joaquin Narvasa, Justin Nicol Gular, Miguel Carlos Fernandez, Karol Grace Oroceo, Clarlaine Radoc, kag Francesca Marie Flores.

text: Ang mga ini ang lunsay halin sa Fortun Narvasa & Salaza law firm.
english: They are both from the Fortun Narvasa & Salaza law firm.

text: Yara man sanday Michael Wesley Poa, Reynold Munsayac, Mark Vinluan, Ralph Bodota kag Roberto Batungbacal.
english: Also present were Michael Wesley Poa, Reynold Munsayac, Mark Vinluan, Ralph Bodota and Roberto Batungbacal.

text: Kasunod sini, nagpahayag sang pagkadismaya si Bicol Saro party-list Rep.
english: Subsequently, Bicol Saro party-list Rep.

text: Terry Ridon bangud duha sa nasambit nga mga abogado nga sanday Poa kag Munsayac ang may conflict of interest bangud nalakip sila sa posible testigo sa paggasto sang confidential funds sang bise presidente.
english: Terry Ridon because two of the said lawyers, Poa and Munsayac, have a conflict of interest because they are among the possible witnesses in the spending of the vice president's confidential funds.

text: Si Poa ang anay tagpamaba ni VP Sara sang tiglikom ini sang DepEd.
english: Poa was the former spokesperson of VP Sara when he was DepEd secretary.

text: Si Munsayac naman ang spokesperson sang Office of the Vice President (OVP) kag former assistant secretary sa DepEd.
english: Munsayac is the spokesperson of the Office of the Vice President (OVP) and former assistant secretary in DepEd.

text: ILOILO CITY- Pilason ang mag-asawa matapos ginluthang samtang nagahiwat sang birthday party sa ila balay sa Barangay Jibao-an, Pavia, Iloilo.
english: ILOILO CITY- A couple was injured after being shot while holding a birthday party at their house in Barangay Jibao-an, Pavia, Iloilo.

text: Ang mga biktima amo sanday alyas June kag Mae samtang ang suspek amo si alyas Philip.
english: The victims were identified as June and Mae while the suspect was identified as Philip.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Lieutenant Russell Husmalaga, Deputy Chief of Police sang Pavia Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga base sa imbestigasyon, birthday sang lalaki nga biktima rason nga may selebrasyon sa ila balay kag may nagakanta sa videoke.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Lieutenant Russell Husmalaga, Deputy Chief of Police of Pavia Municipal Police Station, said that based on the investigation, it was the victim's birthday.

text: Suno kay Husmalaga, may yara man sang nagainom sa pihak nga balay kun sa diin yara ang suspek nga paryente man lang sang mga biktima.
english: According to Husmalaga, there was also a drinker in the other house where the suspect was, who is also a relative of the victims.

text: Ginpahayag ni Husmalaga nga samtang naga-videoke ang mga biktima pasado las-tres sa kaagahon, ginsaway ang mga ini rason nga ila ginkadtuan ang suspek kag didto natabo ang pagbaisay.
english: Husmalaga said that while the victims were videoke around 3:00 am, they were reprimanded and they went to the suspect and there was an argument.

text: Ginsundan ini sang paggabot sang suspek sang pusil kag ginluthang ang mga biktima.
english: This was followed by the suspect pulling out a gun and shooting the victims.

text: Naigo sa tiyan ang bana samtang naigo naman sa abaga ang asawa.
english: The husband was hit in the stomach while the wife was hit in the shoulder.

text: Madasig naman nga nalagyo ang suspek kag padayon pa nga ginapangita sang otoridad.
english: The suspect fled the scene and is still being sought by the police.

text: Ginabulong naman sa ospital ang mag-asawa.
english: The couple are being treated at the hospital.

text: Sa baylo nga monthly basis, himuon na nga tag-15 ka adlaw ukon tunga sa bulan ang pagreview sang community quarantine classification sa Pilipinas.
english: Instead of a monthly basis, the review of the community quarantine classification in the Philippines will be done every 15 days or half a month.

text: Suno kay Presidential Spokesperson Harry Roque, himuon ini sang national COVID-19 inter-agency task force kada 15 ka adlaw agud matumod gilayon kun may surge na sang Delta coronavirus variant sa lain lain nga mga lugar.
english: According to Presidential Spokesperson Harry Roque, the national COVID-19 inter-agency task force will do this every 15 days to immediately identify if there is a surge of the Delta coronavirus variant in different areas.

text: Matandaan nga sang nagligad lang nga semana ginkumpirma sang Department of Health nga may local transmission na sang delta variant sa Pilipinas.
english: Last week, the Department of Health confirmed that there is a local transmission of the delta variant in the Philippines.

text: Lunsay yara na sa Alasla sanday US Pres.
english: Both US Pres.

text: Donal Trump kag Russian President Vladimir Putin para sa patigayunon nga sinapol.
english: Donal Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin for the upcoming meeting.

text: Personal nga nagkamustahanay ang duha ka mga lider pagpanaog pa lamang sang tagsa-tagsa ka mga eroplano.
english: The two leaders personally greeted each other as soon as their respective planes disembarked.

text: Suno sa White House, indi na ini ang mangin one-one meetion bangud sa makaupod sa sinapol ni Trump sanday Secretary of State Marco Rubio kag special envoy Steve Witkoff.
english: According to the White House, it will not be a one-on-one meeting because Trump will be accompanied by Secretary of State Marco Rubio and special envoy Steve Witkoff.

text: May yara man sang post-meeting lunch nga pagtambongan nanday Rubi, Witkoff, Tresury Secretary Scott Bessent, Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, , Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth kag Trump’s chief of staff Susie Wiles.
english: There will also be a post-meeting lunch attended by Rubi, Witkoff, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, , Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth and Trump’s chief of staff Susie Wiles.

text: Ginalauman nga isa sa mga sapolan sang duha ka lider amo ceasefire sa tunga sang Russia kag Ukraine.
english: One of the agreements between the two leaders is expected to be a ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine.

text: Una na nga gin-engganyo sang European Leader nga dapat maupod sa sinapol si Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky.
english: Earlier, the European Leader urged that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky should be included in the meeting.

text: Ginsiling naman ni Trump nga kun magmadinalag-on ang sinapol nanday Putin magapatigayon liwat sila sang meeting kaupod na si Zelensky.
english: Trump said that if the meeting with Putin is successful, they will hold another meeting with Zelensky.

text: Duha ka mga eskwelahan sa Iloilo ang ginkilala nga top performing schools sa May 2025 Chemical Engineers Computer-Based Licensure Examination.
english: Two schools in Iloilo have been recognized as top performing schools in the May 2025 Chemical Engineers Computer-Based Licensure Examination.

text: Ini amo ang Central Philippine University kag ang University of the Philippines Visayas-Iloilo City.
english: These are the Central Philippine University and the University of the Philippines Visayas-Iloilo City.

text: Sandig sa resulta nga gin-release sang Professional Regulation Commission subong nga gab-i, nagapanguna ang UP Iloilo City nga may 100% nga passing rate.
english: According to the results released by the Professional Regulation Commission tonight, UP Iloilo City is leading with a 100% passing rate.

text: Naka-produce man ini sang topnotcher nga si Aaron Paul dela Cruz Infante, Rank 2, nga may rating nga 88.50%.
english: It also produced topnotcher Aaron Paul dela Cruz Infante, Rank 2, with a rating of 88.50%.

text: Magluwas diri, yara man sa lista ang CPU nga nagapang-apat sa nagapanguna nga mga eskwelahan.
english: Besides, CPU is also on the list which is ranked fourth among the top schools.

text: 12 sa 13 ka examinees halin sa amo nga unibersidad ang nakapasar ukon katumbas sang 92.31% nga rating.
english: 12 out of 13 examinees from the university passed or equivalent to 92.31% rating.

text: Base sa PRC, kabug-usan nga 799 ka mga indibidwal ang nagkuha sini nga exam subong nga bulan, apang 602 lamang ang nakapasar.
english: Based on the PRC, a total of 799 individuals took this exam this month, but only 602 passed.

text: Ginpatigayon ang Chemical Engineering board exams sang May 21-23, 2025, sa PRC testing centers sa NCR, Baguio, Cagayan de Oro, Cebu, Davao, Iloilo, Legazpi, Lucena, kag Rosales.
english: The Chemical Engineering board exams were conducted on May 21-23, 2025, at PRC testing centers in NCR, Baguio, Cagayan de Oro, Cebu, Davao, Iloilo, Legazpi, Lucena, and Rosales.

text: Nagsaka ang kaso sang dengue sa probinsya sang Iloilo subong nga tuig, base sa pinakabag-o nga datos halin sa Iloilo Provincial Health Office.
english: The number of dengue cases in Iloilo province has increased this year, based on the latest data from the Iloilo Provincial Health Office.

text: Sa Interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Maeden Quiñon, ang Health Promotion Unit Head sang nasambit nga ahensya, iya ginpahayag nga naglab-ot na sa 1,733 ang kaso sang dengue nga narecord subong nga tuig kun sa diin siyam gid diri ang napatay.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Maeden Quiñon, the Health Promotion Unit Head of the agency, said that 1,733 dengue cases have been recorded this year with nine deaths.

text: Suno kay Quiñon, ini nga numero ang mas mataas kumparar sa 983 ka kaso nga na-record sang nagligad nga tuig kun sa diin nagsaka ini sang 77%.
english: According to Quiñon, this number is higher compared to the 983 cases recorded last year which increased by 77%.

text: Ang pinakaulihi nga biktima sang dengue amo duha ka tuig nga bata nga lalaki nga tumandok sang Sara, Iloilo kun sa diin ginbawian ini sang kabuhi sang Abril sini nga tuig.
english: The latest dengue victim is a two-year-old boy from Sara, Iloilo who died in April this year.

text: Padayon nga nagahingyo ang IPHO sa publiko nga mag-practice sang 4S Strategy Kontra Dengue kag siguraduhon gid nga magpanglimpyo sa palibot agud malikawan ang pagdamo sang lamok.
english: The IPHO continues to urge the public to practice the 4S Strategy Against Dengue and be sure to keep the environment clean to prevent the spread of mosquitoes.

text: ILOILO CITY- Labi pa nga naglala ang kaso sang anti- immigrants violence sa nagkalain-lain nga parte sang United Kingdom kag ginakabig ini nga pinakamalala nga sahi sang pagpang-atake batok sa mga dumuluong sa sulod sang masobra isa ka dekada.
english: ILOILO CITY – Cases of anti-immigrant violence have worsened in various parts of the United Kingdom and are considered the worst form of attack against foreigners in more than a decade.

text: Suno kay Bombo Steven Mark Espinosa, international correspondent sa United Kingdom, ang paglupok sang amo nga anti- immigrants violence ang kasunod sang isa man ka anti-immigrant misinformation campaign nga tuga sang insidente sang pagpangbuno sa isa ka dance class sa Southport, northern England kun sa diin tatlo ka mga bata ang napatay.
english: According to Bombo Steven Mark Espinosa, international correspondent in the United Kingdom, the outbreak of anti-immigrants violence follows a similar anti-immigrant misinformation campaign caused by the shooting incident at a dance class in Southport, northern England where three children were killed.

text: Ginpahayag ni Espinosa nga may pila ka Filipino nurses nga nagatrabaho sa National Health Service ang wala man ginpalampuwas sa kalakasan matapos ginpanghaboy sang bato ang mga ini sang mga rioters.
english: Espinosa said some Filipino nurses working in the National Health Service were not spared the violence after the rioters threw stones at them.

text: Sa subong, yara na sa 370 ka tawo ang naaresto kasunod sang nasambit nga pagpang-atake ilabi na sa mga immigrants.
english: So far, 370 people have been arrested following the attacks, especially on immigrants.

text: Matandaan nga kasunod sang knife attack, naglapta ang sala nga impormasyon sa insidente nga nagasiling nga ang 17-anyos nga suspek ang isa ka immigrant, nga gilayon nagresulta sa anti-Muslim kag anti-immigrant protests.
english: Following the knife attack, false information spread that the 17-year-old suspect was an immigrant, which immediately resulted in anti-Muslim and anti-immigrant protests.

text: Gin-athag naman sang otoridad nga ang suspek ang ginbun-ag sa Britanya.
english: Authorities clarified that the suspect was born in Britain.

text: ILOILO CITY- Madayon na gid ang pagpatindog sang oil depot sang Grayhorse Energy Inc.
english: ILOILO CITY – The construction of the oil depot of Grayhorse Energy Inc.

text: sa 10-ektaryas nga lote sa Talusan, Dumangas, Iloilo sa pihak sang pagpamalabag sang pila ka stakeholders.
english: on a 10-hectare lot in Talusan, Dumangas, Iloilo despite the objections of some stakeholders.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dumangas Mayor Ronaldo Golez, iya ginpahayag nga aprubado na sa Sangguniang Bayan ang amo nga proyekto.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Dumangas Mayor Ronaldo Golez said the project has already been approved by the Sangguniang Bayan.

text: Suno kay Golez, nag-agi ini sa husto nga proseso kaangay sang public hearing kag sa subong, ginahulat nalang nga ma-comply sang amo nga kompaniya ang iban nga ginakinahanglan nga mga permits agud maumpisahan na ang amo nga proyekto.
english: According to Golez, it went through the proper process such as public hearing and now, the company is waiting to comply with the other required permits to start the project.

text: Matandaan nga hugot nga ginabalabagan sang Iloilo Fish Producers Association sa pagpamuno sang presidente nga si Tomas Hautea ang amo nga proyekto bangud sa kahangawa nga sa tion nga magleak ang pipe sang oil depot kag magkadto sa dagat,pat-od nga madulaan sang palangabuhian ang madamo nga mga fisherfolks.
english: It can be recalled that the Iloilo Fish Producers Association led by president Tomas Hautea is strongly opposing the project due to concerns that if the pipe of the oil depot leaks and goes into the sea, many fisherfolks will lose their livelihood.

text: Mangin ang Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources ang nagpahayag man sang pagpamatok sa proyekto apang suno kay Golez, kon basehan ang Local Government Code, may poder ang isa ka Local Government Unit sa pagdesisyon sa mga proyekto nga luyag sini pasudlon ukon ipatuman sa ila banwa.
english: Even the Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources also expressed opposition to the project but according to Golez, based on the Local Government Code, a Local Government Unit has the power to decide on projects that it wants to include or implement in their town.

text: Napaslawan ang pinay weightlifter nga si Elreen Ann Ando nga makakuha sang medalya sa nagapadayon nga Tokyo 2020 Olympics.
english: Filipino weightlifter Elreen Ann Ando failed to medal in the ongoing Tokyo 2020 Olympics.

text: Ika-pito sa pwesto si Ando sa Women’s 64kg Group A sa diin nakatipon siya sang total score nga 222.
english: Ando finished seventh in the Women’s 64kg Group A with a total score of 222.

text: Suno kay Bombo Samurai International Correspondent Josel Palma, direkta sa Japan, sa snatch event, na-alsa ni Ando ang 96kg sa iya first attempt apang napaslawan ang Cebuana weightlifter sa iya 99kg sa second attempt.
english: According to Bombo Samurai International Correspondent Josel Palma, live in Japan, in the snatch event, Ando lifted 96kg in his first attempt but the Cebuana weightlifter failed with his 99kg in the second attempt.

text: Sa clean and jerk, gintapos sang atleta ang iya 122kg lift sa third attempt.
english: In the clean and jerk, the athlete completed her 122kg lift on the third attempt.

text: Ang gold medal ang nakuha sang tiglawas sang Canada nga si Maude Charron matapos narekord ang total lift nga 236 kg.
english: The gold medal was won by Canadian representative Maude Charron after recording a total lift of 236 kg.

text: Samtang nakuha naman ni Giorgua Bordignon sang Italya nga may total lift record nga 232 kg ang silver medal kag ang bronze medal naman ang nakuha sang Chinese-Taipei nga si Chen Wen-Huei nga may 230kg nga lift record.
english: Meanwhile, Giorgua Bordignon of Italy with a total lift record of 232 kg won the silver medal and the bronze medal went to Chinese-Taipei's Chen Wen-Huei with a lift record of 230 kg.

text: Sa pihak sini, nakasulod na sa semifinals ang Pinay swimmer nga si Remedy Rule sa women’s 200m butterfly matapos nakuha ang ika-15 nga pwesto.
english: Meanwhile, Filipina swimmer Remedy Rule has already entered the semifinals in the women's 200m butterfly after taking 15th place.

text: Gintapos ni Rule ang hampang sa 59.68 seconds.
english: Rule finished the match in 59.68 seconds.

text: Apang napaslawan naman ang Pinoy swimmer nga si Luke Gebbie nga maka-abante sa semifinals sang men’s 100 freestyle.
english: However, Filipino swimmer Luke Gebbie failed to advance to the semifinals of the men's 100 freestyle.

text: Tuman nga kalisod ang nabatyagan sang isa ka pamilya sa Purok 2, Barangay San Geronimo, Bagabag, Nueva Vizcaya matapos naubos patay ang ila mga hinuptanan nga ido kadungan sang sunog sa ila nga balay.
english: A family in Purok 2, Barangay San Geronimo, Bagabag, Nueva Vizcaya was devastated after their pet dogs were killed in a fire in their house.

text: Santo sa imbestigasyon sang Bureau of Fire (BFP) Bagabag, ang 29-anyos nga anak ang una nga naka-notisyar sang baho sang sunog tubtub nga nakit-an sini nga may kalayo na nga naga-guwa halin sa kuwarto.
english: According to the investigation of the Bureau of Fire (BFP) Bagabag, the 29-year-old son first noticed the smell of fire until he saw that there was fire coming out of the room.

text: Gintinguhaan sini nga mapalong ang kalayo, apang nagpadayon ini sa paglapta gani sang ulihi, nangayo na ini sang bulig.
english: He tried to put out the fire, but it kept spreading so eventually, he called for help.

text: Ginkamang pa sang tag-iya ang ila mga hinuptanan nga mga ido para masalbar, apang ang iloy lang nga Shih Tzu ang nahingagaw sini bangud nga dako na katama ang kalayo.
english: The owners even grabbed their pet dogs to rescue them, but only the mother Shih Tzu was rescued because the fire was so big.

text: Suno pa sa BFP, sang nakaguwa na sila sa balay, naglukso ang iloy nga ido kag ginbalikan ang iya mga tutoy.
english: According to the BFP, when they got out of the house, the mother dog jumped up and returned to her puppies.

text: Tanan sila ang wala gid nakaluwas sa amo nga insidente.
english: All of them never survived that incident.

text: Nagaguwa man sa imbestigasyon sang fire authority nga nagsugod ang sunog sa electric fan nga nakatutok sa mga Shih Tzu sa isa ka kuwarto.
english: The fire authority's investigation also revealed that the fire started from an electric fan that was focused on the Shih Tzus in a room.

text: Ginalantaw nga nag-overheat ang fan kag naglupok ang mga bombilya.#
english: It is believed that the fan overheated and the bulbs burst.#

text: ILOILO CITY- P2.5M pesos gikan sa Zamboanga City Government ang batunon nga incentive sang 2020 Tokyo Olympics gold medalist nga si Hidilyn Diaz nga tumandok sang Brgy.
english: ILOILO CITY- P2.5M pesos from the Zamboanga City Government will be given to 2020 Tokyo Olympics gold medalist Hidilyn Diaz, a native of Brgy.

text: Mambang sa amo nga syudad.
english: Mambang in the same city.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Zamboanga City Councilor Elbert Bong Atilano, iya ginpahayag nga santo sa ila ginpasar nga ordinansa, magluwas kay Diaz, may batunon man nga P1,250,000 nga incentive ang iya boyfriend kag nagaserbe man sini bilang coach nga si Julius Irvin Naranjo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Zamboanga City Councilor Elbert Bong Atilano said that according to the ordinance, besides Diaz, her boyfriend and coach Julius Irvin Naranjo will also receive a P1,250,000 incentive.

text: Si Naranjo nga isa man ka seasoned weightlifter ang madugay na nga nagserbe bilang strength and conditioning coach ni Diaz humalin pa sang naga-training pa lang ini sa Malaysia.
english: Naranjo, also a seasoned weightlifter, has long served as Diaz's strength and conditioning coach since he was training in Malaysia.

text: Nahibaluan nga matapos makuha ni Diaz ang gold medal sa Tokyo Olympics, gilayon nga nag-post si Naranjo sa iya Instagram story sang pagpasalamat sa mga supporters sang iya girlfriend.
english: After Diaz won the gold medal at the Tokyo Olympics, Naranjo immediately posted on his Instagram story a thank you to his girlfriend's supporters.

text:
Nahibaluan nga magluwas sa P2.5M, may yara na nga daan sang nagahulat nga P33M nga incentive para kay Diaz,

Sa idalom sang Republic Act (RA) 10699, ang Philippine Sports Commission (PSC) amo ang magaprovide sang cash incentive nga P10M sa gold medal winners sa Olympics.
english:
It is known that besides the P2.5M, there is already a waiting P33M incentive for Diaz,

Under Republic Act (RA) 10699, the Philippine Sports Commission (PSC) will provide a cash incentive of P10M to gold medal winners in the Olympics.

text: Apang magluwas sa PSC,may yara sang private companies kag negosyante ang nagpromisa sang nabilin nga P23M incentive para kay Hidilyn, magluwas pa sa house and lot nga nagahulat sa iya.
english: But besides the PSC, there are private companies and businessmen who have promised the remaining P23M incentive for Hidilyn, besides the house and lot waiting for her.

text: ILOILO CITY-Arestado sa buybust operation ang ginakabig nga isa sa pinakadako nga ginabagsakan sang iligal nga druga sa Leganes, Iloilo.
english: ILOILO CITY-An arrested in a buybust operation is considered one of the biggest illegal drugs in Leganes, Iloilo.

text: Natigayon ang operasyon sa Brgy Guinobatan, Leganes.
english: The operation was conducted in Brgy Guinobatan, Leganes.

text: Ang nadakpan amo si alyas Alog, 43-anyos, residente sa isa ka subdivision sa nasambit nga barangay.
english: The suspect was identified as Alog, 43, resident of a subdivision in the said barangay.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain John Robles, Officer in Charge sang Leganes Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga wala pa nakaagi preso ang subject apang base sa imbestigasyon, may yara sang nagahulog sang dako nga supply sang illegal drugs sa iya.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain John Robles, Officer in Charge of the Leganes Municipal Police Station, said the suspect had never been arrested but based on investigation, someone was throwing a large supply of illegal drugs at him.

text: Suno kay Robles, indi pa mabuyagyag ang identity sang ginatumod nga nagabagsak sang dako nga supply sang illegal drugs.
english: According to Robles, the identity of the suspect in the large supply of illegal drugs has not yet been revealed.

text: Ginpahayag naman ni Robles nga ang mga kliyente sang subject ang nagapadulong sa iya balay kun sa diin sila nagabakal sang illegal drugs.
english: Robles said the subject's clients used to go to his house where they bought illegal drugs.

text: Posible man nga ginadul-ong mismo sang subject ang druga sa iya mga customer.
english: It is also possible that the subject himself delivers the drugs to his customers.

text: Ginpa-leave anay ang former actress nga si Nadia Montenegro matapos nga nahingadlan sa incident report kaangot sa ginaalegar nga paggamit sang marijuana sa sulod sang building sang Senado sa Pasay City.
english: Former actress Nadia Montenegro was placed on leave after being named in an incident report regarding the alleged use of marijuana inside the Senate building in Pasay City.

text: Santo ini sa kumpirmasyon sang opisina ni Senator Robin Padilla kun sa diin naga-trabaho si Montenegro bilang political officer.
english: This was confirmed by the office of Senator Robin Padilla where Montenegro works as a political officer.

text: Sa statement sang opisina, ginsiling man nga antes pa man ang imbestigasyon sang Office of the Sergeant At Arms (OSAA), may yara na sang initial internal investigation ang office ni Senator Padilla.
english: In a statement, the office also said that even before the investigation of the Office of the Sergeant At Arms (OSAA), there was an initial internal investigation by Senator Padilla's office.

text: Ginpahayag man nga ginhatagan si Montenegro sang lima ka adlaw ukon tubtub sa Agusto 18 agud nga makapasa ini sang written explanation kaangot sa pagkadalahig sang iya nga pangalan.
english: Montenegro was also given five days or until August 18 to submit a written explanation regarding the involvement of his name.

text: “On August 13, 2025, even before the investigation conducted by the Office of the Sergeant At Arms (OSAA), the office commenced an initial internal investigation regarding media reports allegedly linking Ms. Nadia Montenegro.
english: “On August 13, 2025, even before the investigation conducted by the Office of the Sergeant At Arms (OSAA), the office commenced an initial internal investigation regarding media reports allegedly linking Ms. Nadia Montenegro.

text: On the same day, she was directed to take a leave of absence, effective immediately,” kabahin sang official statement.
english: On the same day, she was directed to take a leave of absence, effective immediately,” part of the official statement.

text: Nahibaluan nga base sa incident report nga napetsahan sang Agusto 13, ginplastar sang security personnel nga si Victor Patelo nga may duha ka insidente nga may napanimahuan nga indi kinaandan sa isa ka area sa Senate building.
english: Based on the incident report dated August 13, security personnel Victor Patelo said there were two incidents involving unusual smells in an area of ​​the Senate building.

text: Una amo ang sa ikaduha nga semana sang Hulyo 2025 kun sa diin may nag-report nga isa ka male staff member nga maisog nga baho, apang wala man sang nakit-an nga nagpanigarilyo.
english: The first was in the second week of July 2025 when a male staff member reported a strong smell, but no one was found smoking.

text: Ikaduha amo ang Agusto 12 kun sa diin nagpalapit ang staff ni Senator Panfilo Lacson sa amo gihapon nga security personnel sa 5th floor, kag nagpanugid nga may indi kinaandan nga baho nga halin sa comfort room sang mga babaye malapit sa extension offices sang mga senador.
english: The second was on August 12 when Senator Panfilo Lacson's staff approached the same security personnel on the 5th floor, and reported an unusual smell coming from the women's comfort room near the senators' extension offices.

text: Ginpahayag nga daw marijuana ang baho kag ang tawo lamang sa area sa amo nga tion amo si Nadia.
english: It reportedly smelled like marijuana and the only person in the area at the time was Nadia.

text: Suno sa security personnel, ginmunuhan sini si Nadia sang naglabay ini sa iya pwesto, apang nagpanginwala ang former actress nga nagpanigarilyo ini ukon naggamit sang marijuana.
english: According to security personnel, he led Nadia as she passed his place, but the former actress denied smoking or using marijuana.

text: Gin-ako sini nga may dala siya nga vape sa iya bag nga amo ang posible ang ginhalinan sang baho.
english: He admitted to having a vape in his bag, which may have been the source of the smell.

text: May ginpasa naman nga investigation report sa Office of the Senate President (OSP) kasunod sang amo nga insidente.#
english: An investigation report was submitted to the Office of the Senate President (OSP) following the incident.

text: Kun sadto, nagapanawagan ang National Economic and Development Authority (NEDA) sang reopening sang ekonomiya sa pungsod apang sa subong , ginaduso sang ahensya ang ‘localized lockdowns’ sa pihak sang nagataas nga kaso sang COVID-19.
english: In the past, the National Economic and Development Authority (NEDA) called for the reopening of the economy in the country but now, the agency is pushing for localized lockdowns despite the increasing cases of COVID-19.

text: Suno kay Acting NEDA Secretary Karl Kendrick Chua, indi na dapat pa nga magpili sa tunga sang ekonomiya kag ikaayong lawas kundi hatagan sang igtalupangod ang total well-being sang mga tawo may kaangtanan sa COVID-19, non-COVID 19, balatian ukon kagutom.
english: According to Acting NEDA Secretary Karl Kendrick Chua, there should no longer be a choice between the economy and health but to pay attention to the total well-being of the people in relation to COVID-19, non-COVID 19, disease or hunger.

text: Ang localized quarantines ang mangin pamaagi agud nga indi tuman nga maapektuhan ang trabaho ukon palangabuhian sang mayorya.
english: Localized quarantines will be a way to ensure that the jobs or livelihoods of the majority are not severely affected.

text: Isa ka tuig matapos ang lockdown, ginpahayag ni Chua nga may yara sang 3.2 million ukon 23% sang National Capital Region ang naka-eksperyensya sang kagutom.
english: A year into the lockdown, Chua said there are 3.2 million or 23% of the National Capital Region experiencing hunger.

text: Nag-resign na gid man kag naghalin na sa Bangladesh si Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina Wazed kasunod sang sinemana na nga protesta sang mga estudyante nga nagdangat sa maduguon na nga kinagamo sa amo nga pungsod diri sa Asya.
english: Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina Wazed has resigned following weeks of student protests that have led to bloody riots in the Asian country.

text: Base sa reports, nagbiya padulong sa India ang 76-anyos nga lider sakay sa helicopter matapos nga ginsulong sang protesters ang iya balay sa Dhaka.
english: According to reports, the 76-year-old leader left for India by helicopter after protesters stormed his house in Dhaka.

text: Ini ang ginakabig nga pagtakop sang pagginahum ni Hasina nga amo ang longest-serving PM sang Bangladesh halin sang nagpungko ini sang 2009.
english: This is seen as the closing of Hasina’s reign as Bangladesh’s longest-serving PM since taking office in 2009.

text: Suno kay Bangladesh army chief Gen.
english: According to Bangladesh army chief Gen.

text: Waker-uz-Zaman, magatukod ang militar sang interim government kasunod sang amo nga development sa gobyerno.
english: Waker-uz-Zaman, the military will form an interim government following the development in the government.

text:
Nagpasalig man ini nga indi magpangluthang ang militar kag pulis kag nagpanawagan sa publiko nga likawan na ang kalakasan

Sang Domingo, matandaan nga 91 ang napatay kag ginatos ang nasamaran bangud sa gamo sa tunga sang pulis kag protesters bangud sa demand nga ibasura na ang quota sa trabaho kag sa gobyerno dala na ang panawagan nga maglayas na ang prime minister.
english:
He also assured that the military and police will not shoot and called on the public to avoid violence

On Sunday, 91 people were killed and hundreds injured in clashes between police and protesters over demands to abolish job quotas and calls for the prime minister to step down.

text: Ang amo nga death toll sang Domingo lakip ang 13 ka mga pulis amo ang pinakamataas sa sulod sang isa ka adlaw — base ina sa recent history sang bisan diin nga pungsod nga may yara sang nagakatabo nga protesta.
english: That death toll on Sunday including 13 police officers was the highest in a single day — that’s based on the recent history of any country with an ongoing protest.

text: Nag-resign sa pwesto si National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) director Jaime Santiago.
english: National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) director Jaime Santiago has resigned.

text: Sa iya sulat nga ginpadala kay President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr., ginsiling sini nga bayaan na sini ang posisyon kun may mahingadlan na nga indibidwal nga magabulos sa iya.
