english: In a letter sent to President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr., he said he will leave the position once an individual is named to replace him.

text: Ginpasalamatan ni Santiago si Marcos sa oportunidad nga pangunahan ang primary law enforcement arm sang Department of Justice.
english: Santiago thanked Marcos for the opportunity to lead the primary law enforcement arm of the Department of Justice.

text: Wala sini ginpatpat sa sulat ang mga sirkumstansya sa likod sang iya nga resignation, apang gin-claim sini nga gina-target siya sang mga mahigko nga mga akusasyon.
english: He did not specify in the letter the circumstances behind his resignation, but claimed he was being targeted with dirty accusations.

text: Nagsugod ini suno sa iya sang nagpasa siya sang courtesy resignation kaupod man sa iban nga government officials kasunod mismo sang mandu ni Marcos pagkatapos sang eleksyon.
english: He said it started when he submitted a courtesy resignation along with other government officials following Marcos' order after the election.

text: Ginpahangop sini nga indi sini matugutan nga gub-on sang mga kabutigan ang reputasyon nga iya ginahuptan.
english: He implied that he could not allow lies to destroy the reputation he had.

text: “Detractors and those who have sinister interest in my position incessantly make moves to blemish my reputation,” kabahin sang iya sulat.
english: “Detractors and those who have a sinister interest in my position incessantly make moves to blemish my reputation,” his letter reads.

text: “To my mind, lies, if repeated overtime, will give a semblance of truth.
english: “To my mind, lies, if repeated overtime, will give a semblance of truth.

text:
I cannot allow this seemingly orchestrated move to blacken my reputation which I molded through the years.”

Isa si Santiago ka former police officer, nangin prosecutor, kag nangin retired Manila Regional Trial Court judge antes ini ginbutang ni Marcos sa NBI sang Hunyo 2024.
english:
I cannot allow this seemingly orchestrated move to blacken my reputation which I molded through the years.”

Santiago is a former police officer, prosecutor, and retired Manila Regional Trial Court judge before Marcos appointed him to the NBI in June 2024.

text: “With my experiences as a former police officer, prosecutor and judge, I steered the Bureau with my best leg forward— regaining the trust and confidence of the Filipino people (and) the media with the Bureau,” pahayag sini sa iya nga resignation letter.
english: “With my experiences as a former police officer, prosecutor and judge, I steered the Bureau with my best leg forward— regaining the trust and confidence of the Filipino people (and) the media with the Bureau,” he said in his resignation letter.

text: Sa iya sulat, nagpasalig man si Santiago nga padayunon sini ang pagsuporta sa administrasyon.
english: In his letter, Santiago also assured that he will continue to support the administration.

text: Wala pa sang napaguwa nga komento ang Malacañang kaangot diri.#
english: Malacañang has not yet issued a comment on the matter.

text: Indi makabangon ang ekonomiya sang Pilipinas samtang nagasalangisag sa gihapon ang mga tawo sa polisa nga dapat tumanon kag samtang wala pa sang vaccination.
english: The Philippine economy cannot recover while people are still confused about the policies to be implemented and while there is no vaccination.

text: Ini ang pahayag sang economic specialist nga si Rae Emmanuel Echaveria, research officer sang Colombo Plan Staff College, isa ka international organization nga nabase sa Manila, samtang nagapadayon sa pagtimbuok ang kaso sang COVID-19 sa pungsod.
english: This was stated by economic specialist Rae Emmanuel Echaveria, research officer of the Colombo Plan Staff College, an international organization based in Manila, as the number of COVID-19 cases in the country continues to rise.

text: Bangud sa pandemya, natabo ang pinakamalala nga contraction sa ekonomiya sang Pilipinas halin sang World War II.
english: Due to the pandemic, the Philippines experienced the worst economic contraction since World War II.

text: Ang gross domestic product (GDP) ang nagnubo sa 9.5% sang 2020.
english: Gross domestic product (GDP) fell to 9.5% in 2020.

text: Subong nga ginpahalugan na ang mga restrictions, nagalaum ang gobyerno nga magbalik na ang trabaho para sa mga Pinoy; apang kun basehan naman ang data, makit-an nga ginbalda gid sang pandemya ang labor market.
english: Now that restrictions have been eased, the government hopes that jobs will resume for Filipinos; but based on the data, it can be seen that the pandemic has severely disrupted the labor market.

text: Santo sa data sang Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), ang annual unemployment rate sang 2020 ang nagsaka sa 10.3% nga katumbas sang 4.5 million nga unemployed nga mga Pinoy.
english: According to data from the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), the annual unemployment rate in 2020 rose to 10.3%, equivalent to 4.5 million unemployed Filipinos.

text: Sang Enero 2021, ginpahayag pa sang PSA nga kapin 4 million ka tawo ang unemployed — mas mataas sa 3.8 million nga unemployed nga mga tawo sang Oktubre 2020 kag 2.4 million nga unemployed sang Enero 2020.
english: In January 2021, the PSA further stated that more than 4 million people were unemployed — up from 3.8 million unemployed people in October 2020 and 2.4 million unemployed in January 2020.

text: Suno kay Echaveria, nagasala ang mga tawo kun pasulabihon ang pagbalik sa trabaho ukon indi anay bangud sang kahadlok sa virus.
english: According to Echaveria, people are wrong whether to prefer to return to work or not because of fear of the virus.

text: Magluwas diri, wala sang unified policy suno kay Echaveria bangud apisar may yara sang resolution nga ginrelease ang National Inter-Agency Task Force may kaangtanan sa Uniform Travel Protocols, may kaugalingon man gihapon nga direktiba ang tagsa ka rehiyon.
english: Besides, there is no unified policy, Echaveria said, because although there is a resolution released by the National Inter-Agency Task Force regarding Uniform Travel Protocols, each region still has its own directive.

text: Suno sa natungdan, mas maayo gid kun ibase sa siyensya ang pagbalay sa mga pagsulundan kag indi pagbasta nga ilugon sa structure sang iban nga pungsod bangud lain man ang kinahanglanon sa Pilipinas.
english: He said it is better to base the rules on science and not just imitate the structure of other countries because the needs in the Philippines are different.

text: Halos makompleto na ang slots sang total nga ruta sang tricycle route plan sa Iloilo City kasunod sang pag-apply sang pila ka mga tricycle drivers sang ila nga prangkisa.
english: The slots of the total route of the tricycle route plan in Iloilo City are almost complete following the application of some tricycle drivers for their franchise.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Iloilo City Councilor Sedfrey Cabaluna, chairman sang Committee on Public Safety, iya ginpahayag nga kon makompleto na, iga-evaluate kon bastante, mahimo nga dugangan, ukon may kulang sa route plan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Iloilo City Councilor Sedfrey Cabaluna, chairman of the Committee on Public Safety, said that once completed, it will be evaluated whether it is sufficient, can be added, or is missing in the route plan.

text: Suno kay Cabaluna, mahimo sa masunod nga bulan magatakop ang aplikasyon para sa mga tricycle drivers, kasunod sang pagsugod sini sang tinalikdan nga tuig, anom na ka bulan ang nagligad.
english: According to Cabaluna, the application for tricycle drivers may end next month, following its start last year, six months ago.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga magakoordinar ang komtiba sa Traffic Transportation and Management Office (TTMO) lakip na sa mga kabarangayan agud nga mapatuman sang matalunsay ang ruta.
english: He also said that the committee will coordinate with the Traffic Transportation and Management Office (TTMO) as well as the barangays to ensure the smooth implementation of the route.

text: Gin-athag man ni Cabaluna nga sa pag-issue sang franchise, ginalantaw, evaluate, kag gina-tsekyar ang ila nga dokumento antes nga magsumpa sa representative sang Iloilo City Council.
english: Cabaluna also explained that in the issuance of the franchise, their documents are reviewed, evaluated, and checked before being sworn in by the representative of the Iloilo City Council.

text: Nagpaandam man ang natungdan sa mga colorum nga kalabanan nagapanukot sang mataas nga plete bangud wala sang ginasundan nga taripa.
english: He also warned the colorums that most of them charge high fares because there is no tariff.

text: Nagpahibalo man ini sa publiko nga ang tricycle nga may prangkisa ang may nakapaskil nga taripa kon sa diin, sila lang ang may kahigayunan nga makapanukot sang plete santo sa pagsulundan.
english: He also informed the public that tricycles with franchises have posted tariffs where, they are the only ones who have the opportunity to collect fares according to the rules.

text: Narekober sang Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) ang debris sang rocket nga may marka sang People’s Republic of China (PRC) sa baybay sang Sitio Gunting, Barangay Bonbon kag Lubang, Looc, Occidental Mindoro sang Agosto 14, 2025.
english: The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) recovered the debris of a rocket marked People’s Republic of China (PRC) off the coast of Sitio Gunting, Barangay Bonbon and Lubang, Looc, Occidental Mindoro on August 14, 2025.

text: Suno sa PCG, isa ka lokal nga mangingisda ang nakakita sang nagalutaw nga debris kag gilayon ini nga ginsugid sa Philippine National Police-Maritime Group.
english: According to the PCG, a local fisherman spotted the floating debris and immediately reported it to the Philippine National Police-Maritime Group.

text: Nagbuligay dayon ang Coast Guard Sub-Station Lubang, Barangay Binacas, kag Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office Lubang Sub-Office sa pagkuha sang debris.
english: Coast Guard Sub-Station Lubang, Barangay Binacas, and Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office Lubang Sub-Office immediately worked together to remove the debris.

text: Ginakabig nga parte ini sang Long March 7A rocket launch sang PRC sang Hulyo 15 tubtob 17, 2025.
english: It is thought to be part of the PRC’s Long March 7A rocket launch on July 15 to 17, 2025.

text: Ang debris may kalaparon nga 10 ka tiil kag kahalabaon nga 14 feet, himo sa alloy, kag may bandera sang China.
english: The debris was 10 feet wide and 14 feet long, made of alloy, and emblazoned with the Chinese flag.

text: Ginbutang na ini sa Sitio Balaguin, Barangay Maliig para sa husto nga pagdumala.
english: It has been placed in Sitio Balaguin, Barangay Maliig for proper management.

text: Ginapahanumdom sang PCG ang mga mangingisda kag pumuluyo sa baybayon nga kun may makita sila nga kaduluda nga butang sa dagat, ipahibalo dayon sa pinakamalapit nga estasyon sang Coast Guard.
english: The PCG reminds fishermen and coastal residents that if they see anything suspicious in the sea, immediately report it to the nearest Coast Guard station.

text: Nagsugtanay ang Pilipinas kag ang Germany nga mas padalumon kag pasangkaron pa ang military cooperation sa tunga sang duha ka pungsod.
english: The Philippines and Germany agreed to deepen and expand military cooperation between the two countries.

text: Ini kasunod sang pagkit-anay nanday German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius kag Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro sa Manila kun sa diin ginpromisa nga pirmahan ang defense cooperation agreement antes magtakop ang tuig.
english: This follows a meeting between German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius and Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro in Manila where they promised to sign a defense cooperation agreement before the end of the year.

text: Ini nga kasugtanan ang magatutok sa “mutual understanding” kaangot sa training kag pagbayluhanay sang mga impormasyon.
english: This agreement will focus on mutual understanding regarding training and information exchange.

text: “We collaborate because we have a shared vision of respect for the United Nations Charter… and our desire to see a stable and peaceful Indo-Pacific,” suno kay Teodoro.
english: “We collaborate because we have a shared vision of respect for the United Nations Charter… and our desire to see a stable and peaceful Indo-Pacific,” according to Teodoro.

text: Nagpasalig man ang duha ka opisyal nga magtukod sang “long-lasting relations” sa tunga sang armed forces kag ginpaguwa man ang posibilidad nga mag-suplay ang Germany sang military equipment sa Pilipinas.
english: The two officials also pledged to establish “long-lasting relations” between the armed forces and also raised the possibility of Germany supplying military equipment to the Philippines.

text: Nahibaluan nga ginapasangkad pa sang Pilipinas ang relasyon sini sa depensa sa Asia-Pacific region kag mangin sa iban pa nga pungsod sa tunga sang padayon nga pag-claim sang China nga ila ang West Philippine Sea.
english: The Philippines is expanding its defense relations with the Asia-Pacific region and other countries amid China's continued claim to the West Philippine Sea.

text: Isa ang Germany sa ginakabig nga oldest formal defense partners sang Pilipinas nga na-establisar paagi sa 1974 administrative agreement nga nagalakip sa training sang Filipino troops.
english: Germany is one of the Philippines' oldest formal defense partners, established through a 1974 administrative agreement that includes the training of Filipino troops.

text: Ginpakahuy-an sang Men’s basketball team sang France ang powerhouse nga Estados Unidos matapos ginpierde sa ila pag-atubangay sa Saitama Super Arena sa nagapadayon nga 2020 Tokyo Olympics.
english: France’s Men’s basketball team embarrassed the powerhouse United States after losing their clash at the Saitama Super Arena in the ongoing 2020 Tokyo Olympics.

text: Natapos ang hampang sa score nga 83-76 pabor sa France.
english: The match ended with a score of 83-76 in favor of France.

text: Nanguna si Evan Fournier sa team sang France matapos nargrekord sang 28 points samtang may 14 points naman kag nine rebounds si Rudy Gobert.
english: Evan Fournier led the French team with 28 points while Rudy Gobert had 14 points and nine rebounds.

text: Wala nakalusot ang 18 points nga ginpangabudlayan ni Jrue Holiday para sa Team USA.
english: Jrue Holiday's 18 points for Team USA did not escape.

text: Ang pwersa sang USA ang ginalakipan man nanday Kevin Durant, Damian Lillard, Jayson Tatum kag Draymond Green.
english: The USA force also includes Kevin Durant, Damian Lillard, Jayson Tatum and Draymond Green.

text: Ini ang pinakauna nga pierde nga natilawan sang Team USA sa Olympics halin pa sadtong 2004.
english: This is the first loss Team USA has tasted at the Olympics since 2004.

text: May tsansa pa nga makabawi ang Estados Unidos bangud may hampang pa sila sa Group A batok sa Iran kag Czech Republic.
english: The United States still has a chance to bounce back as they have Group A games against Iran and the Czech Republic.

text: Nagdangat sa 43 ang patay kag ginatos ang napilasan sa maduguon nga protesta sa Bangladesh samtang nga nagapanawagan ang protesters kay Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina nga manaog sa pwesto.
english: At least 43 people have been killed and hundreds injured in bloody protests in Bangladesh as protesters call on Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina to step down.

text: Napilitan man ang mga pulis nga maggamit sang tear gas kag rubber bullets bangud sa masingki nga protesta sang linibo ka mga tawo nga amo man ang ginakabig pinakadaku nga pagpanghangkat sa administrasyon ni Hasina.
english: The police were also forced to resort to tear gas and rubber bullets due to violent protests by thousands of people which is also seen as the biggest challenge to the Hasina administration.

text: Matandaan nga sang eleksyon pa lang kun sa diin nadag-an sini ang iya ikapaat nga sunod-sunod nga term, gin-boycott ini sang main opposition nga Bangladesh Nationalist Party.
english: It can be recalled that during the election where he won his fourth consecutive term, he was boycotted by the main opposition Bangladesh Nationalist Party.

text: Bangud sa gamo, nag-deklarar ang gobyerno sang indefinite nationwide curfew umpisa sa 6:00 sang Domingo.
english: Due to the unrest, the government declared an indefinite nationwide curfew starting at 6:00 am on Sunday.

text: Na-shut down naman ang internet services sa pungsod.
english: Internet services in the country have been shut down.

text: Nagsabat naman si Hasina nga indi mga estudyante ang naga-protesta subong kundi mga terorista nga nagatuyo nga i-destabilize ang nasyon.
english: Hasina replied that it is not students who are protesting now but terrorists who are trying to destabilize the country.

text: Sunod man sini nga ginpatawag ang national security panel meeting kun sa diin nakaupod ang mga hepe sang army, navy, air force, police kag iban pa nga ahensya.
english: He also convened a national security panel meeting with the chiefs of the army, navy, air force, police and other agencies.

text:
MGA PILIPINO SA BANGLADESH

Gin-report naman sang Department of Migrant Workers nga safe ang mga Pilipino sa Bangladesh sa tunga sang kinagamo.
english:
FILIPINOS IN BANGLADESH

The Department of Migrant Workers reported that Filipinos in Bangladesh are safe amid the unrest.

text: “Ang mga OFW in Bangladesh are mostly skilled workers, technical.
english: “OFWs in Bangladesh are mostly skilled workers, technical.

text: And some of them in the hotel sector, hospitality sector.
english: And some of them in the hotel sector, hospitality sector.

text: They are safe and sound at this stage and we hope it’s safe that way,” suno kay DMW chief Hans Cacdac.
english: They are safe and sound at this stage and we hope it’s safe that way,” said DMW chief Hans Cacdac.

text:
“So far, safe and sound ang around 700 Filipinos in Bangladesh.”

Sang Byernes sang ginpataas sang Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) ang alert status sa Bangladesh sa Alert Level 1 ukon ang precautionary phase bangud sang political demonstrations kag civil unrest.
english:
“So far, around 700 Filipinos in Bangladesh are safe and sound.”

It was on Friday when the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) raised the alert status in Bangladesh to Alert Level 1 or the precautionary phase due to political demonstrations and civil unrest.

text: Kaangay nga nalab-ot gid sang pamilya ni Irish Magno ang langit matapos nga nakuha sang Ilongga boxer ang kadalag-an batok sa Kenyan nga si Christine Ongare sa Round of 32 sang Women’s Flyweight division sa 2020 Tokyo Olympics.
english: Irish Magno's family seems to have reached the sky after the Ilongga boxer won against Kenyan Christine Ongare in the Round of 32 of the Women's Flyweight division at the 2020 Tokyo Olympics.

text: Sa exclusive interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Eva Magno, iloy ni Irish, iya ginpahayag nga naghugyaw gid sila sa kalipay sang gindeklarar nga nagdaog ang iya anak via unanimous decision sa score nga 5-0 sa diin maka-abante na ini sa Round 16 sa Hulyo 29.
english: In an exclusive interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Eva Magno, Irish's mother, said they were overjoyed when her daughter was declared the winner via unanimous decision with a score of 5-0 and will advance to Round 16 on July 29.

text: Suno sa iloy, ginpamatian gid sang Diyos ang ila nga pangamuyo kag nahibal-an gid sang mahal nga makaako ang ila ginahandom.
english: According to the mother, God heard their prayers and knew that God would grant their wishes.

text: Samtang, suno naman sa amay sang Ilongga boxer, ihawon gid niya ang de rasa nga manok sang manghod ni Irish bilang selebrasyon sa kadalag-an sini.
english: Meanwhile, the Ilongga boxer's father said he will slaughter Irish's brother's breed chicken in celebration of his victory.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Rodrigo Magno, iya ginpahayag nga proud gid siya para sa iya anak.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Rodrigo Magno said he is very proud of his son.

text: Nagalaom man siya nga mangin tayuyon na ang kadalag-an sang Ilongga boxer agud maangkon sini ang isa sa dalagko nga medalya sa Olympic.
english: He also hopes that the Ilongga boxer will continue to win one of the big Olympic medals.

text: Nag-agom sang 10 ka pilas ang isa ka babaye matapos nga ginbuno samtang nagakatulog sang wala pa makilal-an nga indibidwal sa Brgy.
english: A woman sustained 10 gunshot wounds after being stabbed while sleeping by an unidentified individual in Brgy.

text: 5, Poblacion, Igbaras, Iloilo.
english: 5, Poblacion, Igbaras, Iloilo.

text: Ang biktima amo si Geraldine Embiado, 21-anyos, residente sang nasambit nga lugar.
english: The victim was identified as Geraldine Embiado, 21, resident of the said place.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Master Sergeant Glen Gellangarin, imbestigador sang Igbaras Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga antes natabo ang insidente, nag-inom- inom pa ang biktima upod ang iya abyan bag-o nagpauli kag nagtulog.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Master Sergeant Glen Gellangarin, investigator of the Igbaras Municipal Police Station, said that before the incident, the victim had been drinking with his friend before going home and sleeping.

text: Suno kay Gellangarin, maswerte man nga nakaluwas sa katalagman ang biktima kag estable na ang kondisyon subong.
english: According to Gellangarin, the victim was lucky to survive and is in stable condition.

text: Dugang pa sang natungdan nga ginahulat-hulat nalang nila nga maistorya liwat ang biktima para makuhaan sang dugang nga impormasyon.
english: He added that they are waiting to talk to the victim again to get more information.

text: Sa subong, nagapadayon pa ang imbestigasyon sa posible motibo sa pagbuno sa biktima.
english: Investigation is ongoing into the possible motive behind the stabbing.

text: Nag-apelar sa Korte Suprema ang beterano nga election lawyer nga si Romulo Macalintal nga ideklarar nga unconstitutional ang layi nga nagasaylo sang December 2025 Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan elections sa Nobyembre 2026.
english: Veteran election lawyer Romulo Macalintal has appealed to the Supreme Court to declare unconstitutional the law that moves the December 2025 Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan elections to November 2026.

text: Matandaan nga sang Mierkules, ginpirmahan ni President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: It can be recalled that on Wednesday, President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.

text: ang Republic Act No.
english: Republic Act No.

text: 12232 nga nagasaylo sang eleksyon sa una nga Lunes sang Nobyembre 2026 kag nagahimo man sang term of office sang tanan nga barangay and SK officials sa apat ka tuig.
english: 12232 which postpones the election to the first Monday of November 2026 and also makes the term of office of all barangay and SK officials four years.

text: Sa iya nga petition for certiorari and prohibition, ginpunto ni Macalintal nga ang RA 12232 wala nagmitlang sang tinaga nga “postponement”, kaangot sa 2023 Supreme Court decision sa Macalintal vs.
english: In his petition for certiorari and prohibition, Macalintal pointed out that RA 12232 does not mention the word “postponement”, in connection with the 2023 Supreme Court decision in Macalintal vs.

text: Comelec, nga nagadeklarar nga unconstitutional ang pag- postpone sang Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan elections nga wala sang balido nga rason.
english: Comelec, declaring unconstitutional the postponement of Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan elections without valid reason.

text: Sa petisyon, ginhingyo ni Macalintal sa korte nga mag-isyu sang Temporary Restraining Order (TRO) ukon status quo ante order nga nagamando sa Office of the President nga untaton ang pagpatuman sang layi.
english: In the petition, Macalintal asked the court to issue a Temporary Restraining Order (TRO) or status quo ante order ordering the Office of the President to stop enforcing the law.

text: Suno kay Macalintal, possible nga pulitika ang rason sa likod sang postponement sang December 2025 polls.
english: According to Macalintal, it is possible that politics is the reason behind the postponement of the December 2025 polls.

text: Handa ang Police Regional Office 6 (PRO-6) nga magtuon sang Korean language agud masolbar ang kriminalidad sa Western Visayas nga involve ang mga foreign nationals.
english: The Police Regional Office 6 (PRO-6) is ready to learn Korean language to solve crime in Western Visayas involving foreign nationals.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Lieutenant Colonel Arnel Solis, Spokesperson sang Police Regional Office 6, iya ginpahayag nga bukas ang talatapan sa amo nga tikang agud nga mapasangkad ang ihibalo sang kapulisan nahanungod sa Korean language.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Lieutenant Colonel Arnel Solis, spokesperson of the Police Regional Office 6, said the office is open to the move to expand the police's knowledge of the Korean language.

text: Suno kay Solis, makabulig ini sa mga desk officers nga masami man nagapanguna sa pag-entertain sa mga tawo nga nagapadulong sa istasyon sang kapulisan.
english: According to Solis, this will help the desk officers who often take the lead in entertaining people who come to the police station.

text: Nagapati man ini nga ang pagtuon sang amo nga lengwahe makabulig sa mga otoridad nga yara sa mga lugar nga masami ginadugok sang mga turista, lakip na diri ang Boracay Island.
english: He also believes that learning the language will help the authorities in areas frequented by tourists, including Boracay Island.

text: Luwas sa Korean language, epektibo man nga ginasunod sang kapulisan ang paggamit sang English sa mga turista.
english: Besides the Korean language, the police are also effectively monitoring the use of English among tourists.

text: Madinalag-on nga ginpanagtag sang Iloilo City Government sa koordinasyon sang Iloilo City Schools Division ang allowance sa mga delegado para sa Palarong Pambansa 2025.
english: The Iloilo City Government in coordination with the Iloilo City Schools Division successfully distributed the allowance to the delegates for the Palarong Pambansa 2025.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Joy Fantilaga, spokesperson ni Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga paagi sa pagbinuligay kag suporta sang City Accountant, City Budget Officer, City Administrator, City Treasurer, kag mga opisyales sang Department of Eduacation natigayon naton nga na-release ang financial aid sa husto nga tion.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Joy Fantilaga, spokesperson of Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas, said that with the cooperation and support of the City Accountant, City Budget Officer, City Administrator, City Treasurer, and officials of the Department of Education, we were able to release the financial aid on time.

text: Suno kay Fantilaga, ang Iloilo City Government nag-alokar sang ₱1,522,800 gikan sa ila pundo, samtang dugang nga ₱1,470,100 ang ginhatag pinaagi sa Local School Board (LSB).
english: According to Fantilaga, the Iloilo City Government allocated ₱1,522,800 from its fund, while an additional ₱1,470,100 was provided through the Local School Board (LSB).

text: Nagpasalig naman ang city government sang pagpasanyog sang paghatag sang serbisyo para sa mga atleta samtang nagapreparar sila sa pagrepresentar indi lamang sang syudad sang Iloilo kag sang probinsya kundi sang bug-os nga rehiyon.
english: The city government assured to improve the provision of services for the athletes as they prepare to represent not only the city of Iloilo and the province but the entire region.

text: Nakit-na ang isa ka Chinese research vessel sa gwa sang Sabina Shoal sa West Philippine Sea.
english: A Chinese research vessel was spotted off the Sabina Shoal in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Suno kay American maritime security expert Ray Powell, ang Chinese research vessel Ke Xue San Ha ang naga-survey sa mga lugar sa nabagatnan-nasidlangan sang Sabina Shoal ukon mas kilala bilang Escoda Shoal humalin pa sang Hulyo 25 kag makit-an 40 nautical miles halin sa Palawan sang Biyernes, Agosto 2.
english: According to American maritime security expert Ray Powell, the Chinese research vessel Ke Xue San Ha has been surveying areas southeast of the Sabina Shoal or better known as Escoda Shoal since July 25 and was located 40 nautical miles from Palawan on Friday, August

text: Ginpahayag ni Powell, nga may yara oa sang iban nga mga maritime features sa lugar kaangay sang First Thomas Shoal, Half Moon Shoal, kag Boxall Reef.
english: Powell said, there oa other maritime features in the area such as First Thomas Shoal, Half Moon Shoal, and Boxall Reef.

text: Gina-monitor naman sang Philippine Coast Guard ang hulag sang nasambit nga research ship.
english: The Philippine Coast Guard is monitoring the movement of the research ship.

text: Tubtob subong, wala naman nakapagwa sang pahayag ang Armed Forces of the Philippines kaangot diri.
english: So far, the Armed Forces of the Philippines has not issued a statement on the matter.

text: 1,500 lang ka inbound passengers sakay sa international flights ang pahanugutan sa Ninoy Aquino International Airport kada adlaw umpisa sa Marso 18.
english: Only 1,500 inbound passengers on international flights will be allowed at Ninoy Aquino International Airport per day starting March 18.

text: Ini ang gin-anunsyo sang Civil Aeronautics Board (CAB) sa tunga sang padayon nga pagtimbuok sang COVID-19 cases sa Pilipinas.
english: This was announced by the Civil Aeronautics Board (CAB) amid the continuous increase in COVID-19 cases in the Philippines.

text: Ang limitasyon nga gin-set sa inbound travels ang magalawig tubtob sa Abril 18, 2021.
english: The limit set on inbound travels will last until April 18, 2021.

text: Santo sa advisory nga gin-isyu sang CAB, gina-abisuhan man ang mga airlines nga magcomply sa mga pagsulundan sang Bureau of Immigration.
english: According to the advisory issued by the CAB, airlines are also advised to comply with the Bureau of Immigration guidelines.

text: Kun indi masunod ang mga direktiba sang Bureau of Immigration may kaangtanan sa inbound travelers, ipatuman ang nagakaigu nga penalidad santo sa measures nga gin-isyu sang CAB, Manila International Airport Authority, Clark International Airport Authority, kag Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines.
english: If the directives of the Bureau of Immigration regarding inbound travelers are not followed, the appropriate penalties will be imposed according to the measures issued by the CAB, Manila International Airport Authority, Clark International Airport Authority, and Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines.

text:
Ginsipa ang show director sang Olympics opening ceremony nga si Kentaro Kobayashi, antes ang pagbukas sang Tokyo 2020 Olympics karon sa gab-i.

Ini matapos nagwa ang pila ka mga video ni Kobayashi sa diin ginlango-lango sini ang natabo nga holocaust.
english:
Olympics opening ceremony show director Kentaro Kobayashi has been kicked out, ahead of the opening of the Tokyo 2020 Olympics tonight.

This comes after several videos of Kobayashi were released in which he mocked the Holocaust.

text: Nahibaluan nga natabo sang World War II ang holocaust ukon state-sponsored persecution sa diin ginpaidalom sa genocide ang six million ka mga Jews sa idalom sang Nazi regime.
english: It is known that World War II saw the holocaust or state-sponsored persecution in which six million Jews were subjected to genocide under the Nazi regime.

text: Suno kay Japanese Olympic chief Seiko Hashimoto, makabig nga isa ka yaguta sa maragtas ang amo nga mga video.
english: According to Japanese Olympic chief Seiko Hashimoto, the videos are considered a mockery of history.

text: Suno naman kay Japanese Prime Minister Yoshihide Suga, isa ka dako nga kahuy-anan ang mga nangin pahayag ni Kobayashi sa videos.
english: Japanese Prime Minister Yoshihide Suga said Kobayashi's statements in the videos were a great shame.

text: Bangud sini, nagpangayo man sang pasaylo ang show director.
english: As a result, the show director also apologized.

text: Si Kobayashi ang isa lamang sa mga opisyal nga ginpahalin sa Olympic sang nagligad nga mga bulan.
english: Kobayashi is just one of the officials fired from the Olympic in recent months.

text: Sang tinalikdan nga mga inadlaw, nagbiya sa pwesto ang composer sang Olympic bangud sa ginapahayag pagpang-bully sa abyan sini nga may sablag sa lawas.
english: In recent days, the Olympic composer resigned over alleged bullying of his disabled friend.

text: Sang Marso sa sini nga tuig, ginsipa man ang chief sang Olympic creative nga si Hiroshi Sasaki matapos ginbasagan nga “Olympig” ang Japanese plus-sized comedian nga si Naomi Watanabe.
english: In March this year, Olympic creative chief Hiroshi Sasaki was also kicked out after calling Japanese plus-sized comedian Naomi Watanabe “Olympig”.

text: Napilitan man nga magpanaog sa pwesto si Yoshiro Mori bilang head sang organizing committee matapos ginlaslasan ang mga kababainhan nga ginapahayag nagaginahod sa tion nga may mga pagsinapol.
english: Yoshiro Mori was also forced to step down as head of the organizing committee after he stabbed women who allegedly made noise during meetings.

text: Nagpaandam si Philippine National Police (PNP) Chief Gen.
english: Philippine National Police (PNP) Chief Gen.

text: Nicolas Torre III sa publiko batok sa paggamit sang illegal nga droga.
english: Nicolas Torre III to the public against the use of illegal drugs.

text: Kabahin ini sang pahayag sang heneral samtang ginapaathag ang mas masangkad nga kampanya sang pulis batok sa droga kasunod sang paglapta sang isa ka sahi sang sigarilyo nga ginatawag nga tuklaw.
english: This was part of the general's statement while explaining the police's intensified anti-drug campaign following the spread of a type of cigarette called tuklaw.

text: Kilala man ini nga black cigarettes.
english: They are also known as black cigarettes.

text: May simpon ini nga ilegal nga kemikal nga synthetic cannabinoid rason nga nagakurog-kurog ang sin-o man nga maghithit sini.
english: It contains an illegal chemical synthetic cannabinoid that makes anyone who smokes it tremble.

text: Sa Puerto Princesa City, may yara sang lima ka estudyante nga nadakpan nga nagagamit sini kadungan sang buy-bust operation.

text:
Apektado sang import ban bangud sa bird flu ang mga kalan-an ukon fast food restaurant nga nagaserbe sang “unli chicken wings.”

The import ban due to bird flu affects restaurants or fast food restaurants that serve “unli chicken wings.”

english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Salvador Jun Altura, Legal Counsel of the Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board Region 6, said that a thorough and in-depth study is required before habal-habals can be franchised.

text: 𝗜𝗡𝗗𝗜𝗔 —Nagapadayon ang rescue operation sa estado sang India sa nabagatnan sang Kerala pagkatapos sang mabaskog nga ulan nga nagtuga sang makamamatay nga landslides nga nagtupa sa mga puluy-an kag nag-stranded sang ginatos ka mga tawo.
english: 𝗜𝗡𝗗𝗜𝗔 —Rescue operations continue in the southern Indian state of Kerala after torrential rains triggered deadly landslides that crashed into homes and stranded hundreds of people.

text: Nagsobra sa 150 ang kadamuon sang mga napatay, madamo sa ila ang nalumos, kag pagdugang sang kadamuon sang mga casualties ang ginalauman nga magataas pagkatapos sang indi magkubos sa duha ka landslides nga nag-igo sa naaminhan-sidlangan nga distrito sang estado sang Wayanad sang kaagahon sang Martes.
english: The death toll has surpassed 150, many of them drowned, and an increase in the number of casualties is expected to rise after at least two landslides hit the state's northeastern district of Wayanad early on Tuesday.

text: Naga-atubang sa karon ang mga rescue workers sang makahaladlok nga mga kahimtangan bangud sang mabaskog nga ulan, kakulang sang kuryente, naguba nga mga taytay kag mga dalan nga ginbalabagan sang natumba nga mga kahoy samtang ginatinguhaan nga malab-ot ang mga nakalampuwas kag mahibaluan ang bug-os nga kasangkaron sang kalamidad.
english: Rescue workers are currently facing harrowing conditions due to torrential rains, power shortages, damaged bridges and roads blocked by fallen trees as they try to reach survivors and determine the full extent of the disaster.

text: Ang mga emergency responders naman sa lugar sang landslides – nga natabunan sang lunang kag natumba nga mga kahoy – nagdala sang mga bangkay sa mga trapal kag nagbulig sa mga pumuluyo nga magsaylo sa safe nga lugar samtang nagabubo ang ulan.
english: Emergency responders in the area of ​​the landslides – covered in mud and fallen trees – carried bodies on tarps and helped residents move to safety as the rain poured down.

text: Suno sa southern command sang Indian Army, naglab-ot sa 1,000 ka mga tawo ang naluwas tubtob subong.
english: According to the southern command of the Indian Army, as many as 1,000 people have been rescued so far.

text: Santo sa weather report, ang lapnagon nga pag-ulan ang may kabug-usan nga 150 mm sa bug-os nga Kerala, nga ang pila ka mga lugar naka-elsperyensya sang halos 250 mm nga ulan sa sulod sang 24-oras.
english: According to the weather report, widespread rainfall totaled 150 mm across Kerala, with some areas experiencing nearly 250 mm rainfall in 24-hours.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang mabaskog nga pagbaha kag landslides ang nagpatay sang ginatos, nagpahalin sang minilyon kag nagguba sang imprastraktura sa bug-os nga Bagatnan nga Asya sang nagligad nga mga binulan.
english: Heavy flooding and landslides have killed hundreds, displaced millions and destroyed infrastructure across South Asia in recent months.

text: Samtang ang mga baha kinaandan sa rehiyon sa tion sang tig-ululan, ang mga siyentipiko nagasiling nga ang krisis sa klima, amo ang nagpalala sang mga hitabo sa panahon.
english: While floods are common in the region during the rainy season, scientists say the climate crisis, has exacerbated the weather events.

english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Eduardo Siacon Jr., chief of Iloilo City Police Station 9, said the subjects were monitored for two weeks before the operation was conducted.

english: A total of 18 grams of suspected shabu worth ₱122,400 were recovered from the suspects.

text: 𝗜𝗦𝗥𝗔𝗘𝗟 —Nagaprepar ang national emergency medical service sang Israel para sa sabat gikan sa Hezbollah pagkatapos nga ginpuntirya kag ginpatay sang Israel Defence Forces (IDF) si Fuad Shukr, isa ka mataas nga lider sang terorista nga grupo, sa Beirut.
english: 𝗜𝗦𝗥𝗔𝗘𝗟 —Israel’s national emergency medical service is preparing for a response from Hezbollah after the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) targeted and killed Fuad Shukr, a senior leader of the terrorist group, in Beirut.

text: Ini ang bilang pagbalos sang Israel Defence Forces matapos ang pag-atake sang rocket sang nagligad nga semana nga nagpatay sa 12 ka mga kabataan kag mga teenagers nga Israelinhon sa isa ka soccer field sa Majdal Shams, isa ka banwa nga kalabanan mga Druze sa Golan Heights sang Israel.
english: This was in retaliation by the Israel Defense Forces after a rocket attack last week killed 12 Israeli children and teenagers on a soccer field in Majdal Shams, a predominantly Druze town in Israel’s Golan Heights.

text: Apisar sang mga kumpirmasyon gikan sa Israel Defence Forces kag United States, ginkumpirmar lamang sang Hezbollah ang iya kamatayon sang Miyerkules, sa amo man nga adlaw nga ang lider sang terorismo sang Hamas nga si Ismail Haniyeh nakasugata sang kaanggid nga kapalaran.
english: Despite confirmations from the Israel Defense Forces and the United States, Hezbollah only confirmed his death on Wednesday, the same day Hamas terror leader Ismail Haniyeh met a similar fate.

text: Si Aryeh Myers, isa ka paramedic upod kay Magen David Adom (MDA), nagsiling nga ang emergency medical service yara sa mataas nga alerto kag may mga ambulansya kag mga boluntaryo nga handa sa paglakat kon may dugang nga mga pag-atake.
english: Aryeh Myers, a paramedic with Magen David Adom (MDA), said the emergency medical service was on high alert and had ambulances and volunteers ready to go in case of further attacks.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Myers nga sugod sang Oktubre 7 nga pag-atake sang mga terorismo nga ginpangunahan sang Hamas sa nabagatnan nga Israel, sa diin kapin sa 1,200 ka tawo ang napatay kag kapin sa 250 ang gin-hostage, suno sa mga awtoridad sang Israel, isa ka bag-o nga proyekto ang ginlunsar agud hatagan ang mga sibilyan sang paghanas sa paghatag sang una nga medikal sabat sa mga sitwasyon sang emerhensya.
english: Myers also said that since the Oct. 7 terrorist attacks led by Hamas in southern Israel, in which more than 1,200 people were killed and more than 250 taken hostage, according to Israeli authorities, a new project has been launched to give civilians priority in providing medical response emergency situation.

text: Ang Magen Project, nga nagakahulugan sang depensa ukon proteksyon, nagatinguha nga mag-intra sang mga katapo sang komunidad nga madasig nga makasabat sa amo nga mga hitabo.
english: The Magen Project, which means defense or protection, seeks to involve community members who can respond quickly to such events.

text: Gin-athag man ni Myers nga ang Magen Project may yara sang mga 33,000 ka mga boluntaryo, nagapat-od nga ang ila mga salakyan sa emerhensya may tawo 24 oras kada adlaw, kag pito ka adlaw kada semana.
english: Myers also explained that the Magen Project has about 33,000 volunteers, making sure its emergency vehicles are manned 24 hours a day, and seven days a week.

text: Nahibaluan nga sugod sang Oktubre 7, ang mga komunidad nagpabaskog sang ila pagpanghanda para sa palaabuton nga mga pag-atake.
english: It is known that since October 7, communities have stepped up their preparations for future attacks.

text: Ang mga doktor, mga nars kag mga Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) nagpangita sang dugang nga lebel sang paghanas sa pag-atubang sa mga pasyente nga may trauma.
english: Doctors, nurses and Emergency Medical Technicians (EMTs) sought additional levels of training to deal with trauma patients.

text: Bag-o lang man natapos ang Israel sang tatlo ka adlaw nga pungsodnon nga pag-ensayo nga nagahanda para sa posibilidad sang isa ka bug-os nga blackout.
english: Israel also recently completed a three-day national drill preparing for the possibility of a total blackout.

text: Sa subong, mas madamo nga komunidad ang may mga sibilyan karon nga may pila ka ihibalo sa medisina nga makahatag sang una nga pag-atipan, samtang ang mga serbisyo sa emerhensya nagakinahanglan sang tion sa pagsabat.
english: In the meantime, more communities now have civilians with some medical knowledge who can provide first aid, while emergency services need time to respond.

text: Dagdagan sang show cause order sang Land Transportation Office (LTO) Region 6 ang rider nga nagtuyo nga himuslan ang 19-anyos nga pasahero sini nga babaye sa Pulo Maestra Vita Oton, Iloilo.
english: The Land Transportation Office (LTO) Region 6 has issued a show cause order against a rider who attempted to rape his 19-year-old female passenger in Pulo Maestra Vita Oton, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Gaudioso Geduspan II, Director sang Land Transportation Office, iya ginpahayag nga na-identify na sang talatapan ang rider nga nagtuyo nga manghimulos sa babaye kag nakabaton naman sang blotter halin sa kapulisan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Gaudioso Geduspan II, Director of the Land Transportation Office, said the office has already identified the rider who tried to rape the woman and received a blotter from the police.

text: Suno kay Geduspan, i-refer sa legal office ang amo nga blotter agud nga gilayon madagdagan sang nasambit nga kaso.
english: Geduspan said the blotter will be referred to the legal office so that the case can be added immediately.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga lantawon sang talatapan ang mahimo nga rekomendasyon sang otoridad kon bala mahimo nga i-suspende ukon i-revoke ang lisensya sang rider.
english: He also said the office will look into the possible recommendation of the authorities on whether the rider's license can be suspended or revoked.

text: Gin-athag man sang natungdan nga padayon ang verification sa plate number sang rider agud mangin accurate ang show cause order nga idagdag batok sa angkas rider.
english: He also explained that the verification of the rider's plate number is ongoing to ensure the accuracy of the show cause order to be added against the rider.

text: Madumduman nga nagsakay ang biktima halin sa Jaro kag pakadto kuntani sa Pavia, Iloilo apang ginhapit ini sang rider sa nasambit nga lugar kag ginapahayag pilit nga ginpanaog sa motorsiklo kag tuyo nga himuslan.
english: It can be recalled that the victim was riding from Jaro to Pavia, Iloilo but was stopped by a rider in the said area and allegedly forced off the motorcycle and intended to rape her.

text: Nakapangayo man sang bulig ang biktima sa naglabay nga mototista rason wala na madayon ang tuyo sang suspek.

english: Phenomenal Ilongga and beauty queen Ayumi Cassandra Zerrudo showed that the youth of today's generation are full of passion and purpose in life.

text: Si Zerrudo isa ka youth leader, advocate, kag ambassadress nga ang implwensiya indi lamang sa eskwelahan kundi sa komunidad kag sa pungsod.
english: Zerrudo is a youth leader, advocate, and ambassador whose influence is not only in the school but in the community and the country.

text: Siya isa sa mga Outstanding Student Leaders sang Iloilo City kag ginpangunahan ang mga inisyatibo para sa mga pagsanyog sang kaangay niya nga pamatan-on.
english: He is one of the Outstanding Student Leaders of Iloilo City and has led initiatives for the advancement of his fellow youth.

text: Siya man ang nagauyat sang title bilang Miss Philippine Youth Iloilo 2025 Princess.
english: She also holds the title as Miss Philippine Youth Iloilo 2025 Princess.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Zerrudo, iya ginpahayag nga bilang isa ka beauty queen kag youth leader, aktibo ini sa pagpakigbahin sa nanari-sari nga mga aktibidad nga nagadul-ong sang kaayuhan sa komunidad.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Zerrudo said that as a beauty queen and youth leader, she is active in participating in various activities that bring good to the community.

text: Suno sa iya, kun paano niya ginahatagan dungog ang titulo kag korona nga iya naangkon, mas ginahatagan sini sang balor ang responsibilidad nga dala sini.
english: He said that the more he honors the title and crown he has earned, the more he values ​​the responsibility that comes with it.

text: Pahayag niya, paagi sa pagtungod niya sa sini nga responsibilidad, makahatag siya sang inspirasyon kag paglaum sa kabataan kag sa iya komunidad.
english: He said that by taking on this responsibility, he can give inspiration and hope to the children and his community.

text: Nagapati naman si Zerrudo nga ang abilidad sang isa ka tawo agud mangin maayo nga impluwensya sa iban nga tawo ang ginatakos paagi sa positibo nga impact sa komunidad kag indi paagi lamang sa edad.Gindugang man sini nga ang tagsa sa pamatan-on may abilidad nga magpamuno kag luyag niya nga mangin instrumento man agud madiskubre sang iban ang ila mga potensyal sa pagpangalagad kag sa iban nga mga patag.
english: Zerrudo believes that a person's ability to be a good influence on others is measured by positive impact on the community and not just by age. He added that each of the youth has the ability to lead and he wants to be an instrument for others to discover their potential in service and other fields.

text: Liwat nga nagbangon ang kahangawa kag mas ginhugtan ang screening measures sa Asya kasunod sang outbreak sang makamamatay nga Nipah virus sa West Bengal state sa India.
english: Concerns have risen again and screening measures have been tightened in Asia following the outbreak of the deadly Nipah virus in India's West Bengal state.

text: Sa Thailand, gin-umpisahan ang pag-screen sa tatlo ka mga paluparan kun sa diin may flights nga halin sa West Bengal.
english: In Thailand, screening has been started at three airports where there are flights from West Bengal.

text: Sa Nepal, may screening man sa nagaabot sa Kathmandu airport kag sa iban nga land border points sa India.
english: In Nepal, there is also screening for arrivals at Kathmandu airport and other land border points in India.

text: Duha na ang kumpirmado nga kaso sang amo nga balatian sa West Bengal halin sang Disyembre.
english: There have been two confirmed cases of the disease in West Bengal since December.

text: 196 ka mga tawo ang na-trace nga na-close contact apang nag-negatibo sa virus.
english: 196 people were traced as close contacts but tested negative for the virus.

text: Ini nga virus ang mahimo maglaton halin sa sapat kaangay sang baboy kag kulunaknit pakadto sa tawo.
english: This virus can be transmitted from animals such as pigs and rabbits to humans.

text: Mahimo man ini magsaylo halin sa isa ka tawo pakadto sa isa pa ka tawo kun nakontamina pagkaon.
english: It can also be transmitted from one person to another if food is contaminated.

text: Mataas ang death range sini, halin sa 40% pasaka sa 75%, bangud wala pa sang bakuna ukon bulong.
english: It has a high death range, from 40% to 75%, because there is no vaccine or treatment.

text: Ginlista ini sang World Health Organization nga nalakip sa top ten priority diseases kaupod sa Covid-19 kag Zika bangud sang potensyal sini nga makatuga sang epidemic.
english: The World Health Organization has listed it among the top ten priority diseases alongside Covid-19 and Zika because of its potential to cause an epidemic.

text: Lakip sang sintomas sini nga balatian amo ang hilanat, pagsakit sang ulo, muscle pain, kag pagsakit sang tutunlan nga mahimo sundan sang pagdula sang animo, pneumonia, kag mahimo man mag-resulta sa encephalitis para sa malala nga mga kaso.
english: Among the symptoms of this disease are fever, headache, muscle pain, and sore throat which can be followed by loss of consciousness, pneumonia, and can also result in encephalitis for severe cases.

text: Nagapati ka man bala sa halambalanon nga “Love is lovelier the second time around”?
english: Do you believe in the saying “Love is lovelier the second time around”?

text: Napamatud-an ini sang anay mag-asawa sa Pennsylvania, USA nga nag-diborsyo halos lima ka dekada na ang nagligad, apang nagpakasal liwat subong nga 2024.
english: This was proven by the former couple in Pennsylvania, USA who divorced almost five decades ago, but remarried as of 2024.

text: Ini ang love story nanday Fay Shober, 89, kag si Robert Wenrich, 94.
english: This is the love story of Fay Shober, 89, and Robert Wenrich, 94.

text: Teenager pa lamang si Fay sang nakilala sini si Robert bangud nga ka-barkada ini sang iya magulang.
english: Fay was a teenager when she met Robert because he was a friend of her brother.

text: Sang una pa lang, ginsiling na ni Robert nga pangasawahon sini si Fay kag natabo ini bangud sang November 10, 1951, nagpakasal sila kag nag-angkon sang mga bunga ang ila paghigugmaanay.
english: Earlier, Robert had said that he would marry Fay and it happened because on November 10, 1951, they got married and their love bore fruit.

text: Ugaling, kaangay sa iban nga love stories, may mga pagpanghangkat man sa ila nga relasyon kag nagdesisyon sila nga magbulagay matapos ang 24 ka tuig nga pag-updanay bilang mag-asawa.
english: However, like other love stories, there were challenges in their relationship and they decided to separate after 24 years of marriage.

text: Bisan may kabataan sila, nag-divorce sila sang 1975.
english: Although they had children, they divorced in 1975.

text: Pagkatapos sadto, nagpangasawa sila kag nagpamana sang lain… apang napatay ang second husband ni Fay sang 2022.
english: After that, they got married and married someone else… but Fay’s second husband died in 2022.

text: 42 ka tuig man ang ila gin-updanay antes ini nabalo.
english: They were also married for 42 years before she became a widow.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, nagpakasal man anay si Robert kay Carol Shultz, apang nabalo man siya bangud napatay ang babaye 24 anyos na ang nagligad.
english: On the other hand, Robert was also previously married to Carol Shultz, but he was also widowed as the woman died 24 years ago.

text: Samtang nagatigulang, naga-tabuay man gihapon ang banas nanday Robert kay Fay bangud pareho sila nga nagatambong sa family events.
english: As they get older, Robert and Fay still cross paths as they both attend family events.

text: Bangud maayo man ang ila nga relasyon, daw kaangay sila sang teenagers nga na-in love liwat sa isa kag isa.
english: Because they have a good relationship, they are like teenagers who are in love with each other again.

text: Bangud first love man ni Robert si Fay, wala na ini nag-uyang sang tiyempo kag ginpakaslan ini liwat sang nagligad lamang nga Disyembre 8.
english: Since Robert was also Fay's first love, he did not waste time and married her again last December 8.

text: Ginpahayag sang mag-asawa nga indi nila batasan nga balikan pa ang rason sang ila pagbulagay sang una bangud ang ila mindset subong amo nga i-enjoy kun ano ang yara sa ila pamilya.
english: The couple said they are not used to going back to the reason for their separation in the past because their mindset now is to enjoy what they have in their family.

text: Gina-enjoy nila ang pagkadto sa simbahan, pagtambong sa birthday parties sang ila mga apo, pagkadto sa casino, kag paghampang sang baraha sa ila nga balay.
english: They enjoy going to church, attending their grandchildren's birthday parties, going to the casino, and playing cards at home.

text: Suno sa newlyweds, sang una anay, tuman sa ila nga sako sa pagpadako sang ila apat ka kabataan gani nga wala gid sila sang bebetime ukon husband-wife date nights.
english: According to the newlyweds, in the past, they were so busy raising their four children that they never had bebetime or husband-wife date nights.

text: Bisan gani lantaw sang sine, indi nila mahimo sang una.
english: Even watching movies, they couldn't before.

text: Pero subong, mas may time na sila nga mag-enjoy ilabi na bangud suportado sila sang ila kabataan kag ginapanginbulahan sila sang halos tanan nga nakakilala sa ila sa ila nga komunidad.
english: But now, they have more time to enjoy especially since they are supported by their children and congratulated by almost everyone who knows them in their community.

text: TUNGOD sa pagbutyog sang bili sang mga balaklon (inflation) sa United States na-obligar ang  US Federal Bank, bilang last resort, sa pagpataas sang interest rates sa pagpahulam sa mga bangko nga nagpataas man sang ila interest rates sa publiko.
english: Due to the rise in inflation in the United States, the US Federal Bank, as a last resort, has been forced to raise interest rates on lending to banks that have also raised their interest rates to the public.

text: Ginhimo ini sang US Federal Bank agud mapanubo ang inflation sa ila pungsod.
english: This was done by the US Federal Bank to reduce inflation in their country.

text: Makapataas man ini sang balor sang US Dollar kag purchasing power sang ila mga pumuluyo.
english: It will also increase the value of the US Dollar and the purchasing power of their citizens.

text: In effect, ugaling, naapektuhan sini ang mga pungsod nga ang balor sang ila kwarta (currency) nagasalig sa balor man sang USD, nga ginakilala sang kadam-an bilang isa ka international money.
english: In effect, however, it affects countries whose currencies depend on the value of the USD, which is widely recognized as an international currency.

text: Sa pagtaas sang balor sang USD natural lang nga maganubo man ang balor sang aton Peso kontra USD.
english: With the increase in the value of the USD, it is natural that the value of our Peso against the USD will also decrease.

text: Labi  na gid kay sa gihapon  laban ang aton pagpamakal (import) sangsa pagbaligya (export) sa luas, nga nagpanubo pa gid sang aton ginakita sa USD.
english: Especially since our imports are still higher than our exports, which has further reduced our USD income.

text:
***

Isa sa daku nga kabangdanan sang  global inflation amo ang gyera sa tunga sang Rusya kag Ukraine.
english:
***

One of the major causes of  global inflation is the war between Russia and Ukraine.

text: Nagtublag ini sang supply sang fossil fuel sa dugang nga paggamit sini sa gyera kag tungod man sa mga sanctions sa tunga sang Rusya kag sang US kag NATO nga nagaapin sa Ukraine.
english: This has disrupted the supply of fossil fuels with its increased use in the war and also because of the sanctions between Russia and the US and NATO defending Ukraine.

text: Nga daan gaantos na ang aton ekonomiya sa Pinas bunga sang pagpamintas sang Covid sugod pa sang Pebrero 2020 kag samtang padayon kita nga nagaantos bilang “most vulnerable” nga pungsod sa Climate Change sa padayon nga paglala sang mga bagyo, baha kag iban pa nga kalamidad.
english: That our economy in the Philippines is already suffering from the impact of Covid since February 2020 and while we continue to suffer as the “most vulnerable” country to Climate Change in the continuous worsening of typhoons, floods and other disasters.

text: Nagdugang pa diri ang kwestyonable nga interes sang Organization of Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC).
english: Added to this is the questionable interest of the Organization of Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC).

text: May 13 ini nga katapo nga may dalagku nga produksyon sang krudo (oil) nga ginagamit sa pag-producir sang fossil fuel, katulad sang gasolina kag diesel fuel.
english: It has 13 members with large production of crude oil used to produce fossil fuels, such as gasoline and diesel fuel.

text: Sa karon, kinahanglan pa ining fossil fuel sang mga pungsod agud mapadayon ang ila moderno nga pagpangabuhi.
english: Today, countries still need this fossil fuel to sustain their modern lifestyles.

text: Indi myembro sang OPEC ang Rusya, US kag NATO countries.
english: Russia, the US and NATO countries are not members of OPEC.

text: Gina-kwestyon gani karon sang US ang ulihi nga anunsyo sang Saudi Arabia, nga isa ka daku nga myembro sang OPEC, nga ibanan ang produksyon sini sang krudo sing isa ka milyon ka bariles.
english: The US is now questioning the recent announcement by Saudi Arabia, a large member of OPEC, to cut its crude production by one million barrels.

text: Makapataas  sing daku ini sang bili sang krudo sa global market!
english: This will dramatically increase the price of crude oil in the global market!

text: Taking advantage na ini sa iban nga pungsod, sa panan-aw sang US, sang isa ka oil-producing nga pungsod samtang isa ini sa may pinakadamo nga reserba sang krudo.
english: It is taking advantage of other countries, in the eyes of the US, of being an oil-producing country while it has one of the largest oil reserves.

text: Namahog na gani ang US nga kuhaon ang bulig pwersa militar sini sa Saudi.
english: The US has even threatened to withdraw its military assistance from Saudi Arabia.

text: In fact, nagsaka na sing daku ang bili sang ginabakal ta nga fossil fuel.
english: In fact, the price of fossil fuels has gone up dramatically.

text: Ang bili sang diesel fuel, nga mayor nga kinahanglanon sang transportasyon publiko sa Pinas, nagsaka na sa P6 kada litro.
english: The price of diesel fuel, which is the main requirement of public transportation in the Philippines, has already increased to P6 per liter.

text:
***

Ti,maano kita sini?
english:
***

Well, what do we do with this?

text: Una, ihatag ta anay seguro ang aton pagsalig sa US agud mapunggan ang ano man nga pagpasaka pa sang bili sang krudo sang OPEC, kag meantime himuon ang kon ano man naton mahimo agud mamedyosan ini nga problema.
english: First, let's give insurance to the US to prevent any further increase in OPEC crude oil prices, and meantime do whatever we can to remedy this problem.

text: Samtang sige man ang ginahimo sang Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) agud ma-proteksyunan ang balor sang Peso.
english: Meanwhile, the Central Bank of the Philippines (BSP) continues to protect the value of the Peso.

text: Sige man ang hikot sang gobyerno agud masabat ang problema sa unemployment kag padayon nga pagsaka sang bili sang serbisyo kag balaklon sa merkado.
english: The government is also working to address the problem of unemployment and the continuous rise in the price of services and goods in the market.

text: Ikaduha amo ang pagpatigayon sang iban nga paagi, katulad sang pag-“import” sang USD agud mabuligan stabilize ang aton exchange rate paagi sa pag-engganyo sang mga USD investment sa Pinas kag pagpauswag sang turismo.
english: The second is to implement other means, such as importing USD to help stabilize our exchange rate by encouraging USD investment in the Philippines and promoting tourism.

text: Ang Pinas nagapahanugot sa mga foreign visitors sa pagpasulod diri sang ila  madala nga USD tubtub sa $10,000.
english: The Philippines allows foreign visitors to bring in USD up to $10,000.

text: Bangod sa pagnubo sang balor sang aton Peso, bentaha ini sa mga US citizens kag iban nga foreign travelers tungod makakuha sila sing mas mataas nga baylo sa aton Peso nga ila magasto samtang diri sa aton.
english: Due to the depreciation of our Peso, this is an advantage for US citizens and other foreign travelers because they can get a higher exchange rate for our Peso that they can spend while here.

text: Gani, amligan ta gid nga indi madismaya sa aton ang aton mga bisita diri sa pungsod.
english: Therefore, let us make sure that our visitors here in the country are not disappointed with us.

text: Angot diri, gina-kondenar naton ang ginhimo nga panloloko sang isa ka taxi driver sa Manila nga nagpanukot sing tatlo ka pilu sang authorized fare sa isa ka myembro sang popular nga K-Pop band sang Korea.
english: In this regard, we condemn the fraud committed by a taxi driver in Manila who charged three times the authorized fare to a member of a popular Korean K-Pop band.

text: Kon sa bagay indi man lang kita may kasubong mga problema sa pila ka taxi driver.
english: In fact, we don't have such problems with some taxi drivers.

text: Nagakatabo man ining panloloko nila sa mga turista sa Thailand, Vietnam, Turkey kag bisan sa New York City.
english: They also scam tourists in Thailand, Vietnam, Turkey and even New York City.

text: Agud matapna ini kinahanglan naton ang maabtik nga aksyon.
english: To prevent this we need urgent action.

text: Ipa-priso gid ang drayber kag ipa-cancel ang iya lisensya katulad sang ginahimo sang Vietnam.
english: The driver will be imprisoned and his license canceled like Vietnam does.

text: Mga haslo matuod nga indi dapat pamarisan!/PN
english: It's a shame that shouldn't be tolerated!/PN

text: Ginkontra sang National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) ang nangin pahayag sang 18 ka mga marino nga naggamit sila sang air taxi flight para mag-deliver sang maleta nga kwarta sa balay ni Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) has refuted the claim of 18 sailors that they used an air taxi flight to deliver a suitcase of money to the house of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: sa Ilocos Norte.
english: in Ilocos Norte.

text: Suno kay NBI chief Atty. Melvin Matibag, wala sila sang nakuha nga ano man nga flight logs nga para pamatud-an nga gin-deliver ni anay Ako Bicol Partylist Rep.
english: According to NBI chief Atty. Melvin Matibag, they did not get any flight logs to prove that former Ako Bicol Partylist Rep.

text: Zaldy Co ang kwarta.
english: Zaldy Co the money.

text: Humalin pa sang 2023 kag 2025, gin-usisa sang NBI ang mga flight record kag wala sila sang nakita nga flight ni Co kag pila ka mga opisyal.
english: As early as 2023 and 2025, the NBI checked flight records and found no flights of Co and several officers.

text: Una nga gin-alegar ni Sgt.
english: Initially, Sgt.

text: Belnard Tube nga gin-upod siya ni Co para magbiyahe sa Ilocos Norte kag i-deliver ang maleta nga kwarta sa presidente.
english: Belnard Tube that Co accompanied him to travel to Ilocos Norte and deliver the suitcase of money to the president.

text: Naglab-ot sa ₱186.8 billion pesos ang napadala nga kwarta sang mga Pilipino ng nagatrabaho sa guwa sang pungsod sang bulan sang Oktubre.
english: Filipinos working abroad remitted ₱186.8 billion pesos in October.

text:
Suno sa Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) humalin Enero tubtob Oktubre, ang kabug-usan nga padala nag-abot sa ₱1.72 trillion Philippine pesos

Ginpahayag sang BSP nga kadam-an sang padala ang naghalin sa Estados Unidos, Singapore, kag Saudi Arabia.
english:
According to the Central Bank of the Philippines (BSP) from January to October, total remittances amounted to ₱1.72trillion Philippine pesos

The BSP said most of the shipment came from the United States, Singapore, and Saudi Arabia.

text: Ang personal nga padala naman sang kwarta nag-abot sa ₱206.6 billion pesos sang Oktubre, kag ₱1.92 trillion pesos bilyon sa unang tatlo ka quarters sang tuig.
english: Personal remittances amounted to ₱206.6 billion pesos in October, and ₱1.92 trillion pesos billion in the first three quarters of the year.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang Pilipinas isa sa mga pungsod nga may pinakadako nga remittances sa kalibutan.
english: The Philippines is one of the countries with the largest remittances in the world.

text: Ang kwarta nga ginapadala sang mga OFW sa ila pamilya sa pungsod nagabulig sa pagpahamtang sang konsumo sa sulod sang pungsod kag pag-uswag sang ekonomiya.
english: The money that OFWs send to their families in the country helps stabilize domestic consumption and economic growth.

text: Gintadtad-labo sang isa ka 70-anyos nga mangunguma ang ulo sang 56-anyos nga upod sini sa inom sa Barangay Poblacion, banwa sang Barotac Viejo, Iloilo.
english: A 70-year-old farmer stabbed his 56-year-old drinking companion in Barangay Poblacion, Barotac Viejo, Iloilo.

text: Ang biktima naman amo si Alyas Alex, 56-anyos, mangunguma, residente sang Barangay Sincua, Lemery, Iloilo.
english: The victim was identified as Alex, 56, farmer, resident of Barangay Sincua, Lemery, Iloilo.

text: Ang suspek amo si Alyas Alonie, 70-anyos, mangunguma, residente sang Sitio Pal-ak, Barangay Poblacion, Barotac Viejo.
english: The suspect was identified as Alonie, 70, farmer, resident of Sitio Pal-ak, Barangay Poblacion, Barotac Viejo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Felix Alianza Jr., hepe sang Barotac Viejo Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga nag-inom ang duwa sang makahulubog nga ilimnon, kag tuyo na tani nga magpahuway sang suspek, apang gusto pa nga magpadugang inom sang biktima apang wala sini ginpahanugutan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Felix Alianza Jr., chief of the Barotac Viejo Municipal Police Station, said the two were drinking alcoholic beverages, and the suspect was about to rest, but the victim wanted to drink more but he did not allow them.

text: Suno kay kay Alianza, nagmaoy ang biktima rason nga gintadtad sang labo sang suspek ang ulo sini gamit ang malaba, matalo, kag duha ka tapak nga kalabaon sang binangon.
english: According to Alianza, the victim became angry and the suspect stabbed him in the head with a long, sharp, two-foot-long binangon.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga nagsungka na ang suspek sa ila nga estasyon kag narecover ang binangon nga ginamit sini sa pagpatay sa biktima.
english: He said the suspect surrendered to their station and the binangon he used to kill the victim was recovered.

text: Ginhingagaw naman dala sa ospital ang biktima apang gindeklara nga dead-on-arrival matapos nag-agum sang patal nga pilas sa ulo, li-og, kag guya, rason man nga nagguluwa ang utok sini.
english: The victim was rushed to the hospital but was declared dead-on-arrival after sustaining fatal injuries to his head, neck, and face, causing his brain to come out.

text: Sa subong, yara na ang suspek sa kustodiya sang Barotac Viejo MPS kag pagasakaan sang kaso nga murder.
english: The suspect is now in the custody of Barotac Viejo MPS and will be charged with murder.

text: Naangkon sang pungsod Japan ang pinakauna nga kadalag-an sa pagbukas sang hinampang sa 2020 Tokyo Olympics.
english: Japan won its first opening game of the 2020 Tokyo Olympics.

text: Suno kay Bombo Samurai International Correspondent Josel Palma direkta sa Japan, ginpatigayon sa Fukushima stadium ang women softball games sa diin ginlutos sang Japan ang pungsod Australia sa score nga 8-1.
english: According to Bombo Samurai International Correspondent Josel Palma directly in Japan, the women's softball games were held at the Fukushima stadium where Japan defeated Australia with a score of 8-1.

text: Ang kadalag-an sang Japan ang bangud man sa pagpanguna sang gold medalist kag pitcher nga si Ueno Yukiko.
english: Japan's victory was also due to the leadership of gold medalist and pitcher Ueno Yukiko.

text: Nagtakop ang hampang matapos ang lima ka innings bangud sa mercy rule.
english: The game ended after five innings due to the mercy rule.

text: Bangud sa pamahog nga dala sang COVID-19, ginhiwat ang hampang nga wala sang spectators kag fans sa sulod sang Fukushima stadium.
english: Due to the threat posed by COVID-19, the match was held without spectators and fans inside the Fukushima stadium.

text: Nagapakig-angot ang Department of Agriculture sang pungsod sa Estados Unidos agud nga maka-sekyar sang bakuna batuk sa African Swine Fever.
english: The country's Department of Agriculture is in contact with the United States to secure a vaccine against African Swine Fever.

text: Suno kay DA Assistant Secretary Noel Reyes, nagalaum ini nga mahatagan ang ahensya sang sample sang bakuna halin sa US Department of Agriculture.
english: DA Assistant Secretary Noel Reyes said he hopes the agency will be given a sample of the vaccine from the US Department of Agriculture.

text: Magapain sang pondo ang ahensya para sa posible bakuna batuk sa ASF.
english: The agency will allocate funds for a possible vaccine against ASF.

text: Nahibaluan nga 2019 pa lang, naga-agunto na ang pungsod sa epekto sang African Swine Fever.
english: It is known that since 2019, the country has been suffering from the effects of African Swine Fever.

text: Ginabanta masobra apat ka milyon nga mga baboy ang nadula sa pungsod bangud sa nasambit nga balatian.
english: It is estimated that more than four million pigs have been lost in the country due to the disease.

text: Padayunon sang Office of the Sergeant-at-Arms (OSAA) sang Senado ang random drug testing sang mga empleyado kag staff kasunod sang reports nga may empleyado nga nagagamit sang marijuana sa sulod sang building.
english: The Office of the Sergeant-at-Arms (OSAA) of the Senate will continue random drug testing of employees and staff following reports that some employees are using marijuana inside the building.

text: Suno sa OSAA, magapasa ini sang report sa Senate President sa update sang imbestigasyon.
english: OSAA said it will submit a report to the Senate President on an update on the investigation.

text: Ginpahayag nga may isa ka OSAA personnel nga nakapanimaho sang marijuana sa opisina sang isa ka senador.
english: An OSAA personnel reportedly smelled marijuana in a senator's office.

text: Nagsabat naman ang isa ka staff nga baho lamang ini sang air freshener.
english: One staff member replied that it was just the smell of air freshener.

text: Gin-alegar man nga gin-flush sang amo nga staff sa basin amo marijuana.
english: The staff also allegedly flushed marijuana into the basin.

text: Ginkakasan na sang pondo ang Ayuda Para sa Kapos ang Kita Program (AKAP) program sang Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) sa idalom sang proposed P6.793 trillion nga 2026 national budget.
english: The Ayuda Para Sa Kapos ang Kita Program (AKAP) program of the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) has been defunded under the proposed P6.793 trillion 2026 national budget.

text: Ini ang ginkumpirma ni Department of Budget and Management (DBM) Secretary Amenah Pangandaman.
english: This was confirmed by Department of Budget and Management (DBM) Secretary Amenah Pangandaman.

text: Ang AKAP ang una nga ginpakilala sang 2023 ni Speaker Martin Romualdez kag anay House Appropriations Chairman Rep.
english: AKAP was first introduced in 2023 by Speaker Martin Romualdez and former House Appropriations Chairman Rep.

text: Elizaldy Co.
english: Elizaldy Co.

text: Katuyuan sini nga maghatag sang pinansyal nga ayuda sa mga minimum wage earners nga pigado nga mga Pilipino nga apektado sang nagtimbuok nga inflation.
english: It aims to provide financial assistance to minimum wage earners who are poor Filipinos affected by rising inflation.

text: Gin-ulan naman sang kritisismo ini nga ginpahayag nga “pet project” ni Romualdez nga nalakip sa national budget sang 2024 nga may pondo nga P26 billion kag amo man sa 2025.
english: Romualdez's alleged “pet project” included in the 2024 national budget with a budget of P26 billion and the same in 2025 has been criticized.

text: Suno kay Pangandaman, wala na ginpondohan ang AKAP para sa 2026 bangud sa limitado nga fiscal space.
english: According to Pangandaman, AKAP has not been funded for 2026 due to limited fiscal space.

text: Samtang, may pondo naman nga P113 bilyon ang Pantawid Pamilyang Pilipino Program ukon 4Ps ka Tulong Panghanapbuhay sa Ating Disadvantaged Workers (TUPAD) Program.
english: Meanwhile, the Pantawid Pamilyang Pilipino Program or 4Ps has a budget of P113 billion.

text: Nagpaandam ang China nga mangatubang ang Pilipinas sang mas daku nga katalagman kasunod sang promisa sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika nga magahatag ini sang $500 million ukon P29.17-billion bilang dugang sa military funding para sa depensa sang pungsod.
english: China has warned that the Philippines faces a greater threat following the United States' promise to provide $500 million or P29.17-billion in additional military funding for the country's defense.

text: Suno kay Chinese foreign ministry spokesman Lin Jian, mabutang lamang sa alang-alang ang regional stability kag mas magasaka ang tension bangud sa gina-obra sang Pilipinas nga pagpangaluyag sa iban nga mga nasyon nga mag-intra sa isyu sa West Philippione Sea.
english: According to Chinese foreign ministry spokesman Lin Jian, regional stability will only be jeopardized and tensions will rise due to the Philippines' efforts to persuade other countries to get involved in the West Philippine Sea issue.

text: Paandam pa ni Lin, mahimo pa gani nga mangin paon ang mga tikang sang Pilipinas bangud padayon ini sa pagpangita sang external forces para apinan ang kaugalingon nga seguridad.
english: Lin warned that the Philippines' actions could even become bait as it continues to seek external forces to protect its own security.

text: “Trying to introduce external forces to protect its own security will only lead to greater insecurity for itself, and it might even become someone else’s pawn,” pahayag ni Lin.
english: “Trying to introduce external forces to protect its own security will only lead to greater insecurity for itself, and it might even become someone else’s pawn,” stated Lin.

text: Ang statement sang sini nga Chinese official ang kasunod man sa pag-abot nanday US State Secretary Antony Blinken kag Defense Secretary Lloyd Austin sa Manila kun sa diin naistorya nila ang ila counterparts diri sa Pilipinas.
english: The statement of the Chinese official also follows the arrival of US State Secretary Antony Blinken and Defense Secretary Lloyd Austin in Manila where they met with their counterparts here in the Philippines.

text: Nahibaluan nga magluwas sa daku nga kantidad nga ginpasalig para i-augment sa defense capabilities, may ihatag man ang Amerika nga $128 million ukon P7.4 billion agud doblehon ang investments sa military bases nga mahimo ma-access sang tropa sang Estados Unidos.
english: It is known that besides the huge amount pledged to augment defense capabilities, the United States will also provide $128 million or P7.4 billion to double investments in military bases that can be accessed by US troops.

text: Base sa mga impormasyon, nagpahayag man ang interes ang Pilipinas nga magbakal sang F-16 jets halin sa Amerika.
english: According to reports, the Philippines has also expressed interest in buying F-16 jets from the United States.

text: Nagapatigayon ang grupo sang mga motorcycle riders sang adbokasiya agud maedukar ang mga motorista ilabi na ang mga pamatan-on tuhoy sa road safety.
english: The group of motorcycle riders is conducting advocacy to educate motorists especially the youth about road safety.

text:
Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Felix Serisola, Regional Director sang Motorcycle Philippines Federation, iya ginpahayag nga may yara sila sang inisyatibo nga ginatawag nga “MOTOSKWELA.”

Suno kay Serisola, sa sini nga programa, nagahiwat sila sang road safety awareness seminar sa mga eskwelahan kag sa mga barangay.
english:
In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Felix Serisola, Regional Director of the Motorcycle Philippines Federation, said they have an initiative called “MOTOSKWELA.”

According to Serisola, in this program, they are conducting road safety awareness seminars in schools and barangays.

text: Pahayag ni Serisola, target nila ang mga menor de edad bangud bangud sa kakulangan sa ihibalo kag eksperyensiya sa dalanon.
english: Serisola said they target minors because of their lack of knowledge and experience on the road.

text: Dugang niya, ginatudlo man nga rason sang mga aksidente amo ang kakulangan sang disiplina sang mga riders.
english: He added that the reason for the accidents is also the lack of discipline of the riders.

text: Base sa record sang Iloilo Police Provincial Office, sang 2024, naglab-ot sa 1157 ang mga road accident kun sa diin 38 diri ang minors, samtang sa first quarter naman sang 2025,yara na sa 907 ang narekord nga aksidente kag 25 diri ang menor de edad.
english: Based on the records of the Iloilo Police Provincial Office, in 2024, there will be 1157 road accidents of which 38 will be minors, while in the first quarter of 2025, there will be 907 recorded accidents and 25 of them will be minors.

text: Nahibaluan nga subong nga Mayo amo ang Road Safety Month.
english: It is known that this May is Road Safety Month.

text: ILOILO CITY- Nadeliver na ang kontrobersyal nga mga heavy equipment nga gin-procure sang Local Government Unit sang Dumangas, Iloilo.
english: ILOILO CITY- The controversial heavy equipment procured by the Local Government Unit of Dumangas, Iloilo has been delivered.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dumangas, Iloilo Mayor Ronaldo Onal Golez, iya ginpahayag nga matapos nag-abot ini nga mga heavy equipment, ginpresentar sa mga natungdan nga ahensya ang mga dokumento sang mga equipment.
