english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Dumangas, Iloilo Mayor Ronaldo Onal Golez said that after the arrival of the heavy equipment, the documents of the equipment were presented to the concerned agencies.

text: Suno kay Golez, gincheck man sang local inspection team ang nasambit nga mga equipment kag nagsibo ang tanan nga specifications sa presyo sang mga equipment sang kompaniya nga AVANTRAC.
english: According to Golez, the local inspection team also checked the said equipment and all the specifications matched the price of the equipment of the company AVANTRAC.

text: Pahayag ni Golez, ginpatalang lang sang iban nga sangguniang bayan members ang publiko paagi sa pagpagwa sang sala nga specifications agud pagwaon nga overpriced ang nasambit nga mga equipment.
english: Golez said some sangguniang bayan members were just misleading the public by issuing false specifications to make it appear that the equipment was overpriced.

text: Matandaan nga ginbuyagyag ni Sangguniang Bayan Member Ian Dolendo nga kon sumahon ang presyo sang ginprocure nga equipment sa kompaniya nga AVANTRAC nga nakabase sa Cebu nga nagdaog sa bidding, nagalab-ot tanan P45M ang balor sang duha ka brand new 6-wheeler dump truck, isa ka brand new nga 6-wheeler garbage compactor, isa ka brand new nga 4 by 4 backhoe loader, isa ka brand new nga 6-wheeler mini dump truck, kag isa ka brand new nga generator set.
english: It can be recalled that Sangguniang Bayan Member Ian Dolendo revealed that if the price of the equipment procured from the company AVANTRAC based in Cebu that won the bidding, the value of two brand new 6-wheeler dump trucks, a brand new 6-wheeler compactor, a brand new garbage collector, a total of P45 million that 4 by 4 backhoe loader, a brand new 6-wheeler mini dump truck, and a brand new generator set.

text: Apang kon presyo naman sang iban nga kompaniya nga HOWO/HOMAN kag SINOTRUK/LONKING ang basehan, nagalab-ot lang ini sa kapin P11.5M.
english: However, if the price of other companies such as HOWO/HOMAN and SINOTRUK/LONKING is the basis, it only reaches more than P11.5M.

text: Dugang pa sang natungdan, ang Commission on Audit lang ang makahusga kon may natabo gid man nga overpricing sa ginpang-procure nga mga equipment.
english: He added that only the Commission on Audit can judge whether there was overpricing in the procured equipment.

text: Nagapati ang presidente sang Samahang Weightlifting ng Pilipinas (SWP) nga dako ang tyansa sang Pinay weightlifter nga si Hidilyn Diaz nga makuha ang gold medal sa 55-kg class competition sa 2020 Tokyo Olympics.
english: The president of the Samahang Weightlifting ng Pilipinas (SWP) believes that Filipino weightlifter Hidilyn Diaz has a good chance of winning the gold medal in the 55-kg class competition at the 2020 Tokyo Olympics.

text: Sa exclusive interview sang Bombo Radyo kay former Bacolod City Representative kag Mayor Monico Puentevella, iya ginpahayag nga makabig nga dako nga balantayan si Diaz bangud una na nga na-angkon sang atleta ang silver medal sa Rio de Janeiro Olympic sang 2016.
english: In an exclusive interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, former Bacolod City Representative and Mayor Monico Puentevella said Diaz is a great example because the athlete previously won a silver medal at the Rio de Janeiro Olympics in 2016.

text: Suno kay Puentevella, pat-od nga handa kag pursigido si Diaz nga malapawan pa ang iya rekord kag mapauli ang gold medal sa sini nga tuig.
english: According to Puentevella, Diaz is ready and determined to break his record and bring home the gold medal this year.

text: Makabig man suno sa iya nga beterano na sa weightlifting si Diaz sa diin ika-apat na ini niya nga appearance sa Olympic Summer Games.
english: He said Diaz is a veteran in weightlifting and this is his fourth appearance at the Olympic Summer Games.

text: Magluwas kay Diaz, gindayaw man ni Puentevella ang tumandok sang Cebu City kag makabig nga promising weightlifter nga si Elreen Ann Ando.
english: Besides Diaz, Puentevella also praised Cebu City native and promising weightlifter Elreen Ann Ando.

text: Gin-ako ni Puentevella nga ginapreparar pa niya kuntani si Ando sa 2024 Olympic nga pagahiwaton sa Paris, France apang timprano pa ini nga na-qualify para sa Summer Games bangud sa impresibo sini nga abilidad sa weightlifting.
english: Puentevella admitted that he was still preparing Ando for the 2024 Olympics to be held in Paris, France but he qualified for the Summer Games early due to his impressive weightlifting skills.

text: Nag-apelar sa publiko ang suod nga abyan ni Senator Manny Pacquiao nga untaton na ang paghaboy sang pagpakamalaot sa boxing champion kag hatagan ini sang suporta para sa nagahilapit na niya nga sambuwa sa Agosto 21 sa Estados Unidos.
english: A close friend of Senator Manny Pacquiao has appealed to the public to stop throwing insults at the boxing champion and give him support for his upcoming fight on August 21 in the United States.

text: Sa exclusive interview kay Samahang Weightlifting ng Pilipinas (SWP) president Monico Puentevella nga amo man ang former Representative kag Mayor sang Bacolod City, iya ginpahayag nga dugo kag balhas ang ginasakripisyo ni Pacquiao para makuha ang kadalag-an sang pungsod sa patag sang boxing.
english: In an exclusive interview with Samahang Weightlifting ng Pilipinas (SWP) president Monico Puentevella, who is also the former Representative and Mayor of Bacolod City, he said that Pacquiao is sacrificing blood and sweat to win the country's victory in the field of boxing.

text: ”Ginpahayag ko ang mensahe tubtob kay Presidente Digong nga kun mahimo, tapuson ta bala anay ang away… kay ang gabato ya Filipino, indi mana ya iban.
english: "I conveyed the message to President Digong that if possible, let's end the fight first... because the one who is fighting is a Filipino, not someone else.

text: Ti gapamalhas ang tawo, nagapanginmatay para sa bandila sang Pilipinas, sagi niyo man ya yaguta kag sagi niyo man ya insulto…Siling ko, kun mahimo, Mr. President, hasta ang mga trolls mo da, kun mahimo untata niyo nana…Didto sa amerika idol siya sang tanan… siling nila, popular pa siya kay Lebron James.
english: People are dressing up, dying for the Philippine flag, you often ridicule and insult... I said, if possible, Mr. President, even your trolls, if you can stop it... In America he is everyone's idol... they say he is more popular than Lebron James.

text:
Ti sagi tadi ya ka yaguta tungod lang sa politika… ti nano bi na,”

Suno kay Puentevella, kilala niya si Pacquiao kag hugot ang pagfocus sini kun may yara sang training para sa natalana nga sambuwa.
english:
He's always making fun of you just because of politics... what's that,”

According to Puentevella, he knows Pacquiao and he is very focused when there is training for the scheduled fight.

text: Pahayag ni Puentevella, una na niya ginhingyo ang government officials ilabi na si Presidente Rodrigo Duterte nga untaton anay ang pagpang-atake kay Pacquiao bangud ginpat-od man sang senador nga sa tion nga matapos ang iya sambuwa batok kay Errol Spence Jr.
english: Puentevella said he had already asked government officials especially President Rodrigo Duterte to stop attacking Pacquiao because the senator also assured that once his fight against Errol Spence Jr. is over,

text: sa Estados Unidos, atubangon niya ang tanan nga isyu sa Pilipinas angot sa politika.
english: in the United States, he will deal with all political issues in the Philippines.

text: Dugang pa niya, nagakadapat nga ipaiway anay sang pungsod ang politika kag suportahan ang Pinoy Pride sa pagbitbit sini sang hayahay sang pungsod para sa nagahilapit nga boxing match.
english: He added that the country should put politics aside and support Pinoy Pride in carrying the country's flag for the upcoming boxing match.

text: ”Ang mensahe ni Senator, simple… nga tapuson ta ang away, pagbalik ko da, blow by blow kita Mr. President.
english: "The Senator's message is simple... that we end the fight, when I come back, we will blow by blow Mr. President.

text:
Ihatag ko sa imo ang audio video sang kurapsyon nga ginbilin koda sa tion nga matapos ang away sa August 21.”

Nahibaluan nga ginbaton ni Pacquiao ang hangkat ni Duterte nga pangalanan ang mga kurap nga ahensya sang gobyerno.
english:
I will give you the audio video of the corruption I left once the fight is over on August 21.”

Pacquiao accepted Duterte's challenge to name corrupt government agencies.

text: Bag-o magpadulong ang Senador sa Estados Unidos para sa iya training, ginbuyagyag niya nga wala na-account sang Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) ang P10.4 billion nga balor sang nagkaladula nga pondo sang gobyerno para sa COVID-19 cash aid program.
english: Before the Senator left for the United States for his training, he revealed that the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) did not account for the P10.4 billion worth of lost government funds for the COVID-19 cash aid program.

text: Ginlaslasan man ni Pacquiao ang Department of Health bangud sa ginapahayag pagbakal sang ahensya sang mga expire nga bulong.
english: Pacquiao also slammed the Department of Health for the agency's alleged purchase of expired medicines.

text: Guilty ang nangin desisyon sang Land Transportation Office (LTO) sa ginhimo nga imbestigasyon batok sa motovlogger nga si “Yanna” kaangot sa nag-viral nga pagbais sini sa isa ka pickup truck driver sa Zambales.
english: The Land Transportation Office (LTO) has found guilty in its investigation against motovlogger “Yanna” in connection with her viral argument with a pickup truck driver in Zambales.

text: Ginpamulta ini sang P5,000 bangud sa paggamit sang motorsiklo nga wala sang side mirror.
english: He was fined P5,000 for using a motorcycle without a side mirror.

text: Ginpabayad man ini sang P2,000 para sa reckless driving.
english: He was also fined P2,000 for reckless driving.

text: Magluwas sa multa, suspendido man sa gihapon ang iya nga driver’s license.
english: Besides the fine, his driver’s license is also suspended.

text: Gin-ako man ni Yanna nga indi siya ang tag-iya sang motorsiklo.
english: Yanna also admitted that he was not the owner of the motorcycle.

text: Ginbasehan sang LTO sa pag-isyu sang desisyon ang viral video, ang apology letter ni Yanna, kag ang affidavit sang pickup driver.
english: The LTO based its decision on the viral video, Yanna's apology letter, and the pickup driver's affidavit.

text: Sa pito ka pahina nga desisyon, ginsiling sang LTO nga makita gid sa mismo nga viral video ni Yanna ang delikado sini nga pagmaniobra sang gin- unahan niya ang pickup truck.
english: In a seven-page decision, the LTO said that Yanna's viral video itself shows her dangerous maneuvering when she overtook the pickup truck.

text: Nangin “kaso” ni Yanna ang Reckless Driving (Sec.
english: Yanna became a “case” of Reckless Driving (Sec.

text: 48 of R.A. 4136), pagmaneho sang motorsiklo nga wala sang side mirror, kag wala man sang plate number nga nagalapas naman sa Sec.
english: 48 of R.A. 4136), driving a motorcycle without a side mirror, and without a plate number which violates Sec.

text: 18 sang R.A. 4136.
Guilty ang nangin desisyon sang LTO sa duha ka nauna nga kaso, samtang naabaswelto naman ini sa isyu sa plaka sang motorsiklo bangud indi siya ang tag-iya.
english: The LTO found him guilty in the two previous cases, while he was acquitted in the motorcycle license plate issue because he was not the owner.

text: Plano sang isa ka Agriculture Official nga irekomenda ang pagpatuman sang mas mataas nga price ceiling sa baboy.
english: An Agriculture Official plans to recommend the implementation of a higher price ceiling on pork.

text: Para kay Department of Agculture Undersecretary Ernesto Gonzales, nagakadapat nga pataasan ang price ceiling sa baboy sa P300 sa kasim kag pigue kag P300 para sa liempo gikan sa P270 nga presyo subong.
english: For Department of Agculture Undersecretary Ernesto Gonzales, the price ceiling for pork should be increased to P300 for kasim and pigue and P300 for liempo from the current P270 price.

text: Sa nangin konsultasyon ni Gonzales sa hog producers, meat dealers kag nagabaligya sang baboy, ginpahayag sang mga grupo sang hog raisers nga sa baylo nga price cap, himuon na lang nga suggested retail price kag pasakaan sa P330 kada kilo ang SRP sa kasim kag pigue kag P360 naman sa kada kilo sang liempo.
english: In Gonzales' consultation with hog producers, meat dealers and pork sellers, the hog raisers groups said that instead of a price cap, the suggested retail price should be increased to P330 per kilo and the SRP for kasim and pigue to P360 per kilo and P360 per kilo for liempo.

text: Apang pahayag niya, P300 tubtob P330 lang ang mahimo nga mapasaka nga presyo bangud pat-od nga madamo ang indi magpabor kun himuon nga P330 tubtob P360 ang kada kilo sang baboy.
english: However, he said, only P300 to P330 can be raised because many will certainly not favor if the price of pork is made P330 to P360 per kilo.

text: Target ni Gonzales nga marekomenda ang iya plano kay Agriculture Secretary William Dar sa masunod nga semana.
english: Gonzales targets to recommend his plan to Agriculture Secretary William Dar next week.

text: Liwat nga ginpasalig sang Tokyo games organizers nga ang Olympic Village ang safe nga tiniran sa pihak ang kahangawa nga posible magtimbuok ang COVID-19 pila ka adlaw antes ang opening ceremony.
english: Tokyo games organizers have reiterated that the Olympic Village is a safe haven despite concerns about a possible outbreak of COVID-19 a few days before the opening ceremony.

text: Matandaan nga sang Hulyo 18, duha ka mga South African footballers kag video analyst ang nagpositibo sa COVID-19 sa Village.
english: On July 18, two South African footballers and a video analyst tested positive for COVID-19 in the Village.

text: Bangud sini, 21 ka mga myembro kag staff members sang South African squad ang gintag bilang close contacts , tatlo ka adlaw antes ang ila nga first match.
english: As a result, 21 members and staff members of the South African squad were tagged as close contacts, three days before their first match.

text: Apang sa pihak sini, gindula sang Games organizers ang kahangawa sang publiko.
english: But despite this, the Games organizers dispelled the public's concerns.

text: Suno kay Tokyo 2020 spokesperson Masa Takaya, wala sang dapat nga kabalak-an bangud ang importante amo ang pagresponde sang Japan sa mga positibo nga kaso.
english: According to Tokyo 2020 spokesperson Masa Takaya, there is nothing to worry about because the important thing is Japan's response to positive cases.

text: Samtang nagpahayag naman ang Czech Olympic Committee nga ang beach volleyball player nga si Ondrej Perusis ang nagpositibo man sa virus sa diin ini na ang ikaapat nga kaso.
english: Meanwhile, the Czech Olympic Committee said beach volleyball player Ondrej Perusis also tested positive for the virus, the fourth case.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang Olympic Village ang tiniran sang 6,700 nga mga athletes kag officials sa Tokyo Olympics.
english: The Olympic Village is home to 6,700 athletes and officials at the Tokyo Olympics.

text: Ginaduso sang Marcos administration ang masobra sa P10 billion nga confidential and intelligence funds (CIF) sa idalom sang Fiscal Year 2026 P6.793-trillion National Expenditure Program (NEP).
english: The Marcos administration is proposing more than P10 billion in confidential and intelligence funds (CIF) under the Fiscal Year 2026 P6.793-trillion National Expenditure Program (NEP).

text: Suno kay Budget Secretary Amenah Pangandaman, ini nga ginaproponer nga secret funds ang mas manubo sa P12.1-billion nga gin-alokar sa idalom sang 2025 General Appropriations Act.
english: According to Budget Secretary Amenah Pangandaman, these proposed secret funds are less than the P12.1-billion allocated under the 2025 General Appropriations Act.

text: Kun pahat-pahaton, ang confidential funds yara sa P4.386 billion samtang nagalab-ot naman ang intelligence funds sa P6.398 billion.
english: If broken down, the confidential funds are P4.386 billion while the intelligence funds are P6.398 billion.

text: Ang confidential funds amo ang alokasyon sa national budget para sa confidential expenses lakip na ang surveillance activities sa civilian government agencies.
english: Confidential funds are allocations in the national budget for confidential expenses including surveillance activities in civilian government agencies.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, ginagamit naman ang intelligence funds sa mga galastuhan nga naangot sa intelligence activities ukon pagtipon sang mga impormasyon para sa military, uniformed personnel, kag iban pa nga intelligence agencies nga ang trabaho para sa seguridad sang Pilipinas.
english: On the other hand, intelligence funds are used for expenses related to intelligence activities or information gathering for the military, uniformed personnel, and other intelligence agencies whose job is for the security of the Philippines.

text: Suno kay Pangandaman, halos katunga sini nga secret funds ukon P4.5 billion ang magakadto sa Office of the President kag pagasundan sang Department of National Defense nga may P1.848 billion.
english: According to Pangandaman, almost half of these secret funds or P4.5 billion will go to the Office of the President followed by the Department of National Defense with P1.848 billion.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, wala naman sang CIF allocation para sa Office of the Vice President (OVP) sa ikaduha na nga sunod-sunod nga tuig.
english: Meanwhile, there is no CIF allocation for the Office of the Vice President (OVP) for the second consecutive year.

text: Una naman nga nagpahayag si VP Sara Duterte nga wala ini nag-request sang CIF para sa masunod nga tuig.
english: Earlier, VP Sara Duterte said she did not request the CIF for next year.

text: Matandaan nga sang nagligad nga tuig, bangud nagpamalibad si Sara sa pagsabat sa mga pamangkot kun sa diin gingamit ang iya budget, ginbuhinan sang Kamara ang pondo sang OVP halin sa P2 billion panubo sa P733 million.
english: Last year, because Sara refused to answer questions about where her budget was used, the House of Representatives reduced the OVP fund from P2 billion to P733 million.

text: Nag-umpisa na sa pagnubo ang presyo sang tamudyos kasunod sang paglift sang “fishing ban” sa nagakalain-lain nga bahin sang pungsod.
english: The price of cod has started to fall following the lifting of the fishing ban in various parts of the country.

text: Suno kay Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) Executive Director Eduardo Gongona, base sa latest report, ang tamudyos subong ang nagabalor sang P180 tubto P200 ang kada kilo.
english: According to Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) Executive Director Eduardo Gongona, based on the latest report, the turkey is now worth P180 to P200 per kilo.

text: Ini ang nagnubo ipaanggid sa P240 kada kilo sadto.
english: This is down from P240 per kilo then.

text: Pahayag niya, nagtaas ang presyo sang tamudyos sadto bangud sa “conservation measures” nga ginpatigayon kaangay sang tatlo ka bulan nga “closed fishing season”.
english: He said the price of turkey increased due to conservation measures such as the three-month closed fishing season.

text: Pinal na kag opisyal ang desisyon nga i-postpone ang barangay and sangguniang kabataan elections (BSKE) subong nga tuig.
english: The decision to postpone the barangay and council children elections (BSKE) this year is final and official.

text: Ini matapos ginpirmahan na ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: This is after President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. signed the

text: ang Republic Act No.
english: Republic Act No.

text: 12232 kun sa diin sa baylo nga sa December 1, 2025 ang eleksyon, ginsaylo ini sa una nga Lunes sang November 2026.
english: 12232 where instead of December 1, 2025, the election was moved to the first Monday of November 2026.

text: Matupa ini sa November 2 nga amo man ang pag-obserbar sang All Souls’ Day.
english: It falls on November 2 which is also the observance of All Souls’ Day.

text: Sa idalom sini nga layi, nakasaad man nga patigayunon ang mga masunod nga BSKE sa kada apat ka tuig.
english: Under this law, it is also promised to conduct the next BSKE every four years.

text: Nakabutang man diri nga ginpalawig ang mga termino sang barangay and SK officials sa apat ka tuig, halin sa anay tatlo ka tuig nga nakabutang sa Local Government Code of 1991.
english: It also states that the terms of barangay and SK officials have been extended to four years, from the previous three years stipulated in the Local Government Code of 1991.

text: Mahimo makaserbe ang barangay officials sang tatlo ka sunod-sunod nga termino ukon tubtub sa 12 ka tuig sa pareho nga posisyon; samtang ang termino naman sang SK officials ang ginbuhinan sa maximum of one.
english: Barangay officials may serve three consecutive terms or up to 12 years in the same position; while the term of SK officials was reduced to a maximum of one.

text: Ang incumbent elective barangay officials nga nagapangalagad sa ila nga third consecutive term sa pareho nga posisyon ang indi eligible nga magpadalagan sa pareho nga pwesto sa November 2026 BSKE.
english: Incumbent elective barangay officials who are serving their third consecutive term in the same position are not eligible to run for the same position in the November 2026 BSKE.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang president nga kinahanglan ipaiway ini nga piniliay subong nga tuig bangud importante nga pasulabihon ang labing-una nga parliamentary elections sang Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM).
english: Earlier, the president said that this year's election should be postponed because it is important to prioritize the first parliamentary elections of the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM).

text: Matabo ang BARMM parliament polls sa Oktubre 13 nga suno sa presidente indi na masarangan sang Comelec kun may masunod pa gid nga eleksyon.#
english: The BARMM parliamentary polls will be held on October 13, which the president said the Comelec will not be able to do if there is another election.

text: Wala nakabutwa ang Phoenix Suns batok sa Milwaukee Bucks sa game 5 sang NBA Finals, sa score nga 123-119.
english: The Phoenix Suns fell short against the Milwaukee Bucks in game 5 of the NBA Finals, 123-119.

text: Ginpakahuy-an sang Bucks sa atubang sang linibo ka mga fans ang Phoenix Suns kag gin-angkon ang 3-2 nga lead.
english: The Bucks humiliated the Phoenix Suns in front of thousands of fans and claimed a 3-2 lead.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Jophil Cercado, basketball trainor kag coach sang Province of Iloilo Sports Program, iya ginpahayag nga sa tatlo ka minutos nga nabilin sa 4th quarter, gintinguhaan pa sang Suns nga makalagas gamit ang 12-3 run kasunod 14 points nga abanse sang Bucks.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Jophil Cercado, basketball trainer and coach of the Province of Iloilo Sports Program, said that with three minutes left in the fourth quarter, the Suns tried to catch up with a 12-3 run following a 14-point lead over the Bucks.

text: Diri kag ginhingalitan sang Suns ang wala nakasulod nga free throw shots ni Giannis Antetokounmpo.
english: The Suns took advantage of Giannis Antetokounmpo's missed free throw shots.

text: Apang nagbida sa gihapon ang anay two-time MVP sang napasulod ang tira halin sa pagpasa ni Jrue Holiday kag ang crucial shot ni Khris Middleton.
english: But the former two-time MVP still starred when he scored from Jrue Holiday's pass and Khris Middleton's crucial shot.

text: Nakaabanse man ang Phoenix sa first quarter, apang wala na nakabutwa batok sa Bucks sa 2nd quarter tubtob sa 4th quarter.
english: Phoenix also took a lead in the first quarter, but didn't get out against the Bucks in the 2nd quarter until the 4th quarter.

text: Suno kay Cercado, nangin epektibo ang defensive game sang Bucks, kag ang ila natural nga talento kag diskarte ang isa sa dako nga liyabe nga nagdala sa ila sang kadalag-an.
english: According to Cercado, the Bucks' defensive game was effective, and their natural talent and strategy was one of the big keys to their victory.

text: Gintapos ni Antetokounmpo ang game 5 nga may 32 points, nine rebounds kag six assists.
english: Antetokounmpo finished game 5 with 32 points, nine rebounds and six assists.

text: Samtang may 27 points naman nga amot si Middleton kag gindugangan pa ni Holiday sang 27 points kag 13 assists.
english: Middleton contributed 27 points and Holiday added 27 points and 13 assists.

text: Bantayan sa Bombo Radyo Iloilo sa Hulyo 21, 2021, ang update sa Game 6 sang NBA Finals.
english: Stay tuned to Bombo Radyo Iloilo on July 21, 2021, for the update on Game 6 of the NBA Finals.

text: Mas padalman pa sang senado ang imbestigasyon sa operasyon sang Private Motor Vehicle Inspection Centers (PMVICs) sa tunga sang alegasyon sang iregularidad sa pagpatuman sang joint project sang Department of Transportation kag Land Transportation Office.
english: The Senate will deepen its investigation into the operation of Private Motor Vehicle Inspection Centers (PMVICs) amid allegations of irregularities in the implementation of the joint project of the Department of Transportation and Land Transportation Office.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Senate Minority Leader Franklin Drilon, iya ginpahayag nga apisar ginsuspend ni Presidente Rodrigo Duterte ang nasambit nga vehicle inspection scheme, nagakadapat nga masabat sa gihapon ang mga palamangkutanon nahanungod sa kon sin-o ang nagpili sa 23 ka mga kompaniya nga amo ang magapatigayon sang inspection apisar nga wala man sang natabo nga bidding.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Senate Minority Leader Franklin Drilon said that although President Rodrigo Duterte suspended the vehicle inspection scheme, the questions about who selected the 23 companies to conduct the inspection should still be answered.

text: Suno kay Drilon, nagalaum siya nga imbestigahan man sang Senate Blue Ribbon Committee kon may yara sang mga layi nga ginlapas agud paboran ang pila ka inspection centers.
english: Drilon said he hopes the Senate Blue Ribbon Committee will also investigate whether any laws were violated to favor certain inspection centers.

text: Pahayag pa sang opposition senator, dapat nga ipasa man sang Land Transportation Office (LTO) sa senado ang official list sang PMVIC operators.
english: The opposition senator said the Land Transportation Office (LTO) should also submit to the Senate the official list of PMVIC operators.

text: Suno sa iya, pondo sang pumuluyo ang ibayad sa private sector nga kuntani, ini nga serbisyo ang dapat himuon sang LTO kag ang bayad ang direkta nga magakadto sa gobyerno kag indi sa mga pribado nga kompaniya.
english: He said the people's funds will be paid to the private sector which should be done by the LTO and the payment will go directly to the government and not to private companies.

text: Ginapanan-aw nga P8-billion ang kitaon sang mga kompaniya kada tuig bangod sa sini nga vehicle inspection scheme.
english: Companies are expected to earn P8-billion annually from this vehicle inspection scheme.

text: Magasambuwa para sa Game 5 ang Milwaukee Bucks kag Phoenix Suns subong las 9 sa aga.
english: The Milwaukee Bucks and Phoenix Suns will face off for Game 5 at 9 a.m.

text: Suno kay Jrue Holiday sang Milwaukee, mangin isa ka mainit nga away ang matabo sa court.
english: According to Milwaukee's Jrue Holiday, it will be a heated battle on the court.

text: Nagpasalig man ang iban nga players sang Bucks nga buligan kag suportahan nila si Giannis Antetokoumpo bangud isa lang ang ila nga tinutuyo — ang magdaog.
english: Other Bucks players also promised to help and support Giannis Antetokoumpo because they have only one goal — to win.

text: Pahayag naman sang coach nga si Monty Williams sang Suns, indi anay pwede ang pagbatyaga sang ‘kapoy’ subong nga Game 5 kag ini man ang ginpaboran ni Chris Paul.
english: Suns coach Monty Williams said it is not allowed to feel tired in Game 5 and Chris Paul also favored it.

text: Matandaan nga nakuha sang Phoenix ang first two games samtang ang sunod nga duha ka games ang nakuha man sang Bucks.
english: Phoenix won the first two games while the Bucks won the next two games.

text: Posible nga nagaplano ang North Korea nga magpatigayon sang nuclear test samtang masako man ang Estados Unidos sang Amerika sa ila nga presidential elections sa Nobyembre.
english: North Korea may be planning to conduct a nuclear test while the United States is busy with its presidential elections in November.

text: Ginpahayag ini ni South Korean Defense Minister Shin Won-sik kasunod man sang kumpirmasyon nga natapos na sang Pyongyang ang ila nga preparasyon kag i-conduct na gid lamang ang test kun nakahimo na sila sang desisyon.
english: South Korean Defense Minister Shin Won-sik said this following confirmation that Pyongyang has completed its preparations and will only conduct the test once it has made a decision.

text: Suno kay Shin, mahimo nga idungan gid ini sang North sa US elections para makapadayaw-dayaw ukon mapakita nila ang ila control.
english: According to Shin, the North may coincide with the US elections to show off or show their control.

text: Ini nga paandam sang Seoul ang kasunod man sa nagasaka nga tension sa tunga sang North kag mga kaalyado sang South Korea, Japan kag United States.
english: This warning by Seoul also follows rising tensions between the North and allies South Korea, Japan and the United States.

text: Nahibaluan nga padayon ang pagpasangkad ni North Korean leader Kim Jong Un sa nuclear arsenal sang pungsod kag ginalaslasan man ini ang nagadalom man nga kooperasyon sa tunga sang ila mga kasumpong.
english: It is known that North Korean leader Kim Jong Un continues to expand the country's nuclear arsenal and is also undermining the deepening cooperation between their opponents.

text: Sang sini lang nga weekend, may report nga yara ang South Korean defense minister sa Tokyo agud pirmahan ang kasugtanan kaupod sa U.S. kag Japan para sa ila security cooperation lakip na ang joint military training.
english: Just this weekend, there were reports that the South Korean defense minister was in Tokyo to sign an agreement with the U.S. and Japan for their security cooperation including joint military training.

text: Napuno sang verbal attack batok sa China kag Russia ang joint statement nga ginpaguwa sang Japan kag Estados Unidos sang Amerika kasunod sang ila nga high-level discussions.
english: The joint statement issued by Japan and the United States of America following their high-level discussions was filled with verbal attacks against China and Russia.

text: Ini ang gintambungan nanday US Secretary of State Antony Blinken, Defense Secretary Lloyd Austin, kag ila nga Japanese counterparts.
english: It was attended by US Secretary of State Antony Blinken, Defense Secretary Lloyd Austin, and their Japanese counterparts.

text: Sa ila nga statement, ginsiling nga ang foreign policy sang China ang ginbalay para nga bag-uhon ang international order kag ginplastar lamang para sa ila kaugalingon nga benepisyo.
english: In their statement, they said that China's foreign policy is designed to change the international order and is only for their own benefit.

text: Ginsulit man sang US kag Japan ang ila pagpamatok sa iligal nga maritime claims sang China, militarisasyon sa reclaimed features, kag pagpamahog sa South China Sea.
english: The US and Japan also reiterated their opposition to China's illegal maritime claims, militarization of reclaimed features, and threats in the South China Sea.

text: Ginplastar man sa statement ang mga aktwasyon sang China kaangay sang pagpang-harass sa kadagatan amo man ang delikado nga paggamit sang Coast Guard kag maritime militia vessels.
english: The statement also laid out China's actions such as harassment in the sea as well as the dangerous use of Coast Guard and maritime militia vessels.

text: Nagpabutyag man sang kahangawa ang duha ka nasyon sa pagpasangkad sang China sang ila nga nuclear weapons arsenal.
english: The two countries also expressed concern over China's expansion of its nuclear weapons arsenal.

text: Gin-highlight sa statement ang nagasangkad pa kag provocative nga strategic military cooperation sang Russia sa China paagi sa joint operations kag drills sa vicinity sang Japan.
english: The statement highlighted Russia's ever-expanding and provocative strategic military cooperation with China through joint operations and drills in the vicinity of Japan.

text: Namunuhan man pati ang suporta sang China sa defense industrial base sang Russia.
english: China's support for Russia's defense industrial base also led.

text: Sunod man nga ginkondenar sang Tokyo kag Washington ang nagadalom nga relasyon sang Moscow kag Pyongyang lakip na ang pag-procure sang Russians sang ballistic missiles halin sa North Korea nga isa ka maathag nga paglapas sa UN Security Council resolutions.
english: Tokyo and Washington also condemned the deepening ties between Moscow and Pyongyang including the Russians' procurement of ballistic missiles from North Korea in clear violation of UN Security Council resolutions.

text: Ginkumpirma man sa statement nga nagaplano ang US nga mag-establisar sang bag-o nga Joint Force Headquarters sa Japan nga pangunahan sang three-star US commander kag paga-updan sang 54,000 military personnel.
english: The statement also confirmed that the US plans to establish a new Joint Force Headquarters in Japan to be led by a three-star US commander and accompanied by 54,000 military personnel.

text: Posible nga ipa-iway sang Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) ang pagbukas sang mga sinehan sa sulod sang duha ka semana.
english: The Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) is likely to postpone the opening of cinemas for two weeks.

text: Ini mismo ang gin-apelar sang mga alkalde sang Metro Manila apang ang pinal nga desisyon ang magahalin sa Inter-Agency Task Force for the Management of Emerging Infectious Diseases (IATF-EID).
english: This was appealed by the mayors of Metro Manila but the final decision will come from the Inter-Agency Task Force for the Management of Emerging Infectious Diseases (IATF-EID).

text: Suno kay DTI Secretary Ramon Lopez, i-review anay sang ahensya ang pagbukas sang sinehan sa mga lugar nga napaidalom sa General Community Quarantine (GCQ).
english: According to DTI Secretary Ramon Lopez, the agency will first review the opening of cinemas in areas under General Community Quarantine (GCQ).

text: Ang liwat nga pagbukas sang sinehan ang subject sa gihapon sa pagsulundan nga i-isyu sang Department of Health kag tagsa nga mga local government units.
english: The reopening of cinemas is still subject to guidelines issued by the Department of Health and each local government unit.

text: Aabot na sa 8,901 na mga iligal na online gambling sites ang naipasara ng Cybercrime Investigation and Coordinating Center (CICC).
english: The Cybercrime Investigation and Coordinating Center (CICC) has shut down 8,901 illegal online gambling sites.

text: Ayon kay CICC Deputy Executive Director Renato Paraiso, na asahan na ito ay madadagdagan pa lalo na at pinaigting nila ang kampanya laban sa online gambling.
english: According to CICC Deputy Executive Director Renato Paraiso, it is expected that this will increase especially since they have intensified the campaign against online gambling.

text: Dagdag pa nito na kasama rin nilang binabantayan ang mga iligal na scam sites ganun din ang mga iligal na recruitment sites.
english: He added that they are also monitoring illegal scam sites as well as illegal recruitment sites.

text: May mga ugnayan na rin sila sa iba’t-ibang ahensiya ng gobyerno para tuluyang labanan agn nasabing iligal na mga online gambling.
english: They also have relationships with various government agencies to fight against illegal online gambling.

text: Magugunitang noong nakaraang buwan ay sinimulan na nilang sulatan ang mga social media influencers na nagsusulong ng mga iligal na online gambling.
english: Last month, they started writing to social media influencers who promote illegal online gambling.

text: Nakabaton sang P10,000 kada isa ang mga  soltero nga nagaedad sang masobra 20-anyos matapos nagpa-paltak sa ginpatigayon nga “Operation Tuli” nga ginpangunahan sang local government sang Lapu-Lapu City sa Cebu.
english: The young men, aged over 20, received P10,000 each after undergoing “Operation Tuli” led by the local government of Lapu-Lapu City in Cebu.

text: Ang programa isa ka inisyatibo sang local government agud engganyuhon ang mga lalaki nga nagaedad sang 20 anyos pasaka nga wala pa napaltak nga magpaidalom sa amo nga procedure.
english: The program is an initiative of the local government to encourage men aged 20 years and above who have not yet been circumcised to undergo the procedure.

text: Samtang, P20,000 naman ang gintigana sa mga senior citizens nga magpapaltak.
english: Meanwhile, P20,000 has been reserved for senior citizens who will resign.

text: JAPAN – Ginkumpirma sang Tokyo Olympics organizers nga may yara sang isa ka overseas visitor nga nakasulod sa Tokyo Olympics Village nga nagpositibo sa COVID-19.
english: JAPAN – Tokyo Olympics organizers have confirmed that an overseas visitor who entered the Tokyo Olympics Village has tested positive for COVID-19.

text: Ini ang una nga gin-report nga kaso sa amo nga village kun sa diin nagatinir ang linibo ka mga atleta para sa hampang nga magaumpisa sa Hulyo 23 kag magalawig tubtub sa Agusto 8.
english: This is the first reported case in the village where thousands of athletes are staying for the games that will start on July 23 and last until August

text: Ginapahayag nga involved sa pag-organisar sang Olympic Games ang foreign national nga infected sang virus.
english: The foreign national infected with the virus is allegedly involved in the organization of the Olympic Games.

text: Gin-confine na ini subong sa isa ka hotel.
english: He is now confined to a hotel.

text: Samtang, ginalauman man nga makasulod na sa Tokyo Olympics Village subong nga Domingo ang mga atleta sang Pilipinas.
english: Meanwhile, Philippine athletes are expected to enter the Tokyo Olympics Village this Sunday.

text: Akuparon sang Team Philippines ang pito ka units nga may apat ka kwarto, duha ka bathrooms, kag isa ka opisina nga magaserbe bilang medical room.
english: Team Philippines will occupy seven units with four bedrooms, two bathrooms, and an office that will serve as a medical room.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Jodie Sebastian direkta sa Tokyo, Japan, tuman ka istrikto ang ginapatuman nga protocols sa sulod sang 44-hectare Olympic village sa Harumi Waterfront District.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Jodie Sebastian directly in Tokyo, Japan, very strict protocols are being implemented inside the 44-hectare Olympic village in the Harumi Waterfront District.

text: Si Sebastian ang nagatrabaho bilang isa ka field cast volunteer kag in-charge gid sa pagpat-od nga yara ang mga kinahanglanon sang mga atleta, government officials sang iban nga mga pungsod, kag naga-inabot nga mga delegasyon.
english: Sebastian works as a field cast volunteer and is in-charge of ensuring that the needs of athletes, government officials of other countries, and arriving delegations are met.

text: Suno kay Sebastian, ginapalibutan sang mga camera ang bilog nga village kag indi madasig nga makalusot ang bisan sin-o sa checkpoints.
english: According to Sebastian, the cameras surround the entire village and no one can escape quickly through the checkpoints.

text: Required ang mga atleta nga magreport sang ila daily health status sa contact tracing app kag health report app.
english: Athletes are required to report their daily health status on the contact tracing app and health report app.

text: Wala ginapahanugutan ang public transport bangud may yara sang Games-dedicated vehicles.
english: Public transport is not allowed as there are Games-dedicated vehicles.

text: DUMANGAS, ILOILO – Dakop sa ginpatigayon nga drug buy bust operation ang isa ka anay Barangay Tanod sa Pulao, Dumangas, Iloilo.
english: DUMANGAS, ILOILO – A former Barangay Tanod was arrested in a drug buy bust operation in Pulao, Dumangas, Iloilo.

text: Ang arestado amo si Judemar Antonio Guelos, 47, residente sang nasambit nga lugar.
english: The arrested was identified as Judemar Antonio Guelos, 47, resident of the said place.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Samuel Vipinosa, hepe sang Dumangas Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga nabaklan si Guelos sang iligal nga droga balor P13,700.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Samuel Vipinosa, chief of the Dumangas Municipal Police Station, said Guelos was bought illegal drugs worth P13,700.

text: Sang ginrikisa sang mga otoridad, nakuhaan pa gid ini sang dugang nga 50 grams sang suspected shabu balor P340,000.
english: When the authorities searched the suspect, they recovered another 50 grams of suspected shabu worth P340,000.

text: Magluwas diri, nakuhaan pa gid ini sang armas nga .38 revolver kag 13 ka mga bala.
english: A .38 revolver and 13 rounds of ammunition were also recovered from the suspect.

text: Sa subong, preso na ini sa Dumangas Municipal Police Station kag nagapangatubang sang kaso nga paglapas sa Republic Act 9165 ukon Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.
english: He is currently detained at the Dumangas Municipal Police Station and is facing charges of violation of Republic Act 9165 or Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.

text: Isa ka trahedya ang nag-abot sa pamilya sang mag-iloy sa Taguig City matapos nga sunod-sunod nga nasapwan ang ila mga lawas nga wala na sang kabuhi.
english: A tragedy struck the family of a mother and daughter in Taguig City after their bodies were found one after another.

text: Una nga nakit-an ang bangkay sang iloy nga si Police Senior Master Sergeant Diane Marie Mollenido sa isa ka sapa sa Pulilan, Bulacan sang Enero 24 ka may igo sang bala sa ulo.
english: The body of the mother, Police Senior Master Sergeant Diane Marie Mollenido, was first found in a river in Pulilan, Bulacan on January 24 with a gunshot wound to the head.

text: Nakit-an naman ang bangkay sang iya bata nga si John Ysmael Mollenido, 8-anyos, sa isa ka calamansi farm sa Barangay Maluid sa Victoria, Tarlac.
english: The body of her son, John Ysmael Mollenido, 8, was found in a calamansi farm in Barangay Maluid in Victoria, Tarlac.

text: Ang bata naputos sa plastic tape.
english: The child was wrapped in plastic tape.

text: Ulihi nga nakit-an nga buhi ang mag-iloy sang Enero 16 sa Quezon City kaupod ang isa ka car agent para sa isa ka transaksiyon.
english: The mother and daughter were last seen alive on January 16 in Quezon City with a car agent for a transaction.

text: Ginakabig na subong nga isa sa mga persons of interest ang car agent.
english: The car agent is now considered one of the persons of interest.

text: Padayon pa ang maid-id nga imbestigasyon.
english: A thorough investigation is ongoing.

text: Nakahimo sang upset ang world no.
english: The world no.

text: 88 nga Alas Pilipinas batok sa World No.
english: 88 Alas Philippines against World No.

text: 21 kag powerhouse team nga Egypt sa ila sambuwa sa 2025 FIVB Men’s World Championship subong nga gab-i, Septyembre 16.
english: 21 and powerhouse team Egypt in their match at the 2025 FIVB Men’s World Championship tonight, September 16.

text: Ini ang una nga set kag match win sang Pilipinas sa FIVB Worlds.
english: This is the Philippines' first set and match win in the FIVB Worlds.

text: Nahimo ini sang national team matapos ang four sets batok sa defending African champions, 29-27, 23-25, 25-21, 25-21, sa preliminary round sang tournament sa Mall of Asia Arena.
english: The national team did so after four sets against the defending African champions, 29-27, 23-25, 25-21, 25-21, in the preliminary round of the tournament at the Mall of Asia Arena.

text: Nanguna sa team ang captain nga si Bryan Bagunas nga may 23 points.
english: Captain Bryan Bagunas led the team with 23 points.

text: Nabutang na sa 1-1 ang standing sang host nation sa Pool A. Sunod sini nga makasumpong ang world no.
english: The host nation is now 1-1 in Pool A. Next, the world no.

text: 13 nga Iran sa Byernes, Septyembre 18.
english: 13 Iran on Friday, September 18.

text: Antes sini nga match, nalutos ang Alas sa imbukada nga hampang kag sa debut sini sa FIVB Worlds sa kamot sang World No.
english: Prior to this match, Alas lost their opening match and FIVB Worlds debut to World No.

text: Wala ginadula ang mga espekulasyon nga gin-relieve sa pwesto si Police Colonel Bayani Razalan bilang Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) Director kaangot sa natabo nga payout sa 4th District sang Iloilo.
english: There are speculations that Police Colonel Bayani Razalan was relieved of his post as Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) Director in connection with the payout in the 4th District of Iloilo.

text: Sa amo man nga tion, ginapahayag nga involve diri ang isa ka incumbent congressman sa amo nga Distrito.
english: At the same time, an incumbent congressman in the district is reportedly involved.

text: Santo sa impormasyon nga nakuha sang Bombo Radyo, Abril 14, 2025 sang may ginpatigayon nga caucus sa Brgy.
english: According to information obtained by Bombo Radyo, April 14, 2025 during a caucus held in Brgy.

text: Maasin, Passi City kag sa amo nga tion may ginapatigayon man nga payout sang Ayuda sa Kapos ang Kita Program (AKAP) sang Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD).
english: Maasin, Passi City and at the same time there is also a payout of the Ayuda sa Kapos an Kita Program (AKAP) of the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD).

text: Ang personnel sang DSWD ang nagmandu nga indi pag-umpisahan ang payout samtang yara pa ang presensya sang mga pulitiko rason man nga na-delay ini.
english: DSWD personnel ordered not to start the payout while the politicians were still present, which is why it was delayed.

text: Didto na kag nagsugod ang pagkakibot sang punong barangay sang nasambit nga lugar.
english: That's when the shock of the barangay captain of the said area began.

text: Sa amo nga tion, yara naman ang presensya sang pila ka pulis kag Special Weapons and Tactics (SWAT) Personnel kon sa diin, ginkumpirma man nga nag-agi lang kag parte lamang ini sang integrated plan sang IPPO.
english: At the same time, there was the presence of several police and Special Weapons and Tactics (SWAT) Personnel where, it was also confirmed that it was just a passing and part of the integrated plan of the IPPO.

text: Gin-athag naman sang kapulisan nga normal lamang nga ginasundan nila ang amo nga kahiwatan ukon payout ilabi na nga may involve nga kwarta.
english: The police explained that it is normal for them to follow such activities or payouts especially when money is involved.

text: Posible naman nga ini ang ginlantaw sang Camp Crame nga rason ukon nakalab-ot nga istorya sa ila nga bahin, nga nangin rason man sang ila nga desisyon batok kay Razalan.
english: It is possible that this was seen by the Camp Crame as a reason or a story that reached them, which also became the reason for their decision against Razalan.

text: Sa pagpakig-angot sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Lieutenant Colonel Arnel Solis, spokesperson sang Police Regional Office 6, iya ginpahayag nga last week sang nagpadala sila sang sulat sa Commission on Elections (COMELEC) agud hibaluon ang sitwasyon sang relief order ni Razalan.
english: Police Lieutenant Colonel Arnel Solis, spokesperson of the Police Regional Office 6, said they sent a letter to the Commission on Elections (COMELEC) last week to find out the status of Razalan's relief order.

text: Apang, tubtob subong wala pa sang reply ukon confirmation ang COMELEC kaangot sa relieve order, rason nga magapabilin sa gihapon nga director sang IPPO si Razalan.
english: However, the COMELEC has not yet received a reply or confirmation regarding the relief order, which is why Razalan will remain the director of the IPPO.

text: Una na nga gintuad sang COMELEC nga temporaryo nga magatal-us kay Razalan si Colonel Rolando Bulalacao, ang chief regional staff sang PRO 6.
english: Earlier, the COMELEC acknowledged that Colonel Rolando Bulalacao, the chief regional staff of PRO 6, will temporarily replace Razalan.

text: DAKU nga halit ang gindulot sa kalibutan sang mapintas nga pandemya (COVID-19) nga una nag-igu sa Wuhan, China sadtong Pebrero 2020.
english: THE world has been devastated by the terrible pandemic (COVID-19) that first hit Wuhan, China in February 2020.

text: Nagpaantos kag nagpatay gid ini sing minilyon ka mga tawo sa kalibutan.
english: It has tortured and killed millions of people in the world.

text: Sunu sa report sang WHO, as of Sep.
english: According to the WHO report, as of Sep.

text: 11, 2022, may 605 ka milyon ang confirmed cases sang COVID-19 kag 6.4 ka milyon ang napatay sa bug-os nga kalibutan.
english: 11, 2022, there are 605 million confirmed cases of COVID-19 and 6.4 million deaths worldwide.

text: Sa report man sang WHO sadtong Oktubre 7, 2022, ang Filipinas may 3,961,349 ka confirmed cases kag 63,149 deaths.
english: According to the WHO report on October 7, 2022, the Philippines has 3,961,349 confirmed cases and 63,149 deaths.

text:
***

Tungod  sa kadasig sang pagpanglaton sini, halos makahulag gani ang mga pumuluyo sa ginapatuman nga mga lockdown kag istrikto nga health protocols.
english:
***

Due to the speed of its spread, residents are almost able to move around the lockdowns and strict health protocols.

text: Madamo ang nawad-an trabaho, nag-collapse ang mga negosyo, kag gasala-sala man gani ang gobyerno kon paano mabuligan ang tanan.
english: Many have lost their jobs, businesses have collapsed, and the government is even wondering how to help everyone.

text: Salamat sa madasig nga pagpang-bakuna,  napatahaw sini ang pandemya, nga kon nagapabilin pa ini indi na gawa makahalalit.
english: Thanks to the rapid vaccination, it has brought the pandemic to an end, which if it had persisted, would not have been harmful.

text: Kag amat-amat nga nagbangon ang mga ekonomiya bisan sige gihapon ang pagpatuman sang health protocols.
english: And economies are slowly recovering despite the continued implementation of health protocols.

text: Ang siste kay duha ka tuig halin sadtong pandemya, nagtuhaw man ang gyera sa tunga sang Rusya kag Ukraine sadtong Pebrero 24, 2022 nga nagapadayon tubtub subong.
english: The problem is that two years after the pandemic, the war between Russia and Ukraine broke out on February 24, 2022 and continues to this day.

text: In fact, indi lang “economic depression”, ukon pagbagsak sang pangbuhian ang natabo kundi ang dugang nga kabudlay nga dala sang “inflation” nga amat-amat manughulog sa “economic recession” sa sige-sige lang pagtaas sang balaklon.
english: In fact, not only economic depression has occurred but also the additional difficulties brought about by inflation that is gradually leading to economic recession as prices continue to rise.

text: Mabasol diri ang pagtaas sang bili sang fossil fuel (oil kag natural gas) nga kinahanglan sa gyera nga mayor nagapahulag sang enerhiya sang tanan nga mga pungsod sa kalibutan, kag tungod man sa mga “sanctions”.
english: This is to blame for the increase in the price of fossil fuels (oil and natural gas) needed in the war that mainly stimulates the energy of all countries in the world, and also because of the sanctions.

text: Nag-domino effect ang pagtaas sang bili sini sa pangabuhian sang mga pumuluyo, nga nagdugang pa sa paghikahos sang mga pumuluyo tungod sa pandemya.
english: The increase in prices has had a domino effect on the livelihoods of the people, adding to the struggles of the people due to the pandemic.

text: Ang siste kay nagpasaka pa sing interest rate ang Federal Bank sang Estados Unidos agud matabangan ang iya ekonomiya nga sadto ang inflation naglapaw na sa 10%, nga sobra kaayo sa ideal nga 2-4% agud mapa-ugwad ang ekonomiya sing mabungahon.
english: The problem is that the Federal Reserve Bank of the United States raised interest rates to help its economy when inflation exceeded 10%, which is far above the ideal 2-4% to grow the economy productively.

text: Nagpanubo ini sang balor sang kwarta sang iban nga mga pungsod nga gasandig sang ila balor sa USD, lakip ang Filipinas.
english: This has devalued the currencies of other countries that depend on the USD, including the Philippines.

text: Labi pa kay negatibo ang aton international trade tungod mas madamo ang ginabakal naton sangsa ginabaligya sa luas.
english: Especially since our international trade is negative because we buy more than we sell abroad.

text: Kon may mahimo kita diri, isa seguro ang pag –“import” sang USD paagi sa mga mapasulod nga investment sa pungsod, kag ang pagpauswag sang aton mismo export.
english: If we can do anything here, one is probably to “import” the USD through investment in the country, and to improve our own exports.

text: Nakabulig man sa aton domestic economy (GDP) ang  sobra 2 ka milyon naton nga OFWs nga padayon nagapadala sang allotment sa ila mga pamilya diri sa pungsod.
english: Our more than 2 million OFWs who continue to send allotments to their families here in the country have also contributed to our domestic economy (GDP).

text: Indi man naton kinahanglan magkahangawa gid kay ang experyensya sang kalibutan sa “Great Depression” sadtong 1929 kag “Great Recession” sadtong 2008 nakuhaan  naton sing leksyon agud mapahagan-hagan ang paghikahos sang aton ekonomiya.
english: We do not need to worry too much because the world's experience in the Great Depression of 1929 and the Great Recession of 2008 has taught us lessons to ease the slowdown of our economy.

text:
***

Kilala nga “spender” ang Filipino  nga bisan ang Bangko Sentral nga Pilipinas (BSP) nakanotar.
english:
***

Filipinos are known to be “spenders” that even the Central Bank of the Philippines (BSP) has noted.

text: Makita naton ini sa aton pag-selebrar sang madamo nga mga pyesta kon san-o ginapilit naton mangutang gid agud lang may mahanda sa nagaduaw nga mga himata kag mga abyan.
english: We see this in our celebration of many festivals when we are forced to borrow money just to prepare something for visiting relatives and friends.

text: Ang mga Filipino man ang may pinakalawig sa kalibutan nga pag-selebrar sang Christmas Season halin Setyembre tubtub Disyembre kag tubtub pa gani sa una nga semana sang bag-ong tuig, nga wala naton ginakahilakan gastusan.
english: Filipinos also have the world's longest celebration of the Christmas Season from September to December and even until the first week of the new year, which we do not hesitate to spend.

text: Well, may bentaha ini sa aton ekonomiya kay nagapadalagan ina sang negosyo kag serbisyo nga makahatag trabaho kag padayon nga pag-uswag sang pangabuhi sa mga bag-o nga mga kinahanglanon.
english: Well, it has an advantage in our economy because it runs businesses and services that can provide jobs and continuous improvement of life in the new needs.

text: So, ang nagakatabo nga ang una kag maabtik nga bulig nga mahatag sang gobyerno sa aton amo gid ang ayuda – pagkaon, ilistaran, kwarta, pati panugod halin sa narusdak nga pangabuhian.
english: So, what happens is that the first and most immediate help that the government can give us is the aid – food, shelter, money, even a start from the broken livelihood.

text: Kag, abaw!, kon indi matagaan bulig ang tanan, ikaw na ang pinakamalain nga gobyerno sa bug-os nga kalibutan!
english: And, wow!, if you don't help everyone, you're the worst government in the world!

text: Well, may bentaha man seguro nga makatuon kita sa pag-save bisan diutay lang bilang pangaman sa bagyo, linog, baha, pagbuga sang bulkan, sunog, kag iban nga masami nagakatabo diri agud indi kita magsaramihay gid kon matabo ang mga ini.
english: Well, there is probably an advantage that we can learn to save even a little as a precaution against typhoons, earthquakes, floods, volcanic eruptions, fires, and other things that often happen here so that we do not have to worry about them when they happen.
