text: Nagapati ang pila ka mga basketball stars nga sanday Portland Trail Blazers point guard Damian Lillard kag Golden State Warriors power forward Draymond Green nga ang pagpang-block ni Giannis Antetokounmpo sang Milwaukee Bucks amo ang magapadaog sa ila nga team batuk sa Phoenix Suns.
english: Some basketball stars Portland Trail Blazers point guard Damian Lillard and Golden State Warriors power forward Draymond Green believe that Giannis Antetokounmpo's blocking of the Milwaukee Bucks will give their team a win against the Phoenix Suns.

text: Suno kay Green, legendary ang ginpakita nga performance ni Giannis sa Game 4 sang NBA Finals sa diin patas na ang serye sang duha ka mga teams.
english: Green said Giannis' performance in Game 4 of the NBA Finals was legendary.

text: Mangin ang mga myembro sang Bucks ang wala nakapati sang ila nakit-an sa diin lapit na lang gid nga magsulod ang bola sang Suns apang natigayon pa ini ni Giannis nga ma-block.
english: Even the Bucks couldn't believe what they saw when the Suns' ball was about to go in but Giannis managed to block it.

text: Balantayan naman sa Dominggo, Hulyo 18 ang Game 5 nga hiwaton sa Phoenix las 9 sang aga.
english: Game 5 will be played on Sunday, July 18 in Phoenix at 9 am.

text: ILOILO CITY- Arestado ang isa ka iloy bangud sa pagbaligya sini sa iya bata nga babaye sa online pornography.
english: ILOILO CITY – A mother was arrested for selling her daughter to online pornography.

text: Ang suspek amo ang 45-anyos nga iloy sa Malabon nga nadakpan paagi sa entrapment operation.
english: The suspect is a 45-year-old mother in Malabon who was arrested through an entrapment operation.

text: Ang biktima nagaedad sang siyam ka tuig.
english: The victim was nine years old.

text: Base sa imbestigasyon, modus sang iloy nga ibaligya ang laragway sang nagahublas niya nga bata kabaylo sang P1,000 halin sa iya mga kliyente nga lunsay mga foreigners.
english: According to the investigation, the mother's modus operandi was to sell the picture of her naked child in exchange for P1,000 from her clients who are all foreigners.

text: Ginapasaot pa sini ang iya bata nga wala sang bayo sa online live show.
english: She even makes her daughter dance naked in an online live show.

text: Suno kay PNP Anti-Cybercrime Group Police Captain Santiago Roy, mismo ang isa ka bata sang suspek ang nag-report sa ila sa ginahimo sang iloy sa iya anak.
english: According to PNP Anti-Cybercrime Group Police Captain Santiago Roy, one of the suspect's children reported to them what the mother was doing to her daughter.

text: Didto na ginkasa ang operasyon kag nadakpan ang suspek sa isa ka hotel room sa Malabon kun sa diin niya ginaubra ang imoral nga aktibidad.
english: The operation was launched and the suspect was arrested in a hotel room in Malabon where he was engaged in immoral activities.

text: Mangatubang ang iloy sa reklamo nga paglapas sa Anti-Online Sexual Abuse or Exploitation Materials Act.
english: The mother will face charges of violating the Anti-Online Sexual Abuse or Exploitation Materials Act.

text: Nagpabutyag naman ini sang iya paghinulsol sa iya nahimo.
english: He expressed his regret for what he had done.

text:
Kinumpirma ng Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) ang presensiya ng dalawang barkong pandigma ng Estados Unidos sa layong 30 nautical miles mula sa Panatag (Scarborough) Shoal.Philippine travel guide

Ang USS Higgins (DDG-76), isang guided-missile destroyer, at ang USS Cincinnati (LCS-20), isang littoral combat ship, ay namonitor sa lugar ilang araw matapos ang banggaan ng dalawang barko ng China sa karagatang sakop ng Pilipinas.
english:
The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) confirmed the presence of two US warships within 30 nautical miles of the Panatag (Scarborough) Shoal.

The USS Higgins (DDG-76), a guided-missile destroyer, and the USS Cincinnati (LCS-20), a littoral combat ship, were monitored in the area several days after the two Chinese ships collided in Philippine waters.

text: Ayon kay Commodore Jay Tarriela, tagapagsalita ng PCG para sa West Philippine Sea, ang presensiya ng mga barko ng US ay naganap kasunod ng insidente noong Agosto 11 kung saan ang China Coast Guard (CCG) vessel na may hull number 3104 ay bumangga sa isang barkong pandigma ng People’s Liberation Army Navy (PLAN) habang hinahabol ang barkong PCG na BRP Suluan.
english: According to Commodore Jay Tarriela, PCG spokesperson for the West Philippine Sea, the presence of US ships follows the incident on August 11 where the China Coast Guard (CCG) vessel with hull number 3104 collided with a warship of the People's Liberation Army (PLAN) PCG and BRP Suluan.

text: Sa ulat ng PCG, nagsagawa ng mapanganib na maniobra ang CCG vessel na naging sanhi ng banggaan.
english: According to the PCG, the CCG vessel made a dangerous maneuver that caused the collision.

text:
Malubha ang pinsala sa unahan ng barkong Tsino, habang nakaiwas naman ang BRP Suluan sa insidente.Philippine travel guide

Nabatid na ang Panatag Shoal, kilala rin bilang Bajo de Masinloc, ay isang bahura na matatagpuan sa loob ng 200-nautical mile Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ) ng Pilipinas.
english:
The front of the Chinese ship was seriously damaged, while the BRP Suluan avoided the incident.

Panatag Shoal, also known as Bajo de Masinloc, is a reef located within the 200-nautical mile Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ) of the Philippines.

text: Bagamat matagal nang bahagi ng tradisyunal na pangingisda ng mga Pilipino, ito ay inaangkin din ng China at patuloy na binabantayan ng kanilang coast guard at navy.
english: Although it has long been part of the traditional fishery of the Filipinos, it is also claimed by China and continues to be monitored by its coast guard and navy.

text: Noong 2012, nagsimula ang tensyon sa lugar nang magkaroon ng standoff sa pagitan ng Pilipinas at China, na nauwi sa de facto control ng China sa bahura.
english: In 2012, tensions in the area began when there was a standoff between the Philippines and China, which resulted in China's de facto control of the reef.

text: Ang pagdating ng mga barkong pandigma ng US ay bahagi ng mas malawak na estratehiya ng Washington upang ipakita ang suporta sa mga kaalyado nito sa Indo-Pacific, kabilang ang Pilipinas.
english: The arrival of US warships is part of Washington's broader strategy to show support for its allies in the Indo-Pacific, including the Philippines.

text:
Sa ilalim ng Mutual Defense Treaty ng 1951, may obligasyon ang Estados Unidos na tumugon sa mga armadong pag-atake laban sa mga barkong pampubliko ng Pilipinas sa Pacific.Philippine travel guide

Bagamat hindi direktang nakikialam ang US sa mga territorial dispute, ang kanilang presensiya ay itinuturing na mensahe ng pagpapanatili ng kalayaan sa paglalayag at paggalang sa international law.
english:
Under the Mutual Defense Treaty of 1951, the United States has an obligation to respond to armed attacks against Philippine public ships in the Pacific.

Although the US is not directly involved in territorial disputes, its presence is seen as a message of maintaining freedom of navigation and respect for international law.

text: Patuloy na naninindigan ang Pilipinas sa karapatang pangkaragatan nito, batay sa 2016 arbitral ruling na pumabor sa bansa at nagpawalang-bisa sa malawak na nine-dash line claim ng China.
english: The Philippines continues to insist on its maritime rights, based on a 2016 arbitral ruling that favored the country and nullified China's extensive nine-dash line claim.

text: Sa kabila ng mga insidente ng pangha-harass sa mga mangingisdang Pilipino, nananatiling aktibo ang PCG sa pagbibigay-proteksyon at pagmomonitor sa mga aktibidad sa West Philippine Sea.
english: Despite incidents of harassment of Filipino fishermen, the PCG remains active in providing protection and monitoring activities in the West Philippine Sea.

text: TAYTAY,RIZAL – Arestado ang isa ka 18-anyos nga dalaga matapos ginbuno sini sang makapila ka beses ang isa ka 10 ka tuig nga bata nga lalaki.
english: TAYTAY, RIZAL – An 18-year-old girl was arrested after she stabbed a 10-year-old boy several times.

text: Natabo ang krimen sa Taytay, Rizal.
english: The crime occurred in Taytay, Rizal.

text: Nag-angkon sang 22 ka kapilasan ang bata kag bali man ang butkon sini kag padayon nga nagarekober sa Rizal Provincial Hospital System (RPHS) Taytay.
english: The child sustained 22 injuries and a broken arm and is still recovering at the Rizal Provincial Hospital System (RPHS) Taytay.

text: Sa imbestigasyon sang otoridad, ginsiling sang suspek nga nahisa ini sa biktima bangud kompleto ang pamilya sini, samtang siya naman ang ginpabay-an sang iya pamilya.
english: According to the investigation of the authorities, the suspect said he was jealous of the victim because she had a complete family, while he was neglected by his family.

text: Nakahunong na ini sa Taytay PNP kag nagapangatubang sang kaso nga frustrated murder.
english: He is currently detained at Taytay PNP and is facing charges of frustrated murder.

text: Na-capture naman sa CCTV camera ang pagpangbuno sang suspek sa bata.
english: The suspect was caught on CCTV camera stabbing the child.

text: ILOILO CITY- Maathag nga nabasa na sang Milwaukee Bucks ang estilo sang hampang kag hulag sang Phoenix Suns rason nga naangkon sang Bucks ang kadalag-an sa score nga 109-103, sa game 4 sang NBA Finals.
english: ILOILO CITY – The Milwaukee Bucks clearly read the style of play and movement of the Phoenix Suns, which is why the Bucks won with a score of 109-103, in game 4 of the NBA Finals.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Jophil Cercado, basketball trainor kag coach sang Province of Iloilo Sports Program, iya ginpahayag nga wala nangin madinalag- on ang transition sang Suns bangud sa match up sang Bucks.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Jophil Cercado, basketball trainer and coach of the Province of Iloilo Sports Program, said the Suns' transition was not successful due to the match up of the Bucks.

text: Suno kay Cercado, impresibo man ang ginpakita ni Khris Middleton nga perimeter shooting.
english: According to Cercado, Khris Middleton also showed impressive perimeter shooting.

text: Si Middleton ang naka-score sang 40 points samtang si Giannis Antetokounmpo ang nakadugang sang 26 points para sa Bucks.
english: Middleton scored 40 points while Giannis Antetokounmpo added 26 points for the Bucks.

text: Sa bahin sang Suns, 42 points ang natipon ni Devin Booker.
english: For the Suns, Devin Booker scored 42 points.

text: PARIS, FRANCE – Ginpasigurado sang host country nga France nga safe kag strikto nga ginapatuman sang gobyerno ang peace and order samtang nagapadayon ang 2024 Paris Olympics.
english: PARIS, FRANCE – Host country France has assured that the government is safe and strictly enforcing peace and order as the 2024 Paris Olympics unfold.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Bombo Ramil Isogon, Bombo International Correspondent sa France, iya ginpahayag nga madamo sang nabasa kagapon nga adlaw bangud man sa pagtupa sang ulan kadungan sa pagbukas sang Olympics 2024.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Bombo Ramil Isogon, Bombo International Correspondent in France, said there were many readings yesterday due to heavy rains during the opening of the 2024 Olympics.

text: Suno kay Isogon, apisar sini, yara sa gihapon ang presensya sang otoridad, kon sa diin, nag-augment sang mga police officers sa pila ka bahin sang Paris agud nga masiguro nga wala sang terrorist attack nga matabo samtang nagapatigayon sang nagkalain-lain nga hinampang.
english: According to Isogon, despite this, there is still the presence of the authorities, where, augmented police officers in some parts of Paris to ensure that no terrorist attack will happen while conducting various games.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga may yara sang 45,000 ka mga kapulisan ang ginpang-deploy agud nga mabantayan ang mga athletes kag mga turista.
english: He also said that 45,000 policemen have been deployed to guard the athletes and tourists.

text: Sa bahin naman sang armadong kusog sang pungdsod, may yara sang 18,000 ka mga aktibo nga military ang nagalibot kag naga-monitor sa kahiwatan.
english: On the part of the country's armed forces, there are 18,000 active military personnel patrolling and monitoring the event.

text: Mas ginpasangkad naman ang pagbantay sa dalagan sang trapiko bangud may yara sang kapin 20,000 ka mga auxiliaries ang naka-standby sa nagkalain-lain nga dalan.
english: Traffic monitoring has been intensified as more than 20,000 auxiliaries are on standby on various roads.

text: Ginpatuman naman ang pila ka road closure, kon sa diin, gina-abisohan ang publiko nga likawan na lang nga magdala sang salakyan kon magtambong sa kahiwatan.
english: Several road closures have been implemented, where the public is advised to avoid bringing vehicles when attending the event.

text: May yara naman sang available nga bisekleta agud nga mahimo magamit sang mga natamad nga maglakat samtang nagalibot sa syudad.
english: There are also bicycles available for those who are lazy to walk while touring the city.

text: Nahatag na ang ginasinggitan nga hustisya matapos napamatud-an sa korte nga guilty ang tatlo ka anay kadete sang Philippine Military Academy (PMA) sa kamatayon sang kaangay man nila nga kadete nga si Darwin Dormitorio sang 2019.
english: The cry for justice has been served after three former cadets of the Philippine Military Academy (PMA) were found guilty in court of the death of fellow cadet Darwin Dormitorio in 2019.

text: Apang kun may isa man ka tawo nga wala nakasaksi sini nga hustisya, ini amo ang amay sang biktima nga si William Dormitorio, isa ka retired Army lieutenant colonel kag miyembro sang PMA Class of 1974, nga napatay sinemana antes mapaguwa sang huwes ang desisyon.
english: But if there is one person who did not witness this justice, it is the victim's father, William Dormitorio, a retired Army lieutenant colonel and member of the PMA Class of 1974, who died weeks before the judge issued the verdict.

text: Ang 75-anyos nga amay ang nagtaliwan sang Hulyo bangud sa cardiac arrest — isa ka sirkumstansya nga amo ang nagdingot sa iya sang kahigayunan nga mabatyagan ang closure sa kaso sang iya 20-anyos nga anak nga napatay bangud sa hazing.
english: The 75-year-old father died in July of cardiac arrest — a circumstance that denied him the opportunity to feel closure in the case of his 20-year-old son’s hazing death.

text: Sa verdict nga ginpagwa kahapon, ginpamatbatan ni Baguio City Regional Trial Court Judge Ligaya Itliong-Rivera sang reclusion perpetua ukon tubtub sa 40 ka tuig nga pagkapreso ang mga suspek nga sanday Shalimar Imperial, Felix Lumbag Jr.
english: In a verdict issued yesterday, Baguio City Regional Trial Court Judge Ligaya Itliong-Rivera sentenced the suspects, Shalimar Imperial, Felix Lumbag Jr., to reclusion perpetua or up to 40 years in prison.

text: kag Julius Tadena bangud sa kamatayon ni Dormitorio.
english: and Julius Tadena for the death of Dormitorio.

text: Na-convict si Tadena bangud sa paglapas sa Anti-Hazing Act kag ginmanduan sang korte nga bayaran ang pamilya sang P2-million; samtang ang duha naman ang guilty sa murder kag violation man sa Anti-Hazing Act of 2018, kag ginpabayad sang P3-million kada isa.
english: Tadena was convicted of violating the Anti-Hazing Act and ordered by the court to pay the family P2-million; while the two were guilty of murder and violation of the Anti-Hazing Act of 2018, and were fined P3-million each.

text: Na-detain ang tatlo sa regional custodial facility kag ginalauman nga sayluhon sa New Bilibid Prison sa Muntinlupa.
english: The three are detained at the regional custodial facility and are expected to be transferred to the New Bilibid Prison in Muntinlupa.

text: Tumandok si Dormitorio sang Cagayan de Oro kag miyembro sang PMA Madasigon class of 2023.
english: Dormitorio is a native of Cagayan de Oro and a member of the PMA Masigagon class of 2023.

text: Napatay siya sang Septyembre 18, 2019 sa PMA Hospital matapos nasapwan nga unconscious sa sulod sang isa ka hulot sa Mayo Hall sang PMA sa Fort Del Pilar.
english: He died on September 18, 2019 at the PMA Hospital after being found unconscious inside a room at the Mayo Hall of the PMA in Fort Del Pilar.

text: Sandig sa record sa korte, ginkastigo si Dormitorio bangud nadula sini ang pares sang botas sang senior cadet.
english: According to court records, Dormitorio was beaten because he lost the senior cadet's pair of boots.

text: Duha ka bulan pa lamang siya sa akademya sang tion nga natabo ang insidente.
english: He had only been at the academy for two months at the time of the incident.

text: Nadiskubrehan man sang otoridad nga isa ka bulan antes ang iya kamatayon, si Dormitorio kag iban pa nga bag-uhan sa PMA ang ginpwersa nga magpaidalom sa electrocution via taser kag iban pa nga physical abuse sa kamot sang ila upperclassmen.#
english: Authorities also discovered that a month before his death, Dormitorio and other PMA freshmen were forced to undergo electrocution via taser and other physical abuse at the hands of their upperclassmen.#

text: Ginkumpirma ni Filipino pole vaulter EJ Obiena nga indi na siya ang magakapot sang Philippine flag sa opening ceremonies sang Tokyo Olympics sa Hulyo 23.
english: Filipino pole vaulter EJ Obiena has confirmed that he will no longer hold the Philippine flag at the opening ceremonies of the Tokyo Olympics on July 23.

text: Gin-ako ni Obiena nga nadulaan siya sang kumpyansa bangud sa pagkakas sa iya bilang flag bearer.
english: Obiena admitted that he lost confidence due to his removal as flag bearer.

text: Suno sa athletics star, ang pagkakas sa iya ang bangud sa panibag-o nga protocol sang Tokyo Olympics sa diin kinahanglan nga yara na ang flag bearer sa Tokyo 48 oras antes ang opening ceremonies.
english: According to the athletics star, his removal was due to the new protocol of the Tokyo Olympics where the flag bearer must be in Tokyo 48 hours before the opening ceremonies.

text: Apang ang arrival sang 25 anyos nga si Obiena ang natalana pa sa adlaw mismo sang Olympics las 12:30 sang udto oras sa Japan kag indi na ini mahimo pa nga ma-adjust.
english: However, the arrival of 25-year-old Obiena is still scheduled for the day of the Olympics at 12:30 noon Japan time and cannot be adjusted.

text: Samtang las 8 naman sang gab-i ang pagbukas sang Olympics.
english: Meanwhile, the opening of the Olympics will be held at 8 pm.

text: Sa subong, wala pa sang may gin-announce nga panibag-o nga male flag bearer si Philippine Olympic Committee (POC) president Abraham “Bambol” Tolentino.
english: Philippine Olympic Committee (POC) president Abraham “Bambol” Tolentino has not yet announced a new male flag bearer.

text: Gin-endorso na ni anay US President Barack Obama si Vice President Kamara Harris bilang kandidato sang Democratic Party para sa presidential elections subong nga tuig kag magabunggo kay anay Presidente Donald Trump nga amo naman ang official candidate sang Republicans.
english: Former US President Barack Obama has endorsed Vice President Kamara Harris as the Democratic Party's candidate for this year's presidential elections and will face former President Donald Trump who is the official candidate of the Republicans.

text: Si Obama ang pinakaulihi sa active high-profile figures nga naghatag sang suporta kay Harris kasunod sang pag-atras sang 81-anyos nga si President Joe Biden sa presidential race.
english: Obama is the latest in a string of active high-profile figures to lend support to Harris following 81-year-old President Joe Biden’s withdrawal from the presidential race.

text: Una nga nagguwa ang impormasyon nga pabor si Obama nga magpatigayon sang nominating contest kadungan sang Democratic national convention sa Chicago agud nga opisyal nga mahingadlan kun sin-o ang mangin standard bearer sang Democrats.
english: Initially, information surfaced that Obama was in favor of holding a nominating contest in conjunction with the Democratic national convention in Chicago to officially name who would be the standard bearer of the Democrats.

text: Apang nakuha na ni Harris ang suporta kag endorsement nanday Biden, Bill kag Hillary Clinton, Nancy Pelosi, host sang state governors kag kadam-an sang senior Democrats sa Kongreso rason nga nagdugang si Obama sa lista para matib-ong pa ang kandidatura sang bise-presidente.
english: But Harris has already won the support and endorsement of Biden, Bill and Hillary Clinton, Nancy Pelosi, host of state governors and most senior Democrats in Congress, adding Obama to the list to further strengthen the vice president's candidacy.

text: Sang ginkumpirma sang 44th president ang iya suporta kay Harris paagi sa phone call, kaupod sini si anay First Lady Michelle Obama.
english: When the 44th president confirmed his support for Harris via phone call, he was accompanied by former First Lady Michelle Obama.

text: Si Obama amo ang una nga Black US President kag pananglitan mangin kandidato si Harris sang Democrats kag magdaog batok kay Trump, siya naman ang mangin first woman, first Black woman kag first person nga may south Asian descent nga magaserbe nga presidente sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: Obama is the first Black US President and if Harris becomes the Democratic candidate and wins against Trump, she will be the first woman, first Black woman and first person of south Asian descent to serve as president of the United States of America.

text: Nahibaluan nga ginlunsar na sang Harris campaign ang “weekend of action” nga amo ang nagamarka sang 100 nga adlaw antes ang eleksyon.
english: The Harris campaign has already launched a “weekend of action” that marks 100 days before the election.

text: Tatlo ka tawo ang patay samtang apat naman ang pilason matapos ang encounter sa tunga sang duha ka grupo sang Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF) sa Barangay Linantangan,Shariff Saidona Mustapha, Maguindanao del Sur.
english: Three people were killed and four others injured after an encounter between two groups of the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF) in Barangay Linantangan, Shariff Saidona Mustapha, Maguindanao del Sur.

text: Suno sa Police Regional Office-Bangsamoro Autonomous Region, sakay sang tatlo ka minivan ang mga tinawo nanday MILF Commander Malimbuteng kag Zainudin Kairo, pareho nga katapo sang 128 MILF Base Command, sang gin-ambush sang grupo nanday Kagui Gani Adam, Esmail Salim kag Tuhami Mamulintao sa isa ka bain sang highway sa Barangay Linantangan.
english: According to the Police Regional Office-Bangsamoro Autonomous Region, the personnel of MILF Commander Malimbuteng and Zainudin Kairo, both members of the 128 MILF Base Command, were riding in three minivans when they were ambushed by a group of Kagui Gani Adam, Esmail Salim and Tuhami Malintao on the Baintao highway in Bainan.

text: Sanday Adam, Salim kag Mamulintao ang mga miyembro naman sang 118th MILF Base Command.
english: Adam, Salim and Mamulintao are members of the 118th MILF Base Command.

text: Ang mga napatay amo ang tatlo ka sakay sang mga naka-convoy nga minivan matapos nag-angkon sang madamo nga igo sang bala sa lawas samtang apat pa sa ila kaupdanan ang pilason.
english: The dead were three occupants of the convoyed minivan after sustaining multiple gunshot wounds while four others were injured.

text: Ginpahayag nga madugay nga may inaway ang grupo nga pareho nga katapo sang MILF.
english: The group, both members of the MILF, reportedly had a long-standing war.

text: Nag-ugat ang inaway bangud sa agaway sang mga teritoryo kag pulitika.
english: The war was rooted in territorial and political disputes.

text: Magkaribal sa pulitika ang ila nga mga ginsuportahan sang nagligad nga May 12, 2025 nga eleksyon.
english: Their supporters in the last May 12, 2025 elections are political rivals.

text: Mangin ang mabaskog nga pag-ulan ang wala nakapugong sa maragtason kag maduagon nga opening ceremony sang Paris Olympics 2024 nga gintambungan sang delegasyon sang nagkalain-lain nga mga pungsod lakip ang Pilipinas.
english: Even the heavy rains did not stop the historic and victorious opening ceremony of the Paris Olympics 2024 which was attended by delegations of various countries including the Philippines.

text: Nagsugod ang seremonya eksakto 1:30 kaina sang kaagahon oras sa Pilipinas kag nagtapos pasado na ‘las singko subong nga kaagahon.
english: The ceremony began at exactly 1:30 am Philippine time and ended past 5 am this morning.

text: Indi kaangay sa iban nga edisyon sang Olympiada kun sa diin ginapatigayon ang seremonya sa stadium, ini nga kahiwatan ang ginhimo sa River Seine kun sa diin nagparada ang mga atleta samtang yara sa mga sakayan kag naglabay sa historic landmarks sa City of Love kaangay sang Notre-Dame de Paris cathedral kag Louvre.
english: Unlike other editions of the Olympiad where the ceremony is held in the stadium, this event was held on the River Seine where the athletes paraded while in boats and passed historical landmarks in the City of Love such as the Notre-Dame de Paris cathedral and the Louvre.

text: Nagtapos ang parada sang mga sakayan tubtub sa Trocadero Gardens nga nahamtang malapit sa bantog nga Eiffel Tower.
english: The parade of boats ended at the Trocadero Gardens located near the famous Eiffel Tower.

text: Suno kay Bombo Hexyl Panes, international correspondent sa Paris, France, ang may pinakamatunog nga hugyaw kag palakpak amo ang Estados Unidos sang Amerika nga may 592 ka mga atleta sa pagpanguna sang flagbearers sang pungsod nga sanday tennis superstar Coco Gauff kag basketball icon LeBron James.
english: According to Bombo Hexyl Panes, international correspondent in Paris, France, the United States of America had the loudest cheers and applause with 592 athletes led by the country's flagbearers tennis superstar Coco Gauff and basketball icon LeBron James.

text: Ulihi naman nga nag-abot sa Trocadero Gardens amo ang host nation nga may 571 ka mga atleta.
english: Last to arrive at Trocadero Gardens was the host nation with 571 athletes.

text: Samtang, nagpasakop man sa parade of nations ang mga atleta sang Pilipinas nga nagasuksok sang Sinag Barong nga himo sang renowned Filipino designer nga si Francis Libiran.
english: Meanwhile, Philippine athletes also participated in the parade of nations wearing Sinag Barong made by renowned Filipino designer Francis Libiran.

text: Kaupod sang Pilipinas sa sakayan amo ang mga atleta sang Puerto Rico kag Poland.
english: Along with the Philippines in the boat are athletes from Puerto Rico and Poland.

text: Nagpanguna sa 22 ka atleta sang pungsod ang Olympic silver medalists nga sanday Nesthy Petecio kag Carlo Paalam.
english: Olympic silver medalists Nesthy Petecio and Carlo Paalam led the country's 22 athletes.

text: Ginbanta sang organizers nga naglab-ot sa 320,000 ang tumalan-aw lakip ang A-list celebrities nga naglinya man sa River Seina.
english: Organizers estimated 320,000 spectators including A-list celebrities who also lined the River Seina.

text: Sa labing-una man sa maragtas sang Olympiada, maga-compete sa Paris Olympic Games ang equal 50-50 ratio sa male kag female athletes suno sa International Olympic Committee.
english: For the first time in the history of the Olympics, an equal 50-50 ratio of male and female athletes will compete in the Paris Olympic Games, according to the International Olympic Committee.

text:
SEGURIDAD

Samtang, mas nangin hugot naman ang seguridad malapit sa venue kasunod sang pagpang-sabotahe kag arson attack sa porsyon sang high-speed rail network sang France inoras antes ang opening ceremony.
english:
SECURITY

Meanwhile, security was tightened near the venue following the sabotage and arson attack on a portion of France's high-speed rail network hours before the opening ceremony.

text: Ini nga mga pagpang-atake nga gintawag sang otoridad nga “coordinated acts of sabotage” ang nag-atrasar sang byahe sang ginatos ka mga pasahero.
english: These attacks, which authorities called “coordinated acts of sabotage” delayed flights for hundreds of passengers.

text: Sang ulihi, ginkumpirma nga 800,000 gid ka mga pasahero ang naapektuhan sa rail traffic.
english: Later, it was confirmed that indeed 800,000 passengers were affected in rail traffic.

text: Bangud sa sabotahe, ginpahayag sang national train operator nga apektado gid ang ila nga Atlantic, northern kag eastern lines.
english: Due to the sabotage, the national train operator said its Atlantic, northern and eastern lines were severely affected.

text: Ginpahayag man nga daku ang halit sa ila pasilidad bangud ginsunog ini kag posible nga indi tayuyon ang operasyon tubtub sa weekend bangud kinahanglan pa ang repair.
english: He also said that their facility was badly damaged because it was burned and it is possible that the operation will not continue until the weekend because it still needs repairs.

text: OTON, ILOILO – Preso ang isa ka pulis matapos nagpaniro sang iya abyan sa Barangay Sta.
english: OTON, ILOILO – A policeman was arrested after he shot his friend in Barangay Sta.

text: Rita, Oton, Iloilo.
english: Rita, Oton, Iloilo.

text: Ang suspek amo si Patrolman Mike Tagacay, legal ang edad, kasado, residente sang nasambit nga barangay kag assigned sa Oton Municipal Police Station.
english: The suspect was identified as Patrolman Mike Tagacay, legal age, married, resident of the said barangay and assigned to the Oton Municipal Police Station.

text: Ang biktima naman amo si Maria Librias Billones, 50, residente man sang nasambit nga lugar.
english: The victim was identified as Maria Librias Billones, 50, also a resident of the said place.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Lunelyn Talamillo, deputy chief of police sang Oton Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga nag-inom-inom ang pulis kaupod ang biktima.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Lunelyn Talamillo, deputy chief of police of Oton Municipal Police Station, said the policeman was drinking with the victim.

text: Bangud sa tuman nga kahulugbon, nagbais ang mga ini tubtob gintiro sang pulis ang biktima sa tiyan kag dughan.
english: Due to the drunkenness, they argued until the policeman shot the victim in the stomach and chest.

text: Gindala naman sa ospital ang biktima agud hatagan sang nagakaigo nga pagbulong.
english: The victim was taken to the hospital for treatment.

text: Nagsungka naman ang pulis sa Oton Municipal Police Station dala ang iya 9mm nga pusil nga amo ang gingamit sa krimen.
english: The policeman surrendered to the Oton Municipal Police Station with his 9mm pistol used in the crime.

text: USA – Isa ka daku nga balyena ang nakit-an nga nagalumpat kag nagabunggo sa isa ka gamay nga fishing boat sa kadagatan sang New Hampshire sa Estados Unidos.
english: USA – A large whale was spotted jumping and colliding with a small fishing boat in the waters of New Hampshire in the United States.

text: Santo sa mga report, ang humpback whale nakita nga nagsaka gikan sa dagat kag daw naga-embow drop sa sakayan nga naigo sa likod nga bahin.
english: According to reports, the humpback whale was seen rising from the sea and appeared to embow drop on the boat that was hit on the stern.

text: Nagtuwas naman ang unahan sang sakayan tubtob nga nagtakilid ini kag nagbaliskad.
english: The front of the boat rose until it tilted and capsized.

text: Isa ka tawo ang naglumpat sa sakayan, samtang ang isa ang nabilin sa sulod.
english: One person jumped into the boat, while the other stayed inside.

text: Maswerte naman nga safe ang duha sang iban pa nga mga manugpangisda sa lugar, apang nahalitan ang ila sakayan kag kinahanglan nga guyuron pabalik sa pantalan.
english: Fortunately, two of the other fishermen in the area were safe, but their boat was damaged and had to be towed back to the dock.

text: Suno Greg Paquette, sakay sa sakayan sa pagpangisda, nagbalikid lang siya kag ang ulo sang balyena nagapanaug na sa ibabaw sang makina.
english: According to Greg Paquette, on a fishing boat, he just turned around and the whale’s head was coming down on top of the engine.

text: Ginpahayag man ang natungdan nga nakit-an ang balyena sa lugar isa ka semana antes ang insidente.
english: He also said the whale was spotted in the area a week before the incident.

text: Ang hitabo isa ka misteryo sa madamo bangod suno sa mga eksperto, wala nagasalakay ang mga humpback whale sa mga sakayan.
english: The incident is a mystery to many because according to experts, humpback whales do not attack boats.

text: Ginakabig man sila nga malulo sa mga tawo.
english: They are also considered to be gentle with humans.

text: Suno sa isa ka katapo sang Blue Ocean Society for Marine Conservation, nagapangita sang makaon ang balyena rason nga nahimo sini ang magtuyo nga magsaka sa sakayan-pandagat.
english: According to a member of the Blue Ocean Society for Marine Conservation, the whale was looking for food and managed to board the boat.

text: Suno naman kay Dianna Schulte sang Blue Ocean Society for Marine Conservation, madamo sang menhaden, ukon isa ka sahi sang magagmay nga isda nga paon, sa suba sang damlag lang.
english: As for Dianna Schulte of the Blue Ocean Society for Marine Conservation, there have been a lot of menhaden, or a type of small baitfish, in the river lately.

text: Gani posible, nagasulod ini sa suba agud nga magapangita lang sang iya nga pagkaon.
english: So it is possible that it enters the river to look for food.

text: Nakasaka na ang Tropical Cyclone Wind Signal No.
english: Tropical Cyclone Wind Signal No.

text: 2 sa Itbayat, Batanes bangud sa gulpiyada nga pagbaskog sang Bagyo Gorio, suno sa Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA).
english: 2 in Itbayat, Batanes due to the sudden strengthening of Typhoon Gorio, according to the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA).

text: Samtang, ang nabilin nga bahin sang probinsya sang Batanes yara sa idalom sang Signal No.
english: Meanwhile, the rest of Batanes province is under Signal No.

text: Suno sa report sang PAGASA, nakita ang sentro sang bagyo sa distansya nga 300 kilometros East Northeast sang Itbayat.
english: According to PAGASA, the epicenter of the typhoon was located 300 kilometers East Northeast of Itbayat.

text:
May dala gihapon ini nga kusog nga hangin nga nagalab-ot tubtob 130km/h kag bugso nga naga-abot sa 160km/h.

Ginalauman sang PAGASA nga magaguwa sa Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) ang Bagyo Gorio karon sa hapon, Agosto 13, kag maga-landfall sa Taiwan sa pareho man nga adlaw sa aga.
english:
It still has sustained winds of up to 130km/h and gusts of up to 160km/h.

PAGASA expects Typhoon Gorio to leave the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility (PAR) this afternoon, August 13, and make landfall in Taiwan the same morning.

text: Ginpahanumdom sang mga otoridad ang mga pumuluyo nga magpanghanda kag mag-monitor sang opisyal nga advisories halin sa PAGASA.
english: Authorities reminded residents to prepare and monitor official advisories from PAGASA.

text: Ginapamulta sang P75,000 ang basketball player nga si Jio Jalalon sang Magnolia Hotshots bangud sa paglapas sa COVID-19 protocols, lima ka adlaw antes ang pagbukas sang liga sa Hulyo 16.
english: Basketball player Jio Jalalon of the Magnolia Hotshots was fined P75,000 for violating COVID-19 protocols, five days before the league opens on July 16.

text: Suno kay PBA Commissioner Willie Marcial, gin-ako man ni Jalalon ang iya sala kag nagpangayo ini sang sorry.
english: According to PBA Commissioner Willie Marcial, Jalalon also admitted his mistake and apologized.

text: Magluwas sa multa pahayag ni Marcial, lima pa gid ka adlaw nga suspension nga wala sang bayad ang ginhatag sa nasambit nga player.
english: In addition to the fine, Marcial said the player was also given a five-day suspension without pay.

text:
Dugang pa sang natungdan, nagpartisipar si Jalalon sa isa ka basketball game sa Northern Luzon sa diin ginlapas sini ang closed-circuit format sang liga ukon ang “home-venue-home scheme.”

May yara naman sang ginahimo nga tikang ang Magnolia team management.
english:
He added that Jalalon participated in a basketball game in Northern Luzon where he violated the closed-circuit format of the league or the “home-venue-home scheme.”

The Magnolia team management is taking steps.

text: Nahibaluan nga tuman ka-strikto ang liga sa COVID-19 protocols ilabi na nga bag-o lang man ini ginpasugtan sang Inter-Agency Task Force kag sang Game and Amusements Board nga maka-umpisa na sa pagpatigayon sang live games sa Hulyo 16.
english: The league is very strict on COVID-19 protocols especially since it was recently approved by the Inter-Agency Task Force and the Game and Amusements Board to start conducting live games on July 16.

text: Nagnubo ang average nga residential electricity rate sang MORE Electric and Power Corporation.
english: The average residential electricity rate of MORE Electric and Power Corporation has decreased.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Engineer Joe-Mel Zaporteza, Chief Operating Officer sang MORE Power, iya ginpahayag nga nagnubo sa P11.1354 kada kilowatt-hour ang average nga residential electricity rate, mas manubo sangsa P12.0344 kada kilowatt-hour sang nagligad nga bulan, nga nagapakita sang P0.8990 kilowatt-hour nga pagnubo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Engineer Joe-Mel Zaporteza, Chief Operating Officer of MORE Power, said the average residential electricity rate dropped to P11.1354 per kilowatt-hour, lower than P12.0344 per kilowatt-hour last month, representing an increase of P0.890 per kilowatt-hour.

text: Suno kay Zaporteza, ang mas manubo nga bili sang kuryente bangud sa lower generation and transmission cost, nga may pagnubo sang presyo gikan sa Wholesale Electricity Spot Market (WESM) kag stable nga presyo gikan sa bilateral contracts.
english: According to Zaporteza, the lower cost of electricity is due to lower generation and transmission cost, with reduced prices from the Wholesale Electricity Spot Market (WESM) and stable prices from bilateral contracts.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga gin-gamit sang MORE Power ang paborable nga presyo gikan sa merkado sang kuryente paagi sa pagbakal sang dugang pa kon manubo ang presyo sang WESM.
english: He also said MORE Power took advantage of favorable prices from the electricity market by buying more when WESM prices were low.

text: Ang distribution sang MORE Power nagapabilin nga pareho.
english: The distribution of MORE Power remains the same.

text: Nagpaathag man ang korporasyon nga ang pagtaas ukon pagnubo sang balayran nagadepende sa bili sang kuryente para sa lebel sang konsumo kag sa kabug-usan nga kuryente nga ginkonsumo.
english: The corporation also explained that the increase or decrease in the bill depends on the cost of electricity for the level of consumption and the total electricity consumed.

text: IVISAN, CAPIZ – Duha ang patay kag masobra 20 naman ang pilason matapos gin-arado sang 10-wheeler truck ang 28 ka mga salakyan sa Brgy.
english: IVISAN, CAPIZ – Two people were killed and more than 20 others injured after a 10-wheeler truck plowed into 28 vehicles in Brgy.

text: Poblacion Norte, Ivisan, Capiz.
english: Poblacion Norte, Ivisan, Capiz.

text: Ang mga napatay biktima amo sanday Maricel Sargento, street sweeper, residente sang Barangay Poblacion Sur, Ivisan, Capiz kag isa pa gid ka senior citizen.
english: The victims were identified as Maricel Sargento, street sweeper, resident of Barangay Poblacion Sur, Ivisan, Capiz and another senior citizen.

text: Ang driver naman sang truck amo si Ryan Bengan Molato, 39, residente sang Purok 8, Barangay Tarong, Carles, Iloilo.
english: The driver of the truck was identified as Ryan Bengan Molato, 39, resident of Purok 8, Barangay Tarong, Carles, Iloilo.

text: Suno kay Police Major Ruby Magallanes, hepe sang Ivisan Municipal Police Station, nadulaan sang preno ang driver sang truck nga may karga nga hardware materials.
english: According to Police Major Ruby Magallanes, chief of Ivisan Municipal Police Station, the driver of the truck loaded with hardware materials lost his brakes.

text: Naghalin ang truck sa Balasan, Iloilo kag padulong kuntani sa Kalibo, Aklan sang natabo ang aksidente.
english: The truck was heading from Balasan, Iloilo to Kalibo, Aklan when the accident occurred.

text: Sakay naman sang truck ang apat ka pahinante.
english: The four drivers were in the truck.

text: Ini amo sanday, Orland Mercado Dumdumaya, 27, sang Barangay Mamhut NorteNorte, Balasan, Iloilo; Arvin Bantiling Bata-anon, 24, kag Raymund Bantiling De Asis, 27, lunsay residente sang Barangay Tingui-an, Balasan, Iloilo; kag Jeffry Valenzuela Belarmino, 28, residente sang Barangay Poblacion Sur, Balasan, Iloilo.
english: They are Orland Mercado Dumdumaya, 27, of Barangay Mamhut NorteNorte, Balasan, Iloilo; Arvin Bantiling Bata-anon, 24, and Raymund Bantiling De Asis, 27, both residents of Barangay Tingui-an, Balasan, Iloilo; and Jeffry Valenzuela Belarmino, 28, resident of Barangay Poblacion Sur, Balasan, Iloilo.

text: Posible naman nga magapangatubang ang driver sang truck sang kaso nga Reckless Imprudence Resulting to Homicide, Multiple Serious Physical Injuries and Damage to Properties.
english: The driver of the truck is likely to face charges of Reckless Imprudence Resulting to Homicide, Multiple Serious Physical Injuries and Damage to Properties.

text: Suno naman kay Mira Docallos, Municipal Social Welfare and Development Officer sang Ivisan, sabton sang local government unit ang tanan nga galastuhan sang mga napatay sa aksidente.
english: Mira Docallos, Municipal Social Welfare and Development Officer of Ivisan, said the local government unit will bear all the expenses of the victims.

text: Wala nagakabalaka ang Milwaukee Bucks apisar nga abanse na sa 2-0 ang ila kasumpong nga Phoenix Suns sa nagapadayon nga NBA Finals.
english: The Milwaukee Bucks are not worried despite their 2-0 lead over the Phoenix Suns in the ongoing NBA Finals.

text: Suno sa Bucks, na-eksperyensyahan na nila ang 2-0 deficit sa Eastern Conference finals sang naatubang nila ang Brooklyn Nets.
english: According to the Bucks, they already experienced a 2-0 deficit in the Eastern Conference finals when they faced the Brooklyn Nets.

text: Apang sa ulihe, nakabangon pa ang team kag ginkilala pa sila nga conference champions.
english: But eventually, the team recovered and were recognized as conference champions.

text: Para sa anay MVP nga si Giannis Antetokounmpo, tuman lang ang paghanda sang Phoenix kag sa Lunes, Hulyo 12, las 8 sa aga, kahigayunan naman sang ila nga teaMm nga maghanda kag depensahan man ang ila nga home court sa Game 3.
english: For former MVP Giannis Antetokounmpo, Phoenix is ​​preparing enough and on Monday, July 12, at 8 am, their team will have the opportunity to prepare and defend their home court in Game 3.

text: Nagalaum si Giannis nga maninguha man ang iya mga teammates agud nga makabawi sila sa Game 1 kag Game 2 nila nga kapyerdehan batuk sa Suns.
english: Giannis hopes that his teammates will also work hard to recover from their Game 1 and Game 2 losses against the Suns.

text: Pila sa mga pork retailers kag traders ang magapatigayon sang “pork holiday” sa tion nga mapatuman na ang price ceiling sa baboy kag manok.
english: Some pork retailers and traders will hold a pork holiday once the price ceiling on pork and chicken is implemented.

text: Suno kay Ricardo Chan sang Manila Meat Dealers Association, indi sila anay magbaligya sang baboy kadungan sang 60 ka adlaw nga implementasyon sang price cap agud nga malikawan ang kapiyerdehan kag penalidad.
english: Ricardo Chan of the Manila Meat Dealers Association said they will not sell pork during the 60-day implementation of the price cap to avoid losses and penalties.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagmandu sang Pebrero 1 si Presidente Rodrigo Duterte sa pagpatuman sang price cap sa mga baboy kag manok sa sulod sang 60 ka adlaw sa National Capital Region bangud sa mataas nga presyo.
english: President Rodrigo Duterte on February 1 ordered the implementation of a price cap on pigs and chickens for 60 days in the National Capital Region due to high prices.

text: Ang price ceiling ang mangin epektibo na sa Pebrero 8.
english: The price ceiling will be effective on February 8.

text: ASIA – Nagpanawagan ang United Nations’ Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) nga doblehon ang pagtinguha sa tagsa ka rehiyon sa pagpakig-away sa pagdamo sang mga kaso sang avian influenza sa bug-os nga Asia-Pacific Region.
english: ASIA – The United Nations’ Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) has called for redoubling efforts in each region to combat the rise in avian influenza cases across the Asia-Pacific Region.

text: Suno kay Kachen Wongsathapornchai, regional manager sang Food and Agriculture Organization Emergency Center for Transboundary Animal Diseases (ECTAD), nga sugod sang ulihi nga bahin sang 2023, naobserbahan sang talatapan ang pagtaas sang mga kaso sang virus nga nagalapta sa bag-o nga mga specie sang sapat.
english: Kachen Wongsathapornchai, regional manager of the Food and Agriculture Organization Emergency Center for Transboundary Animal Diseases (ECTAD), said that since late 2023, the office has observed an increase in cases of the virus spreading to new animal species.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga ang pag-utwas sang mga bag-o nga A/H5N1 nga mga strain, nga mas madali nga mapasa, nagapadugang sang pamahog sang pandemya, rason nga kinahanglan ang madasig kag koordinado nga mga tikang sa pagtapna sang amo nga balatian.
english: It also said that the emergence of new A/H5N1 strains, which are more transmissible, increases the threat of the pandemic, necessitating urgent and coordinated measures to prevent such disease.

text: Ang bird flu nagalapta sa mga sapat nga ginasagod gikan sa wild nga mga pispis.
english: Bird flu spreads to domestic animals from wild birds.

text: Santo sa data sang talatapan, ang H5N1 nga sahi sang avian flu naglapnag sa bug-os nga kalibutan sang nagligad nga mga tinuig, nga nagpatay sang binilyon ka mga pispis nga ginasagod kag wild kag naglapta sa napulo ka mga species sang mammals.
english: According to the bureau’s data, the H5N1 strain of avian flu has spread around the world in recent years, killing billions of domestic and wild birds and spreading to tens of mammalian species.

text: Na-rekord naman sang Australia ang isa ka kaso sang H5N1 sa tawo sang Mayo.
english: Australia recorded one case of H5N1 in humans in May.

text: Sang temprano sini nga tuig, isa ka Intsik nga babayi ang napatay gikan sa isa ka talagsahon nga H3N8 subtype sang avian influenza, nga ginkabig nga labing-una nga kamatayon sa kalibutan gikan sa strain.
english: Earlier this year, a Chinese woman died from a rare H3N8 subtype of avian influenza, considered the world’s first death from the strain.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang Australia, ang may yara sang indi magnubo sa 10 ka mga poultry sang manok ang natapikan, ang naga-atubang sang tatlo ka magkaanggid nga outbreaks sang bird flu.
english: Australia, which has at least 10 poultry farms infected, is facing three similar outbreaks of bird flu.

text: Wala nagpa-areglo ang motorcycle rider nga nabalian sang tul-an sa paa matapos nabungguan sang modernized jeep nga nag-U-turn sa Brgy.
english: A motorcycle rider who broke his leg after being hit by a modernized jeep that made a U-turn in Brgy.

text: Concepcion, City Proper sang nagligad nga adlaw.
english: Concepcion, City Proper last day.

text: Ang biktima amo si alias Nonoy, 32, nga halin sang direksyon sang Parola wharf kag padulong kuntani sa Muelle Loney sang natabo ang insidente.
english: The victim was identified as Nonoy, 32, who was heading towards Muelle Loney from the direction of Parola wharf when the incident occurred.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Corporal Emmanuel Jude Garcesa, imbestigador sa kaso, iya ginpahayag nga base sa istorya sang driver, nag-overtake siya sa traditional jeep nga iya ginasundan bangud maligwa man ang dalan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Corporal Emmanuel Jude Garcesa, investigator of the case, said that based on the driver's story, he overtook the traditional jeep he was following because the road was wide.

text: Ginpahayag nga naga-park ang modernized jeep sa higad sang karsada apang hinali lang nga nag-U-turn pakadto sa direksyon sang Parola Wharf kag wala man nag-signal rason nga nagluntad ang aksidente.
english: The modernized jeep was reportedly parked on the side of the road but suddenly made a U-turn in the direction of Parola Wharf and did not signal causing the accident.

text: Kun basehan naman ang driver sang modernized jeep, ma-U-turn kuntani ini sang nakit-an nga nagapadulong ang motorsiklo rason nga nagpreno ini apang nalab-ot gid sang motor ang iya nga bumper.
english: According to the driver of the modernized jeep, he was about to make a U-turn when he saw the motorcycle approaching and braked but the motorcycle hit his bumper.

text: Sa interview naman sang Bombo Radyo kay Nonoy, ginpahayag sini nga indi matuod nga siya ang nakabunggo sa modernized jeep kag makapamatuod diri ang eyewitnesses suno sa iya nga nagabasol man sa modernized unit.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Nonoy said it is not true that he was hit by the modernized jeep and eyewitnesses can prove it, he said, blaming the modernized unit.

text: Naghingyo man ang biktima nga bayaran sang driver ang gasto sini sa pagpaospital amo man ang adlaw-adlaw nga galastuhon sang iya pamilya bangud apektado man ang iya palangabuhian matapos ang insidente.#
english: The victim also requested that the driver pay for his hospitalization expenses as well as the daily expenses of his family as his livelihood was also affected after the incident.

text: Dako ang nangin pasensya kag disiplina sang Phoenix Suns ipaanggid sa Milwaukee Bucks rason nga nakuha sang Suns ang kadalag-an sa game 2 sang NBA Finals sa score nga 118-108.
english: The Phoenix Suns showed great patience and discipline compared to the Milwaukee Bucks, which led the Suns to win game 2 of the NBA Finals 118-108.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Jophil Cercado, basketball trainor kag coach sang Province of Iloilo Sports Program, iya ginpahayag nga kulang sa ‘awareness’ ang Bucks sa mga masunod nga hulag kag diskarte sang Suns.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Jophil Cercado, basketball trainer and coach of the Province of Iloilo Sports Program, said the Bucks lack awareness of the Suns' next moves and strategies.

text: Suno kay Cercado, masami man nga nagakatalang ang mga player sang Bucks sa diin nagakabudlayan ang mga ini magpakot sang masunod nga hulag sang Suns tubtub natapos ang game 2.
english: According to Cercado, Bucks players often get lost and have difficulty predicting the Suns' next move until the end of game 2.

text: Ginpahayag niya nga sa bahin sang Suns, nangin impresibo ang ginpakita nga composure, kontrol kag pag-intindihanay sang isa kag isa sa sulod sang court.
english: He said that on the part of the Suns, it was impressive to show composure, control and understanding of each other inside the court.

text: Nangin epektibo man ang mga tira kag style sang pointguard nga si Chris Paul.
english: Pointguard Chris Paul’s shots and style have also been effective.

text: Agud makabawi sa game 2 ang Bucks, ginpahayag ni Cercado nga pila sa mga adjustments nga dapat himuon sang Bucks amo ang husto nga pagtuon sa mga istilo sang kontra kag tun-an ang mga tactics sang Suns.
english: In order for the Bucks to recover in game 2, Cercado said some of the adjustments the Bucks must make are to properly learn the opponent's styles and learn the Suns' tactics.

text: ILOILO CITY– Mahimo nga arestuhon apisar nga wala sang warrant ang mga tawo sa likod sang double your money investment scams kaangay sang Chiyuto Double Your Money Scheme kag iban pa nga nga kompaniya nga nagatanyag sang kasubong nga schemes.
english: ILOILO CITY – People behind double your money investment scams such as the Chiyuto Double Your Money Scheme and other companies that offer similar schemes can be arrested without a warrant.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Senate Minority Leader Franklin Drilon, iya ginpahayag nga ini nga sahi sang iligal nga buluhaton ang makabig nga continuing crime gani mahimo nga magpatigayon sang warrantless arrest.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Senate Minority Leader Franklin Drilon said that this type of illegal activity is considered a continuing crime and can lead to warrantless arrest.

text: Suno kay Drilon, maathag man nga ginlapas sang sini nga double your money investment scheme ang revised corporation code, revised penal code kag ang securities code bangud mismo ang Securities and Exchange Commission ang nagpamat-ud nga wala ini sang lisensya para nga magsolicit sang kwarta gikan sa mga tawo.
english: According to Drilon, it is also clear that this double your money investment scheme violates the revised corporation code, revised penal code and the securities code because the Securities and Exchange Commission itself has determined that it does not have a license to solicit money from the people.

text: Dugang pa sang Ilonggo senator, apisar may registration sa Department of Trade and Industry ini nga mga investment schemes, indi ini bastante nga dokumento.
english: The Ilonggo senator added that although these investment schemes are registered with the Department of Trade and Industry, this is not a sufficient document.

text: Mahimo naman nga mapasakaan sang kaso nga syndicated estafa ang mga tawo sa likod sini ilabi na ang mga aktibo nga nagapang-solicit sang kwarta.
english: The people behind it, especially those who actively solicit money, can be charged with syndicated estafa.

text: Paathag pa sang natungdan, bisan isa lang ka affidavit, mahimo na nga makapasaka sang kaso.
english: He explained that even one affidavit can be used to file a case.

text: Posible nga mapamatbatan sang silot nga life imprisonment ang mapamatud-an nga guilty.
english: Those found guilty could face life imprisonment.

text: Aminado ang All-Star point guard sang Phoenix Suns nga si Chris Paul nga malayo pa nga matapos ang serye nila batuk sa Milwaukee Bucks sa NBA Finals.
english: Phoenix Suns All-Star point guard Chris Paul admitted that their series against the Milwaukee Bucks in the NBA Finals is far from over.

text: Suno sa veteran player nga nanguna sa Game 1, isa ka daog pa lang ang ila nahimo kag kinahanglan pa ang 3-wins.
english: According to the veteran player who took the lead in Game 1, they are only one win away and need 3-wins.

text: Kuntani pahayag niya, indi lang sila madulaan sang focus sa best-of-seven series.
english: Hopefully, he said, they will not lose focus on the best-of-seven series.

text: Pahayag naman sang teammates ni Paul nga sanday Devin Booker kag Mikal Bridges, makit-an nga tuman ka-handa sa iya una nga NBA Finals si Paul sa diin sulod kag may puntos gid ang kada tira sini sang bola.
english: Paul's teammates Devin Booker and Mikal Bridges said Paul was very ready for his first NBA Finals.

text: Sa kampo naman sang Milwaukee, ginpahayag sang top scorer nga si Kris Middleton nga nakahibalo sila nga mabuday ang serye kag may kahigayunan nga mapyerde sila.
english: In the Milwaukee camp, top scorer Kris Middleton said they knew the series would be close and there was a chance they would lose.

text: Apang pahayag sang ila nga coach nga si Mike Budenholzer, samtang nagadugay ang serye, naga-maayo ang performance sang ila nga team ilabi na nga nagbalik ang ila two-time MVP nga si Giannis Antetokounmpo.
english: However, coach Mike Budenholzer said that as the series progressed, the performance of their team improved especially with the return of their two-time MVP Giannis Antetokounmpo.

text: Patigayunon sa bwas ang game 2 sa tunga sang Suns kag Bucks sa homecourt sang Phoenix.
english: Game 2 between the Suns and Bucks will be played tomorrow at Phoenix's homecourt.

text: Ginpanubo pa sang pandemya ang ekonomiya sang Pilipinas sang 2020 kag naghatag ini sang negative growth sa bilog nga tuig.
english: The pandemic further weakened the Philippine economy in 2020 and it resulted in negative growth throughout the year.

text:
Yara sa -9.5 percent ang gross domestic product (GDP) para sa 2020 — ang pinakamalala humalin sang 1947 ukon pagkatapos sang World War 2

Suno kay acting Socioeconomic Planning Secretary Karl Chua, ang quarantine restrictions ang nagpanubo sang household spending sa P801 billion sang 2020 ukon ginabanta P2.2 billion kada adlaw.
english:
Gross domestic product (GDP) is at -9.5 percent for 2020 — the worst since 1947 or after World War 2

According to acting Socioeconomic Planning Secretary Karl Chua, the quarantine restrictions reduced household spending to P801 billion in 2020 or an estimated P2.2 billion per day.

text: Ang total income loss naman sang consumption ang yara sa P1.04 trillion sang 2020 ukon ginabanta P2.8 billion kada adlaw.
english: The total income loss of consumption was P1.04 trillion in 2020 or approximately P2.8 billion per day.

text: Sa pihak sini nagalaum ang gobyerno nga makabangon na ang ekonomiya subong nga 2021 kadungan sang paghalog sang quarantine restriction kag ang ginalauman nga pag-umpisa sang paghatag sang bakuna batuk sa COVID19.
english: Meanwhile, the government hopes that the economy will recover in 2021 with the lifting of quarantine restrictions and the expected start of vaccination against COVID19.

text: Linibo ka protesters ang nagtinir malapit sa United States Capitol antes ang speech ni Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu sa atubang sang mga miyembro sang Kongreso.
english: Thousands of protesters stayed near the United States Capitol ahead of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's speech before members of Congress.

text: Ini nga protesters ang lunsay nagapamatok sa binulan na nga pagpang-atake sang Israel sa Gaza bilang balos man sa pag-atake anay sang Hamas militants sa southern Israel sang nagligad nga Oktubre 2023.
english: The protesters are all opposing Israel's months-long attack on Gaza in retaliation for the earlier attack by Hamas militants in southern Israel last October 2023.

text: Dala sang mga naga-protesta ang nagkalain-lain nga banners lakip na ang isa nga may nakasulat nga “Wanted War Criminal” bilang reference sa arrest warrant nga ginduso anay sang prosecutors sang International Criminal Court.
english: The protesters carried various banners including one that read “Wanted War Criminal” in reference to the arrest warrant earlier pushed by prosecutors of the International Criminal Court.

text: Mangin ang Oscar-winning actor nga si Susan Sarandon ang yara man sa protesta kag nagpatunga pa agud nga ikondena ang nagapanglakaak nga numero sang patay sa Gaza bangud sa giyera.
english: Even Oscar-winning actor Susan Sarandon was present at the protest and even intervened to condemn the rising death toll in Gaza due to the war.

text: May yara man sang demonstrators nga nagdala sang halos 30 ka human-size nga mga lungon nga human sa carboard kag nakaputos pa sa flag sang Palestine bilang pagdumdum sa mga nagkalamatay sa Gaza.
english: There were also demonstrators who carried nearly 30 human-size coffins made of carboard and wrapped in the Palestinian flag in memory of those killed in Gaza.

text: Nahibaluan nga antes ang speech ni Netanyahu, madamo na nga Democratic lawmakers ang nagsiling nga indi sila magtambong bangud dismayado man sa death toll kag sa humanitarian crisis dala sang pagpang-atake sang Israel.
english: Before Netanyahu's speech, many Democratic lawmakers said they would not attend because they were disappointed with the death toll and the humanitarian crisis caused by Israel's attack.

text: Antes sini, matandaan nga sang naglinigad nga binulan, kadungan sang graduation season, nangin lapnagon man ang mga protesta sa mga unibersidad sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika bilang matunog nga pagpamatok sang opensiba sang Israel nga nagpatay na sang halos 40,000 ka Palestinians kag 2.3-million naman ang nadulaan sang mga puluy-an.
english: Earlier, it can be recalled that last month, during the graduation season, protests at universities in the United States of America also became widespread in strong opposition to the Israeli offensive that has killed nearly 40,000 Palestinians and displaced 2.3 million.

text: Ginpresentar ni Presidente Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr.
english: Presented by President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr.

text: ang napirmahan nga Government Optimization Act kay Executive Secretary Lucas P. Bersamin sa isa ka seremonya sa Malacañang Palace sang Martes, Agosto 12.
english: the signed Government Optimization Act to Executive Secretary Lucas P. Bersamin at a ceremony at the Malacañang Palace on Tuesday, August 12.

text: Ang ini nga layi, Republic Act No.
english: This law, Republic Act No.

text: 12231, nagahatag sang otoridad sa Presidente nga magreorganisa, mag-streamline, kag mag-optimize sang mga ahensya sa executive branch sa sulod sang lima ka tuig agud mapabaskug ang serbisyo, malikawan ang doble-doble nga trabaho, kag mapatuman ang mas epektibo nga pang-gobyerno.
english: 12231, authorizes the President to reorganize, streamline, and optimize executive branch agencies within five years to strengthen service, avoid duplication of work, and implement more efficient governance.
