text: NEPAL – Patay ang 18 ka tawo matapos nagtibusok ang isa ka gamay nga eroplano sa runway kadungan sang iya pag-take off.
english: NEPAL – At least 18 people were killed after a small plane crashed on the runway during takeoff.

text: Suno kay Gyanendra Bhul, information officer sa Tribhuvan International Airport, isa ka tawo ang nakaluwas samtang sakay sa Saurya Airlines.
english: According to Gyanendra Bhul, information officer at Tribhuvan International Airport, one person escaped while on board Saurya Airlines.

text:
“Rescue efforts were started immediately and the situation was brought under control.”

Sakay sang eroplano ang 18 ka mga Nepalis kag isa ka Yemeni citizen sa diin lunsay ang mga ini empleyado sang carrier.
english:
“Rescue efforts were started immediately and the situation was brought under control.”

The plane was carrying 18 Nepalis and one Yemeni citizen, both employees of the carrier.

text: Nahibaluan nga nag-take off ang eroplano halin sa Kathmandu kag padulong kuntani sa Pokhara City.
english: The plane took off from Kathmandu and was bound for Pokhara City.

text: Ang eroplano ang mapaidalom kuntani sa technical maintenance sang natabo ang insidente.
english: The plane was about to undergo technical maintenance when the incident occurred.

text: Pareho nga nakuhaan sang iligal ang duha ka mga lalaki nga nadakpan sa separado nga roving kag checkpoint operations sa Janiuay, Iloilo.
english: Both men were arrested in separate roving and checkpoint operations in Janiuay, Iloilo.

text: Ang una amo si alias Ryan, residente sang Barangay Damoong sa amo nga banwa nga ginpapundo sang mga pulis sa Crispin Salazar South (Poblacion) matapos nakit-an nga nagalabaw ang ginasukbit sini nga kutsilyo.
english: The first is alias Ryan, resident of Barangay Damoong in the same town who was stopped by police in Crispin Salazar South (Poblacion) after he was found carrying a knife.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Alwin Salmon, hepe sang Janiuay Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga sang gin-check na ang lalaki, nakumpiskar pa gid ang isa ka sachet sang suspected shabu nga nagabalor sang ginabanta P1,200.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Alwin Salmon, chief of the Janiuay Municipal Police Station, said that when the man was checked, a sachet of suspected shabu worth P1,200 was also confiscated.

text: Sang ulihi, nahibaluan sa record nga isa ini ka Tokhang surrenderer.
english: It was later learned from the record that he was a Tokhang surrenderer.

text: Samtang padayon ang inventory sang pulis, ginparahan ang isa pa gid ka motorsiklo nga naglabay bangud wala ini sang headlight kag magahod ang tambutso.
english: While the police were continuing their inventory, another motorcycle was stopped because it did not have a headlight and the exhaust was noisy.

text: Ang nagadala sang motorsiklo amo si alias Santi, 29, residente sang Barangay Balanac sa amo nga banwa, nga wala man sang mapakita nga nagakaigu nga papeles.
english: The driver of the motorcycle was identified as Santi, 29, resident of Barangay Balanac in the same town, who did not have proper documents.

text: Suno sa hepe, nakuha pa gid sa possession sang suspek ang ginapahayag tatlo ka gramos sang ginapasuni shabu nga nagabalor sang ginabanta P20,400.
english: According to the chief, three grams of suspected shabu worth P20,400 were also recovered from the suspect.

text: Base sa impormasyon sang otoridad, nagagamit man ini sang iligal nga droga.
english: According to the authorities, he also uses illegal drugs.

text: Mangatubang ang mga suspek sang kaso nga paglapas sa Republic Act 9165 ukon Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.
english: The suspects will face charges of violation of Republic Act 9165 or Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.

text: ILOILO CITY- Na- outrun, na- outplay, kag na- outsmart sang Phoenix Suns ang Milwaukee Bucks sa umpisa pa lang sang hampang rason nga nakuha sang Suns ang kadalag-an sa game 1 sang NBA Finals sa score nga 118-105.
english: ILOILO CITY- The Phoenix Suns outrun, outplayed, and outsmarted the Milwaukee Bucks early in the game, leading to a 118-105 victory in game 1 of the NBA Finals.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Jophil Cercado, basketball trainor kag coach sang Province of Iloilo Sports Program, iya ginpahayag nga kulang sa pagkaagresibo ang Bucks kag wala man sang maayo nga opensa.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Jophil Cercado, basketball trainer and coach of the Province of Iloilo Sports Program, said the Bucks lack aggressiveness and do not have a good offense.

text: Suno kay Cercado, ginkulang man sa movement sang bola si Giannis Antetokuonmpo samtang nangin limitado naman ang kontribusyon ni Brook Lopez.
english: According to Cercado, Giannis Antetokuonmpo also lacked ball movement while Brook Lopez's contribution was limited.

text: Ginpahayag niya nga sa bahin sang Suns, nangin impresibo ang ginpakita nga speed kag transition ilabi na sang pointguard nga si Chris Paul.
english: He said that on the part of the Suns, the speed and transition shown especially by pointguard Chris Paul was impressive.

text: Agud makabawi sa game 2 ang Bucks, ginpahayag ni Cercado nga pila sa mga adjustments nga dapat himuon sang Bucks amo ang husto nga match- up sa kaabtik sang players sang Suns.
english: In order for the Bucks to recover in game 2, Cercado said some of the adjustments the Bucks need to make are the right match-ups with the skills of the Suns players.

text: Masobra tunga sa million ka pesos ang nakumpiska sa isa ka birthday celebrator sa drug buy-bust operation sa Zone 3 Brgy.
english: More than half a million pesos was seized from a birthday celebrant in a drug buy-bust operation in Zone 3 Brgy.

text: San Juan, Molo, Iloilo City.
english: San Juan, Molo, Iloilo City.

text: Ang subject amo si Alyas Inday, (HVI), 52, kasado kag residente sang nasambit nga lugar.
english: The subject was identified as Inday, (HVI), 52, married and resident of the said place.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Lieutenant Lloyd Pagulayan, deputy chief of police sang Iloilo City Police Station (ICPS) 4, iya ginpahayg nga nakaagi na nga nadakpan si Alyas Inday sang tuig 2021 kag matapos nga makagwa ini nagbalik naman ini liwat sa paggamit sang illegal nga droga.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Lieutenant Lloyd Pagulayan, deputy chief of police of Iloilo City Police Station (ICPS) 4, said that Inday was arrested in 2021 and after being released, he returned to using illegal drugs.

text: Suno kay Pagulayan, natyempohan nga subong man nga adlaw, Mayo 19 ang kaadlawan sini.
english: According to Pagulayan, it was timed to be his birthday on May 19.

text: Dugang diri, wala nagtul-id si Alyas Inday kun diin ang source sang illegal nga droga apang ang mga parokyano ukon customer niya mismo ang nagapadulong sa ila balay agud magbakal sang illegal nga droga.
english: In addition, Alyas Inday did not specify the source of the illegal drugs but her parishioners or customers themselves come to her house to buy illegal drugs.

text: Natigayon nga nakumpiskar ang 100 grams sang suspected shabu nga may Standard Drug Price nga Php 680,000.00.
english: Seized were 100 grams of suspected shabu with a Standard Drug Price of Php 680,000.00.

text: Sa subong, yara na ini sa kustodiya sang ICPS 4 kag nagapangatubang sang kaso nga paglapas sa RA 9165 ukon Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.
english: He is now in the custody of ICPS 4 and is facing charges of violation of RA 9165 or Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.

text: Nagahingyo ang Police Regional Office (PRO) 6 sang dugang nga pondo para sa Regional Anti-Cybercrime Unit (RACU) agud nga mapasangkad pa ang ila nga operasyon ilabi na subong nga mas abanse naman ang teknolohiya nga ginagamit sang mga suspek sa paghimo sang mga krimen.
english: The Police Regional Office (PRO) 6 is requesting additional funds for the Regional Anti-Cybercrime Unit (RACU) to expand their operations especially now that the technology used by suspects to commit crimes is more advanced.

text: Suno kay Police Brigadier General Jack Wanky, regional police director sang Western Visayas, apisar mahapos man para sa pulis nga ma-trace ang simple nga mga krimen kaangay sang scams, may iban nga pagpanghangkat nga ginaatubang ang law enforcers nga ma-crack down ang iban nga sistema sang mga suspek nga nagagamit sang advanced technologies.
english: Police Brigadier General Jack Wanky, regional police director of Western Visayas, said that although it is easy for the police to trace simple crimes such as scams, there are other challenges facing law enforcers to crack down on other systems of suspects using advanced technologies.

text: Pahayag ni Wanky, paagi sa dugang nga budget, mapauswag pa ang kapasidad sang RACU kag masolusyunan ini nga kakulangan sang mas madasig kag mas epektibo.
english: Wanky said that with the additional budget, the capacity of the RACU will be improved and this shortage will be addressed more quickly and effectively.

text: Gin-engganyo man sini ang publiko nga mag-report gilayon sa otoridad pananglitan may nahibaluan nga cybercrime incidents.
english: He also urged the public to immediately report any cybercrime incidents to the authorities.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa latest data sang opisina, may 218 ka mga insidente nga na-rekord sa first half subong nga tuig nga may 80 incidents ukon 26.8 percent nga pagnubo ipaanggid sa 298 incidents nga na-report sa amo man nga period sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: According to the latest data of the office, there were 218 incidents recorded in the first half of this year with 80 incidents or a 26.8 percent decrease compared to 298 incidents reported in the same period last year.

text: Sandig sa sini nga data, ang 10 sa nagapanguna nga cybercrimes sa rehiyon amo ang swindling/estafa (online scams); illegal access sa computer systems; online libel; ATM/credit card fraud; grave threats; computer related identity theft; unjust vexation; grave coercion; photo and video voyeurism; kag fraudulent access devices.
english: Based on this data, 10 of the top cybercrimes in the region are swindling/estafa (online scams); illegal access to computer systems; online libel; ATM/credit card fraud; grave threats; computer related identity theft; unjust vexation; serious coercion; photo and video voyeurism; and fraudulent access devices.

text: Magaatubangay na sa Game 1 sang NBA Finals ang Phoenix Suns kag ang Milwaukee Bucks sa Mierkules, Hulyo 7, ‘las 9:00 sa aga oras sa Pilipinas.
english: The Phoenix Suns and Milwaukee Bucks will face off in Game 1 of the NBA Finals on Wednesday, July 7, at 9:00 am Philippine time.

text: Ini ang labing-una nga tion halin sang 1974 nga nakaabante sa finals ang Bucks.
english: It was the first time since 1974 that the Bucks advanced to the finals.

text: Kahapon, Domingo nga adlaw, gintapos sang Bucks ang hampang batok sa Atlanta Hawks sa Game Six sang Eastern Conference Finals, 118-107.
english: Yesterday, Sunday, the Bucks finished off the Atlanta Hawks in Game Six of the Eastern Conference Finals, 118-107.

text: Nakuha sang team ang kadalag-an apisar wala nakahampang ang star forward nga si Giannis Antetokounmpo.
english: The team got the win despite the absence of star forward Giannis Antetokounmpo.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang Suns ang wala pa man nakaagi secure sang championship sa Finals kag ini na ang ila third all-time Finals appearance.
english: The Suns have never secured a championship in the Finals and this is their third all-time Finals appearance.

text: Wala man sang player halin sa duha ka nasambit nga team ang nakaagi daug sang NBA championship.
english: Neither player from the two teams has ever won an NBA championship.

text: UPOD kita sa hingyo sang mga kabataan nga ginapangunahan ni Greta Thunberg sang Sweden nga magdeklarar na sang Climate Emergency ang tanan nga mga pungsod.
english: WE ARE with the children's demand led by Sweden's Greta Thunberg for all countries to declare a Climate Emergency.

text: Ina tungod kay sa matuod naga-experyensya na gid man kita sang Climate Crisis.
english: That's because we're actually experiencing a Climate Crisis.

text: Sige-sige na lang ang paglala sang lakat sang panahon nga indi na malilong sang aton mga siyentipiko ang trahedya nga nagakatabo kag matabo pa sa aton planeta kag sa katauhan kon indi naton matagaan ini sing seryoso kag madasig nga aksyon.
english: The pace of time is getting worse and worse and our scientists can no longer hide the tragedy that is happening and will happen to our planet and humanity if we do not give it serious and urgent action.

text: Samtang, daw sa waay lang ini nga problema sa mga pulitiko nga ang tuyu amo lang ang pagdaug sa eleksyon sa ila pagtutok lang sa temporaryo nga mga problema sang mga botante kag wala sing patungod sa mas importante nga mga problema sa palaabuton bisan pa kon maguba na ang kalibutan buas.
english: Meanwhile, it seems that this is not a problem for politicians whose only goal is to win elections as they focus on the temporary problems of the voters and have no regard for the more important problems of the future even if the world collapses tomorrow.

text: Samtang man, sige lang isip sang kwarta ang mga negosyante sa ila ganansyahon halin sa fossil fuel (oil, natural gas kag coal) nga amo ang daku gid nga diyablo sang Climate Change.
english: Meanwhile, businessmen are always counting on the money they can make from fossil fuels (oil, natural gas and coal) which is the biggest devil of Climate Change.

text:
***

Sa karon nabatyagan na sa kalibutan ang pagluntad sang makahaladlok nga mga “climate extremes” nga wala pa matabo sa mga nagliligad nga tinuig.
english:
***

The world is now experiencing the occurrence of terrible climate extremes that have not occurred in recent years.

text: Katulad sang mas makahalalit nga mga bagyo, pagtaas sang taob sa baybayon, tagtuyot (drought), sobra-sobra nga pag-inulan kag pagbinaha, kag iban pa.
english: Such as more destructive typhoons, rising coastal tides, drought, excessive rainfall and flooding, and others.

text: Tuga ini sang Global Warming, ukon pagtaas sang init sang kalibutan nga dulot sang air pollution nga dala sang Greenhouse Gases (GHG), nga mayor diri ang carbon dioxide.
english: This is caused by Global Warming, or the increase in the Earth's temperature caused by air pollution caused by Greenhouse Gases (GHG), the main one being carbon dioxide.

text: Ginakulbaan na gani sang mga siyentipiko ang posible pagtaas sing 2 degrees Celsius pa sang kainit sang kalibutan, nga basi bangdan na ini sang “katapusan sang kalibutan”.
english: Scientists are even worried about a possible rise of another 2 degrees Celsius in global temperatures, which could lead to the “end of the world”.

text: Gani, dapat na kita magkabalaka sa pwede matabo sa aton planeta kag sa bug-os nga katauhan, labi na gid sa mga kabataan nga mabilin agud atubangon ini sa ila panahon nga wala na ang ila mga katigulangan.
english: Therefore, we should be concerned about what could happen to our planet and to all humanity, especially to the children who will be left to face it in their time without their ancestors.

text:
***

Nangin bisita si Greta sang mga lideres sang kalibutan sa ila pagtililipon sa United Nations sadtong 2018.
english:
***

Greta was a guest of world leaders at their meeting at the United Nations in 2018.

text: Gin-kritikar sini ang ila pagpabaya sa problema sang Climate Change nga, sa lugar aksyonan ini sing tuod-tuod, ginahampangan lang nila sa ila pagpamulitika.
english: He criticized their neglect of the problem of Climate Change that, instead of taking serious action, they are just playing with their politics.

text: Wala maluyagi sang iban ang pag-kritikar ni Greta kag gin-akusaran pa ini sang kon ano-ano, samtang sa matuod negosyo gihapon gali ang mayor nga unod sang ulo sang mga negosyante sa ila.
english: Others did not like Greta's criticism and accused her of something, while in fact business is still the main content of the businessmen's heads.

text: Partikular nga natublag ang United Kingdom Parliament kag gin-imbitar si Greta agud maghambal man sa ila atubangan.
english: The United Kingdom Parliament was particularly agitated and Greta was invited to speak before them as well.

text: Diri, liwat ginapanawagan ni Greta ang “urgency” nga atubangon na sing lubos ang problema sa Climate Change.
english: Here, Greta again calls for the “urgency” to address the problem of Climate Change.

text: Ginpabakud pa ini sang pag-broadcast ni David Attenborough sang iya documentary: “Climate Change: The Facts”, kag sang 11 ka adlaw nga protesta sang environmental group nga Extinction Rebellion nga naggamit sang “pink party boat” bilang stage sa ila tuman kagahod nga pag-rally sa London.
english: This was further reinforced by David Attenborough’s broadcast of his documentary: “Climate Change: The Facts”, and an 11-day protest by the environmental group Extinction Rebellion who used a “pink party boat” as a stage for their very noisy rally in London.

text: Tungod sini, nanguna na sa pag-deklarar sang Climate Emergency ang United Kingdom sadtong 2019.
english: As a result, the United Kingdom took the lead in declaring a Climate Emergency in 2019.

text: Ginsundan ini sang mga 38 pa ka mga pungsod, nga indi kalakip ang Filipinas bisan pa nagapanguna ini sa kalibutan sa mga “most vulnerable” kag “most risky” sa Climate Change.
english: This was followed by about 38 other countries, excluding the Philippines despite leading the world in the “most vulnerable” and “most risky” to Climate Change.

text:
***

Bilang katapo sang Paris Agreement, ang mga wala sing ikasarang nga mga pungsod, katulad sang Filipinas, makapaabot sing bulig nga “funding” kag “technological assistance” agud mapatuman ang obligasyon sang mga katapo nga mapanubo ang GHG emission sa 70% sugod sa 2030 tubtub 2050 kon san-o pwede ma-control ining dugang nga init sa 1.5o C, ukon bag-o malab-ut ang  2oC sa 2100.
english:
***

As members of the Paris Agreement, disadvantaged countries, such as the Philippines, can expect funding and technological assistance to implement the obligation of members to reduce GHG emissions by 70% from 2030 to 2050 when they can be controlled, in addition to the new 15 C-5. reach  2ºC by 2100.

text: Ugaling, halin pa sa panahon ni Presidente Duterte tubtub sa sining karon nga administrasyon, nagahulat kita gihapon sa sining ginapasalig nga bulig sang Paris Agreement.
english: However, from the time of President Duterte to the present administration, we are still waiting for this promised assistance of the Paris Agreement.

text: Sa amo sina nga kahimtangan, ano ayhan ang mahimo naton in the meantime?
english: In that case, what can we do in the meantime?

text: Naka-producir na kita sang renewable energy halin sa init sang adlaw (solar) kag hydropower kag sa iban pa nga padihot.
english: We have already produced renewable energy from solar and hydropower and other sources.

text: Ugaling malayo pa kita sa aton obligasyon sa Paris Agreement.
english: But we are still far from our obligations under the Paris Agreement.

text: Luas sa mahimo lang naton sa karon sa pag-mitigate kag pagpanagang sa impact sang Climate change, may isa ka bagay nga pwede mahimo man naton seguro.
english: In addition to what we can do now to mitigate and protect against the impact of climate change, there is one thing we can do.

text: Pasigehon anay ang mga fossil fuel-fed nga power plants agud magamit man ini sa paghatag elektrisidad sa pag-producir sang mga electric vehicles.
english: Fossil fuel-fed power plants should be continued so that they can also be used to provide electricity for the production of electric vehicles.

text: Anyway, manubo kag indi makatulublag pa man ang aton GHG emission.
english: Anyway, our GHG emission is still low and not worrying.

text: Paagi sini maibanan naton ang paggamit sang fossil fuel sa mga salakyan gamit ang e-vehicles.
english: With this we can reduce the use of fossil fuel in vehicles using e-vehicles.

text: Ginapatuman ini sa Norway, ang “EV Capital of the World”./PN
english: It is being implemented in Norway, the “EV Capital of the World”./PN

text: Na-obserbahan ni Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr.
english: Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr. observed.

text: nga nagaperform sang maayo si Police Colonel Bayani Razalan bilang Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) Director sugod sang nagpungko ini sang 2024.
english: that Police Colonel Bayani Razalan has been performing well as Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) Director since he took office in 2024.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Governor Defensor, iya ginkatingala ang gulpyada nga pag-relieve sa nasambit nga pulis.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Governor Defensor said he was surprised by the sudden relief of the policeman.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga nga ginarespeto niya ang nangin administrative order sang amo nga ahensya.
english: He also explained that he respects the administrative order of the agency.

text: Nagalaum man si Defensor nga kontani nga makaistorya siya kay Philippine National Police (PNP) chief General Rommel Marbil agud mahibaluan sini ang rason sang relieve order ni Razalan.
english: Defensor also hopes that he can talk to Philippine National Police (PNP) chief General Rommel Marbil so that he can know the reason for Razalan's relief order.

text: Gin-ako man sang gobernador nga wala sang ‘prior consultation’ sa iya ang amo nga tikang apang ginklaro man niya nga indi man gid ini kinahanglanon.
english: The governor also acknowledged that he had no prior consultation on the move but clarified that it was not necessary.

text: Suno kay Defensor, kon lantawon, isa ang IPPO sa may pinakamadamo nga nadagdag nga warrant of arrest sa bug-os nga pungsod.
english: According to Defensor, the IPPO has one of the highest number of warrants of arrest in the country.

text: Sang damlag lang, isa ka lola ang nagselebrar sang iya ika-106 nga kaadlawan sa isa ka retirement home sa Ohio.
english: Recently, a grandmother celebrated her 106th birthday at a retirement home in Ohio.

text: Ini amo si Florence Hackman.
english: This is Florence Hackman.

text: Ginpakigbahin ni Hackman nga masami siya nga malipayon kag mahiligon nga makig-abyan.
english: Hackman shared that he is usually upbeat and eager to make friends.

text: Gintuad man niya nga adlaw-adlaw siya nga nagainom sang whiskey kag suno sa iya, isa ini sa nagapalawig sang iya kabuhi.
english: He also confessed that he drinks whiskey every day and says it is one of the things that prolongs his life.

text: Nagsaka na sa 34 ang patay sa landslide sa West Java province sa Indonesia.
english: The death toll from a landslide in Indonesia's West Java province has risen to 34.

text: Natabo ini sa residential area sa Bandung Barat region bangud sa madamol nga ulan sang weekend.
english: It happened in the residential area in Bandung Barat region due to heavy rains over the weekend.

text: Masobra 30 ka balay ang nalubong bangud sa pagkatiphag sang duta.
english: More than 30 houses were buried by the landslide.

text: Suno naman sa Indonesia Navy, lakip sa na-trap sa area amo ang 23 ka Navy Officers.
english: According to the Indonesian Navy, among those trapped in the area are 23 Navy Officers.

text: Nagapatigayon sila sang border patrol training sang natabo ang landslide.
english: They were conducting border patrol training when the landslide occurred.

text: Problemado man subong ang mga opisyal bangud indi makaabot ang heavy equipment sa disaster zone bangud sa malain nga tyempo.
english: Officials are also facing problems because heavy equipment cannot reach the disaster zone due to bad weather.

text: Natabo ini nga trahedya duha ka bulan matapos nga nagdala man sang landslides kag pagbaha ang bagyo sa Sumatra nga nagpatay sa 1,200 ka mga tawo.
english: The tragedy came two months after a typhoon also brought landslides and flooding to Sumatra that killed 1,200 people.

text: ILOILO CITY- Ang tambo ukon bamboo shoots manggaranon sa dietary fiber, low in calories, kag power-packed sang essential nutrients.
english: ILOILO CITY- Bamboo shoots are rich in dietary fiber, low in calories, and power-packed with essential nutrients.

text: Suno sa pagtuon sang Comprehensive Reviews in Food Science and Food Safety,bugana ini sa protein, carbohydrates, amino acids, minerals, fats, sugars, fibers, kag inorganic salts.
english: According to a study by Comprehensive Reviews in Food Science and Food Safety,it is rich in protein, carbohydrates, amino acids, minerals, fats, sugars, fibers, and inorganic salts.

text: Suno sa pila ka research, ang phytosterols kag phytonutrients sa tambo ang ideal sa pagtunaw sang harmful LDL cholesterol sa lawas.
english: According to some research, the phytosterols and phytonutrients in reeds are ideal for dissolving harmful LDL cholesterol in the body.

text: Ang vitamins kag minerals sa bamboo shoots ang ideal para sa pag- improve sang immune system sang lawas.
english: The vitamins and minerals in bamboo shoots are ideal for improving the body's immune system.

text: Ang antioxidants sa tambo ang essential man sa pagpabaskog sa sulod kag gwa sang lawas.
english: The antioxidants in bamboo are also essential for strengthening the body inside and out.

text: Suno naman sa research sa Journal of Ethnopharmacology,ang bamboo shoots may yara sang anti-inflammatory kag analgesic (pain-killing) properties.
english: According to research in the Journal of Ethnopharmacology, bamboo shoots have anti-inflammatory and analgesic (pain-killing) properties.

text: ILOILO CITY-Gin-anunsyo sang aktor kag high-profile Democratic activist nga si George Clooney ang suporta sini kay Vice President Kamala Harris para magbulos kay President Joe Biden bilang flag bearer sang Democrats batok kay Donald Trump sa eleksyon sa Nobyembre.
english: ILOILO CITY-Actor and high-profile Democratic activist George Clooney announced his support for Vice President Kamala Harris to replace President Joe Biden as the flag bearer of the Democrats against Donald Trump in the November election.

text: Si Clooney ang isa sa pinakauna nga Democratic activists nga nagpanawagan kay Biden nga indi na magpa-reelect.
english: Clooney was among the first Democratic activists to call on Biden not to seek reelection.

text: Kadungan sang pagpahayag sang suporta kay Harris, gindayaw man sini si Biden bangud sa pagpakita sang matuod-tuod nga liderato kag pagsalbar sang demokrasya.
english: Along with expressing support for Harris, he also praised Biden for showing real leadership and saving democracy.

text: Si Clooney nga isa ka major fundraiser para sa Democratic candidates kag longtime Biden booster, ang nagpangabay sa 81-anyos nga president nga magpaiway para sa mas bataon nga kandidato agud may tsansa sila nga mapierde si Trump sa Nobyembre.
english: Clooney, a major fundraiser for Democratic candidates and longtime Biden booster, has asked the 81-year-old president to step aside for a younger candidate so they have a chance to defeat Trump in November.

text: Kasunod naman sang pag-atras sang presidente, nangin matunog ang pangalan ni Harris agud magtal-os kay Biden sa pagka-presidente.
english: Following the president's withdrawal, Harris' name became popular to succeed Biden as president.

text: Naglupad na padulong sa Los Angeles, California sa Estados Unidos si eight-division world champion Manny Pacquiao.
english: Eight-division world champion Manny Pacquiao has flown to Los Angeles, California in the United States.

text: Nag-umpisa sang training si Pacquiao sa General Santos City kag ang final phase sang iya pagpanghanda para sa “blockbuster encounter” batuk kay American boxer Errol Spence ang hiwaton sa Hulyo 6 sa Wild Card Boxing Club sa Hollywood.
english: Pacquiao started training in General Santos City and the final phase of his preparation for the blockbuster encounter against American boxer Errol Spence will be held on July 6 at the Wild Card Boxing Club in Hollywood.

text: Nagalaum ang fighting senator nga makuha niya ang World Boxing Council kag International Boxing Federation bantamweight sa Agusto 21.
english: The fighting senator hopes to win the World Boxing Council and International Boxing Federation bantamweight on August 21.

text: Suno kay Pacquiao, indi niya mapat-od kun bala ini na ang iya mangin katapusan nga hampang ukon mahimo pa ini nga masundan.
english: Pacquiao said he is not sure if this will be his last fight or if it could be followed.

text: Nahibaluan nga sang 2019, nalutos man ni Pacquiao si American boxer Keith Thurman pinaagi sa unanimous decision sa diin ginkilala ang Filipino boxer nga “oldest welterweight champion” sa edad nga 40 anyos sang amo nga tion.
english: In 2019, Pacquiao also defeated American boxer Keith Thurman by unanimous decision where the Filipino boxer was recognized as the “oldest welterweight champion” at the age of 40 at the time.

text: ILOILO CITY-Kumbinsido sang pamilya sang ginpatay nga si former Punong Barangay Ernie Poral sang Ingore, La Paz nga ginsugo lang si Nilo Guardaya, ang suspek sa pagpatay sa anay opisyal.
english: ILOILO CITY-The family of the murdered former Punong Barangay Ernie Poral of Ingore, La Paz is convinced that Nilo Guardaya, the suspect in the murder of the former official, was ordered.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Edwin Poral, utod sang biktima, iya ginpahayag nga napat-ud nila nga indi kilalahay kag indi kontrahanay ang iya utod kag si Guardaya.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Edwin Poral, the victim's brother, said they were sure that his brother and Guardaya did not know each other.

text: Suno kay Poral, indi basta-basta ang tawo nga ila ginapatihan nga amo ang nagsugo agud ipapatay ang iya manghod.
english: According to Poral, the person they believe ordered the killing of his brother was not a random person.

text: Suno sa iya, posible nga ang personalidad sang utod nga nagapanindugan sa prinsipyo ang rason kun ngaa ginpapatay ini.
english: He said it is possible that the brother's principled personality was the reason why he was killed.

text: Nahibaluan nga may isa ka proyekto sa Ingore nga ginapamatukan sang anay punong barangay apang wala nila ginakumpirmar nga may kaangtanan gid man ini sa natabo sa anay punong barangay.
english: It is learned that there is a project in Ingore that is opposed by the former barangay captain but they do not confirm that it is related to what happened to the former barangay captain.

text: Natapos na ang tyansa sang Gilas Pilipinas para makahampang sa Tokyo Olympics.
english: Gilas Pilipinas' chance to play in the Tokyo Olympics is over.

text: Ini matapos nga ginpyerde sila sang Dominican Republic sa score nga 94-67 sa FIBA Olympic Qualifying Tournament nga ginhiwat sa Belgrade, Serbia.
english: This was after the Dominican Republic defeated them 94-67 in the FIBA ​​Olympic Qualifying Tournament held in Belgrade, Serbia.

text: Nabudlayan ang Gilas sa ila nga opensa sa diin humalin sang umpisa sang hampang, wala na sila nakaabanse pa sa team.
english: The Gilas struggled with their offense and since the beginning of the game, they have not been ahead of the team.

text: Wala napuslan ang 16 points kag tatlo ka assists ni Jordan Heading samtang 10 points naman kag anom ka rebounds ang nahatag ni Angelo Kouame.
english: Jordan Heading had 16 points and three assists while Angelo Kouame had 10 points and six rebounds.

text: Una na nga napaslawan ang Gilas sa Serbia sa score nga 76-83.
english: The Gilas had previously lost to Serbia with a score of 76-83.

text: Nautdan gid sang kamot ang isa ka 64-anyos nga iloy matapos ginlabo sang iya nagmaoy nga anak sa San Manuel, Pangasinan.
english: A 64-year-old mother lost her hand after being stabbed by her son in San Manuel, Pangasinan.

text: Suno sa pulis, isa ka residente man ang pilason sang nagtuyo ng punggan ang nagahurumintado nga suspek.
english: According to police, a resident was also injured when he tried to stop the suspect.

text: Nakit-an naman ang nautod nga kamot sang iloy sa idalom sang ila nga lamesa.
english: The mother's severed hand was found under their table.

text: Nagpalagyo ang suspek matapos ang pagpanglabo apang sang ulihi, nagsungka man.
english: The suspect fled the scene after the stabbing but later surrendered.

text: Wala pa mahibaluan ang rason kun ngaa nahimo sang anak ang amo nga akto.
english: The reason why the son committed the act is still unknown.

text: Sa inisyal nga pag-istorya sang otoridad sa suspek, ginsiling sini nga may yara sang tawo nga luyag magpatay sa iya.
english: In initial contact with the suspect, he said that someone wanted to kill him.

text: Nagapangatubang sang nagakaigo nga reklamo ang suspek samtang padayon nga ginabulong sa ospital ang iya nga iloy.
english: The suspect is facing appropriate charges while his mother is undergoing treatment at the hospital.

text: ILOILO CITY-Nagsaka pa sa 157 ang numero sang patay sa duha ka landslides sa southern Ethiopia.
english: ILOILO CITY-The death toll from two landslides in southern Ethiopia has risen to 157.

text: Ang landslide naglubong sang buhi sa mga tawo sa Gofa zone sa Southern Ethiopia regional state, nga ginsundan sang pagkatiphag sang duta sa amo man nga area kun sa diin natampukan ang mga tawo nga yara sa lugar agud kuntani magbulig sa rescue operation.
english: The landslide buried people alive in the Gofa zone of Southern Ethiopia regional state, followed by a landslide in the same area where people who were in the area gathered to help in the rescue operation.

text: Suno kay Markos Melese, head sang National Disaster Response agency sa Gofa Zone,padayon ang pagpangita sa mga lawas sa pihak sang tuman ka budlay nga sitwasyon sa lugar.
english: According to Markos Melese, head of the National Disaster Response agency in Gofa Zone, the search for the bodies continues despite the very difficult situation in the area.

text: Pila sa mga napatay ang kabataan kag may yara pa sang police officers.
english: Some of the dead were children and police officers.

text: Ginpatpat sang Schools Division of Iloilo ang importansya ang bag-o lang ginpirmahan ni President Ferdinand Bongbong Marcosang Republic Act No.
english: The Schools Division of Iloilo stressed the importance of the recently signed Republic Act No.

text: 12199 ukon ang “Early Childhood Care and Development System Act”.
english: 12199 or the “Early Childhood Care and Development System Act”.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Nestor Paul Pingil, Chief Education Supervisor Curriculum Implementation Division sang Schools Division of Iloilo, iya ginpahayag nga ang programa ang magahatag sang prayoridad sa temprano nga edukasyon, nagakaigo nga nutrisyon, kag suporta agud ang mga kabataan nga Pilipino may maayo kag mabakod nga pagsugod sa kabuhi.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Nestor Paul Pingil, Chief Education Supervisor Curriculum Implementation Division of the Schools Division of Iloilo, said the program will give priority to early education, proper nutrition, and support so that Filipino children have a good and strong start in life.

text: Suno kay Pingil, ang ECCD System Act isa sa mga yabi nga tikang nga ginarekomendar sang Second Congressional Commission on Education (EDCOM 2) agud mapasanyog ang sistema sang edukasyon sa pungsod kag mapanindugan ang mga kinamatarong sang tagsa ka kabataan.
english: According to Pingil, the ECCD System Act is one of the key measures recommended by the Second Congressional Commission on Education (EDCOM 2) to improve the education system in the country and uphold the rights of every child.

text: Gin-repeal sini ang RA No.
english: It repealed RA No.

text:
10410 ukon ang “Early Years Act (EYA) sang 2013.”

Ini nagatuyo sa pagpanubo sang child mortality, pagsuporta sa child development, paghanda sang kabataan para sa pormal nga pag-eskwela, kag pagtukod sang mga sistema sang early intervention para sa mga bata nga may pinasahi nga mga kinahanglanon.
english:
10410 or the “Early Years Act (EYA) of 2013.”

It aims to reduce child mortality, support child development, prepare children for formal schooling, and establish early intervention systems for children with special needs.

text:
(SCHOOL)

Sa pagpirma sini nga laye, tuyo sang gobyerno nga mapauswag ang kaayuhan kag potensyal sang mga kabataan nga Pilipino sa tion sang ila mga formative years.
english:
(SCHOOL)

By signing this law, the government aims to enhance the well-being and potential of Filipino children during their formative years.

text: Mataas gihapon ang pagsalig ni Vice President Sara Duterte kay Atty. Nicolas Kaufman nga amo ang naga-uyat sang kaso sang iya amay nga si anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte sa International Criminal Court (ICC).
english: Vice President Sara Duterte still has high confidence in Atty. Nicolas Kaufman who is handling the case of his father, former President Rodrigo Duterte, at the International Criminal Court (ICC).

text: Suno sa iya, si Kaufman ang ginpili mismo sang anay presidente, gani importante nga magsalig sa iya.
english: He said Kaufman was handpicked by the former president himself, so it was important to trust him.

text: Magakooperar sila kag magasunod sa kon ano man ang kinahanglanon sang legal team.
english: They will cooperate and comply with whatever the legal team needs.

text: Ginhimo sang Bise Presidente ang pahayag sa palaabuton nga kumpirmasyon sang panumbungon sang ICC batuk kay Duterte sa Setyembre 23.
english: The Vice President made the statement on the upcoming confirmation of the ICC's indictment against Duterte on September 23.

text: Inanunsyo ni Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese na kikilalanin na ng Australia ang estado ng Palestine sa darating na sesyon ng United Nations (UN) General Assembly sa Setyembre 2025.
english: Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has announced that Australia will recognize the state of Palestine at the next session of the United Nations (UN) General Assembly in September 2025.

text: Ayon kay Albanese, ang desisyon ay isinagawa matapos makuha ng Australia ang mga pangako mula sa Palestinian Authority, kabilang ang demilitarisasyon, pagdaraos ng halalan, at patuloy na pagkilala sa Israel sa rehiyon.
english: According to Albanese, the decision was made after Australia obtained commitments from the Palestinian Authority, including demilitarization, holding elections, and continued recognition of Israel in the region.

text: “It is humanity’s best hope,” ani Albanese, kaugnay ng two-state solution para sa kapayapaan sa Middle East.
english: “It is humanity’s best hope,” Albanese said, regarding the two-state solution for peace in the Middle East.

text: Ginawa ang pahayag kasunod ng pag-uusap sa mga lider mula sa UK, France, New Zealand, at Japan.
english: The statement was made following talks with leaders from the UK, France, New Zealand, and Japan.

text: Mariing tinutulan ng Israel ang hakbang, at sinabing ito ay reward sa mga terorista, lalo na’t patuloy pa rin ang opensiba nito laban sa Hamas sa Gaza, kung saan mahigit 61,000 katao na ang naiulat na nasawi mula noong 2023 ayon sa Hamas-run health ministry.
english: Israel has strongly opposed the move, saying it is a reward for terrorists, especially as it continues its offensive against Hamas in Gaza, where more than 61,000 people have been reported dead since 2023 according to the Hamas-run health ministry.

text: Sa kabilang banda, sinabi naman ng Palestinian Authority na ang pagkilala ng mga bansa ay patunay ng lumalawak na suporta para sa karapatan ng mga Palestino para mag pasya.
english: On the other hand, the Palestinian Authority said that the recognition of the countries is proof of widespread support for the right of Palestinians to self-determination.

text: Dagdag pa rito tiniyak pa ni Albanese na hindi nito bibigyan ng papel ang Hamas sa para pang himasukan ang Palestine.
english: Albanese also assured that he will not give Hamas a role in fighting for Palestine.

text: Samantala, nanindigan naman ang Estados Unidos na hindi nito kikilalanin ang estado ng Palestine sa ngayon, dahil umano sa kawalan ng epektibong pamahalaan.
english: Meanwhile, the United States has insisted that it will not recognize the current Palestinian state, due to the lack of an effective government.

text:
Binatikos naman ni Israeli PM Benjamin Netanyahu ang Australia at mga bansa sa Europa sa kanilang hakbang, na tinawag niyang “shameful.”

Sa kasalukuyan, 147 mga bansa sa 193 miyembro ng UN ang kumikilala sa estado ng Palestine, na may “permanent observer state” status sa organisasyon.
english:
Israeli PM Benjamin Netanyahu criticized Australia and European countries for their move, which he called “shameful.”

Currently, 147 of the 193 UN member states recognize the state of Palestine, with permanent observer state status in the organization.

text: ILOILO CITY- Patay ang isa ka babaye matapos ini gintiro sa nawong sang iya live-in partner nga pulis sa Davao City.
english: ILOILO CITY – A woman was shot dead in the face by her live-in partner, a policeman, in Davao City.

text: Ginkilala ang biktima nga si Justine Villaroja, residente sang Brgy.
english: The victim was identified as Justine Villaroja, resident of Brgy.

text: Buhangin sa amo nga syudad.
english: Sand in that city.

text: Ang suspek amo si Patrolman Alvin John Tayamin nga assigned sa Mandug Police Station sa Davao City Police Office apang tumandok sang Kidapawan City,Cotabato Province.
english: The suspect was identified as Patrolman Alvin John Tayamin assigned to the Mandug Police Station in Davao City Police Office but a native of Kidapawan City, Cotabato Province.

text: Sa imbestigasyon, nagainom ang biktima kag suspek sa Barangay Indangan sang nagbaisay ang mga ini bangud sa pagpangimon.
english: According to the investigation, the victim and the suspect were drinking in Barangay Indangan when they had an argument over jealousy.

text: Didto na ginkuha sang suspek ang iya service firearm kag ginluthang ang biktima.
english: The suspect then took out his service firearm and shot the victim.

text: Nagsungka naman ang suspek kag mangatubang sang nagakaigo nga kaso.
english: The suspect surrendered and will face appropriate charges.

text: Pilason ang driver sang tricycle matapos madalasa sang pick up nga may karga nga isda sa Brgy.
english: A tricycle driver was injured after being hit by a pick up loaded with fish in Brgy.

text: Agtambo, Passi City, Iloilo.
english: Agtambo, Passi City, Iloilo.

text: Ang biktima amo si Alyas Roque, 59-anyos, samtang ang driver sang pick up amo si Alyas Rino, 48-anyos, kasado kag residente sang Brgy.
english: The victim was identified as Roque, 59, while the driver of the pick up was identified as Rino, 48, married and resident of Brgy.

text: Dayao, Roxas City.
english: Dayao, Roxas City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Master Sergeant John Hersly Fajardo, Imbestigador sang Passi City Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga halin sa Roxas City ang pick up kag madeliver kuntani sang isda sa Passi City kag Calinog.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Master Sergeant John Hersly Fajardo, Investigator of Passi City Police Station, said the pick up was from Roxas City and was supposed to deliver fish to Passi City and Calinog.

text: Base imbestigasyon sang kapulisan, may salakyan sa atubang sang pick up samtang nagapalapit ini sa intersection kag mapundo ini kuntani apang wala nagkagat ang preno kag nadulaan sang control rason nga nasalapay ang duha ka nagaparking nga tricycle sa kilid lakip na ang biktima nga gatindog.
english: According to police investigation, there was a vehicle in front of the pick up while it was approaching the intersection and it was about to stop but did not bite the brakes and lost control causing the two parked tricycles on the side including the victim who was standing.

text: Nakaagum ang driver sang tricycle sang menor nga kapilasan sa nagkalain-lain nga parte sang iya lawas, gindala ini sa ospital kag gilayon ma nga nakagwa.
english: The driver of the tricycle sustained minor injuries in various parts of his body, was taken to the hospital and was immediately discharged.

text: Ginsabat naman sang driver sang pick up ang pagpabulong sa driver sang tricycle.
english: The driver of the pick up responded by treating the driver of the tricycle.

text: Text by: Bombo Pauline Pillora
english: Text by: Bombo Pauline Pillora

text: Napaslawan ang Gilas Pilipinas sa Serbia sa score nga 76-83 sa FIBA Olympic Qualifying Tournament nga ginhiwat sa Belgrade, Serbia.
english: Gilas Pilipinas lost to Serbia 76-83 in the FIBA ​​Olympic Qualifying Tournament held in Belgrade, Serbia.

text: Wala naglayo ang abanse sang Serbia sa hampang sa diin nagpatas pa ang scores sang duha ka team sa ika-tatlo nga quarter.
english: Serbia's lead did not go far in the game where the scores of the two teams were equal in the third quarter.

text:
Una nga ginpyerde sang Serbia ang Dominican Republic sa score nga 94-74 sa Group A sa diin sigurado na ang ila nga pwesto sa semifinals kaupod ang Italy, Puerto Rico kag Sengal sa Group B.

Sunod naman nga makasambuwa sang Gilas Pilipinas ang Dominican Republic.
english:
Serbia first defeated the Dominican Republic 94-74 in Group A to secure their place in the semifinals alongside Italy, Puerto Rico and Senegal in Group B.

The Dominican Republic will next face Gilas Pilipinas.

text: Mangin prayoridad sang National Economic and Development Authority (NEDA) ang pagpasangkad sang social security kag pagpauswag sang edukasyon sa human development sa sulod sang masunod nga duha ka tuig.
english: The National Economic and Development Authority (NEDA) will prioritize expanding social security and improving human development education over the next two years.

text:
Suno kay Acting Socioeconomic Planning Secretary Karl Chua, sa idalom sang Updated Philippine Development

Plan 2017-2022, hugot nga tutukan ang pagpasanyog sang Universal Health Care Act, kalidad sang edukasyon kag workforce.
english:
According to Acting Socioeconomic Planning Secretary Karl Chua, under the Updated Philippine Development

Plan 2017-2022, strongly focus on promoting the Universal Health Care Act, quality of education and workforce.

text: Ginhatagan man sang igtalupangod ang pagbalay sang Social Protection Floor nga amo ang nagahatag sang basic nga lebel sang seguridad sang income pinaagi sa mahapos nga transfer kag access sa kinahanglanon nga mga serbisyo.
english: Attention was also given to the construction of the Social Protection Floor which provides a basic level of income security through easy transfer and access to essential services.

text: Ang Updated Philippine Development Plan ang igalunsyar sa bulan sang Pebrero.
english: The Updated Philippine Development Plan will be launched in February.

text: Diri man nalakip ang reporma kag mga stratehiya agud mapadasig ang paglab-ot sang Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
english: It also includes reform and strategies to accelerate the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

text: Ginkasubo ni eight division world champion Manny Pacquiao ang nangin tikang sang Paradigm Sports nga pagpasaka sang kaso sa iya bangud sa ginapahayag breach of contract.
english: Eight division world champion Manny Pacquiao regretted Paradigm Sports' decision to file a lawsuit against him for alleged breach of contract.

text: Suno kay Pacquiao, wala sang merito ang kaso batuk sa iya kag luyag lamang nga gub-on ang iya konsentrasyon sa pagpanghanda sa iya palaabuton nga away batuk kay American undefeated champion Errol Spence.
english: According to Pacquiao, the case against him has no merit and only wants to break his concentration in preparing for his upcoming fight against American undefeated champion Errol Spence.

text: Pahayag sang fighing senator, base sa iya kontra sa Paradigm Sports, may yara siya sang kinamatarong nga magsulod sa agreement kag atubangon si Spence.
english: The fighting senator said, based on his opponent in Paradigm Sports, he has the right to enter into an agreement and face Spence.

text: Ginasiguro ni Pacquiao sa iya mga fans nga wala sang dapat kabalak-an bangud indi ini makaapekto sa iya nga away.
english: Pacquiao assures his fans that there is nothing to worry about because it will not affect his fight.

text: ILOILO CITY-Amat- amat na nga naganubo ang numero sang ginaihaw nga baboy sa Iloilo City Slaughterhouse.
english: ILOILO CITY-The number of pigs slaughtered at the Iloilo City Slaughterhouse is slowly decreasing.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Simplicio Subaldo, Executive Assistant for Local Economic Enterprise, iya ginpahayag nga nabudlayan na mangita ang mga supplier nga nagadala sang baboy nga amo ang ginaihaw sa slaughter house.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Simplicio Subaldo, Executive Assistant for Local Economic Enterprise, said it is difficult to find suppliers who bring pigs that are slaughtered at the slaughter house.

text: Suno kay Subaldo, kon sadto, indi magnubo sa 300 ka mga baboy ang ginaihaw sa isa ka adlaw apang subong, yara na lang ini sa 260 tubtob 270.
english: According to Subaldo, in the past, at least 300 pigs were slaughtered a day but now, it is only 260 to 270 pigs.

text: Pahayag ni Subaldo, ini ang resulta sang pagsuplay sang Iloilo sang baboy sa iban nga rehiyon kon sa diin indi naman mahimo nga magpasulod sang baboy gikan sa iban nga rehiyon bangod sa pagpamahog sang African Swine Fever.
english: Subaldo said this is the result of Iloilo's supply of pigs to other regions where it is not possible to import pigs from other regions due to the threat of African Swine Fever.

text: Dugang ni Subaldo, mas ginapili sang mga nagasagod sang baboy nga ibaligya ang ila sapat sa mga manugbakal sang baboy agud i-supply sa iban nga rehiyon bangud sa mas mahal nga presyo kag mas dako ang ila maginansya kun ipaanggid sa presyuhanay sa Iloilo.
english: Subaldo added that pig farmers prefer to sell their animals to pig buyers to supply to other regions because of the higher price and higher profits compared to the price in Iloilo.

text: Nagpangabay naman ini nga kon mahimo, untaton anay ang pagsuplay sang baboy sa gwa sang rehiyon 6 agud indi man maapektuhan ang suplay sa Western Visayas.
english: He requested that if possible, stop the supply of pigs outside Region 6 so that the supply in Western Visayas will not be affected.

text: Nalakip si Gilas Pilipinas star Dwight Ramos sa mga ginakabig must-watch players sa palaabuton nga FIBA Olympic Qualifying Tournament sa Belgrade, Serbia.
english: Gilas Pilipinas star Dwight Ramos is among the must-watch players in the upcoming FIBA ​​Olympic Qualifying Tournament in Belgrade, Serbia.

text: Ang pagkilala ang nakuha ni Ramos matapos ang iya dalayawon nga performance sa third and final window sang FIBA Asia Cup 2021 qualifiers sa Clark, Pampanga.
english: Ramos earned the recognition after his impressive performance in the third and final window of the FIBA ​​Asia Cup 2021 qualifiers in Clark, Pampanga.

text: Sa duha ka hampang batok sa South Korea kag isa batok sa Indonesia, may average ang 22-anyos nga si Ramos nga 15 points, 6.7 rebounds, 2.3 steals, kag two assists per contest.
english: In two games against South Korea and one against Indonesia, the 22-year-old Ramos averaged 15 points, 6.7 rebounds, 2.3 steals, and two assists per contest.

text: Sa website sang FIBA, ginpahayag nga ‘go-to guy in the new Gilas generation’ si Ramos.
english: On the FIBA ​​website, Ramos is said to be the ‘go-to guy in the new Gilas generation’.

text: “He is the go-to guy in the new Gilas generation, which is still on a mission to find a new leader after legendary Andray Blatche.
english: “He is the go-to guy in the new Gilas generation, which is still on a mission to find a new leader after legendary Andray Blatche.

text:
Dwight’s numbers and games in the Fiba Asia Cup qualifiers show that he is on a good way to follow the path blazed by his countrymate.”

Balantayan si Ramos kag anga Gilas team sa hampang batok sa Serbia kag Dominican Republic.Una na nga ginpahayag ni Gilas Pilipinas coach Tab Baldwin nga may “major concern” kaangot kay Ramos bangud wala pa ini naka-recover gikan sa groin injury.
english:
Dwight’s numbers and games in the Fiba Asia Cup qualifiers show that he is on a good way to follow the path blazed by his countrymate.”

Ramos and the Gilas team will be watched for the matches against Serbia and the Dominican Republic. Earlier, Gilas Pilipinas coach Tab Baldwin said there is a “major concern” regarding Ramos as he has not yet recovered from his groin injury.

text: Magluwas kay Ramos, ang nakitaan pa sang FIBA sang potensyal amo si Vasilije Micic sang Serbia, ang Most Valuable Player sang Euroleague.
english: Besides Ramos, FIBA ​​also saw potential in Serbia's Vasilije Micic, the Euroleague's Most Valuable Player.

text: Nagpakita sa publiko si US Vice President Kamala Harris sa labing-una nga tion halin sang gin-endorso ini ni President Joe Biden nga mangin kandidato sang Democratic Party para sa 2024 presidential elections.
english: Nagpakita sa publiko si US Vice President Kamala Harris sa labing-una nga tion halin sang gin-endorso ini ni President Joe Biden nga mangin kandidato sang Democratic Party para sa 2024 presidential elections.

text: Ini kasunod man sang pagkumpirma sang 81-anyos nga Democrat leader nga indi na ini magpadayon sa presidential race subong nga tuig kag suportado sini si Harris nga amo ang magatiglawas sang ila partido para magbunggo kay anay President Donald Trump nga amo naman ang kandidato sang Republicans.
english: This follows the 81-year-old Democrat leader's confirmation that he will not continue in the presidential race this year and that he supports Harris, who will represent his party to face former President Donald Trump, who is also the Republican candidate.

text: Sa iya nga speech sa White House agud pasidunggan ang college athletes, gindayaw ni Harris si Biden kag ang mga hinimuan sini sa sulod sang iya apat ka tuig nga termino.
english: In her speech at the White House to honor the college athletes, Harris praised Biden and his accomplishments during his four-year term.

text: “Joe Biden’s legacy over the last three years is unmatched in modern history,” pahayag sini.
english: “Joe Biden’s legacy over the last three years is unmatched in modern history,” it said.

text:
“Every day, our president, Joe Biden, fights for the American people and we are deeply, deeply grateful for his service to our nation.”

Wala pa ginpakilala ni Harris ang iya kaugalingon bilang nagapanguna nga Democratic presidential candidate sa pagka-presidente.
english:
“Every day, our president, Joe Biden, fights for the American people and we are deeply, deeply grateful for his service to our nation.”

Harris has yet to establish herself as the leading Democratic presidential candidate.

text: Ang pinakaulihi nga nag-endorso sa iya amo mismo si U.S. Representative Nancy Pelosi, anay House speaker kag isa ka influential voice sa Democratic Party.
english: The latest to endorse him is U.S. Representative Nancy Pelosi herself, former House speaker and an influential voice in the Democratic Party.

text: Sunod man nga nagbisita ang bise-presidente sa Delaware agud bisitahon ang Biden campaign headquarters nga amo subong ang nagaserbe nga iya main campaign office.
english: The vice president also visited Delaware to visit the Biden campaign headquarters which now serves as his main campaign office.

text: Ang iban pa nga ginalantaw nga challengers sa posible nga kandidatura ni Harris amo sanday Michigan Governor Gretchen Whitmer, California Governor Gavin Newsom kag Kentucky Governor Andy Beshear.
english: Other perceived challengers to Harris’ potential candidacy include Michigan Governor Gretchen Whitmer, California Governor Gavin Newsom and Kentucky Governor Andy Beshear.

text: Nagpadayon si anay US President Donald Trump sa paglaslas kay President Joe Biden apisar nga nag-atras na ang Democrat leader sa reelection campaign sini subong nga 2024.
english: Former US President Donald Trump continued to criticize President Joe Biden despite the Democrat leader's withdrawal from his reelection campaign in 2024.

english: Following Biden's confirmation that he will withdraw from the presidential race, Trump also issued a statement on Truth Social in which he called Biden the "worst president" in the history of the country.

text:

“All those around him, including his Doctor and the Media, knew that he wasn’t capable of being President, and he wasn’t.”

english:

text: Gin-endorso man sini si Vice President Kamala Harris nga amo ang mangin kandidato sang Democrats.
english: He also endorsed Vice President Kamala Harris as the Democrats' nominee.
