english: This follows the world's poor performance in the presidential debate against former US President Donald Trump last month.

text: Sa amo nga debate nga naglawig sang 90 minutos, madumduman nga nagakalipat na si Biden sa mga inughambal sini kag masami nga wala na sang isugpon sa iya statement rason nga madamo nga nagapati nga maluya na ang estado ni Biden para patiniron pa sa White House sa masunod nga apat ka tuig.#
english: During the 90-minute debate, Biden forgot his words and often had nothing to add to his statement, leading many to believe that Biden's state was too weak to keep him in the White House for the next four years.

text: Nagtapos sa 79-79 draw ang tune-up games sang Gilas Pilipinas kag China nga ginhiwat sa Angeles City University Foundation Gym sa Pampanga.
english: The tune-up games between Gilas Pilipinas and China held at the Angeles City University Foundation Gym in Pampanga ended in a 79-79 draw.

text: Ginpangunahan ni Kai Sotto ang national basketball team nga may yara sang 13 points.
english: Kai Sotto led the national basketball team with 13 points.

text: May yara man sang tag-12 points sanday Ange Kouame kag Jordan Heading samtang 9 points naman si RJ Abarrientos.
english: Ange Kouame and Jordan Heading also had 12 points each while RJ Abarrientos had 9 points.

text: Ginpatigayon sang China kag Pilipinas ang tune-up games bilang pagpanghanda para sa FIBA Olympic Qualifying Tournament nga hiwaton sa Serbia.
english: China and the Philippines held tune-up games in preparation for the FIBA ​​Olympic Qualifying Tournament to be held in Serbia.

text: Una na diri, nangin madinalag-on ang Gilas sa bag-o lang natapos nga FIBA Asia Cup Qualifiers sang ginlutos sang makaduha ka beses ang South Korea kg Indonesia.
english: Earlier, the Gilas were successful in the recently concluded FIBA ​​Asia Cup Qualifiers by beating South Korea and Indonesia twice.

text: Gin-ugyunan ni Gilas Pilipinas coach Tab Baldwin ang komento ni Indonesia coach Rajko Toroman may kaangtanan sa Gilas player nga si Dwight Ramos.
english: Gilas Pilipinas coach Tab Baldwin agreed with Indonesia coach Rajko Toroman's comments regarding Gilas player Dwight Ramos.

text: ‘Revelation’ kun kabigon si Ramos bangud sang iya nangin impressive performances sa 2021 Fiba Asia Cup Qualifiers.
english: Ramos is a 'revelation' for his impressive performances in the 2021 Fiba Asia Cup Qualifiers.

text: Ginpaanggid man ang Gilas star sa European basketball players bangud sang iya size, toughness, kag shooting ability.
english: The Gilas star has also been compared to European basketball players for his size, toughness, and shooting ability.

text: Kahapon, gindayaw ang nangin performance sang Gilas Pilipinas kun sa diin isa si Ramos sa nagpanguna agud nga makuha sang Pilipinas ang 6-0 record sa FIBA Asia Cup qualifiers campaign kasunod sang 82-77 win sa rematch batok sa South Korea.
english: Yesterday, Gilas Pilipinas' performance was praised where Ramos was one of the leaders to lead the Philippines to a 6-0 record in the FIBA ​​Asia Cup qualifiers campaign following an 82-77 win in the rematch against South Korea.

text: Anum na ang daug kag wala sang pierde ang Pilipinas samtang ang South Korea naman ang may apat ka daug kag duha ka pierde sa Group A sa torneo nga ginpatigayon sa Angeles University Foundation sa Clark, Pampanga.
english: The Philippines has six wins and no losses while South Korea has four wins and two losses in Group A in the tournament held at the Angeles University Foundation in Clark, Pampanga.

text: Si Ramos ang may yara sang 19 points, 5 assists, kag duha ka steals samtang may ara naman sang tag-10 points sanday Jordan Heading, Kai Sotto kag Rj Abarrientos.
english: Ramos had 19 points, 5 assists, and two steals while Jordan Heading, Kai Sotto and Rj Abarrientos had 10 points each.

text: Kasado na ang imbestigasyon sang Senado angot sa online gambing sa pungsod.
english: The Senate is already investigating online gambling in the country.

text: Ginpangunahan ni Senator Erwin Tulfo, bilang chairman sang Senate Committee on games and Amusement ang gin-file nga hagna batok sa online gambling sa Agusto 14.
english: Senator Erwin Tulfo, as chairman of the Senate Committee on games and Amusement, led the bill filed against online gambling on August 14.

text: Suno sa Senador, nagpromisa ini nga unahon niya nga tutukan ang mga hagna nga ini bangud ang makabig ini nga krisis ang sitwasyon.
english: The senator said he promised to focus on these bills first because the situation is considered a crisis.

text: Pahayag pa niya, kinahanglan sini ang gilayon nga lihok agud maresolba ang mga problema angot diri.
english: He said it needs immediate action to resolve the problems.

text: Apisar, total ban ang ginatuyo sang Senador, pamatian sagihapn sini ang posisyon sang gobyerno kapareho sang Philippine Amusement Gaming Corporation (PAGCOR) kag Department of Finance.
english: Although the Senator is aiming for a total ban, he will still listen to the position of the government such as the Philippine Amusement Gaming Corporation (PAGCOR) and the Department of Finance.

text:
Dugang pa sini, lantawon sagihapon ang pros kag cons kun ini na ang maguba ang online gambling

Ginpunto man sang senador nga wala sang regulasyon gani wala man untat ang pagsugal sang mga tawo, kag wala man sang control kun pila ang igtaya.
english:
He added that the pros and cons of online gambling will still be considered.

The senator also pointed out that there is no regulation so people do not stop gambling, and there is no control over how much to bet.

text: ILOILO CITY-May duha na ka mga testigo nga ginauyatan ang La Paz Police Station may kaangtanan sa pagluthang-patay kay former Ingore, La Paz Punong Barangay Ernie Poral sang Agosto 5 sa Baldoza, La Paz, Iloilo City.
english: ILOILO CITY-The La Paz Police Station has two witnesses in connection with the shooting death of former Ingore, La Paz Punong Barangay Ernie Poral on August 5 in Baldoza, La Paz, Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Marlon Perez, hepe sang La Paz Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga ang isa ka testigo amo ang anak mismo ni Poral.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Marlon Perez, chief of La Paz Police Station, said one of the witnesses was Poral's own son.

text: Suno kay Perez, nakit-an mismo sang anak ni Poral malapit sa ila balay ang suspek nga si Nilo Guardaya, 39, residente sang Igcocolo, Guimbal, Iloilo.
english: According to Perez, Poral's son saw the suspect, Nilo Guardaya, 39, resident of Igcocolo, Guimbal, Iloilo, near their house.

text: Ginpahayag nga sang amo nga tion, nagapanilag na ang anak ni Poral bangud may ideya na ini nga yara sang naga-monitor sa hulag sang iya amay.
english: It was reported that at that time, Poral's son was already watching because he had an idea that someone was monitoring his father's movements.

text: Suno kay Perez, base sa panaysayon sang anak ni Poral, nakit-an niya ang suspek nga nagbakal sang sigarilyo sa tiangge kag wala ini sang suksok nga helmet gani natandaan niya ang nawong sini nga nagsanto gid sa itsura ni Guardaya.
english: According to Perez, based on the testimony of Poral's son, he saw the suspect buying cigarettes at the shop and he was not wearing a helmet so he remembered his face that matched the appearance of Guardaya.

text: Gindugang ni Perez nga ang isa pa testigo amo ang tricycle driver sa terminal sa Baldoza, La Paz.
english: Perez added that another witness was a tricycle driver at the terminal in Baldoza, La Paz.

text: Suno sa hepe, base sa panaysayon sang tricycle driver, antes ang pagpangluthang, nakit-an niya si Guardaya nga nag-park sang iya motorsiklo terminal kun sa diin ginkakas sini ang iya helmet kag nag-inom sang tubig rason nga nakit-an niya ang nawong sang suspek.
english: According to the chief, based on the testimony of the tricycle driver, before the shooting, he saw Guardaya parked his motorcycle terminal where he took off his helmet and drank water so he saw the face of the suspect.

text: Makaligad ang pila oras, didto na natabo ang pagluthang kay Poral kag sang ginpakita ang kuha sang cctv sa pagtiro sa biktima, ang ginasuksok sang gunman amo man ang ginasuksok sang lalaki nga nakit-an sang testigo sa terminal kag mangin ang nawong sini ang pareho gid.
english: A few hours later, Poral was shot and when the cctv footage of the shooting was shown, the gunman was wearing the same thing as the man the witness saw at the terminal and his face was the same.

text: Sa karon, tatlo ka mga motibo ang ginasundan sang kapulisan may kaangtanan sa pagluthang-patay kay Poral.
english: Police are currently investigating three motives in connection with the shooting death of Poral.

text: Ini ang ginalakpan sang negosyo apang wala pa ma-specify kun ano ini, amo man ang iya pagka-punong barangay, kag personal nga mahimo may nakaaway ini.
english: He is involved in business but it has not been specified what it is, as well as his position as punong barangay, and personally he may have had a fight.

text: Indi pagpalampason sang Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) ang mga manugbaligya nga nagalapas sa suggested retail prices (SRP) ukon ang mga nga nagapataka lang sa pagpasaka sang presyo sa ila nga baligya nga produkto.
english: The Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) will not ignore vendors who violate the suggested retail prices (SRP) or those who are just trying to raise the price of their products.

text: Suno kay Trade Secretary Ramon Lopez, sa ila nga latest report, nagdangat na sa 1,070 ka letters of inquiry ang ila napadala sa mga violators sa SRP sang DTI kag sang Department of Agriculture (DA).
english: According to Trade Secretary Ramon Lopez, in their latest report, they have already sent 1,070 letters of inquiry to violators of the SRP of the DTI and the Department of Agriculture (DA).

text: Ginhingyo ang mga manugbaligya nga ipaathag kun ngaa nakalab-ot sila sa mas mataas nga presyo.
english: Sellers were asked to explain why they arrived at the higher price.

text: Sa presyo sang karne sang baboy, ginapahayag nga naglab-ot sa P380 tubtob P400 ang kilo sa mga merkado sa Metro Manila– mas mataas sa SRP nga P225.
english: The price of pork reportedly reached P380 to P400 per kilo in Metro Manila markets – higher than the SRP of P225.

text: P70 per kilo ang SRP sa manok apang may yara man sang ginapahayag nga nagabaligya sang P200 per kilo.
english: The SRP for chicken is P70 per kilo but there are also those who sell it at P200 per kilo.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang ginatudlo nga rason sa pagtaas sang presyo sa agricultural products amo ang manubo nga suplay sa pungsod tuga sang African swine flu kag bangud man sa epekto sang paglaslas sang asud-asud nga mga bagyo sang katapusan nga bahin sang 2020.
english: It is known that the reason for the increase in prices of agricultural products is the low supply in the country caused by the African swine flu and also due to the impact of the frequent typhoons in the last part of 2020.

text: Suno naman kay Lopez, padayunon nila ang inspection indi lamang sa mga manugbaligya kundi pati na sa distributors, retailers, kag iban pa nga middlemen sa trading.
english: Lopez said they will continue to inspect not only vendors but also distributors, retailers, and other middlemen in trading.

text: Tinguhaan sang Western Visayas nga malab-ot ang ginahandum nga pinaka-una nga pwesto sa Palarong Pambansa 2025.
english: Western Visayas will strive to achieve the coveted top spot in the Palarong Pambansa 2025.

text: Ini paagi sa masobra 600 ka mga atleta nga ginpadala sang Rehiyon VI sa Laoag, Ilocos Norte agud magpasakop sa nagkalain-lain nga sports events.
english: This is through more than 600 athletes sent by Region VI to Laoag, Ilocos Norte to participate in various sports events.

text: Madumduman nga halin sa second place finish sang 2023, nag-us-os ang Western Visayas sa ikatatlo nga pwesto sang 2024 sa Cebu City.
english: It can be recalled that from a second place finish in 2023, Western Visayas dropped to third place in 2024 in Cebu City.

text: Ang kinahanglan nga lutuson sang mga atleta sang rehiyon agud nga malab-ot ang target nga korona amo ang National Capital Region (NCR) nga nakakuha sang ila ika-17 nga korona sa Palarong Pambansa sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: The athletes of the region will have to beat in order to achieve the target crown is the National Capital Region (NCR) which won its 17th crown in the Palarong Pambansa last year.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Hernani Escullar, spokesperson sang Department of Education Region VI, iya ginpahayag nga magluwas sa preparasyon sang rehiyon, mangin unique ang partisipasyon sang Western Visayas subong nga tuig bangud duha ka regional directors ang maga-oversee sa WV Regional Athletic Association.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Hernani Escullar, spokesperson of the Department of Education Region VI, said that besides the preparation of the region, the participation of Western Visayas will be unique this year as two regional directors will oversee the WV Regional Athletic Association.

text: Ini amo sanday DepEd Region VI OIC Director Dr. Cristito A. Eco, kag si Negros Island Region Director Dr. Ramir Uytico nga halin man diri anay sa Region VI.
english: They are DepEd Region VI OIC Director Dr. Cristito A. Eco, and Negros Island Region Director Dr. Ramir Uytico who is also from Region VI.

text: Bangud na-ulihi na na-establisar ang DepEd NIR, maga-upod anay ang delegates sang Negros Occidental sa Panay kag Guimaras subong nga tuig.
english: Since the DepEd NIR was established later, the delegates of Negros Occidental will first accompany Panay and Guimaras this year.

text: Maragtason ini bangud ini na ang katapusan nga tuig nga makaupod pa ang Negros Occidental sa delegasyon sang Region VI.
english: This is historic because this is the last year that Negros Occidental will be with the delegation of Region VI.

text:
Magluwas sa 608 athletes, may 152 coaches, assistant coaches, kag chaperones; 249 committee members, kag anum ka honorary members nga ginpadala ang Western Visayas para sa amo nga daku nga hinampang.#

(Screengrab from DepEd Western Visayas/FB)
english:
In addition to the 608 athletes, there were 152 coaches, assistant coaches, and chaperones; 249 committee members, and six honorary members were sent to Western Visayas for the big game.

(Screengrab from DepEd Western Visayas/FB)

text: Gin-anunsyo na ni US President Joe Biden nga indi na ini magdayon sa pag-pa-reelect bilang presidente sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: US President Joe Biden has announced that he will not run for re-election as president of the United States of America.

text: Ginpaguwa sang 81-anyos nga lider ini nga statement kasunod man sang mas nagatunog nga panawagan halin sa Democrat leaders nga mag-atras na ini sa presidential campaign para sa November 2024 elections.
english: The 81-year-old leader issued this statement also following more resounding calls from Democrat leaders for him to withdraw from the presidential campaign for the November 2024 elections.

text: Pahayag ni Biden, para sa “best interest” sang iya partido kag pungsod ang iya nga desisyon nga magtutok na lamang sa nabilin sini nga termino bilang presidente.
english: Biden said his decision to focus on the remainder of his term as president is in the “best interest” of his party and country.

text: Natalana man ini nga mag-atubang sa publiko kag maghatag sang speech kaangot diri.
english: He is also scheduled to appear before the public and give a speech in this regard.

text:
“While it has been my intention to seek reelection, I believe it is in the best interest of my party and the country for me to stand down and to focus solely on fulfilling my duties as President for the remainder of my term,” pahayag sini sa X. “I will speak to the Nation later this week in more detail about my decision.”

Ginpasalamatan man sini si Vice President Kamala Harris sa pagpungko bilang “extraordinary partner”, kag sunod nga gin-endorso ang bise-presidente nga amo ang mangin nominee sang Democrats subong nga tuig.
english:
“While it has been my intention to seek reelection, I believe it is in the best interest of my party and the country for me to stand down and to focus solely on fulfilling my duties as President for the remainder of my term,” he told X. “I will speak to the Nation later this week in more detail about my decision.”

He also thanked Vice President Kamala Harris for serving as an “extraordinary partner”, and subsequently endorsed the vice-president as the Democrats’ nominee this year.

text: “My very first decision as the party nominee in 2020 was to pick Kamala Harris as my Vice President,” dugang sini.
english: “My very first decision as the party nominee in 2020 was to pick Kamala Harris as my Vice President,” it added.

text: “And it’s been the best decision I’ve made.
english: “And it’s been the best decision I’ve made.

text:
Today I want to offer my full support and endorsement for Kamala to be the nominee of our party this year.”

Ang pag-withdraw ni Biden ang kasunod man sa nasaksihan sang kalibutan nga pigado nga performance sini sa presidential debate batok kay anay US President Donald Trump sang nagligad nga bulan.
english:
Today I want to offer my full support and endorsement for Kamala to be the nominee of our party this year.”

Biden's withdrawal also follows the world's poor performance in the presidential debate against former US President Donald Trump last month.

text: Sa amo nga debate nga naglawig sang 90 minutos, madumduman nga nagakalipat na si Biden sa mga inughambal sini kag masami nga wala na sang isugpon sa iya statement.
english: During the 90-minute debate, Biden forgot his words and often had nothing to add to his statement.

text: More on this shortly.
english: More on this shortly.

text: Naghatag sang reaksyon ang China sa ginpagguwan nga pahayag ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: China has reacted to the statement issued by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: nga posible nga ma-involve ang Pilipinas sa tunga sang giyera kun magluntad ang full-scale war sa tunga sang Estados Unidos kag China bangud sang tensyon sa Taiwan.
english: that the Philippines could be involved in the middle of the war if a full-scale war breaks out between the United States and China over tensions in Taiwan.

text: Sa isa ka statement, ginpahayag ni Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun nga ang Taiwan isa ka “inalienable part” ukon indi mabakod nga kabahin sang teritoryo sang China.
english: In a statement, Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said that Taiwan is an “inalienable part” or insecure part of China’s territory.

text: Gindugang pa niya nga ang isyu sa Taiwan “internal affair” sang China kag wala sang lugar ang Pilipinas ukon bisan sin-o nga pungsod nga mag-intra.
english: He added that the Taiwan issue is an “internal affair” of China and there is no place for the Philippines or any other country to interfere.

text: Ginklaro liwat sang China nga padayon nila nga ginakabig ang Taiwan nga kabahin sang ila teritoryo kag nagpaandam nga magagamit sila sang puwersa agud nga mabalik ini sa idalom sang ila kontrol.
english: China has again made clear that it continues to consider Taiwan part of its territory and has warned that it will use force to bring it back under its control.

text: Matandaan nga sa isa ka interview kay Marcos sa sidelines sang iya lima ka adlaw nga state visit sa India, ginpahayag niya nga indi malikawan nga indi ma-involve ang Pilipinas angut sa nasambit nga topiko agud proteheran ang pungsod kag ang mga Pinoy nga nagaistar sa Taiwan.
english: In an interview with Marcos on the sidelines of his five-day state visit to India, he said it is inevitable that the Philippines will not be involved in the issue in order to protect the country and the Filipinos living in Taiwan.

text: Nagmahal ang presyo sang mga utanon nga ginagamit sa mga salad kag chopsuey.
english: The price of vegetables used in salads and chopsuey has gone up.

text: Sa exclusive interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Engr.
english: In an exclusive interview with Bombo Radyo, Engr.

text: Remelyn Recoter, Regional Director sang Department of Agriculture Region 6, iya ginpahayag nga pila sa mga ulutanon ang may yara sang pagsaka sa presyo bangud sa kakulang sa supply sang produkto sa pungsod.
english: Remelyn Recoter, Regional Director of the Department of Agriculture Region 6, said that some of the vegetables have increased in price due to the shortage of product supply in the country.

text: Lakip diri suno kay Recoter amo ang brocolli, bombay, carrots kag iban pa.
english: Recoter said these include brocolli, bombay, carrots and others.

text: Samtang ang mga panakot naman sang pinakbet ang estable sa gihapon ang presyo.
english: Meanwhile, the spices of pinakbet are still stable in price.

text: Ginpaathag ni Recoter nga kun gamay ang suplay sang utan kag magsaka ang demand, posible nga magasaka man ang presyo sini.
english: Recoter explained that if the supply of vegetables is low and demand increases, the price may also increase.

text: Suno kay Recoter, kun magnubo naman ang demand kag magsaka ang suplay, may yara naman sang pagnubo sang presyo.
english: According to Recoter, if demand decreases and supply increases, there will be a decrease in prices.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa supply kag demand forecast sang Department of Agriculture, may yara lamang sang 78.4 percent nga demand sa ginabakal nga utan nga local kag imported supply.
english: According to the supply and demand forecast of the Department of Agriculture, there is only 78.4 percent of the demand for local and imported vegetables.

text: Buot silingon, may yara sang kakulang sa pila ka mga utan kag oversupply naman sa iban depende sa pananom.
english: This means that there is a shortage of some vegetables and an oversupply of others depending on the crop.

text: Pahalugan ang mga pagsulundan sa siyam ka mga prefectures sa Japan lakip na sa Tokyo samtang nagahilapit ang Tokyo Olympics apang may pila gihapon ka pagpanghugot nga dapat ipabilin agud nga malikawan ang surge sang COVID-19 cases.
english: Regulations will be relaxed in nine prefectures in Japan including Tokyo as the Tokyo Olympics approach but there are still some restrictions that must be maintained to avoid a surge of COVID-19 cases.

text: Nagpangabay si Prime Minister Yoshihide Suga sa publiko nga maglantaw na lang sang Olympics sa TV agud malikawan nga maglapta ang virus.
english: Prime Minister Yoshihide Suga has urged the public to watch the Olympics on TV to prevent the spread of the virus.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag ni Suga nga i-lift na ang state of emergency sa siyam ka areas apang ipabilin ang “quasi-emergency” measures sa pito sa sini nga mga lugar lakip na sa Tokyo tubtob sa Hulyo 11.
english: Earlier, Suga said the state of emergency would be lifted in nine areas but quasi-emergency measures would remain in seven of these areas, including Tokyo, until July 11.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Josel Palma direkta sa Japan, nagpaandam man subong ang Japanese medical experts nga ang pag-patigayon sang Olympics sa tunga sang COVID-19 pandemic ang may daku nga posibilidad nga makapasaka sang infections.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Josel Palma directly in Japan, Japanese medical experts have also warned that holding the Olympics in the midst of the COVID-19 pandemic has a high possibility of increasing infections.

text: Ang ginapahayag least risky nga opsyon amo nga dumilian ang spectators halin sa luwas sang pungsod nga makalantaw sang personal sa hampang, apang ginatun-an pa subong kun ano ang mangin pagsulundan sa fans halin mismo sa Japan.
english: The supposed least risky option is to ban spectators from abroad from watching the game in person, but it is still being studied what the rules will be for fans from Japan itself.

text: Sa Lunes, magadesisyon na sang pinal ang Tokyo 2020 organizers, International Olympic Committee, kag mga tiglawas halin sa national kag Tokyo governments kun ano ang mangin pagsulundan para sa fans halin sa Japan nga luyag maglantaw sang personal sa mga hampang.
english: On Monday, the Tokyo 2020 organizers, International Olympic Committee, and representatives from the national and Tokyo governments will make a final decision on what the rules will be for fans from Japan who want to watch the games in person.

text: Indi na makahulat pa si National team stalwart Gabe Norwood nga makit-an nga nagaperform ang mga “young Gilas Pilipinas squad” sa FIBA competitions sa masunod nga bulan.
english: National team stalwart Gabe Norwood can’t wait to see the “young Gilas Pilipinas squad” perform in the FIBA ​​competitions next month.

text: Si Norwood ang isa ka Filipino-American professional basketball player nga nagahampang sa Rain or Shine Elasto Painters.
english: Norwood is a Filipino-American professional basketball player who plays for the Rain or Shine Elasto Painters.

text: Magapadala sang “young team of cadets” ang Samahang Basketbol ng Pilipinas (SBP) sa FIBA Asia Cup 2021 qualifiers sa Clark, Pampanga sa Hunyo 16 tubtob 20, amo man sa FIBA Olympic Qualifying Tournament sa Belgrade, Serbia sa Hunyo 29 tubtob Hulyo 4.
english: The Philippine Basketball Association (SBP) will send a young team of cadets to the FIBA ​​Asia Cup 2021 qualifiers in Clark, Pampanga from June 16 to 20, as well as to the FIBA ​​Olympic Qualifying Tournament in Belgrade, Serbia from June 29 to July 4.

text: Wala nagaduha-duha si Norwood nga mapakita sang mga kabataan ang ila maayo nga performance sa duha ka mga events.
english: Norwood has no doubt that the kids will be able to perform well in both events.

text: Ang nagahatag sang kumpiyansa kay Norwood nga masarangan sang mga youth players ang paghampang amo nga bangud ginahatagan sang mga kabataan sang oras ang ila nga paghanas humalin sang pag-umpisa sang tuig para sa duha ka mga FIBA competitions.
english: What gives Norwood confidence that the youth players can play is because the children have been giving time to their training since the beginning of the year for the two FIBA ​​competitions.

text: Sa subong, ang Gilas Pilipinas ang may yara sang 3-0 record sa Group A sang FIBA Asia Cup 2021 qualifiers.
english: Gilas Pilipinas currently has a 3-0 record in Group A of the FIBA ​​Asia Cup 2021 qualifiers.

text: Kinahanglan nga siguraduhon sang gobyerno nga may yara sang available nga bakuna ang mg empleyado sang Micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) bangud indi sini masarangan nga magbakal sang bakuna.
english: The government must ensure that there is available vaccine for employees of Micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) because they cannot afford to buy the vaccine.

text: Suno kay Philippinee Chamber of Commerce and Industry (PCCI) President Benedicto Yujuico, kadam-an sa mga negosyo sa pungsod ang lunsay MSMEs nga nagakabudlayan na sa paghatag sa ila mga emplyeado sang sweldo subong nga may pandemya.
english: According to Philippine Chamber of Commerce and Industry (PCCI) President Benedicto Yujuico, most of the businesses in the country are MSMEs that are struggling to pay their employees during the pandemic.

text: Pahayag niya, ang mga dalagko nga kompaniya lang ang may ikasarang nga maghatag sang bakuna sa ila mga empleyado , gani nagakadapat nga buligan sang national government kag local government units ang mga magagmay nga negosyo.
english: He said only large companies have the ability to provide vaccines to their employees, so the national government and local government units should help small businesses.

text: Katungdanan sang gobyerno ang mga Micro, small, and medium enterprises dugang pa sang natungdan kag indi sang pribado nga sektor.
english: The government is responsible for the micro, small, and medium enterprises in addition to the concerned and not the private sector.

text: Nagalaum si Pope Francis nga mangin palaagyan ang Olympic kag Paralympic Games agud nga maestablisar ang ceasefire sa mga pungsod nga may giyera.
english: Pope Francis hopes that the Olympic and Paralympic Games will be a platform to establish a ceasefire in war-torn countries.

text: Ginpahayag ini sang Santo Papa kasunod sang Angelus Prayer sa St.
english: The Pope made the announcement following the Angelus Prayer at St.

text: Peter’s Square kag pila ka adlaw antes ang pormal nga pagsugod sang Olympiada sa Paris, France.
english: Peter’s Square and a few days before the formal start of the Olympiad in Paris, France.

text: Lakip sa na-mensyonar sini amo ang Ukraine, Palestine, Israel kag Myanmar kun sa diin iya ginpahangop nga wala sang may nagadaog sa tion nga may giyera.

text: Ginamandu sang amo nga hagna ang pagsapubliko nga pagpagwa sang mga kritikal nga impormasyon, lakip na ang tuigan nga Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth (SALN) sang mga masunod: Presidente, Bise Presidente, Mga Cabinet Secretaries, Mga myembro sang Kongreso, Mga mahistrado sang Supreme Court, Mga opisyal sang Constitutional Commissions kag iban pa nga ahensya nga ginakabig nga constitutional offices, kag mga opisyal sang Armed Forces nga may General ukon Flag Ranks.
english: The bill mandates the public release of critical information, including the annual Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth (SALN) of the following: President, Vice President, Cabinet Secretaries, Members of Congress, Supreme Court Justices, Constitutional Commission officials and other constitutional offices, and officers of the Armed Forces with General or Flag Ranks.

text: Ginamando man sang hagna nga ang tanan nga ahensya sang gobyerno dapat mag-upload sang importante nga impormasyon sa ila tagsa ka opisyal nga website agud mas madali ini ma-access sang publiko.
english: The bill also mandates that all government agencies upload vital information on their respective official websites to make it more accessible to the public.

text: Ginkabalak-an sang tiglikom sang Department of Energy nga si Sharon Garin, ang mataas nga presyo sang produktong petrolyo nga nagakaapekto sa mga nagkalain-lain nga sektor sa pungsod.
english: Department of Energy Secretary Sharon Garin expressed concern over the high prices of petroleum products that are affecting various sectors in the country.

text: Ini matapos nga gin-anunsyo sini sa Senate of the Philippines kahapon nga adlaw ang isa sa pinakadako nga pagsaka sang presyo sang mga produktong petrolyo sa kasaysayan sang Pilipinas bangod sang nagakatabo nga krisis sa Iran.
english: This comes after he announced in the Senate of the Philippines yesterday one of the biggest increases in the price of petroleum products in Philippine history due to the ongoing crisis with Iran.

text: Sa gintingob nga hearing sang Senate Committee on Ways and Means kag Senate Committee on Energy, gin-athag sang tiglikom nga tuman ka bug-at ang pagsaka sang presyo sang gatong sa sini nga semana.
english: In a joint hearing of the Senate Committee on Ways and Means and the Senate Committee on Energy, the secretary explained that the increase in fuel prices this week was very heavy.

text: Suno pa sa iya nga ang tuman nga ginakabalak-an sang publiko nga presyo sang gatong amo ang diesel bangud 65% sang public transportation ang nagagamit sini.
english: He said that the public is very concerned about the price of fuel is diesel because 65% of public transportation uses it.

text: Dugang pa niya nga dapat himuan sang paagi nga mabuhinan ang presyo sang diesel gamit ang budget sang gobyerno bangud amo sini ang tuman nga nagaapekto sa mga tawo.
english: He added that ways should be found to reduce the price of diesel using the government budget as this is what affects the people the most.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagsaka sang ₱7.00 tubtob ₱13.00 ang gasolina; samtang ₱17.50 tubtob ₱24.25 sa diesel; kag ₱32.00 tubtob ₱38.50 naman ang sa kerosene.

text: Maganubo sang senintimos ang presyo sang produktong-petrolyo sa masunod nga semana.

text:
Yari ang posible nga rollback suno sa Department of Energy – Oil Industry Management Bureau (DOE-OIMB):

Gasoline – more or less rollback of P0.30Diesel – more or less rollback of P0.60Kerosene – more or less rollback of P0.65

english:

text: ANG Filipinas isa sang “most vulnerable” nga mga pungsod sa kalibutan kon ang krisis nga dulot kag madulot sang Climate Change ang pagahambalan.
english: THE Philippines is one of the “most vulnerable” countries in the world when it comes to the crisis caused and caused by Climate Change.

text: In fact, sunu sa 2019 nga report sang Institute for Economics and Peace, ang Filipinas ang nagapanguna sa mga pungsod nga may daku nga risgo (most risk) sa kahalitan nga matuga sang Climate Crisis.
english: In fact, according to a 2019 report by the Institute for Economics and Peace, the Philippines is among the countries most at risk of the damage caused by the Climate Crisis.

text: Ang Global Climte Risk Index 2020 naman nagbutang sang Filipinas sa ika-2 nga ranggo sa “most vulnerable” nga mga pungsod, bisan pa nga isa ini sa may diutay nga amot sa pagbuga sang Greenhouse Gas (GHG) sa atmospera nga nagatuga sang Global Warming, ukon pagtaas sang pag-init (surface temperature) sang kalibutan.
english: The Global Climte Risk Index 2020 ranked the Philippines 2nd among the “most vulnerable” countries, despite being one of the smallest contributors to greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions in the atmosphere that cause Global Warming.

text: Sa sige pagtaas sang temperatura, ginakulbaan na gani sa karon sang aton mga siyentipiko nga basi malab-ut na sini ang “tipping point” sa madugang nga 2 degrees Celsius sa mean ukon average temperature sang kalibutan nga malapit na matabo sa karon.
english: With the continuous rise in temperature, our scientists are now worried that it may reach the tipping point with an additional 2 degrees Celsius in the mean or average temperature of the world that is about to happen now.

text: Kon matabo, posible nga indi na mapunggan ang salta sini kag mangin ulianon na ang lakat sang panahon nga indi na naton ma-control ang panimuot.
english: If that happens, it is possible that it will become unstoppable and that the course of time will become so repetitive that we will no longer be able to control our attitude.

text: Sa karon, ginakahadlukan na gani nga malab-ut na ining “tipping point” sa tuig 2050 kon indi na mahimuan dayon sing bagay nga aksyon sang mga lideres sang kalibutan, nga katapo sang Paris Agreement.
english: Today, it is feared that this “tipping point” will be reached by 2050 if appropriate action is not taken by world leaders, who are members of the Paris Agreement.

text:
***

Isa sang resulta sang Global Warming, sunu sa mga siyentipiko, amo ang pagtaas sang tubig sa kadagatan (tide rise) upod sa pagtaas man sang temperatura tungod sa matunaw nga mga yelo sa Antartica kag iban pa nga malamig nga rehiyon sang kalibutan.
english:
***

One of the consequences of Global Warming, according to scientists, is the rise in ocean water (tide rise) along with the rise in temperature due to the melting of ice in Antarctica and other cold regions of the world.

text: Kon matabo, nga amat-amat na nabatyagan sang kalibutan halin pa sadtong tuig 2000 kag lubos na ma-experyensyahan sa 2050, mga 60 ka milyon ka mga Filipino nga nagapuluyo malapit sa baybayon ang kinahanglan na ma-relocate sa mataas nga lugar sa ina nga tion.
english: If it happens, which the world has been slowly feeling since 2000 and will fully experience by 2050, about 60 million Filipinos living near the coast will have to be relocated to higher ground by then.

text: Tuga man sang paglumbayag na sang Global Warming ang amat-amat nga pagtuhaw sang mas mabaskug kag tuman ka makahalalit nga mga bagyo, nga mga 20 sini ang nagaabot sa aton pungsod kada tuig, ang makakululba na nga pag-inulan, pagbaha kag landslide nga nagautas sang linibu nga kabuhi kag paghinibi sang mga namatyan, kag minilyon ka pesos nga kahalitan sa infrastructura kag pangabuhian.
english: Global warming is also causing the gradual emergence of stronger and more destructive typhoons, about 20 of which hit our country each year, the devastating rains, floods and landslides that claim thousands of lives and the tears of the dead, and millions of pesos in damage to infrastructure and livelihoods.

text: Tungod sining mga hitabo, sunu sa 2022 Statista survey, 73.8% sang mga respondents sa Filipinas ang nagapati nga “immediate threat” na ang Climate Change.
english: Given these developments, according to the 2022 Statista survey, 73.8% of respondents in the Philippines believe that Climate Change is an “immediate threat”.

text: Isa ka pagtuon sang The Lancet angot sa Climate Change nagpakita man  nga 92% sang mga kabataan sa Filipinas ang nagapati nga ang ila “future is frightening”.
english: A study by The Lancet on Climate Change also showed that 92% of children in the Philippines believe that their “future is frightening”.

text: Mga 68% naman ang nagapati nga nalugaw-an ang gobyerno sa paghimo sing nagakaigu nga mga tikang nga ma-mitigate kag matambagan ang kahalitan nga natuga na sang Climate Crisis sa Filipinas.
english: About 68% believe that the government has failed to take appropriate measures to mitigate and address the damage already caused by the Climate Crisis in the Philippines.

text: Tungod sini, kinahanglan na seguro nga mag-deklarar sing Climate Emergency sa aton pungsod katulad sang ginhimo na sang United Kingdom kag Scotland.
english: Because of this, it is probably necessary to declare a Climate Emergency in our country as the United Kingdom and Scotland have done.

text:
***

Sa tinuig sugod karon padulong sa 2050 wala na ang madamo naton nga mga katigulangan kag ang mabilin na lang amo ang ila mga kabataan kag kaapohan.
english:
***

In the years from now until 2050, many of our ancestors will be gone and only their children and grandchildren will remain.

text: Gani, ang magalukdo sining mga dalagku nga problema nga dala sang Climate Change amo gid ang ulihing henerasyon, ukon ang aton mga kabataan sa karon.
english: Therefore, the ones who will solve these big problems brought about by Climate Change are the next generation, or our children today.

text: Tungod sini, indi katingalahan nga ang pila ka maalam sa ila maghatag gid sing daku nga kabalaka kag magwa na sa ila mga alukba agud magpahayag sang ila masingki nga balatyagon, nga kon tawgon sa karon mga environmental activists.
english: Because of this, it is not surprising that some of the smartest of them would be very concerned and would come out of their caves to express their violent feelings, which are now called environmental activists.

text: Isa sang pinaka-popular sa sining kabataan amo si Greta Thunberg nga isa ka Swedish teenager.
english: One of the most popular of these children is Greta Thunberg who is a Swedish teenager.

text: Tungod sa iya kasupog sa pagdala sang iya kawsa naging Nobel Peace Prize nominee ini.
english: Because of his courage in carrying out his cause, he became a Nobel Peace Prize nominee.

text: Sang 2018, gin-imbitar ini siya sa paghambal angot sa “climate activism” sa atubangan sang mga world leaders sa United Nations.
english: In 2018, he was invited to speak on climate activism before world leaders at the United Nations.

text: Ginpatalupangod niya nga daw mga bata kuno ang aton mga lideres nga indi maghilituhog sa ila luyag matabo sa problema sang Climate Change.
english: He pointed out that our leaders are like children who will not compromise on what they want to happen on the problem of Climate Change.

text: Gani, siling niya, indi na mabasol ang mga kabataan sang ila karon henerasyon agud mangisug sa pag-kritikar sa sining mga lideres parti sa ila pagpabaya sa sining problema.
english: Therefore, he said, the children of their present generation cannot be blamed for daring to criticize these leaders for their neglect of this problem.

text: Samtang, indi man maulihi ang mga kabataan nga Filipino sa advocacia nga awayon sing husto ang Climate Change, labi na gid diri sa pungsod.
english: Meanwhile, Filipino children will not be left behind in advocacy to fight Climate Change properly, especially here in the country.

text: Gintukod nila sadtong 2019 ang Youth Advocates for Climate Action Philippines, ukon YACAP, kag makita na ini sila sa mga rally sa NCR kag iban  pa nga lugar sa pungsod.
english: They founded the Youth Advocates for Climate Action Philippines, or YACAP, in 2019, and they can already be seen at rallies in the NCR and other parts of the country.

text: Ginapangunahan ini ni Jon Bonifacio bilang national coordinator./PN
english: It is headed by Jon Bonifacio as national coordinator./PN

text: Naghimo sang historic win si Terrence Crawford matapos ginpierde si Canelo Alvarez paagi sa unanimous decision kag nangin pinakabag-o nga undisputed super middleweight champion sa ila away nga ginpatigayon sa Allegiant Stadium sa Las Vegas.
english: Terrence Crawford made a historic win after defeating Canelo Alvarez via unanimous decision to become the newest undisputed super middleweight champion in their fight held at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas.

text: Sa amo nga kadalag-an, si Crawford ang nangin pinakauna nga lalaki nga boxer sa four-belt era nga mangin undisputed sa tatlo ka weight classes.
english: With that victory, Crawford became the first male boxer in the four-belt era to be undisputed in all three weight classes.

text: Ginhimo niya ini sa atubang sang 70,482 ka tawo sa e stadium kag kalabanan mga fans ni Alvarez.
english: He did it in front of 70,482 people in the e stadium and mostly Alvarez fans.

text: Matapos makuha ang world titles sa apat ka weight classes kalakip na ang undisputed status sa junior welterweight kag welterweight, ginhimo ni Crawford ang paglukso halin sa 154 pounds pasaka sa 168 pounds agud ma-dethrone ang biggest star sang boxing.
english: After winning world titles in four weight classes including undisputed status at junior welterweight and welterweight, Crawford made the jump from 154 pounds to 168 pounds to dethrone boxing's biggest star.

text: “Si Inday Raisa Treñas magaserbisyo sa tanan nga nag-upod, nagbulig, nagboto — kag sa mga wala nagboto.
english: “Inday Raisa Treñas will serve all those who joined, helped, voted — and those who did not vote.

text:
Si Inday Raisa mangin mayor para sa tanan diri sa syudad sang Iloilo.”

Ini ang pasalig ni Raisa Treñas-Chu pila ka adlaw matapos nakuha ang kadalag-an sa 2025 mayoral race sa Iloilo City.
english:
Inday Raisa will be the mayor for everyone here in Iloilo City.”

This is the assurance of Raisa Treñas-Chu a few days after winning the 2025 mayoral race in Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo sa mayor-elect nga subang nga anak ni outgoing Mayor Jerry Treñas, ginpahayag sini nga kasubong sang isa ka iloy sa puluy-an, tatapon niya ang iya tanan nga ‘kabataan’ sa syudad.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, the mayor-elect's youngest son, outgoing Mayor Jerry Treñas, said that like a mother at home, she will take care of all her 'children' in the city.

text: “Kun iloy ka na sang syudad, indi ka pwede magpili.
english: “When you’re the mother of the city, you’re not allowed to choose.

text: Para ka gid sa tanan mo nga kabataan sa Iloilo City,” pahayag sini.
english: You are for all your children in Iloilo City,” he said.

text: Gindugang man sini nga daku gid ang nangin impluwensya sang iya amay agud nga mahulma ang iya ikasarang bilang lider.
english: He also added that his father was a great influence in shaping his ability as a leader.

text: Magluwas sa mga natun-an sini sa adlaw-adlaw nga ginapakita sang alkalde, ginbaklan man siya sini ang mga leadership books agud nga madugangan ang iya ihibalo sa pagserbisyo sa publiko.
english: Besides the daily lessons he learned from the mayor, he also bought him leadership books to increase his knowledge in serving the public.

text: “Ginhambalan niya [Mayor Jerry] ko nga what you lack in experience and time, you read para mas madamo ka pa gid sang ma-learn,” suno kay Raisa.
english: “He [Mayor Jerry] told me that what you lack in experience and time, you read so you can learn more,” Raisa said.

text: Ginpakigbahin man sini ang tatlo sa iya nagapanguna nga prayoridad sa una nga 100 ka adlaw sa iya administrasyon.
english: He also shared three of his top priorities for the first 100 days in his administration.

text: Una, pauswagon sini ang mga pangitan-an sang mga Ilonggo, ilabi na kasunod sang nakit-an nga madamo ang job fairs apang gamay lang ang naga-apply.
english: First, it will improve the livelihoods of Ilonggos, especially following the finding that there are many job fairs but few apply.

text: Suno kay Raisa, may nakit-an ini nga problema sa job matching, gani importante ang courses ukon re-training para nga ma-upscale pa ang workforce sa syudad.
english: According to Raisa, she saw a problem in job matching, so courses or re-training are important to upscale the workforce in the city.

text: Ang ikaduha amo ang paghatag sang atensyon sa healthcare.
english: The second is to focus on healthcare.

text: Pahayag sini, pasangkaron niya ang mga serbisyo nga ibutang sa Uswag Mega Health Centers lakip na ang laboratory services, siguraduhon nga accessible ini sa mga pumuluyo, kag butangan man ang kada distrito.
english: He said he will expand the services to be provided at Uswag Mega Health Centers including laboratory services, ensure that they are accessible to the people, and also provided to each district.

text: Ikatatlo, ang hatagan sini sang atensyon amo ang edukasyon ilabi na ang pagpadamo sang Uswag scholars nga subong masobra na sa 30,000.
english: Third, it will focus on education especially the increase in the number of Uswag scholars which now numbers more than 30,000.

text: Ginaplano man sini nga magdugang sang Iloilo City Community College – City Proper Campus.
english: It also plans to add an Iloilo City Community College – City Proper Campus.

text: Ini bangud sa nakit-an nga problema sa campus sa Molo nga indi na makadugang sang mga program kag estudyante bangud nga ginakulang na sang classrooms.
english: This is due to the problem found in the campus in Molo that can no longer increase programs and students because of the lack of classrooms.

text: Mayo 13 sang ginproklamar sang Iloilo City Board of Canvassers ang 39-anyos nga si Treñas-Chu bilang winner sa mayoral elections.
english: On May 13, the Iloilo City Board of Canvassers proclaimed 39-year-old Treñas-Chu as the winner of the mayoral elections.

text: Apisar bag-uhan sa pulitika, nakuha sini ang landslide win nga may 170,162 votes, ukon 69.37 percent, kun sa diin ginlutos sini ang isahanon nga kasumpong nga si Roland Magahin, nga nakakuha sang 75,139 votes, ukon 30.63 percent.#
english: Despite being a newcomer to politics, he won a landslide victory with 170,162 votes, or 69.37 percent, defeating his only opponent, Roland Magahin, who won 75,139 votes, or 30.63 percent.

text: Nagsulod na sa Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) ang bagyo nga Gorio kagab-i, Agusto 10, ini suno sa state weather bureau.
english: Typhoon Gorio entered the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility (PAR) last night, August 10, according to the state weather bureau.

text: Base sa Tropical Cyclone Advisory No.
english: Based on Tropical Cyclone Advisory No.

text: 6 nga ginpaguwa sang bureau, naghina ang Severe Tropical Storm Podul samtang padayon man ini nga nagahulag pakanluran.
english: 6 issued by the bureau, Severe Tropical Storm Podul weakened as it continued to move westward.

text:
Ulihi nga nga siplatan ang sentro sang bagyo sa kalayuon nga 1,420km East sang Extreme Northern Luzon sagguwa sang Philippine Area of Responsibility, kag pagdapya sang hangin nga naglab-ot sa 100km/h tubtob 125km/h.

Ini ang nagahulag pa-nakatundan sa kadasigon nga 25km/h.

Suno sa ahensya, gamay ang posibilidad nga direkta nga makaepekto si Podul sa kondisyon sang kadagatan sa pungsod sa masunod nga lima ka adlaw.
english:
The center of the typhoon was last spotted at a distance of 1,420km East of Extreme Northern Luzon outside the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility, with winds of 100km/h to 125km/h.

It is moving westward at 25km/h.

The agency said Podul is unlikely to directly impact sea conditions in the country for the next five days.

text: Ginalauman nga magapadulong ini sa direksyon nakatundan tubtob sa Martes, Agusto 12, antes ini maghulag pa naaminhan-nakatundan.
english: It is expected to head in a westerly direction until Tuesday, August 12, before moving further northwest.

text: Gina-abisuhan man ang publiko kag ang disaster risk reduction and management offices nga padayon nga mag-monitor sa mga masunod nga abiso may kaangtanan sa bagyo Podul.
english: The public and disaster risk reduction and management offices are also advised to continue to monitor the following warnings related to typhoon Podul.

text: Bakunahan batuk sa COVID-19 ang mga atleta kag team members nga nagatinir sa Olympic village sa Tokyo, Japan samtang ginatinguhaan sang mga organizers nga pakalmahon ang kakulba nga ginabatyag sang kadam-an sa desisyon nga dayunon ang event sa pihak sang pagtimbuok sang kaso sang virus sa nasambit nga pungsod.
english: Athletes and team members staying at the Olympic village in Tokyo, Japan will be vaccinated against COVID-19 as organizers try to calm the nervousness of the public over the decision to hold the event despite the increase in cases of the virus in the country.

text: Duha ka bulan antes ang pandemic-postponed Tokyo Games nga magabukas sa Hulyo 23, pila ka bahin sang Japan subong ang yara sa idalom sang state of emergency kag mayorya sa mga Japanese ang luyag kuntani nga kanselahon ang hampang.
english: Two months before the pandemic-postponed Tokyo Games open on July 23, several parts of Japan are now under a state of emergency and a majority of Japanese would have liked to cancel the games.

text: Suno kay International Olympic Committee chief Thomas Bach, safe nga lugar ang Olympic village kag ang Olympic kag Paralympic Games sang Tokyo 2020 ang i-organisa sa safe man nga pamaagi.
english: According to International Olympic Committee chief Thomas Bach, the Olympic village is a safe place and the Olympic and Paralympic Games of Tokyo 2020 will be organized in a safe manner.

text: Si Bach kuntani ang magabisita sa Tokyo subong nga semana apang bangud sa virus restrictions, wala ini natigayon nga makakadto sa nasambit nga lugar.
english: Bach was supposed to visit Tokyo this week but due to virus restrictions, he was unable to make the trip.

text: Pahayag niya, sa subong nga tion, 75% na sang mga residente sang Olympic village ang nabakunahan kag pagabakunahan pa antes ang Olympic Games.
english: He said that at present, 75% of the residents of the Olympic village have been vaccinated and will be vaccinated before the Olympic Games.

text: Nahibaluan nga may yara na sang nahitso nga mga virus countermeasures ang organizers agud nga mapabilin nga safe ang hampang lakip na ang pagban sa mga overseas fans sa labing una nga tion.
english: It is known that the organizers have already put in place virus countermeasures to keep the game safe including banning overseas fans for the first time.

text: Patay ang bise-alkalde kag isa sa iya nga security aides matapos nga gin-ambush sa Maguindanao del Sir.
english: The vice-mayor and one of his security aides were killed after being ambushed in Maguindanao del Sir.

text: Ang biktima amo si South Upi Vice Mayor Roldan Benito nga nagasakay gid sa isa ka pick-up truck sa Sitio Linao, Barangay Pandan sa amo nga banwa kaupod ang iya pamilya kag security detail sang sila ang gin-atake.
english: The victim was identified as South Upi Vice Mayor Roldan Benito who was riding in a pick-up truck in Sitio Linao, Barangay Pandan in the same town with his family and security detail when they were attacked.

text: Sa amo nga ambush, napilasan man ang asawa ni Benito nga isa ka punong barangay sa amo nga lugar amo man ang ila bata kag isa pa ka security escort.
english: In the ambush, Benito's wife, a barangay captain in the area, as well as their child and another security escort were also wounded.

text: Suno sa Bangsamoro Autonomous Region Police Office, gilayon nga nagpalagyo ang mga suspek sa wala pa nahibaluan nga direksyon kag padayon pa subong ang pag-ayam sang kapulisan.
english: According to the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region Police Office, the suspects immediately fled in an unknown direction and the police are still hunting for them.

text: Ang South Upi Police kag 57th Infantry Battalion sang Philippine Army ang nagapatigayon sang clearing kag pursuit operations.
english: The South Upi Police and 57th Infantry Battalion of the Philippine Army are conducting clearing and pursuit operations.

text: Ang alkalde sang South Upi nga si Mayor Reynalbert Insular — nga survivor man sang tatlo anay ka ambush attempts — ang gilayon nga nagkondena sa insidente kag nagpadala sang mensahe sang simpatiya sa nalisdan nga pamilya.#
english: South Upi mayor Mayor Reynalbert Insular — who is also a survivor of three previous ambush attempts — immediately condemned the incident and sent a message of sympathy to the bereaved family.

text: Ginsuportahan sang daku nga medical organization sa Tokyo, Japan ang mga panawagan sa otoridad nga kansehalon anay ang pagpatigayon sang Tokyo Olympics.
english: A major medical organization in Tokyo, Japan has supported calls for the authorities to cancel the Tokyo Olympics.

text: Suno sa Tokyo Medical Practitioners Association nga ginabug-usan sang 6,000 ka primary care doctors, puno na gid ang mga ospital sa ila nga syudad kag wala na sang kapasidad nga magbaton sang dugang nga pasyente bangud nagasaka pa subong ang kaso sang COVID-19 sa Japan.
english: According to the Tokyo Medical Practitioners Association, which consists of 6,000 primary care doctors, hospitals in the city are already full and do not have the capacity to accept more patients as the number of COVID-19 cases in Japan is still rising.

text: Sa sulat nga ginpadala sang organisasyon kay Prime Minister Yoshihide Suga sang Mayo 14, nagpahayag ang grupo nga kuntani kumbinsehon man ang International Olympic Committee nga mabudlay subong ang pag-host sang hinampang kag mas maayo nga ipaiway anay.
english: In a letter sent by the organization to Prime Minister Yoshihide Suga on May 14, the group said it hopes to convince the International Olympic Committee that hosting the games is difficult now and that it is better to postpone it.

text: Una diri, may mga health experts kag medical groups nga nagpamatok man sa pagpatigayon sang hampang sa Olympics kag may online petition nga ginpirmahan sang linibo ka mga tawo.
english: Earlier, health experts and medical groups also opposed the Olympics and an online petition was signed by thousands of people.

text: Naga-kooperar sa kapulisan ang ginakabig nga person of interest sa likod sang kamatayon sang isa ka 41-anyos nga lalaki sa Brgy.
english: The person of interest behind the death of a 41-year-old man in Brgy.

text: Bongol San Miguel, Guimbal, Iloilo.
english: Bongol San Miguel, Guimbal, Iloilo.

text: Sang nagligad sang aga sang nasapwan ang lawas sang biktima sa talamnan sa kun sa diin may igo ini sang pagkatiro sa likod nga naglapos sa tuo nga portion sang iya nga tiyan.
english: The victim's body was found in the field last morning with a gunshot wound to the back that penetrated the right portion of his abdomen.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Corporal Karl Francis Boston, imbestigador sang Guimbal Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga nag-execute man sang affidavit ang person of interest nga magpaidalom ini sa paraffin test kag sa iban pa nga tests nga kinahanglan sang otoridad.
english: Police Corporal Karl Francis Boston, investigator of the Guimbal Municipal Police Station, said the person of interest also executed an affidavit to undergo a paraffin test and other tests required by the authorities.

text: Sa pagpangusisa sang pulis, masabad ang biktima kag may record na sa pagpangawat nga na-settle lamang anay sa lebel sang barangay.
english: According to police investigation, the victim was a robber and had a record of theft that was settled at the barangay level.

text: Ginpahayag man nga nakaagi man sini labo ang hose nga ginagamit sang person of interest sa ila nga patubigan.
english: It was also reported that the hose used by the person of interest in their water supply was also damaged.

text: Gina-establisar pa sang dugang kun ano gid ang motibo sa krimen.
english: The motive of the crime is still being established.

text: Patay ang 64-anyos nga senior citizen matapos maaksidente ang ginamaneho nga motorsiklo sa Brgy.
english: A 64-year-old senior citizen was killed after his motorcycle crashed in Brgy.

text: Aldeguer, Sara, Iloilo.
english: Aldeguer, Sara, Iloilo.

text: Angkas sang senior citizen ang iya anak nga 17-anyos halin sa ila puluy-an sa Brgy.
english: The senior citizen was riding his 17-year-old son from his home in Brgy.

text: Alibayog, Sara kag padulong kuntani sa Pilar, Capiz.
english: Alibayog, Sara and was heading to Pilar, Capiz.

text: Sa pihak naman nga motorsiklo amo ang 33-anyos nga driver kag angkas sini ang 40-anyos nga lalaki kag lunsay residente sa Brgy.
english: On the other motorcycle, the 33-year-old driver and his passenger were a 40-year-old man, both residents of Brgy.

text: Improgo, Sara.
english: I promise, Sarah.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Staff Sergeant Samuel Damate, imbestigador sang Sara Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga nagsaysay ang bata sang senior citizen nga naglain ang pamatyag sini rason nga nadulaan ini sang kontrol kag nakabunggo sa motorsiklo nga yara sa tunga sang karsada nga nagahana magliko.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Staff Sergeant Samuel Damate, investigator of the Sara Municipal Police Station, said the senior citizen's son told him that he felt unwell and lost control and collided with a motorcycle in the middle of the road that was about to turn.

text: Nakaagum ini sang pilas sa nagkalain-lain nga parte sang lawas lakip na ang iya ulo nga gintunaan sang iya kamatayon.
english: He sustained injuries in various parts of his body including his head which led to his death.

text: (Article: Bombo Phauline Pillora)
english: (Article: Bombo Phauline Pillora)

text: Makahalanusbo ang natabo sa isa ka manunudlo matapos nga ginluthang sang iya kaugalingon nga estudyante sa sulod sang ila campus sang Balabagan Trade School sa Barangay Narra, Balabagan, Lanao del Sur.
english: A teacher was shot dead by his own student inside the campus of Balabagan Trade School in Barangay Narra, Balabagan, Lanao del Sur.

text: Base sa mga otoridad, nag-umpisa ang pagpangluthang sa biktima nga si Danilo Barba, 34 anyos matapos nga ginhatagan sang lagbong nga grade ang isa ka subject ni Alias Kaizer, 20-anyos kag Grade 11 student.
english: According to the authorities, the shooting of the victim, Danilo Barba, 34, began after Alias ​​Kaizer, 20, a Grade 11 student, gave a subject a high grade.

text: Suno sa Balabagan Municipal Police Station, mismo ang suspek ang nag-ako sang krimen nga iya nakomiter bangud naakig ini sa manunudlo nga naglagbong sa iya.
english: According to the Balabagan Municipal Police Station, the suspect himself confessed to the crime he committed because he was angry with the teacher who threw him.

text: Base sa imbestigasyon, natabo ang insidente mga alas 8:00 sang aga sang Agosto 4, 2025.
english: Based on the investigation, the incident occurred around 8:00 am on August 4, 2025.

text: Hana na kuntani nga magsulod sa campus si Barba sang ginpunggan ini sang suspek kag gintiro sa ulo gamit ang caliber .45 pistol nga gintunaan sang iya instant death.
english: Barba was about to enter the campus when the suspect stopped him and shot him in the head with a caliber .45 pistol, killing him instantly.

text: Matapos ang krimen, nagpanago ang suspek sa mga himata sa Marogong.
english: After the crime, the suspect hid with relatives in Marogong.

text: Apang sa bulig sang iya utod nga lalaki, isa ka pulis, boluntaryo siya nga nagsungka sa mga awtoridad pagkasunod nga adlaw.
english: But with the help of his brother, a police officer, he voluntarily surrendered to the authorities the next day.

text: Ginapahayag nga indi lamang ang biktima nga isa ka manunudlo ang naglagbong sa suspek kag may iban pa ini nga mga manunudlo nga posible target, apang gin-athag sang suspek nga may kaakig lang siya kay Barba.
english: It is alleged that the victim, a teacher, was not the only one who stabbed the suspect and that there were other teachers who were possible targets, but the suspect explained that he was just angry with Barba.

text: Sa subong, may mga pulis kag suldado nga na-assign nga magbulig sa pagbantay sa eskwelahan.
english: Currently, there are police and soldiers assigned to help guard the school.

text:
Ginklaro sang Malacañang nga indi batok sa Marcos administration ang pagboto sang Senado nga i-archive ang impeachment case batok kay Vice President Sara Duterte

Suno kay Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Claire Castro, wala man sang kahilabtanan ang Executive Department sa impeachment process.
english:
Malacañang clarified that the Senate's vote to archive the impeachment case against Vice President Sara Duterte is not against the Marcos administration

Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Claire Castro said the Executive Department has nothing to do with the impeachment process.

text: Ginpaathag sini nga ang Kamara amo ang nagsumite sang Articles of Impeachment kag indi ang ehekutibo ukon si President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: He explained that it was the House that submitted the Articles of Impeachment and not the executive or President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.

text: “Hindi ang ehekutibo ang nagsampa o nag-submit ng Articles of Impeachment kundi ang House of Representatives,” suno kay Castro.
english: “It was not the executive that filed or submitted the Articles of Impeachment but the House of Representatives,” Castro said.

text: Kun may ginkontra man ang boto sang Senado, ini amo ang prosecution team sang lower chamber kag indi ang presidente, dugang pa sang Palace official.
english: If there is anything against the Senate vote, it is the prosecution team of the lower chamber and not the president, the Palace official added.

text: “So kung meron mang dito na sinasabi ang desisyon ay laban, laban kanino?
english: “So if there is anything here that says the decision is against, against whom?

text: Most probably hindi sa administrasyon ni Pangulong Marcos Jr.,” pahayag sini.
english: Most probably not in the administration of President Marcos Jr.,” he said.

text: Matandaan nga may nauna na nga ruling ang Korte Suprema nga nagasiling nga unconstitutional ang articles of impeachment.
english: It can be recalled that the Supreme Court has already ruled that the articles of impeachment are unconstitutional.

text: May tatlo naman ka motions for reconsideration nga gin-file agud hingyuon sa mga mahistrado nga baliskadon ang ila nga desisyon.
english: Three motions for reconsideration were filed to ask the judges to reverse their decision.

text: Kun maka-desisyon man ang High Court sa motion for reconsideration, respetuhon ini ni Marcos suno pa kay Castro.
english: If the High Court decides on the motion for reconsideration, Marcos will respect it, Castro said.

text: “Noon pa natin sinagot ito.
english: “We answered that a long time ago.

text: Kung anuman ang magiging desisyon ng Supreme Court yan ay igagalang ng Pangulo, ng Ehekutibo.
english: Whatever the Supreme Court decides, it will be respected by the President, by the Executive.

text: Bakit?
english: Why?

text: Because the Supreme Court is the final arbiter of any legal issues,” pahayag sini.#
english: Because the Supreme Court is the final arbiter of any legal issues,” he said.

text: Magabalik sa Pilipinas ang Jr.
english: Jr. will return to the Philippines.

text: NBA — ang global youth basketball program sang National Basketball Association pinaagi sa Jr.
english: NBA — the global youth basketball program of the National Basketball Association through Jr.

text: NBA Philippines online clinics.
english: NBA Philippines online clinics.

text: Ang serye sang virtual basketball clinics para sa 13 tubtob 17 anyos nga mga kabataan sa pungsod ang maga-umpisa sa Mayo 29 kag Hunyo 12.
english: A series of virtual basketball clinics for 13 to 17-year-olds in the country will begin on May 29 and June 12.

text: Sanday Filipino-American guards Jordan Clarkson sang Utah Jazz kag Jalen Green sang NBA G League Ignite, ang maga-upod sa Jr.
english: Filipino-American guards Jordan Clarkson of the Utah Jazz and Jalen Green of the NBA G League Ignite, will join Jr.

text: NBA coaches sa pagpamuno sa Filipino youth pinaagi sa basketball drills.
english: NBA coaches to lead Filipino youth through basketball drills.

text: Magapartisipar man sa life session kag magadiscuss sang importansya sang fundamental skills training sa ila professional careers sanday Clarkson kag Green sa online event sa Mayo 29.
english: Clarkson and Green will also participate in the life session and discuss the importance of fundamental skills training in their professional careers during the May 29 online event.

text: Ginapaabot nga magsulod si Severe Tropical Storm “Podul” sa Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) sa masunod nga 24 oras.
english: Severe Tropical Storm “Podul” is expected to enter the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility (PAR) in the next 24 hours.

text: Suno sa alas dos sa hapon nga weather advisory sang PAGASA, nakit-an si Podul sa kalayuon nga 1,615 kilometros nasidlangan sang Extreme Northern Luzon.
english: According to the 2 pm weather advisory of PAGASA, Podul was spotted 1,615 kilometers east of Extreme Northern Luzon.

text:
Dala sini ang kabaskugon sang hangin nga 110 km/h kag nagahulag pa-nakatundan sa kadasigon nga 20 km/h.

Base naman sa 11 a.m. tropical cyclone advisory, padayon nga nagadasig si Podul samtang nga ginapabilin man ang kabaskugon sini.
english:
It carries winds of 110 km/h and is moving westward at 20 km/h.

Based on the 11 a.m. tropical cyclone advisory, Podul continues to intensify while maintaining its strength.

text: Kun opisyal na nga makasulod sa PAR, pagatawgon ini nga si “Gorio”.
english: When it officially enters the PAR, it will be called “Gorio”.

text: “PODUL is forecast to move generally westward today and tomorrow (11 August), then west northwestward or northwestward from Tuesday (12 August) through the end of the forecast period.
english: “PODUL is forecast to move generally westward today and tomorrow (11 August), then west northwestward or northwestward from Tuesday (12 August) through the end of the forecast period.

text: PODUL may enter the Philippine Area of Responsibility between tonight and tomorrow early morning,” suno sa weather bureau.
english: PODUL may enter the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility between tonight and tomorrow early morning,” the weather bureau said.

text: Sandig sa general outlook para sa forecast period sang PAGASA, manubo ang tyansa nga direkta nga maapektuhan sang bagyo ang weather and sea conditions sa pungsod sa masunod nga lima ka adlaw.
english: According to the general outlook for the forecast period of PAGASA, there is little chance that the typhoon will directly affect the weather and sea conditions in the country in the next five days.

text: “On the track forecast, PODUL may pass close or over the southern Ryukyu Islands on Wednesday (13 August) morning.
english: “On the track forecast, PODUL may pass close or over the southern Ryukyu Islands on Wednesday (13 August) morning.

text: Furthermore, a landfall scenario over Taiwan on Wednesday afternoon or evening is also not ruled out,” pahayag sang PAGASA.
english: Furthermore, a landfall scenario over Taiwan on Wednesday afternoon or evening is also not ruled out,” PAGASA said.

text: Padayon nga ginapahanumdom sang ahensya sa public and disaster risk reduction and management offices nga magpadayon sa monitoring para sa updates sa dalagan sang tyempo.#
english: The agency continues to remind public and disaster risk reduction and management offices to continue monitoring for updates as time goes on.

text: Doble nga disgrasya gid ang naabtan sang isa ka lalaki matapos nga naaksidente sa motorsiklo sa Dumangas, Iloilo kag sang ulihi nakuhaan pa gid sang 40 gramos sang ginapasuni shabu.
english: A man was involved in a double accident after he was involved in a motorcycle accident in Dumangas, Iloilo and was later recovered with 40 grams of suspected shabu.

text: Ini amo si alias Niloy, 32, residente sang Barangay Lacturan sa amo man nga banwa.
english: This is alias Niloy, 32, resident of Barangay Lacturan in the same town.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Staff Sergeant Josebel Doromal, imbestigador sang Dumangas Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga halin sa Lacturan padulong sa Sapao ang direksyon ni alias Niloy sang nakabunggo ini sa isa pa ka motorsiklo bangud nagsaylo ini sang lane.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Staff Sergeant Josebel Doromal, investigator of the Dumangas Municipal Police Station, said alias Niloy was heading from Lacturan to Sapao when he collided with another motorcycle because he changed lanes.

text: Base sa mga nakakita, madasig ang pagpadalagan sini sang motorsiklo antes ang insidente kag ginapatihan nga posible nakainom sang makahulubog nga ilimnon.
english: According to witnesses, he was driving fast before the incident and is believed to have been under the influence of alcohol.

text: Gindala ini sa ospital sa Barotac Nuevo kag sang ginbukad ang iya bag agud kuntani mausisa kun may yara sang Identification Card, nakit-an sang pulis ang plastic sachets sang suspected shabu.
english: He was taken to the hospital in Barotac Nuevo and when his bag was opened to check for identification card, the police found plastic sachets of suspected shabu.

text: Magluwas diri, may yara sang isa ka sachet sang amo man nga iligal nga droga sa iya bulsa kag ginapatihan may standard drug price nga P272,000.
english: In addition, he had a sachet of the same illegal drugs in his pocket and believed to have a standard drug price of P272,000.

text: Gin-refer ini sa ospital sa Pototan bangud ginpahayag nga na-utod ang tul-an sini sa paa.
english: He was referred to the hospital in Pototan because he reportedly broke a bone in his leg.

text: Base sa record sang pulis, na-preso man sadto si alias Niloy bangud man sa kaangtanan sa iligal nga droga.
english: According to police records, alias Niloy was also jailed for illegal drugs.

text: Nagsaka na sa 33 ang tally sang congressional Democrats ang nagpanawagan kay President Joe Biden nga mag-atras na sa iya kampanya nga magpa-reelect bilang presidente sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: The tally of congressional Democrats who have called on President Joe Biden to withdraw from his campaign for re-election as president of the United States of America has risen to 33.

text: Magluwas pa ini sa grupo sang masobra 50 ka former U.S. foreign kag national security officials nga nagpanawagan sa 81-anyos nga Democrat leader nga indi na pagdayunon ang iya kandidatura — lakip na si Anthony Lake nga anay national security advisor ni former President Bill Clinton.
english: This is in addition to a group of more than 50 former U.S. foreign and national security officials who have called on the 81-year-old Democrat leader not to pursue his candidacy — including Anthony Lake, a former national security adviser to former President Bill Clinton.

text: Ginsaad sang grupo nga ang mga isyu nga nagapalibot kay Biden kag ang daku nga tyansa sa electoral college victory para kay Donald Trump amo ang rason nga mabutang sa risgo ang national security accomplishments kag mga legasiya sang Democrats.
english: The group promised that the issues surrounding Biden and the high chance of an electoral college victory for Donald Trump would put the Democrats' national security accomplishments and legacies at risk.

text: Masobra naman sa 14% sang Democratic House caucus ang nagsiling nga gusto nila ang lain nga nominee nga magaatubang kay Trump nga amo na ang opisyal nga presidential candidate sang Republicans.
english: More than 14% of the Democratic House caucus said they wanted a different nominee to face Trump, who is now the Republicans' official presidential candidate.

text: Nahibaluan nga naka-isolate subong si Biden sa iya beach house sa Rehoboth, Delaware matapos nagpositibo sa Covid-19 infection apang ginpahayag nga nag-improve na ang kondisyon sini magluwas lamang sa ginasuprer pa sini nga pag-ubo.
english: Biden is currently in isolation at his beach house in Rehoboth, Delaware after testing positive for Covid-19 infection but his condition has reportedly improved except for a cough.

text: Ginkilala bilang isa sa mga World Chess Hall of Fame sang World Chess Federation si Filipino Grandmaster Eugene Torre.
english: Filipino Grandmaster Eugene Torre has been recognized as one of the World Chess Hall of Fame by the World Chess Federation.

text: Siya ang labing una nga lalaki gikan sa Asya nga nakabaton sang nasambit nga pasidungog.
english: He is the first man from Asia to receive the award.

text: Suno kay Torre, bugal para sa iya nga siya ang labing una nga Asian male player nga nominado sa World Chess Federation.
english: Torre said he is proud to be the first Asian male player to be nominated by the World Chess Federation.

text: Ang importante pahayag niya, nahatagan man sang pagkilala ang mga Asyano sa chess nga sa pagkamatuod mas beterano pa ang mga Russians, Americans kag Europeans sa nasambit nga hampang.
english: The important thing, he said, is that Asians have also been given recognition in chess, which is actually more veteran than Russians, Americans and Europeans in the game.

text: Kaupod ni Torre nga yara sa exclusive list sang mga players nga nalakip sa Chess Hall of Fame amo sanday French chess player Alexander Alekhine, Russian chess player Anatoly Karpov kag Russian chess grandmaster Garry Kasparov.
english: With Torre on the exclusive list of players inducted into the Chess Hall of Fame are French chess player Alexander Alekhine, Russian chess player Anatoly Karpov and Russian chess grandmaster Garry Kasparov.

text: Nahibaluan nga si Torre ang nangin labing una nga grandmaster sang Asya sa edad nga 22 sang 1974 kag nalakip sa Philippine Sports Hall of Fame sang 2016.
english: Torre became the first Asian grandmaster at the age of 22 in 1974 and was inducted into the Philippine Sports Hall of Fame in 2016.

text: Ginakasubo sang pamilya sang tatlo ka mga menor de edad nga mga kabataan nga lunsay mga lalaki matapos nga ginsunog sang ila kaugalingon nga iloy sa Bulacan.
english: The families of three minor children, all boys, are mourning after they were burned by their own mother in Bulacan.

text: Ginkilala ang iloy kay alyas Joyce kag nakapamana kay Kim Aspero nga residente sang Brgy.
english: The mother was identified as alias Joyce and married to Kim Aspero, resident of Brgy.

text: Managupaya, Banate, Iloilo, kag apo sang anay punong barangay sang nasambit nga lugar.
english: Managupaya, Banate, Iloilo, and grandson of the former barangay captain of the said area.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Lea Allado Silahis, tiya sang amay sang mga kabataan, iya ginpahayag nga grabi gid ang iya kaluoy sa naabtan sang iya mga apo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Lea Allado Silahis, aunt of the children's father, said she is very sorry for what happened to her grandchildren.

text: Suno kay Silahis, ginkadenahan sang iloy ang duha niya ka mga kabataan sa sulod sang comfort room kag ginsaraduhan.
english: According to Silahis, the mother chained her two children inside the comfort room and locked it.

text: Samtang, ginbubuan naman sang iloy ang hiligdaan sang iya agot nga bata sang gas kag ginsindutan, kun sa diin nasunog gid ang bilog nila nga puluy-an.
english: Meanwhile, the mother poured gas on her youngest son's bed and set it on fire, which burned down their entire house.

text: Dugang pa ni Silahis, napatay gilayon ang ikaduha kag ikatatlo nga anak, samtang nadala pa sa hospital ang subang nga bata kun sa diin nakahambal pa sang tinaga nga “I love you Dady” sa iya amay bag-o pa ini ginbawian sang kabuhi.
english: Silahis said the second and third children died immediately, while the youngest child was taken to the hospital where he said “I love you Dady” to his father before he died.

text: Ginpakigbahin man ni Silahis nga nakabati siya sadto sang estorya nga ang pamilya sang babaye ang may mga deperensya sa paminsaron, kun sa diin isa man ini sa ginalantaw sang pamilya nga rason sa ginhimo nga krimen.
english: Silahis also shared that he heard the story that the woman's family had mental disorders, which is also one of the reasons the family believes in the crime.

text: Nagkarab-karab ang duha ka daku nga oil tankers matapos nga nagbungguanay malapit sa Singapore — ang pinakadaku nga oil trading hub sa Asya kag pinakadaku man nga bunkering port sa kalibutan.
english: Two large oil tankers collided near Singapore — Asia's largest oil trading hub and the world's largest bunkering port.

text: Suno sa otoridad kag isa sa mga tag-iya sang tankers, gin-airlift lang agud madala sa ospital ang duha ka crew members samtang na-rescue naman ang iban sa ila kaupdanan.
english: According to authorities and one of the owners of the tankers, the two crew members were airlifted to hospital while the others were rescued.

text: Sandig sa dugang nga impormasyon halin sa Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (MPA), involved sa ini nga insidente ang Singapore-flagged tanker nga Hafnia Nile kag ang Sao Tome and Principe-flagged tanker nga Ceres I. Ginabanta nga yara na ang mga ini sa 55 km (34 miles) naamin-nasidlangan sang isla nga Pedra Branca sang natabo ang pagbungguanay.
english: According to additional information from the Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (MPA), the Singapore-flagged tanker Hafnia Nile and the Sao Tome and Principe-flagged tanker Ceres I were involved in the incident. collision.

text:
Hilway na sa katalagman ang 22 ka crew members sang Hafnia Nile amo man ang 40 nga yara sa Ceres I.

Kasunod sini, nag-anunsyo man ang environmental authorities sa Malaysia nga gin-abisuhan na sila nga magpreparar sa posible magluntad nga pagtagas sang langis ukon oil spill.
english:
The 22 crew members of Hafnia Nile are safe, as are the 40 on board Ceres I.

Subsequently, environmental authorities in Malaysia also announced that they have been warned to prepare for a possible oil spill.

text: Ginapahayag nga ang tanker nga si Hafnia Nile ang nagakarga sang 300,000 barrels sang naphtha, samtang ang Ceres I ang gina-alegar may karga nga 2 million barrels sang Iranian crude.
english: The tanker Hafnia Nile was reportedly carrying 300,000 barrels of naphtha, while the Ceres I was allegedly carrying 2 million barrels of Iranian crude.
