text: Ginkilala nga kampyeon ang E-Gilas Pilipinas sa bag-o lang natapos nga Southeast Asian Conference sang FIBA Esports Open III.
english: E-Gilas Pilipinas was recognized as the champion of the recently concluded Southeast Asian Conference of the FIBA ​​Esports Open III.

text: Ini matapos ginpierde sang Pilipinas ang Indonesia sa best of three finals sa score nga 60-53.
english: This is after the Philippines defeated Indonesia in the best of three finals with a score of 60-53.

text: Nagpanguna sa pagdaog si Angelico ‘Shinataro’ Cruzin.
english: Angelico ‘Shinataro’ Cruzin led the way to victory.

text: Ginpahayag naman sang coach nga si Rial Polog Jr nga tuman man ang ila pagpanghanda sa amo nga hampang batok sa Indonesia.
english: Coach Rial Polog Jr. said they are well prepared for the match against Indonesia.

text: Antes makasulod sa finals, ginlampaso man anay sang Pilipinas ang Mongolia sa best of three semifinals 95-35 kag 64-53 sa Game 2.
english: Before reaching the finals, the Philippines also beat Mongolia in the best of three semifinals 95-35 and 64-53 in Game 2.

text: Nahibaluan nga 60 ka mga team ang yara sa amo nga hampang.
english: It is known that 60 teams are in the game.

text: Isa si Msgr.
english: One is Msgr.

text: Meliton Oso, director sang Jaro Archdiocesan Social Action Center, sa mga nagalaom nga baliskadon sang Supreme Court ang nauna nga ruling sini nga “unconstitutional” ang articles of impeachment batok kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: Meliton Oso, director of the Jaro Archdiocesan Social Action Center, to those who hope that the Supreme Court will overturn its previous ruling that the articles of impeachment against Vice President Sara Duterte are “unconstitutional”.

text:
Pahayag ni Oso matapos gindala man ang isyu sa iya homily sa Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral subong nga aga, Agusto 10: “Kun masanagan sila kag mahatagan sang husto nga information, I think bag-uhon nila ang ila nga desisyon.”

Panawagan sini sa publiko: “Tun-an naton nga mga Pilipino ang isyu [sa impeachment], and speak out.
english:
Oso said after the issue was also brought up in his homily at the Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral this morning, August 10: “If they are enlightened and given the right information, I think they will change their decision.”

Its appeal to the public: “Let us Filipinos study the issue [of impeachment], and speak out.

text:
Ipaabot naton sa ila kun ano ang nakita naton nga kamatuoran.”

Matandaan nga nagboto ang Korte Suprema, 13-0-2, kag nagsaad nga ang Articles of Impeachment ang barred sang one-year rule sa idalom sang Article XI Section 3 paragraph 5 sang Constitution.
english:
We will tell them what we have found to be true.”

It can be recalled that the Supreme Court voted, 13-0-2, and promised that the Articles of Impeachment are barred by the one-year rule under Article XI Section 3 paragraph 5 of the Constitution.

text: Ginsiling man sang mga mahistrado nga ang articles sang Kamara ang naglapas sa right to due process.
english: The judges also said the articles of the House violated the right to due process.

text: Apang nagalaom si Oso nga masanagan ang mga mahistrado paagi pag-repaso sa ila ruling.
english: But Oso hopes to enlighten the judges by reviewing their ruling.

text: Gindala man sini sa panawagan ang mga Senador matapos nga nagboto ang upper chamber, 19-4-1, agud nga i-archive ang articles of impeachment.
english: He also called on the Senators after the upper chamber voted, 19-4-1, to archive the articles of impeachment.

text: “We pray nga masanagan ang justices sang Supreme Court kag ang aton nga Senado, kay tanan kita suluguon sang Diyos.
english: “We pray that the justices of the Supreme Court and our Senate will be enlightened, because we are all servants of God.

text: Timbang.
english: Weigh.

text: Timbang.
english: Weigh.

text: Klaro nga ang kabubut-on sang Diyos ang dapat masunod.
english: Clearly, God's will must be done.

text: That is why we ask the justices of the Supreme Court: ‘Ginasunod niyo bala ang kabubut-on sang inyo Master nga amo ang Ginuong Hesukristo?’ Ang mga senador, ginapamangkot man naton, ‘Ginasunod niyo bala ang kabubut-on sang inyo Master nga amo si Kristo, ukon ang inyo nga ambisyon ang inyo ginaprotektahan inyo?’,” dugang ni Oso.
english: That is why we ask the justices of the Supreme Court: 'Are you following the will of your Master who is the Lord Jesus Christ?' Senators, we also ask, 'Are you following the will of your Master who is Christ, or are you protecting your own ambition?',” Oso added.

text: Tatlo ka motions for reconsideration ang napasaka na sa Korte Suprema agud nga hingyuon ang justices nga baliskadon ang ila nauna nga desisyon.#
english: Three motions for reconsideration have already been filed in the Supreme Court to ask the justices to reverse their previous decision.

text: Nadakpan sang Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) Iloilo kag Mandurriao Police Station ang isa ka security guard bangud sang iligal nga pagbaligya sang armas sa Barangay Q. Abeto Mirasol, Mandurriao, Iloilo City.
english: The Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) Iloilo and Mandurriao Police Station arrested a security guard for illegal sale of firearms in Barangay Q. Abeto Mirasol, Mandurriao, Iloilo City.

text: Ang arestado amo si Stephen Brito, 35, residente sang Barangay Rizal Pala-Pala 1, City Proper.
english: The arrested was identified as Stephen Brito, 35, resident of Barangay Rizal Pala-Pala 1, City Proper.

text: Sandig sa accomplishment report sang CIDG, nabaklan sang poseur buyer ang suspek sang duha ka units sang caliber .45 pistol kag isa ka unit sang caliber .38 revolver.
english: According to the accomplishment report of the CIDG, the poseur buyer bought the suspect two units of caliber .45 pistol and one unit of caliber .38 revolver.

text: Nakumpiska man sa sulod sang armored vehicle nga gingamit sang suspek amo ang isa ka unit sang 12 gauge shotgun.
english: Also confiscated from the armored vehicle used by the suspect was a unit of 12 gauge shotgun.

text: Nagapangatubang ang amo nga security guard sang kaso nga paglapas sa Republic Act 10591 ukon Comprehensive Law on Firearms and Ammunitions Regulation Act.
english: The security guard is facing charges of violating Republic Act 10591 or the Comprehensive Law on Firearms and Ammunitions Regulation Act.

text: Target ni Senate Finance Committee chairperson Sherwin Gatchalian na ang pondo para sa sektor ng edukasyon sa 2026 ay umabot o lumampas pa sa katumbas na apat na porsyento ng gross domestic product o GDP, alinsunod sa internasyonal na pamantayan.
english: Senate Finance Committee chairperson Sherwin Gatchalian targets that funding for the education sector by 2026 will reach or exceed the equivalent of four percent of gross domestic product or GDP, in line with international standards.

text: Giit ni Gatchalian, gagawin niya ang lahat ng paraan upang maisakatuparan ito bilang hakbang sa pagtugon sa krisis sa edukasyon.
english: Gatchalian insisted that he will do everything possible to implement it as a step towards responding to the education crisis.

text: Paliwanag niya, bibigyang-prayoridad ang edukasyon nang hindi isinasantabi ang ibang sektor.
english: He explained that education will be given priority without neglecting other sectors.

text: Ayon sa mambabatas, ang panukalang ₱6.793 trilyong badyet para sa susunod na taon ay tututok sa pagpapalakas ng literacy at numeracy mula kindergarten hanggang Grade 3, pagpapatuloy ng Academic Recovery and Accessible Learning o ARAL Program, at pagbabalik ng cost-sharing scheme sa pagpapatayo ng mga silid-aralan.
english: According to the lawmaker, the proposed ₱6.793 trillion budget for next year will focus on strengthening literacy and numeracy from kindergarten to Grade 3, continuing the Academic Recovery and Accessible Learning or ARAL Program, and restoring the cost-sharing scheme for education.

text: Plano rin ang pag-hire ng mas maraming teacher aides upang maibsan ang non-teaching tasks ng mga guro.
english: There are also plans to hire more teacher aides to reduce the non-teaching tasks of teachers.

text: Matagal nang panawagan ng mga guro ang pagtaas ng pondo sa edukasyon ng hindi bababa sa 4% ng GDP, na minsang kinuwestiyon dahil sa pagsama ng budget para sa military at police academies.
english: Teachers have long called for an increase in education funding of no less than 4% of GDP, which has sometimes been questioned because of the combined budget for military and police academies.

text: Nag-issue si Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr.
english: Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr. issued.

text: sang Executive Order No.
english: of Executive Order No.

text: 42 nga naga-implementar sang “Limpyo Eleksyon for MoRProGRes”.
english: 42 implementing “Clean Elections for MoRProGRes”.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Defensor, iya ginpahayag nga ang executive order isa ka post-election waste management program sang probinsya kun sa diin, nagamandu ini sa tanan nga mga kandidato, political parties, kag mga party-list organizations nga nagpartisipar sa eleksyon, nga magpakigbahin sa pagpanglimpyo kag tsakto nga paghaboy sang mga campaign materials nga ginpanggamit.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Defensor said the executive order is a post-election waste management program of the province where it directs all candidates, political parties, and party-list organizations that participated in the election, to participate in the cleaning and proper disposal of campaign materials used.

text: Suno kay Defensor ang proper collection kag disposal sang basura ang dapat sundon suno sa Republic Act 9003 ukon Ecological Solid Waste Management Act of 2000.
english: Defensor said the proper collection and disposal of waste should be followed in accordance with Republic Act 9003 or Ecological Solid Waste Management Act of 2000.

text: Nagmadu man si Defensor nga pangkakson ang tanan nga mga campaign materials nga nahamtang sa mga karsada kag pampubliko nga lugar.
english: Defensor also ordered the removal of all campaign materials located on the streets and public places.

text: Magluwas diri, ang Limpyo Eleksyon isa man ka pamaagi agud suportahan ang Balik-Alat Program sang gobernador nga nagaengganyo sa paggamit sang mga reusable kag eco-friendly nga basket, imbes nga single-use plastics.
english: Besides, the Limpyo Eleksyon is also a way to support the governor's Balik-Alat Program which encourages the use of reusable and eco-friendly baskets, instead of single-use plastics.

text: Ang mga nakuha nga campaign materials ipaturn-over sa mga community-based organizations para i-upcycle kag himuon nga mga bag, pouch, kag wallet.
english: Captured campaign materials will be turned-over to community-based organizations to be upcycled and made into bags, pouches, and wallets.

text: Nagsabat ang bag-o nga foreign minister sang Taiwan nga dapat magmato-mato na lamang sila kag saligan ang ila kaugalingon nga isla nga maprotektahan ang ila kaugalingon samtang nga nagataas ang tensyon sini batok sa China.
english: Taiwan's new foreign minister replied that they should be patient and trust their own island to protect itself as tensions against China rise.

text: Ginpahayag ini ni Taiwanese foreign minister Lin Chia-lung matapos nga nagguwa ang interview kay anay US President kag subong Republican presidential candidate Donald Trump kun sa diin ginpahayag sini nga dapat magbayad ang Taiwan sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika bangud sa depensa nga ila ginahatag kaangot sa kumplikto sa Beijing.
english: Taiwanese foreign minister Lin Chia-lung made the remarks after an interview with former US President and current Republican presidential candidate Donald Trump appeared in which he said Taiwan should pay the United States of America for the defense they provide in connection with the conflict in Beijing.

text: Suno kay Lin, seryoso ang ila paghangop sa nangin komento ni Trump.
english: Lin said they take Trump's comments seriously.

text: Kaangot diri suno sa iya, ginpasaka na sang Taiwan ang ila military budget kag ginalauman nga magataas pa gid ini sa masunod nga mga tinuig indi lamang para makabakal sang dugang nga mga armas kundi agud ma-establisar man ang mga pagbag-o sa militar.
english: In this regard, he said, Taiwan has already increased its military budget and is expected to increase it in the coming years not only to purchase more weapons but also to stabilize military changes.

text: Nahibaluan nga gina-claim sang China ang Taiwan nga kabahin pa sang ila teritoryo rason nga mas ginapasangkad nila ang ila military presence sa amo nga isla.
english: China claims Taiwan as part of its territory and is expanding its military presence on the island.

text: Ang Estados Unidos naman ang isa sa pinakadaku nga kaalyado sang Taiwan, kag sang damlag lang, gin-aprubahan sang Biden administration ang multi-billion-dollar military aid package para nga mabatuan sang Taiwan ang China.
english: The United States is one of Taiwan's biggest allies, and the Biden administration recently approved a multi-billion-dollar military aid package for Taiwan to fight China.

text: Bangud sa nangin komento ni Trump nga dapat magbayad ang Taiwan sa Amerika, una na nga ginpahayag sang analysts nga posible maapektuhan sini ang relasyon sang Washington kag Taipei ilabi na kun si Trump ang magdaog sa November 2024 presidential elections.
english: Trump's comments that Taiwan should pay the United States have earlier said that this could affect relations between Washington and Taipei especially if Trump wins the November 2024 presidential elections.

text: Indi pagbuksan sang Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) ang 46th season sang liga subong nga bulan sang Abril.
english: The Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) will not open the 46th season of the league this April.

text: Suno kay PBA commissioner Willie Marcial, bangud sang pagpatuman sang enhanced community quarantine (ECQ) sa Metro Manila kag kaiping nga mga probinsya, ang liga ang yara subong sa wait and see-mode may kaangtanan sa ila nga mga plano.
english: According to PBA commissioner Willie Marcial, due to the implementation of enhanced community quarantine (ECQ) in Metro Manila and neighboring provinces, the league is now in wait and see-mode regarding their plans.

text: Hulaton suno kay Marcial nga ma-lift na ang ECQ sa Abril 11 antes sila magpatigayon sang board meeting para sa ila masunod nga mga tikang para sa liga.
english: Marcial said they will wait until the ECQ is lifted on April 11 before they hold a board meeting for their next steps for the league.

text: Suno kay Marcial, kinahanglan nga hatagan ang mga teams sang duha tubtob tatlo ka semana nga practice antes mag-umpisa ang season.
english: Marcial said teams need to be given two to three weeks of practice before the season starts.

text: Gani kun magaplano pa lang ang PBA sa opening sang season subong nga Abril, indi na ini magsanto sa schedule.
english: So if the PBA is still planning for the opening of the season this April, it will not fit the schedule.

text: Ang pinakatemprano nga opening of season ang posible patigayunon sa Mayo apang depende pa sa COVID-19 situation sa NCR Plus area.
english: The earliest opening of season is likely to be held in May but it depends on the COVID-19 situation in the NCR Plus area.

text: 𝗔𝗨𝗦𝗧𝗥𝗔𝗟𝗜𝗔 — Nagpatawag ang Australian Federal Government sang pagsinapol kasunod sang lapnagon nga computer outage nga ginakontrolar sang Microsoft Windows operating system.
english: 𝗔𝗨𝗦𝗧𝗥𝗔𝗟𝗜𝗔 — The Australian Federal Government has called a meeting following a widespread computer outage controlled by the Microsoft Windows operating system.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Bombo Denmark Suede, International Correspondent sa Australia, iya ginpahayag nga indi lang ang pungsod Australia ang naka-eksperyensya sang amo nga hitabo bangud halos bug-os nga kalibutan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Bombo Denmark Suede, International Correspondent in Australia, said that Australia is not the only country that experienced the incident because almost the whole world.

text: Suno kay Suede, lakip man sa outage ang mga kumpanya nga nakabase sa Pilipinas, bangud sa mga report nga ang ila mga operasyon ang apektado sang problema sa serbisyo sang Microsoft kahapon nga adlaw.
english: Suede said companies based in the Philippines were also included in the outage, due to reports that their operations were affected by Microsoft's service problem yesterday.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga ginaimbestigaran na sang Microsoft ang amo nga issue agud nga liwat nga mabalik sa tayuyon ang mga operasyon sang system.
english: He also said that Microsoft is investigating the issue in order to restore the system's operations.

text: Ginakabig naman sang Australia nga isa ka national security threat ang natabo nga kinahanglan gilayon nga hatagan sang igtalupangod.
english: Australia considers the incident a national security threat that requires immediate attention.

text: Dako naman nga kapierdehan sa ekonomiya sang Australia ang natabo nga outage, ilabi na sa mga online banking.
english: The outage was a huge loss to the Australian economy, especially in online banking.

text: Wala naman sang may ginpaguwa nga pahayag ang technology provider nga CrowdStrike, nga nagtuga sang pag-untat sang sistema sang Microsoft sa bug-os nga kalibutan.
english: Technology provider CrowdStrike, which caused a global system outage for Microsoft, did not issue a statement.

text: Apektado naman ang iban pa nga mga negosyo sa Pilipinas kaangay na lamang sang mga airlines nga Cebu Pacific kag Air Asia.
english: Other businesses in the Philippines such as airlines Cebu Pacific and Air Asia were also affected.

text: Nahibaluan nga outage reporting website downdetector.com ang nagapakita man sang pagdamo sang mga user nga nagareport sang mga outage sa cloud computing platform sang Microsoft nga Azure, kag ang iya office productivity suite 365.
english: It is known that outage reporting website downdetector.com is also showing an increase in users reporting outages to Microsoft’s cloud computing platform Azure, and its office productivity suite 365.

text: Kritikal ang isa ka babayi matapos gintiro sang iya utod sa Barangay, Tigmarabo, Miagao, Iloilo.
english: A woman is critically injured after being shot by her brother in Barangay, Tigmarabo, Miagao, Iloilo.

text: Ang biktima amo si Lee Ann Moro, 33, samtang ang suspek amo si Rodel Moro, 38, kag lunsay residente sang nasambit lugar.
english: The victim was identified as Lee Ann Moro, 33, while the suspect was identified as Rodel Moro, 38, both residents of the said area.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Richard Lao, hepe sang Miagao Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga nakabaton sila sang report nga may yara sang shooting incident sa nasambit nga lugar, kun sa diin gilayon man nila nga ginrespondehan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Richard Lao, chief of Miagao Municipal Police Station, said they received a report that there was a shooting incident in the area, which they immediately responded to.

text: Suno kay Lao, gilayon man sila nga nagpatigayon sang hot pursuit operation rason nga madasig nadakpan ang suspek.
english: Lao said they immediately conducted a hot pursuit operation and quickly arrested the suspect.

text: Dugang pa sang natungdan, madugay na nga wala naga-ilintindihanay ang mag-utod, kun sa diin nagbaisay pa ini sila antes matabo ang nasambit nga insidente.
english: He added that the brothers had been misunderstanding each other for a long time, where they had an argument before the incident.

text: Ginkumpirmar man ni Lao nga wala sang bala kag mga basiyo nga na-recover sa ginluntaran sang insidente kag base sa pagpangusisa sang mga kapulisan sa suspek, ginhaboy niya ang pusil nga iya gingamit.
english: Lao also confirmed that no bullets and ammunition were recovered from the scene of the incident and based on police questioning of the suspect, he threw away the gun he used.

text: Sa subong, yara na sa kustodiya sang Miagao MPS ang suspek kag nagapangatubang sang kaso nga frustrated homicide.
english: The suspect is now in the custody of Miagao MPS and is facing charges of frustrated homicide.

text: Amat-amat na nga nagarekover ang ekonomiya sang Pilipinas sa tunga sang pagpahalog sang mga quarantine restrictions bangud sa COVID-19 pandemic.
english: The Philippine economy is slowly recovering amid the lifting of quarantine restrictions due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Suno kay Department of Finance Undersecretary Gil Beltran, 12.6 percent nalang ang narecord nga pagnubo sang merchandise trade sa pungsod sang Oktubre.
english: According to Department of Finance Undersecretary Gil Beltran, merchandise trade in the country recorded a decline of 12.6 percent in October.

text: May improvement na diri suno kay Beltran ipaanggid sa 59.5 percent nga pagsusurot sang merchandise trade sang Abril 2020 sang ginpaidalom ang Luzon kag iban pa nga bahin sang pungsod sa tuman ka hugot nga mga mobility restrictions.
english: Beltran said there is an improvement compared to the 59.5 percent increase in merchandise trade in April 2020 when Luzon and other parts of the country were placed under strict mobility restrictions.

text: Pahayag ni Beltran, lakip man diri ang exports kag imports sang mga produkto sa diin 65.3 percent ang pagdecline sang Abril.
english: Beltran said this includes exports and imports of products which declined by 65.3 percent in April.

text: Nagapati si Beltran nga samtang nagahulat ang pungsod sang COVID-19 vaccine, kinahanglanan buksan man sang gobyerno ang iban nga sektor sang ekonomiya.
english: Beltran believes that while the country is waiting for the COVID-19 vaccine, the government needs to open up other sectors of the economy.

text: Dugang pa sang natungdan, dapat nga i-adopt sang Pilipinas ang mga economic reform agud makaganyat sang investments.
english: He added that the Philippines should adopt economic reforms to attract investments.

text: Nagabilib si Gilas Pilipinas program director Tab Baldwin sa 18-anyos nga teen sensation nga si Kai Sotto kag sa iya development sa hampang sa basketball.
english: Gilas Pilipinas program director Tab Baldwin is impressed with 18-year-old teen sensation Kai Sotto and his development in the game of basketball.

text: Si Kai ang may malip-ot nga appearance sa Gilas camp sang nagligad nga Pebrero.
english: Kai made a brief appearance at Gilas camp last February.

text: Suno kay Baldwin, nakit-an man niya kun daw ano ang pagpursige kag ang commitment ni Kai agud makasulod sa NBA.
english: Baldwin said he also saw how much perseverance and commitment Kai had to make it to the NBA.

text: Sang Pebrero, nagbalik sa Manila si Kai agud updan ang Gilas sa ila preparasyon para kuntani sa final window sang FIBA Asia Cup Qualifiers sa Doha, Qatar.
english: In February, Kai returned to Manila to accompany the Gilas in their preparations for the final window of the FIBA ​​Asia Cup Qualifiers in Doha, Qatar.

text: Bangud sa quarantine restrictions kag wala nahauman nga pagkansela sa window, ginpahayag ni Baldwin nga gamay lang ang ila nasaksihan sa nangin performance ni Kai sa basketball floor.
english: Due to quarantine restrictions and unexpected window cancellations, Baldwin said they witnessed little of Kai's performance on the basketball floor.

text: Nagalaum si Baldwin nga pahanugutan si Kai nga makapasakop sa national team sa palaabuton nga mga tournaments.
english: Baldwin hopes to allow Kai to join the national team in future tournaments.

text: Ginklaro sang otoridad nga mga hampanganan lamang ang una gin-alegar nga armas kag granada nga nakit-an sa sulod sang isa ka shoulder bag sa entrada sang Guimaras Provincial Capitol sa Barangay San Miguel, Jordan, Guimaras.
english: Authorities clarified that the first alleged weapon and grenade found inside a shoulder bag at the entrance of the Guimaras Provincial Capitol in Barangay San Miguel, Jordan, Guimaras were only toys.

text: Ginpahayag ini sang pulis matapos nga napuhag gid ang mga tawo sa amo nga lugar kaina sang udto.
english: Police said this after people in the area were shocked yesterday afternoon.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Jhona Casono, hepe sang Jordan Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga gina-review subong ang closed circuit television (CCTV) footage agud mahibaluan kun sin-o ang tag-iya sang bag kag mausisa man kun hungod ini nga ginbilin.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Jhona Casono, chief of the Jordan Municipal Police Station, said the closed circuit television (CCTV) footage is being reviewed to identify the owner of the bag and to investigate whether it was left deliberately.

text: Suno kay Casono, base sa ila nga nakit-an sa lugar, pink ang shoulder bag, may unod nga replica nga hand grenade kag pellet gun, relo, shorts, perfume, kag mga papel.
english: According to Casono, based on what they found at the scene, the shoulder bag was pink, containing a replica hand grenade and pellet gun, watch, shorts, perfume, and papers.

text: Pahayag pa sang hepe, may mga nakasulat man sa dokumento gani nga i-check man ini sang pulis para matigayon nga mahibaluan kun sin-o ang tag-iya.
english: The chief said there are also writings on the document so the police will check it to find out who the owner is.

text: Gin-athag sang hepe nga posible man nga nagpa-picture lang ang tag-iya sa ginatukod nga provincial capitol, apang nalipatan nga kuhaon ukon balikan ang iya bag.#
english: The chief explained that it is also possible that the owner just took a picture at the provincial capitol under construction, but forgot to pick up or return his bag.

text: 𝗠𝗔𝗡𝗜𝗟𝗔 — Nagpasalig ang Microsoft nga gina-imbestigaran na nila ang isa ka isyu matapos ang pila ka mga kompaniya, lakip na ang mga kumpanya nga nakabase sa Pilipinas, ang nagreport nga ang ila mga operasyon apektado sang problema sa serbisyo sang Microsoft subong nga Biyernes.
english: 𝗠𝗔𝗡𝗜𝗟𝗔 — Microsoft has assured that it is already investigating an issue after several companies, including Philippine-based firms, reported that their operations were affected by a Microsoft service problem this Friday.

text: Nagpaguwa man sang pahayag ang Cebu Pacific nga nagapahanumdom sa mga pasahero sini nga naga-eksperyensya ang kompanya sa karon sang mga isyu sa teknikal, nga ginareport nga may kaangtanan sa technology provider nga CrowdStrike, nga nagtuga sang pag-untat sang sistema sang Microsoft sa bug-os nga kalibutan.
english: Cebu Pacific also issued a statement reminding its passengers that the company is currently experiencing technical issues, reportedly related to technology provider CrowdStrike, which caused a global Microsoft system outage.

text: Suno sa kompanya, ginatinguhaan nila nga mapahaganhagan ang mga pagkatublag sa ila mga operasyon kag magahatag sang regular nga mga update samtang nagapadayon ang sitwasyon.
english: The company said it is working to minimize disruptions to its operations and will provide regular updates as the situation evolves.

text: Ang AirAsia nagsiling nga ang ila mga serbisyo naapektuhan man sang isyu sang Microsoft.
english: AirAsia said its services were also affected by the Microsoft issue.

text: Ginpanugyan man sang airline ang mga pasahero nga magbisita sa ila social media platforms kag sa airasia newsroom sa ila website para sa mga updates.
english: The airline also advised passengers to visit its social media platforms and the airasia newsroom on its website for updates.

text: Ginpahayag nga apektado man ang iban pa nga mga negosyo sa Pilipinas.
english: Other businesses in the Philippines were also reportedly affected.

text: Nahibaluan nga outage reporting website downdetector.com nagpakita man sang pagdamo sang mga user nga nagareport sang mga outage sa cloud computing platform sang Microsoft nga Azure, kag ang iya office productivity suite 365.
english: Noted outage reporting website downdetector.com also showed an increase in users reporting outages to Microsoft’s cloud computing platform Azure, and its office productivity suite 365.

text: Mariing itinanggi ni Department of Justice (DOJ) Secretary Jesus Crispin “Boying” Remulla ang mga kumakalat na alegasyong siya ay disqualified sa kanyang aplikasyon bilang susunod na Ombudsman ng bansa.
english: Department of Justice (DOJ) Secretary Jesus Crispin “Boying” Remulla has strongly denied allegations that he is disqualified from his application as the country's next Ombudsman.

text: Ito’y kasunod ng mga ulat sa social media na nagsasabing diniskwalipika umano ng Judicial and Bar Council (JBC) si Remulla bunsod ng umano’y pending na kaso sa Office of the Ombudsman.
english: This follows reports on social media that the Judicial and Bar Council (JBC) allegedly disqualified Remulla from a pending case with the Office of the Ombudsman.

text: Ayon kay Remulla, hindi totoo ang naturang balita at iginiit niyang hindi “accurate” ang kumakalat na impormasyon online.
english: According to Remulla, the news is not true and he insisted that the information spread online is not “accurate”.

text: “Walang basehan ang sinasabing diskwalipikasyon.
english: “The alleged disqualification is baseless.

text: Hanggang ngayon ay tuloy pa rin ang aking aplikasyon,” pahayag ni Remulla.
english: My application is still ongoing,” Remulla said.

text: Matatandaang sinampahan ng reklamo si Remulla at ilang iba pa ni Senadora Imee Marcos dahil sa diumano’y paglabag sa Anti-Graft and Corrupt Practices Act, Arbitrary Detention, Usurpation of Judicial Functions, at Grave Misconduct kaugnay ng naging pag-aresto kay dating Pangulong Rodrigo Duterte.
english: It can be recalled that Remulla and several others were filed a complaint by Senator Imee Marcos for alleged violation of the Anti-Graft and Corrupt Practices Act, Arbitrary Detention, Usurpation of Judicial Functions, and Grave Misconduct in connection with the arrest of former Panglong Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Sa kabila nito, iginiit ng kalihim na hindi siya uurong sa kanyang hangaring maging Ombudsman.
english: However, the secretary insisted that he will not give up on his desire to become an Ombudsman.

text: “Ito ay isang mahalagang posisyon sa paglilingkod-bayan, at nararapat lamang na dumaan ito sa tamang proseso,” aniya.
english: “This is an important position in public service, and it deserves to go through the proper process,” he said.

text: Samantala, nilinaw na rin ng Korte Suprema na hindi pa pinal ang opisyal na listahan ng mga aplikante para sa posisyon, taliwas sa mga kumakalat na balita.
english: Meanwhile, the Supreme Court has also clarified that the official list of applicants for the position is not yet final, despite rumors.

text: Kasalukuyang binubusisi pa ng JBC ang mga aplikasyong isinumite.
english: JBC is currently reviewing the applications submitted.

text: Ang posisyon ng Ombudsman ay nabakante matapos ang pagreretiro ni dating Ombudsman Samuel Martires.
english: The position of Ombudsman became vacant after the retirement of former Ombudsman Samuel Martires.

text: Kapag napili si Remulla, kinakailangan niyang iwanan ang kanyang kasalukuyang puwesto bilang kalihim ng DOJ.
english: If elected, Remulla will have to leave his current position as DOJ secretary.

text: Wala nagpakita si Vice President Sara Duterte sa ikaduha nga preliminary investigation nga ginpatigayon subong nga adlaw sang Department of Justice (DOJ) nga may kaangtanan sa mga reklamo nga ginpasaka batok sa iya.
english: Vice President Sara Duterte did not appear in the second preliminary investigation conducted today by the Department of Justice (DOJ) in connection with the complaints filed against her.

text: Ang reklamo nga inciting to sedition kag grave threats ginpasaka sang National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) batok sa bise presidente, matapos ang iya mga pahayag nga ginahalinan sang isyu.
english: The complaint of inciting to sedition and grave threats was filed by the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) against the vice president, after his statements that sparked the issue.

text: Gani, gin-imbitar siya sang DOJ agud personal nga magpresentar sang iya panig sa ikaduha nga preliminary hearing, apang wala siya nagtambong.
english: Therefore, the DOJ invited him to present his side in person at the second preliminary hearing, but he did not attend.

text: Suno sa iya mga abogado nga sanday Atty. Michal Poa kag Atty. Paul Lim, indi kinahanglan nga magpakita ang bise presidente sa subong nga hearing bangud ang NBI pa lang ang ginahulat nga magsumiter sang ila reply.
english: According to his lawyers, Atty. Michal Poa and Atty. Paul Lim, the vice president does not need to appear in the current hearing because the NBI is still waiting to submit their reply.

text: Gindugang pa nila nga nagsumiter na si VP Duterte sang iya counter affidavit sang nagligad nga semana agud ipaathag ang iya depensa sa mga alegasyon nga ginpasaka kontra sa iya.
english: They added that VP Duterte submitted his counter affidavit last week to explain his defense against the allegations filed against him.

text:
Nakabaton ang talatapan sang General Services Office (GSO) sang impormasyon nga wala gasiga ang pila ka suga sa Esplanade 1 kag 4 bangud sa kawat ang wire

Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Engr.
english:
The General Services Office (GSO) received information that some lights in Esplanade 1 and 4 were not working due to wire theft

In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Engr.

text: Neil Ravena, Head sang GSO, iya ginpahayag nga may ginkawat nga wire sa power source sa likod sang comfort room, isa ka circuit kag panel board.
english: Neil Ravena, Head of GSO, said a wire from the power source behind the comfort room, a circuit and panel board were stolen.

text: Suno kay Ravena, gin-refer naman ini sa City Electrical Engineering District agud ma-restore ang power source kag mapasiga ang mga naapektuhan nga suga sa nasambit nga lugar.
english: According to Ravena, it was referred to the City Electrical Engineering District to restore the power source and turn on the affected lights in the said area.

text: Dugang pa niya, indi lang ini ang una nga beses natabo ang pagpangawat sa amo nga lugar.
english: He added that this is not the first time that theft has happened in the area.

text: Sa subong, wala pa sang persons of interest kun sin-o ang may kahimuan sang pagpangawat, apang gin-refer naman ini kay Ret.
english: At present, there are no persons of interest who is responsible for the robbery, but it was referred to Ret.

text: Police Colonel Uldarico Garbanzos.
english: Police Colonel Uldarico Garbanzos.

text: Nag-file si Mamamayang Liberal (ML) Party-list Representative Leila de Lima sang isa ka hagna nga nagatuyo nga repasuhon ang nangin kasugtanan sa serbisyo sang tubig sa tunga sang mga local nga water district kag mga pribado nga kompaniya.
english: Mamamayang Liberal (ML) Party-list Representative Leila de Lima filed a bill that aims to review the water service agreement between local water districts and private companies.

text: Ang House Bill No.
english: House Bill No.

text: 2906, nga ginatawag nga “2025 Water Crisis Act,” nagasunod sa kapareho nga hagna nga gin-file ni Senador Risa Hontiveros sa Senado sa ika-20 nga Kongreso.
english: 2906, dubbed the “2025 Water Crisis Act,” follows a similar bill Senator Risa Hontiveros filed in the Senate in the 20th Congress.

text: Suno kay De Lima, ini nga hagna ang nagahandom nga matapna ang mga sistematiko nga problema nga nagabilin sa gobyerno kag pumuluyo nga wala sang pretection batok sa mga indi patas nga kontrata sa sektor sang tubig.
english: According to De Lima, this bill aims to address the systemic problems that leave the government and the people without pretection against unfair contracts in the water sector.

text: Sa idalom sang hagna, isa ka unified JVA oversight kag legal team ang pagatukuron agud usisaon sa sulod sang isa ka tuig nga Joint Venture Agreements (JVAs) sa tunga sang local water districts kag mga pribado nga kompaniya.
english: Under the bill, a unified JVA oversight and legal team would be established to review within a year Joint Venture Agreements (JVAs) between local water districts and private companies.

text: Luyag sang Seoul, South Korea nga mangin co-host ang North Korea sa 2032 Olympics.
english: Seoul, South Korea wants North Korea to co-host the 2032 Olympics.

text: Suno sa International Olympic Committee (IOC), ila ginatun-an ang ini nga posibilidad bangud una nila nga napilian ang Australia bilang hosting partner.
english: According to the International Olympic Committee (IOC), they are studying this possibility as they initially chose Australia as a hosting partner.

text: Una nga nahisugtan nanday South Korean President Moon Jae-In kag North Korean leader Kim Jong Un nga maghost sang Olympics humalin pa sang 2018.
english: South Korean President Moon Jae-In and North Korean leader Kim Jong Un first agreed to host the Olympics from 2018.

text: Nahibaluan nga nakaupdanay na ang South kag North Korea sa paghost sang 2018 Pyeongchang Winter Olympics sa diin nag-martsa ang duha sa isa ka hayahay.
english: South and North Korea have already jointly hosted the 2018 Pyeongchang Winter Olympics where the two marched in unison.

text: Sa pinakauna nga kahigayunan matapos ang natabo nga assassination attempt kay former United States President Donald Trump samtang nagapatigayon ang rally sa Butler, Pennsylvania, nagwa na ini sa publiko.
english: For the first time since the assassination attempt on former United States President Donald Trump while holding a rally in Butler, Pennsylvania, it has come out in public.

text: Nag-atubang si Trump sa iya Republican supporters sa Milwaukee.
english: Trump faced off with his Republican supporters in Milwaukee.

text: Suno kay Trump, isa ka bes lang ini nga maistorya sa pagluthang sa iya bangud masakit ini nga istorya.
english: Trump said he will only talk to him once about the shooting because it is a painful story.

text: Kadungan sini, gin-anunsyo man ni Trump ang pagbaton sini sang nomination sang Republican para sa pagpadalagan sa United States presidential elections.
english: Meanwhile, Trump also announced his acceptance of the Republican nomination to run in the United States presidential elections.

text: Nagbilin sang kapin P10.5 million nga balor sang halit sa sektor sang agrikultura ang Bagyo Vicky.
english: Typhoon Vicky left more than P10.5 million worth of damage in the agriculture sector.

text: Suno kay Department of Agriculture Secretary William Dar, handa sila nga magbulig pinaagi sa paghatag sang mga binhi kag loan assistance agud mabuligan ang apektado nga mga mangunguma.
english: Department of Agriculture Secretary William Dar said they are ready to help by providing seeds and loan assistance to help the affected farmers.

text: Ginpasalig man ni Dar nga may yara man sang nagakaigo nga supply sang bugas ang pungsod sa pihak sang paglaslas sang bagyo sa mga humayan.
english: Dar also assured that the country has an adequate supply of rice despite the typhoon's destruction of rice fields.

text: Dugang pa sang natungdan, apisar naapektuhan man ang suplay sang prutas kag utan bangud sa mga bagyo nga naglaslas sa pungsod, naga-amat-amat naman ini damo sa subong.
english: He added that although the supply of fruits and vegetables was also affected due to the typhoons that hit the country, they are slowly increasing.

text: Nangin kauna-unahan nga Filipino volleyball player si Jaja Santiago nga nakakuha sang volleyball title sa guwa sang Pilipinas sa isa ka foreign league matapos ginbuligan ang Saitama Ageo Medics nga mangibabaw batuk sa NEC Red Rockets sa Japan V. League V Cup sa Ota City General Gymnasium sa Tokyo.
english: Jaja Santiago became the first Filipino volleyball player to win a volleyball title outside the Philippines in a foreign league after helping Saitama Ageo Medics win against NEC Red Rockets in the Japan V. League V Cup at the Ota City General Gymnasium in Tokyo.

text: Naghatag sang 11 points si Santiago sa nine kills kag two blocks samtang si Mami Uchiseto kag Yuka Sato ang may yara sang 15 points.
english: Santiago contributed 11 points on nine kills and two blocks while Mami Uchiseto and Yuka Sato each had 15 points.

text: Nagdugang man sang 14 points si Shaina Joseph.
english: Shaina Joseph also added 14 points.

text: Pito ka mga hampang sa V Cup ang nadag-an sang Ageo Medics kag may yara na sila subong nga 14 consecutive matches humalin sang main V.League tournament sang Pebrero sa diin nagtapos sila sa ika-lima nga pwesto.
english: Ageo Medics have won seven V Cup matches and now have 14 consecutive matches since the main V.League tournament in February where they finished fifth.

text: Nagdugang na naman ang V Cup trophy ni Santiago matapos nakuha ang bronze medal nga nadag-an niya sa Ageo Medics sang last season sang V.League tournament.
english: Santiago's V Cup trophy was added after he won the bronze medal against Ageo Medics last season of the V.League tournament.

text: Nahibaluan nga sang 2017, nagdaog si Santiago sa Premier Volleyball League 1st Season Collegiate Conference championship sa National University Lady Bulldogs kag ginkilala sang conference bilang MVP.
english: It is known that in 2017, Santiago won the Premier Volleyball League 1st Season Collegiate Conference championship with the National University Lady Bulldogs and was recognized by the conference as the MVP.

text: CHILE – Gintay-og sang magnitude 7.4 nga linog ang Northern Chile.
english: CHILE – A magnitude 7.4 earthquake shook Northern Chile.

text: Suno sa Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (PHIVOLCS), nagluntad ang linog, 09:51 subong nga aga.
english: According to the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (PHIVOLCS), the quake occurred at 09:51 this morning.

text: Ini ang may kadalumon nga 170 kilometers.
english: It is 170 kilometers deep.

text: Ang sentro sini ang yara sa 22.8°S, 68.0°W sang Northern Chile.
english: Its center is located at 22.8°S, 68.0°W of Northern Chile.

text: Gin-athag naman sang PHIVOLCS nga wala sang tsunami threat sa Pilipinas kasunod sang linog.
english: PHIVOLCS clarified that there is no tsunami threat in the Philippines following the earthquake.

text: Nahibaluan nga 17,140 kms.
english: It is known to be 17,140 kms.

text: ang distansya sang Chile sa Pilipinas.
english: the distance of Chile to the Philippines.

text: SA NAPAMATUD-an na sang mga health authorities, ang face mask isa ka proteksyon batok sa pagpanglaton sang balatian nga COVID-19 nga makuha sa infected person ukon infected nga palibut.
english: As health authorities have proven, the face mask is a protection against the spread of the disease COVID-19 from an infected person or infected environment.

text: Makuha ang virus sang COVID-19 sa isa ka infected person sa iya pag-ubo, pangatsi, ukon paghambal nga mahaklo sang malapit nga katupad paagi sa iya ilong, baba kag mata.
english: An infected person can get the COVID-19 virus from coughing, sneezing, or talking that a close contact can inhale through his or her nose, mouth and eyes.

text: Subong man sa infected nga palibut sa diin nagapabilin sa hangin ang magagmay (aerosol) nga mga COVID-19 virus, labi na gid sa mga lugar nga cerrado, ukon bisan sa gwa man kon diin nagaginutok ang mga tawo.
english: Also in infected environments where small (aerosol) COVID-19 viruses remain in the air, especially in closed areas, or even outside where people are crowded.

text: Makuha man ini sa mga bagay nga infected, katulad sang doorknob ukon hambuyan nga railings, nga madala sang mahigko nga kamot sa ilong, baba kag mata.
english: It can also be transmitted from infected objects, such as doorknobs or railings, which are carried by dirty hands to the nose, mouth and eyes.

text: On the other hand, sa panugyan man sang mga health authorities, malikawan ta ang COVID-19 infection paagi sa mga health measures katulad sang pagpanghugas sang kamot nga may habon ukon paggamit sang sanitizer katulad sang 70% nga alcohol, social distancing lapaw sa isa ka metro, paglikaw sa mga gutok nga mga lugar, kag sa paggamit sang face mask.
english: On the other hand, on the advice of the health authorities, we can prevent COVID-19 infection through health measures such as washing hands with soap or using sanitizer such as 70% alcohol, social distancing above one meter, avoiding crowded places, and using face masks.

text:
***

Pero paano naton ma-justify ang pagpatuman sang “optional” nga paggamit sang face mask kon ga-expose pa gani ini sa infection sang wala nagagamit sang face mask?
english:
***

But how can we justify the implementation of the “optional” use of face masks if it exposes those who do not wear face masks to infection?
